data.projectName: Development of A VR -Based Vestibule Training and Educational Aid for Pakistani Oil and Gas Industries: HAZFO Expert 2.0
data.projectDigest: Oil and gas industries play a major role for the growth of world economy and drilling operation is considered as most challenging and hazardous procedure for oil and gas drilling crew due to the lack of effectual and user-friendly safety and health teaching and learning aids with updated knowledge and training capability. As per the previous researchers, there is an urgent industrial need for user interactive technological aid for enhancing the teaching and learning process of oil and gas drilling crew and safety officials at onshore and offshore drilling domain to full fill the requirements of fourth industrial and educational revolution. Therefore, this research article proposed a new virtual reality (VR) based Hazard Free Operation (HAZFO Expert 2.0) teaching and learning aid to reduce the workplace risk and hazards to enhance the vestibule and experiential learning performance of oil and gas drilling process at Pakistani drilling industries. In the development of this proposed interactive teaching and learning application mix methods (Qualitative and Quantitative) approach will be used for the identification of potential hazards and their suitable controls to prevent the accidents according to the modern technologies in this era of IR 4.0. Whereas, for the development of VR based educational aid for Pakistani oil and gas industries Autodesk 3ds Max, visual studio and MySQL software’s will be utilized. Furthermore, this proposed virtual reality based educational aid for safe drilling process will be the first teaching and e- learning technology which covers all onshore and offshore drilling operation in Pakistani oil and gas industries.

data.projectName: Coxeter generators for the subgroups of bimonster group
data.projectDigest:
The Bimonster group contains the most famous, difficult and bizarre sporadic simple group known as the Monster or Fischer Griess Monster. Since the minimal space in which Bimonster can exist, is of 4 million dimensions, it makes it difficult  to do computations inside the Bimonster.
We aim to devise means for computations inside the Bimonster. Though our methods will heavily depend on  the techniques developed by Wilson and Holmes  but it will bridge the gap which has prevented to fully understand the moonshine phenomenon. Moreover, we aim to compute the Coxeter generators for the subgroups of the Bimonster, including the Monster itself.

data.projectName: Analysis and Differentiation of Bovine and Porcine Gelatin Sources in Commercial Products
data.projectDigest: Gelatin is a mixture of polypeptides obtained from the hydrolysis of collagens of animals connective tissues and has been widely used in food products, cosmetics and in pharmaceutical industries. It is also used in nonfood products, including medical products, and in veterinary applications. Common sources of gelatin are pigskin, cattle hides, cattle bones, and, less frequently, fish skins and poultry skins. In general, a product label does not indicate the source of the gelatin, so halal consumers normally avoid products containing gelatin unless they are certified halal. As Muslim countries, have increased imports of food products containing gelatin without mentioning source. Several gelatin manufacturers in Europe, India, and now in Pakistan also produce halal gelatin. The gelatin synthesis processes contain common steps including pretreatment of the uncooked material, extraction, purification and drying to yield preferred gelatin. Gelatin has unique properties such as foam stabilizer, gelling agent and binding agent. The concern of this research proposal is to differentiate and characterize between bovine and porcine gelatins. The methodology used for the differentiation of Bovine and Porcine gelatin sources in commercial products through RP-HPLC combined with computational parameters that give best solution for Halal authentication process in consumable products containing gelatin.

data.projectName: Metric Dimension of the Various Chemical Structures
data.projectDigest: In mathematical chemistry and graph theory, the goal presented in this project is very inspiring and fascinating. Metric dimension is among the most significant areas in graph theory. It has lot of use in daily life for  example in chemistry [11, 14]. There could be more than one proposed formulation of a chemical compound, nonetheless, only one of them is appropriate, expressing the physical and chemical properties of the compound. The chemists require distinct representations of chemical network to distinct compounds. Let G be a graph that is connected, a shortest path in G is the length between two vertices which is represented by the distance d(u,v). In a scenario where illustration of each vertex is unique with respect to W={w_(1 ,   ) w_(2 ,   )…w_(k  ) }, then W is known as resolving set [4,15] of G and the determination of the minimum number of elements in resolving set is known as metric basis and also the number of metric basis is referred to as metric dimensions, represented by dim(G)[9]. The aim of this project is to study chemical structures and then convert them into planar network graphs. As a result, you can determine the metric dimension of these network graphs.

data.projectName: Optimization of Efficient Plant Model as a Pharmaceutical Factory by Targeting Endogenous Biosynthetic Pathway
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest: Plants are the best producer on the planet Earth with a large chemo-diversity of active biological compounds. For centuries, human are using plants to treat various disease conditions. Nature and accumulation of these compounds varies in every plant species depending upon their development and physiological conditions. Some of the bioactive compounds play crucial role as immunomodulators and immunoboosters, thereby used to cure diseases. Scalability of these compounds is a challenge as they account for less than 1% of dry weight of plant. Fluctuation in the production and accumulation of these compounds have been observed under the influence of various external and internal stimuli which signifies some factors that are responsible for the regulation of these compounds. Next Generation Sequence (NGS) is a high-throughput method that has potential to unravel the mystery factors governing the biosynthesis and accumulation of secondary metabolites. Computational analysis and CRISPR/dCas technology would be used to design and develop an optimal plant model that can produce and accumulate secondary metabolite proficient manner. The proposed study would not only be beneficial to develop plant model that will produce high value medicinal compounds for pharmaceutical industry but would also identify the factor to develop stress resistant crop varieties.

data.projectName: Degradation of phenolic waste from industrial open dump sites; a novel approach
data.projectDigest: Phenol, a waste product of industrial processes that is introduced into soil and aquatic ecosystems through open dumpsites and waste water, respectively. In addition to clear toxicities, phenol causes many indirect effects to the biota, such as reduced fertility, decreased survival of the young, and inhibition of growth. It is rapidly absorbed through the skin and by inhalation through the lungs. High exposures to phenol may be fatal to human beings; infants appear to be hyper susceptible to phenol. Phenol toxicity in open dump sites and waste water off industrial states in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa has never been explored. In the industrial states, there are no proper facilities for safe disposal of industrial waste. That’s why it is speculated that waste, off the industries, will be having toxic levels of phenols and phenolic compounds. Our project will comprise; survey, identification and quantitation of phenols, isolation and molecular characterization of microbes for biodegradation of phenols and phenolic compounds. Microbes will be isolated on microbial growth media and isolated strains will be further characterized through PCR amplification of 16S rRNA and ITS rRNA gene sequence analysis. Incubation and pot experiments will be conducted for phenol biodegrading ability of the isolated microbes. Globally, filled dump sites with waste have extensively been planned for residential societies. Taking into consideration, presence of phenols in underground water fear exists that similar hazards can happen on large scale in the country. Given this situation, it is imperative to assess and plan to address the alarming hazards.

data.projectName: Green synthesis of nanoformulation of phytonutrients and their impact on fertility status in model animals
data.projectDigest: Infertility has been well recognized as one of global health issues. It is the biological inability to conceive after regular unprotected intercourse after a period of at least 12 months. Multiple factors contribute to infertility affecting about 25 % of couples in low income countries. Global infertility incidence is about 10-15%, while in Pakistan the occurrence of infertility is estimated to be 21.9 %. Both male and female factors contribute to a couple’s infertility. Numerous folk medicinal treatments have been explored over the years to overcome the problem of infertility. Recently, there had been a substantial focus on natural plant based alternative therapies to treat this disorder. The pharmaceutical industries have prepared new therapies in last few decades but there is still need for the development of alternative treatment options. With the advancement in technology use in pharmaceuticals, the application of nanotechnology to herbal formulation becomes of great importance because nanostructured system is able to reduce the dose and side effects with improved activity. The present project has been planned to prepare nanoformulations of phytonutrients from selected plants sources by coating with biopolymer based nanoparticles, with the aims in improving the fertility status in married couples with functional reproductive abnormalities.

data.projectName: Improving Wheat Performance in Conditions of Climate Change by Employing Osmoprotectants
data.projectDigest: Ambient temperatures are continuously increasing from the commencement of this century. It is forecasted to endure increased under changing climatic conditions. These enhanced temperatures often cause high temperature stress that is an alarming intimidation to wheat productivity, specifically when it occurs during lateral stages i.e. reproductive and grain-filling phases. Wheat cultivars articulating heat shock proteins are considered good to cope with high temperature stress because these proteins provide escape from high mercury-induced damage. Heat resistance can be enhanced either by using heat tolerant wheat varieties or via exogenously applied certain Osmoprotectants. Polyamines (Putrescine, Spermidine and Spermine) are low molecular non-protein polycation, are of exceptional significance having potential to improve resistance against abiotic stresses. In this project, wheat genotypes with diverse characteristics will be screened for heat tolerance during the reproductive phase. Various concentrations of Polyamines (0.1-1.0 mM) will be optimized for levels and methods of application in earthen pots in Green House of Department of Agronomy, Bahauddin Zakariya University, Multan at Green house and field level and mechanism of heat resistance will be studied. Then optimized treatments will be used for field appraisal at Multan and Bahawalpur. Economic analysis will be done to determine the feasibility of the technology for on-farm adaptation. The most optimal level of Putrescine (Put), Spermidine (Spd) and Spermine (Spm) and most responsive varieties will be recommended for fetching acceptable yields from relatively warmer areas of Pakistan.  All the green house trials will be carried out in Complete Randomize Design and that of field experiments in RCBD design.

data.projectName: Shari’ah Governance and Risk Management in Islamic Banking: A Theoretical and Empirical Analysis
data.projectDigest: Efficient Risk management practices have gain significant attention especially after global financial crisis. This study will encompass liquidity risk management and credit risk management efficiency of Islamic Banks keeping in view the significant role of Shari’ah Governance in four progressive Islamic banking business countries like Malaysia, Bahrain, UAE, and Pakistan. The study will employ methodology through structured questionnaires from Shari’ah scholars and top management of Islamic banks. The multiple hierarchical regressions, Co-relation and descriptive analysis will be used to test the hypotheses. This study intends to identify and draw lessons from best Risk management and Shari’ah governance practices for Islamic banks of Pakistan. It has important research implications for researchers, policy makers and practitioners of Islamic banks in the country.

data.projectName: Mathematical modeling and simulation of various shaped fins inside the cavity intended for phase change materials and nanofluids
data.projectDigest: This project is set out to deal the mathematical modeling and simulation of problems occurring at the industrial level due to lack of structure designs and inappropriate use of working fluid having poor thermal conductivity. A finite element method will apply to deal the highly nonlinear mathematical models that gives the high resolution of results and easy to compare with the experimental results. In the last few decay transport processes become the vital demand at the industrial level and many engineering applications include the desalination process, solar energy collector, design of heat exchanger etc. So, the models related to the circulation of flow in a closed geometry also have many industrial applications. So, our current project will cover the cavity shapes models that can also be used for longitudinal groves having shape like triangular cavity, square cavity, corrugated cavity and many other closed shapes geometries as per requirement of industries. In the recent development of heat transfer phenomenon, one of the best ways to enhance the thermal conductivity or to boost the system is by addition of nanoscale particles within the working liquids. we will try to figure out the most relevant problem that can be developed mathematically and then the limitation will define at the surface. Mathematical model consists of system of partial differential equations based upon law of conservation of mass, law of energy, momentum equation concentration and conditions at various walls.

data.projectName: Genetic Analysis of Gall-Stone Disease
data.projectDigest: Gall bladder stores bile that is produced in the liver and then transported to gall bladder for storage, bile is released in the small intestine as and when needed for digesting lipids in the nutrition. Gall bladder attack results in severe abdominal pain, sometimes accompanied by nausea and vomiting. Removal of gall bladder somehow cures this pain, but most of the people make complaints even after surgery. Approximately 10-20% of people have been reported to have gall stone disease (GSD). The incidence of GSD in rising and becoming a socioeconomic burden on the families especially in developing countries. Although genetic mechanisms underlying the accumulation of cholesterol and/or bilirubin in the form of gall stones are not completely understood, unraveling the molecular pathways may warrant to open new horizons in combating the disease.  Blood samples from the GSD patients will be collected and used for deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) extraction. The DNA of patients will be subjected to genetic analysis including case-control association studies as well as exome sequencing. These genetic analyses will result in generation of novel genetic data, which might be helpful in the early diagnosis and timely management and prevention of the disease thus improving the quality of life.

data.projectName: EFFICIENT WAVELETS BASED ALGORITHMS FOR THE NUMERICAL STUDY OF INTEGER AND FRACTIONAL ORDER PARTIAL DIFFERENTIAL EQUATIONS
data.piUniversity: Kohat University of Science and Technology, Kohat
data.projectDigest:
Wavelet based numerical methods have given more emphasis in last two decades.  Wavelets are piece wise  functions which have advantages over existing  Fourier methods . It  can be used  to  detect singularities  and express a function at different resolution levels for  the purpose of accuracy. Our aim is to develop fast and an efficient algorithms for the numerical study of  different partial differential equations (PDEs)  of integer and fractional order.  The  models which will be under observations  are given as follows: 
(i)  Brain Tumors  growth model (ii)  Solitary wave solutions of nonlinear PDEs    (iii)  Fractional PDEs models of constant and variable-order .

data.projectName: Financial Regulations and Fund Manager’s Perceptions, Are these Regulations Constraints Fund Managerial Ability?
data.projectDigest:
Mutual Fund Industry around the globe attracts the money savers for a profitable and well diversified portfolio that maximize the wealth of investors. Investing in Stock Market need highly technical skills and market knowledge, which a common savers lacking. Mutual Fund offers Collective Investment Scheme (CIS), that pool up the money from these small investors into a big fund, coupled with Fund Manager Ability and skills. Since Mutual Fund involved money, so the Industry undergoes tight monitoring and tough regulations from state agencies, like Security and Exchange Commission (SEC), Central Banks of Country. Existing Research focuses on the performance and determents of performance and cash flows of these funds. However, literature is lacking that how these regulations influence the ability of fund managers to invest. The Current Research will fulfill this gap and evaluate the Fund Managers Perceptions about the Rules and Regulations under which the Fund Managers performs. Whether these Regulations are hurdles to their investing ability or playing a facilitative Role? 
To evaluate this problem is important due to two reasons, first to know the economics of these financial regulations. Whether these rules are beneficial to both Industrialist (Fund Managers) and as well as Customers of the industry (Investors). What the Managers think about these regulatory laws, are these laws influence both investor and fund managers equally or tilled towards investors at large. A qualitative Study will be conducted to unpin the Managers Perceptions about the rules and monitoring mechanism of Mutual Fund Industry. In-depth interviews with fund managers will uncover the puzzle. Furthermore, grounded theory procedure to measure the perceptions will be used to empirically testing the man

data.projectName: Biotechnological intervention in Stevia rebaudiana for large scale production of biomass and enhancement of natural calorie free steviol glycosides: Implementation of modern in vitro propagation methods and CRISPR-cas 9 based fine tuning of metabolic path
data.projectDigest:
Stevia rebaudiana is a complete and natural substitute of sugar.  In Pakistan, stevia cultivation has a tremendous potential as a candidate cash crop to meet sugar demand from a growing population. National stevia growing programs need implementation of research programs on improvement of stevia for commercial production to meet the emerging industrial demands. 
This project will establish the biotechnological R & D platform for the production of quality stevia plants with higher sweetening potential. Since micro propagation is the most resilient and successful method for the commercial production of disease free stevia plants those might have higher field performance. We will optimize different micropropagation methods for the enhanced production of biomass and steviol glycosides (SGs). We will employ different elicitation strategies for enhancement of steviol glycosides and other health promoting metabolites during micro propagation of Stevia rebaudiana. 
We will establish cost effective hydroponic technologies for the rapid, feasible and quality production of stevia plants for commercial applications. This project is also bringing state-of-the-art genome editing technology CRISPR-Cas9 and related latest molecular biology techniques for tailoring the metabolic pathway of stevia to enhance biosynthesis of steviol glycosides, this will be a step forward in development of genetic engineering technologies in Pakistan.

data.projectName: Exploration, Conservation, Biological Potential Assessment and Molecular Species Identification of Selected Pteridophytes of Hazara Division and Adjoining Areas, Pakistan by DNA Barcoding
data.projectDigest: World is facing severe problems of drastic human diseases due to diabetes including strokes, heart attacks kidney failure and direct deaths. Similarly, microbial infections and multi drug resistance in both Western and developing countries are causing human deaths. Higher plants of Pakistan have been extensively explored and well exploited for pharmaceutical purpose. However very little is known about pteridophytes exploration, conservation and their drugs potential assessment is almost neglected. Their secondary metabolites investigation against multi drug resistant microbes and diabetes and various human ailments are necessary. Pteridophytes are spore producing vascular plants and their therapeutic value has been explored earlier than 2000 years. In current investigation pteridophytes of Hazara Division, their species diversity, identification by various modern techniques, conservation and biological potential assessment will be explored. Although source of potential new drugs but most of the species are threatened worldwide and Various threats are common in Hazara Region and their timely measure is necessary. During comprehensive field visits for 3 years field information’s of every species i.e. habit, habitat, population size, geographic distribution and anthropogenic impacts i.e. habitat quality will be conducted. Selected taxa will be identified by SEM and DNA Barcoding, using species specific primers based on established molecular markers and their DNA sequence analyses. Traditional medicinal and abundant taxa will used for biological potential assessment. For anti-microbial activity, cleaned shade dried plant parts aqueus ethanolic, methanolic, extract seted on rotary evaporator will be prepared. The experimental work will be conducted in the Cryptogamic Lab HU.

data.projectName: Identification of New and Novel Inhibitors of Phosphodiesterase-I mainly Natural Products Isolated from the Medicinal Plants of District Dera Ghazi Khan
data.projectDigest: Compounds isolated from the medicinal plants always played their role for cure and prevention of complex human and animal diseases. A lot of drugs are available in the market which are herbal and plant based material. .There are about 11 PDEs which are superfamily and are widely distributed in animals. These types have specific substrate and selective inhibitors. The intracellular level of cAMP is controlled via its hydrolysis by cyclic nucleotide Consequently the main functions of PDEs are to activate a molecule of water to hydrolyze the phosphodiester bonds in order to produce 3?,5?-cyclic adenosine monophosphate (cAMP) and 3?,5?-cyclic guanosine monophosphate (cGMP) as the second messengers as well as to regulate cAMP- and cGMP-mediated main signaling pathways Appropriate pharmacological suggestions of inhibitors are known in a large spectrum such as, cardiovascular, inflammation (i.e. asthma), action influencing through blood pressure and platelet aggregation, central nervous system disorders erectile function, and several metabolic diseases  Among total PDEs, only PDE-1, PDE-2, PDE-3, PDE-10, and PDE-11, are called as “dual PDEs”, which can hydrolyze both cAMP and cGMP On the other hand, PDE-1 family encoded by three genes (A-C) also possesses a distinctive feature having two binding sites for the Ca2+ binding protein i.e. calmodulinin N-domain. In fact, overexpression of both PDE-1 and PDE-5 enzymes in hypertrophy and heart failure pathology have been reported and, thus, inhibition of these enzymes is a new therapeutic approach. Compounds isolated from the natural resources will be tested against PDE-1 for their inhibitory potential by ELISA microtiter enzyme assays. PDE-1 inhibitors are not available in the market and heart attack is at alarming rate.

data.projectName: Impact of Exposure To Community Violence on Pakistani Youth: Sufism as a Psychotherapy
data.projectDigest: History reveals that in subcontinent Sufism had received the credit for the prevalence of peace and harmony, through the lesson of monotheism, unity of human being, brotherhood, justice, forgiveness and self-control to a fragmented society where the social discrimination was common. Not surprisingly, Pakistani society is facing the same situation and furthermore, the scary rise of community violence is an undeniable fact in present. Exposure to community violence is all the more alarming because Pakistan has one of the highest youth populations in the world which are exposed to community violence excessively on a regular basis. Literature suggests that violence exposure has a significant relation to violent behavior for youth. Therefore, the purpose of this study is to investigate the risk of exposure to community violence and its relation to violence perpetration among a sample of n=1000 Pakistani youth living in different cities of Province Punjab. The study further argues for the adaptation of cognitive behavior therapy (CBT) associated with the Sufism- Islamic Mindfulness to protect the youth from the psychiatric disorders and negative effects of exposure to community violence, specifically regarding the likelihood of later violence by that youth.

data.projectName: Detection and identification of autoantibodies as serologic biomarkers for early diagnosis of primaryhepatic malignancies
data.projectDigest: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and cholangiocarcinoma (CC) are primary liver malignancies associated with higher mortality rate and increasing incidence. HCC is the second leading cause of cancer related deaths being the fifth most common cancer among all cancer types. In Pakistan, HCC is one of the top raising and most common cancers in adults. Whereas, CC is a bile duct cancer, its incidence is rare (< 2% of all diagnosed cancers) comparing HCC. Treatment of both cancers is challenging due to the lack of proper and in time diagnosis. Treatment options are limited because of advanced stage diagnosis of these malignancies. Silence nature of these cancers makes them clinically undetectable until the appearance of advanced stage symptoms. Unavailability of specific biomarkers might be one of the reasons of late diagnosis. Autoantibodies (AAbs) appear in circulation long before the clinical onset of disease, might be during the transit phase of the disease. These AAbs might be used as diagnostic biomarkers for early stage detection of these cancers. Few biomarkers are currently used for screening of HCC and CC with low specificity and sensitivity which include alpha fetoprotein (AFP), carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) and cancer antigens (CA19-9).  Aim of the present study is to detect and identify the serum Autoantibodies as diagnostic biomarkers in sera of patients with HCC and CC.

data.projectDigest:
Voting is a tool to gauge the will of people in formation of electoral bodies. The application of voting instrument can be paper intensive or electronic. The electronic voting has not been so successful in the past because of the associated threats and vulnerabilities of the equipment, algorithms, and execution of the experiments. The historical perspective of last two decades demonstrate certain partial or full failures of the electronic voting during the elections, due to algorithmic, execution, data handling, and management problems. However, implantation of a transparent and secure electronic voting system is the need of the hour for emerging democracies around the globe. We take the initiative of introducing a Blockchain based e-voting system for secure and transparent electoral voting. data.projectName: Management of Post harvest losses in Banana by using Silver Nanoparticles
data.projectDigest: Banana is the most important global fruit which faces several post-harvest damaging effect such as mechanical and physiological degradation as well as microbial attack.  Moreover, it has a different pattern of ethylene production which is the main source of banana degradation. This piece of research work will reveal the effect of green nano-silver on ethylene production and decline the post-harvest losses in banana by subjecting the green synthesis of silver nanoparticles from waste material. The previous studies have explained the chemical, physical, mechanical and microbial synthesis of different types of nanoparticles that is expensive approach and have environmental effects. So, it is essential to investigate and analyze the cheapest source of nanoparticle biosynthesis. In this regard, this ecofriendly and cost effective procedure to produce the silver nanoparticle from kitchen waste (vegetable and banana peels) will provide basis to increase shelf life of banana.  Silver nanoparticles achieved by banana peel extract is the best and cost effective technique for post-harvest management by controlling ethylene production, determining starch contents, measuring weight loss effect and acting as antimicrobial agent. This fast, easy and rapid extracellular production of silver NPs will also reveal its effect on post-harvest disease management through its antimicrobial studies. Further, the study of characteristic features and application of nano-coating silver on banana will ensure the edible, safe, reliable and biocompatible use of AgNPs. Finally, the treatment of NPs will provide the basis to analyze the pattern of genes expression coded for ethylene production that will be used to overcome the limitations of current treatment procedures.

data.projectName: Some Resolving Parameters of Simple Connected Graphs and their Applications
data.projectDigest:
Graphs are the most general structures for representing different relations and methods in different scientific fields like physical sciences, social systems, biology, chemistry, and economics and in different sections of computer sciences. In this project we plan to work on some newly defined invariants in graph theory i.e. edge resolvability, vertex-edge resolvability, and edge partition dimension in simple connected and undirected graphs. These are very important notions in metric graph theory which have many useful applications in different branches of physical science, social science, computer sciences/ computer networking, facility location problems, robot navigation, mastermind games, mathematical and pharmaceutical chemistry and drug design etc. 
Edge resolving set is the set of  minimum number of senors that are required to identify  any issue  in the connection of the network while  the  vertex-edge resolving set  is the set of  minimum number of senors that are required to identify  any issue  in the node /computer as well as in the connection of the network .

data.projectName: control charts for  monitoring Process mean under Non Normality
data.projectDigest:
Statistical Process Control (SPC) is a group of statistical methods that have found prevalent use in today’s manufacturing and services industries. Control charts are the most effective and simplest tool in SPC. A control chart is a graphical display of process stability or instability over time. The core intention of using a control chart is to rapidly detect the presence of assignable causes so that an examination of the process along with corrective actions can be initiated to bring the out-of-control process into statistical control prior to the production of many nonconforming units. Attentive and routine use of control charts ensure enhancement in quality and productivity of a production process. 
The exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA) and Hybrid EWMA charts are  memory control charts based on current and past historical data that have high sensitivity in detecting small and moderate shifts in the process. The EWMA chart assumes a normal underlying process distribution. Likewise, the formulation of the Hybrid-EWMA chart is also based on the property of the normal distribution. Nonetheless, this normality assumption is unrealistic and hard to justify in many practical situations. In numerous industrial applications, it may occur that a process being monitored does not follow a normal distribution. One common case is that the process distribution
is skewed or symmetrical but not normal. For example, the distributions of measurements that are observed from the processes of  filling machines ,chemical engineering semiconductor and cutting tool wear  are usually not normal but skewed. data.projectName: Solar Light driven Photocatalysis for Methanol (CH3OH) production from aqueous Carbon dioxide (CO2)
data.projectDigest: The basic goal of this project is to establish the concept of photocatalysis for the production of various valuable chemicals and/or fuels from water and CO2 using sunlight, thus fixing the pollution issues from excess CO2 level originated from traditional fossil energies leading to “global warming”. In this project, the main focus will be towards the development of photocatalysts based on semiconductor materials, which are active under the visible light range. The project will be conducted mainly by preparation of visible light active/sunlight active photocatalsysts, surface and physicochemical properties design, conductivity enhancement and finally application for photocatalytic conversion of aqueous CO2 to CH3OH. Some methods, individually or combination, will be employed for the development the advanced photocatalsyst and then subjected to characterization, analysis and respective photocatalysis application. The successful execution of this project will further enrich the concept of efficiently utilizing the renewable energy sources to synthesize valuable chemicals and fuels in a sustainable manner leading to produce the clean energies and improve our climate. The bottom line is that the current project is an attempt to propose the development of basic and applied research infrastructure for photocatalytic CO2 conversion to valuable chemicals/fuels.

data.projectName: Kidney in a dish: Development and application of human renal organoids using adipose derived mesenchymal stem cells
data.projectDigest: In human body, kidneys filter and remove wastes from the body in the form of urine. If your kidneys stop working, wastes accumulate in the body hindering the normal body functions. Moreover, prolonged dysfunction can lead to kidney failure resulting in death of the person. Rapidly increasing prevalence of kidneys diseases has become a major health problem influencing millions of people worldwide. In Pakistan, a rapidly growing risk of kidney diseases results in estimated 20,000 deaths annually. Dialysis and renal transplant are the only available treatments of kidney failure. Despite huge burden on economy, both have certain limitations.  Dialysis is very labor-intensive and tedious practice whereas, success rate in renal transplant is also very low. Control of disease progression is a need of hour to minimize the economic and social burden posed by renal failure. Current project aims at generation and characterization of kidney organoids using an easily accessible source of stem cells isolated from human fat removed as a waste during cosmetic surgeries such as liposuction. Development of organoid based models of different chronic kidney disease will help to identify checkpoints to control their progression and overcome the problems associated with dialysis and kidney transplant.

data.projectName: Early diagnostic genetic tool for Cardiovascular Disease in Pakistani population
data.projectDigest: The cardiovascular disease (CVD) is a major health issue and budding as big problem throughout the world.  This disease is considered as the principal reason of the global disability. World Heart Federation has demonstrated that around 17.1 million deaths per year globally are due to CVD. The major reason of increasing rate is unknown. It has been predicted that this disease run in the families and one reason for its higher rate in Pakistani population is the cousin marriages. The proposed project is development of a pre diagnostic kit for the screening of families which are at the risk of CVD. The pre diagnostic information will be helpful in the prevention of CVD to the next generation. The suggested kit will consist of a 96-well PCR plate containing a set of forward and reverse primers associated with CVD along with all reagents for PCR, excluding template DNA. Selected primers will have same annealing temperature so it could be run in single PCR amplification reaction. Primers for separate allele at each locus will be used separately for gaining the data of genotype about homozygous or heterozygous. The combined information will then be used to describe CVD score sheet or potential of this disease spreading in next generation of the patient. The proposed kit will be used as prototype at its initial stage. Blood samples will be collected from Punjab Institute of Cardiology under the supervision of Dr. Ahmad Shahbaz. All the work will be done in PI’s lab in GCU Lahore and co PI’s Lab in University of the Punjab Lahore.

data.projectName: A preliminary study to determine therapeutic potential of combined treatment of Cannabidiol and palmitoylethanolamide in Alzheimer’s disease
data.piUniversity: National University of Medical Sciences, Rawalpindi
data.projectDigest: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a neurodegenerative disorder of old age. Both genetic and environmental factors contribute to AD etiology. Among environmental factors aluminum is known for over a century to be a contributing factor towards the pathogenesis of AD. Pakistan is among the regions where population aged 65 years, and above, will double between now and 2050.  Therefore if AD treatment is not taken seriously now, there will be a large population at risk of developing this disease. The complex nature of AD has resulted in inability of the researchers to propose a treatment that can cure the disease. Specifically, due to involvement of different mechanisms in AD pathogenesis, the drugs that can act on multiple targets are highly desired. For this purpose, cannabinoids are promising candidates because these compounds have effect on multiple cytotoxic components. Among many different cannabinoids, cannabidiol a phytocannabinoid, and Palmitoylethanolamide, an endocannabinoid-related compound, are promising candidates because both these compounds are shown to have promising results in AD but their co-treatment is not investigated.  Based on our expertise on aluminum induced neurotoxicity (from past several years) this project is designed to study therapeutic potential of co-treatment of CBD and PEA on Aluminum induced AD.

data.projectName: Mechanism of synergistic interactions between Meloidogyne spp.  and Fusarium spp. on different vegetables and their integrated management
data.projectDigest: Climatic conditions are encouraging in Pakistan for the production of vegetables with good quality. There are several factors which affects the average yield of vegetables. Among all the synergistic interaction between pathogens especially nematode and fungi have more destructive effects on yield.  Disease complex between root-knot nematodes, Meloidogyne species  and Fusarium spp. has been reported on different vegetables causing reduction in quantity and quality of the produce. Therefore, mechanism of synergism and its management is the need of hour to sustain the production of vegetables with good quality. Synergistic interaction between Meloidogyne spp.  and Fusarium spp. will be studied on different vegetables, different activities will be performed to minimize their effects. Integrated management plan will be followed to reduce the losses caused by disease complex by utilizing all available resources. Different bioagents, chemicals, resistance inducers and plant extracts will be evaluated under both in vitro and in vivo conditions. Proposed research will be helpful to the farmers to sustain vegetable production with high quality as they would be able to protect their plants from the damaging effects of nematode and fungi and to get good price of their produce.

data.projectName: Synthesis of pyrazole substituted thioureas as multi targeted therapeutics for the management of neuro-inflammation in Alzhimer Disease
data.projectDigest: Alzheimer, a neurodegenerative disease, is associated with the loss of memory. The primary cause of the disease is the irreversible growth of the protein around the brain cells which lead towards the loss of neurotransmitters and causes inflammation. There are commercially available drugs approved by FDA for AD treatment but the problem associated with the approved drugs is that they lack the disease-modifying abilities and are mainly symptomatic. In conclusion, while the social values of Alzheimer's disease are considered, there is a motivation to believe that discovery of new drugs base on multitarget-directed ligands (MTDLs) are potent in addressing the complex nature of the disease. In our efforts to contribute to the development of novel compounds that may be useful in the treatment of neurodegenerative disorders such as Parkinson’s disease (PD) or Alzheimer’s disease (AD), in current proposal we are aiming on the synthesis of pyrazole substituted thioureas. Structures of all the synthesized compounds will be confirmed by spectrometric analysis. All the synthesized compounds will be subjected to cholinesterase inhibition assays to isolate the compounds having dual inhibition potentials. These synthesized compounds will be tested for their anti-inflammatory activities like COX-1, COX-2 and 5-LOX inhibitory activities. Structures activities relationship and molecular docking studies of the multi target directed ligands inhibitors potentials will also be carried out in order to check the mode of action and kinetic studies.

data.projectName: Development of Methods and Control Techniques for Compensating Variability of Solar Photovoltaic Energy Systems
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest:
Electrical power sector in Pakistan is faced with multifarious challenges including energy deficit, de-rated power transmission network, high electricity tariffs, obsolete technology, and environmental impact. These challenges are juxtaposed with untapped potential of renewable energy resources, which remain minimally utilized due to technical & economic challenges in its development. Historically, power systems have been developed in terms of controlling supply to match uncertain demand. At long time scales, this means the expansion in power generation and bulk transmission lines. The status quo in the development of the Pakistani power sector is continuing this trend. However, this idea of relying only on expanding the bulk power system is no longer sustainable. 

It is a known fact that increased penetration of non-coordinated renewable energy sources without achieving deep renewable integration and the development of associated markets for variable generation may lead to unreliable operation of the system. In this project, we will focus on developing advanced direct load control, monitoring and optimization strategies to compensate the variability of renewable power generation. This project will offer a cross-sectorial environment to both researchers and graduate research students to shape their long-term research view and get fundamental methodological tools on the research field.

data.projectName: NRPU:  Geological Mapping of Industrial and Metallic Minerals by Applying Artificial Intelligence Techniques on Remote Sensing Data
data.projectDigest: Surface geological mapping is the first stage of establishing a mineral resource, followed by mining, processing, metallurgical and economic evaluations to convert the resource to reserve. Conventional mineral prospecting/resource mapping, where geologists physically access the site to collect samples and mark geological alterations/ features, are costly and time consuming. Available Geological Survey of Pakistan maps are is scaled as 1: 100,000 i.e 1 inch to 2.5Km. One of the most economical and efficient ways of minerals mapping is using Remote Sensing data. Remote sensing is the science of obtaining information about an objects or areas from a distance, typically using a Satellites, Aircrafts, or Drones etc. which captures reflected radiations radiation in different Electromagnetic (EM) ranges from earth surface using different sensors. Rocks and minerals exhibit distinctive reflectance and absorption features, these implicit features can be extracted by application of various data mining techniques like PCA, ICA, Spectral Unmixing and non-deep learning machine learning approaches etc. on Satellite data. This project uses the strength of specialists in AI algorithms in collaboration with the field knowledge  of the geologists. A number of areas bearing industrial and metallic minerals will be identified for mapping through remote sensing and AI/data mining algorithms which will be validated through selective field sampling and geological investigations in accessible areas by specialists in Geology to present reliable and cheaper geological maps.

data.projectName: Development of nanofluid based novel solar water treatment system for sustainable supply of potable water
data.projectDigest:
Across the different continents of the world, the demand for fresh water is on the increase exacerbated by a growing world population, depletion of natural resources, climate change and industrialization. An alarming report by the United Nations Organization depicted that an estimated 1.8 Billion people across the globe will be under serious water scarcity by the year 2025. With a rapidly diminishing access to freshwater reserves attention is now being focused on desalination of saltwater to obtain adequate freshwater for human sustenance amongst other needs.
Solar energy, on the other hand, is the largest available resource amongst renewable energy resources and the most direct and straightforward method to utilize solar energy is the solar to thermal conversion. Some of many applications of solar thermal energy are heating and cooling of space, solar water heating, solar refrigeration, thermal power generation, solar desalination and photochemical conversion. The absorption of most of the heat transfer fluids is very low in visible to infrared range of the solar spectrum where most of the solar energy is contained. 
The solar absorption capability of heat transfer fluids in solar collectors can expressively be enhanced by suspending nanoparticles of various materials. This project is aimed at to develop nanofluid based solar driven water treatment system to produce drinking water from wastewater. It is anticipated that this project will make best utilization of the freely available solar energy to produce drinking water to cope with the exponentially increasing water crisis.

data.projectName: Development of Modified 316L Stainless for Bio Medical Applications Via Powder Injection molding
data.projectDigest: In the present era, biomedical implant materials have gained significant attention worldwide due to growing need to provide rehabilitation of affected individuals. Among all the metals, stainless steel is preferred because of adequate mechanical properties, corrosion resistance and low cost as compared to the other metal implants. However, corrosion of stainless steel implants is very serious concern as it causes hypersensitivity and allergies to the patients due to leaching of metal ions and they have to undergo surgery in a short span of time. This issue can be resolved by the addition of modifier and by getting the passive chromium oxide layer at the surface of the implant via powder injection molding (PIM) process. This technology is still new in Pakistan and has a scope to grow. A proper control of process parameters (simulation and experimentation) during PIM process can be helpful in achieving high densification and comparable mechanical properties. In our study, development of modified 316L SS will have improved densification, mechanical properties, enhanced the corrosion resistance and minimizing the leaching of toxic metal ion. These properties will make the material suitable for biomedical implants.

data.projectName: Political Tolerance and Party Workers in Pakistan: Issues and Challenges
data.piUniversity: Government College for Women University, Sialkot
data.projectDigest: Politics and society have been intervened; the training of political workers is one of the earliest reasons for developed countries. But political workers have often been the direct target of clashes between different political parties on issues such as principles, interests and power. Parties are responsible to provide education and awareness to their workers to come in the field of politics. But the situation is entirely different in Pakistan. This study will analyze the issues and challenges faced by political workers to maintain the level of tolerance so that their strength be utilized in positive way for creating politically tolerant society in Pakistan. This study will pave the way to create a tolerant society in terms of Political and Social issues and will also be  fruitful for political workers, political parties, politicians, Election Commission of Pakistan, General Masses (Voters), NGOs (national and International), and Government

data.projectName: Block Chain Based Supply Chain Management System for Agriculture in Pakistan
data.projectDigest: Block chain based supply chain management system for agriculture of Pakistan facilitates all the transactions related to the crops. Different crops available from the farmers can be bought directly using block chain based supply chain management system. Generally, block chain based supply chain management system involves four entities, a farmer, a government agent, bank and a trusted third-party agent as shown in the Figure 1. It is clearly illustrated in Figure 1 that the farmers will sale their crops to the government officials where the record will be stored in block chain system for making transparent transactions. The payment process will be handled through banks. In case of any dispute occurs between farmers and government officials, the trusted third party will be involved to resolve that dispute. The basic purpose of block chain based supply chain management system is to provide framework for an online purchase and sale of crops by assuring fair sale, purchase, storage, distribution and exchange of crops, crop safety and dispute resolution. Here, the fair exchange means that no one can take illegal advantages from the system.

data.projectName: Modeling of Glucose-Insulin System and Control of Artificial Pancreas
data.piUniversity: Pakistan Institute of Engineering & Applied Sciences, Islamabad (PIEAS)
data.projectDigest:
Blood glucose-insulin system is one of very important physiological systems in a human body. In this system, pancreas plays a vital role, it secrets insulin into blood thereby keeping the glucose concentration in a normal range of 70mg/dL-110 mg/dL. In diabetic patients, pancreas is unable to secret enough insulin required for regulation of glucose level. Diabetes can lead to many serious problems including cardiovascular disease, kidney failure, and amputation etc. It is one of the most fatal and widely spread diseases in the world  

The proposed project aims at the development of an artificial pancreas for regulation of blood glucose-insulin process in a human body. The developed equipment will be based upon more a refined mathematical model and more sophisticated control algorithms. Furthermore, advanced process monitoring and diagnosis techniques will be implemented to ensure high reliability and dependability of the developed equipment.

data.projectName: DEVELOPMENT OF MODERN METHODOLOGY IN CURE RATE MODELS
data.projectDigest:
Medical advancement has substantially improved the cure rates of many chronic diseases. The survival models that were considered previously feasible are now receiving a little attention. In life testing experiments, it is assumed that if the complete follow-up of the individuals were possible, each will eventually experience the event of interest. However, in many clinical trials, it is observed that some patients are cured for sufficiently long follow-up time. The survival models incorporating the cured fraction in the population are known as cure rate models. These models received a considerable attention of the researchers particularly in cancer studies. In these studies, the researchers are interested in the waiting time until the occurrence of event of interest and the proportion of individuals for which the event never occurs. 
A statistical investigation is based on two related components: design of experiment and analysis of data. A good statistical designing of experiment ensures that maximum amount of information (data) is collected from the experiment; a good statistical analysis of data ensures that the resulting conclusions will be valid relevant to the phenomenon under investigation. This research aims to consider the second component, namely, the analysis of survival data with cure fraction resulting from life testing experiments in medical sciences. 
The proposed research aims to target the health and medicine industries. The estimates of cured fraction, survival and hazard functions will assist authorities, researchers and general public to understand the treatment conditions of cancer patients in Pakistan in comparison to foreign countries. The proposed study may provide an opportunity of collaborative research to statisticians and medical researchers.

data.projectName: Development of Pakistan National Corpus of Languages
data.projectDigest: Languages have been a topic of interest among researchers since long. These have been explored from several interdisciplinary perspectives to uncover the unique functionalities of language that make each language unique. The current project will be beneficial for the researchers as it portrays Pakistani languages at different levels of linguistic analysis, such as, morphology, syntax, pragmatics and discourse. This study will develop a corpus that will provide the frequencies, collocations and contextual uses of lexicons in Pakistani languages. Once the corpus is developed completely it will be made available online. The corpus will be accessible for national and international scholars, academicians and researchers interested in exploring Pakistani languages. The Department of English, Air University intends to update the corpus biannually after completion of the project so the researchers can get access to maximum up-to-date data of Pakistani languages. In Pakistan, the national and regional languages are still under researched and one of the major reasons behind this lack of research is the absence of standardized corpora. This study will address this issue by developing a benchmark corpus of Pakistani languages that will remove hindrance for the researchers to explore these languages.

data.projectName: Mesoporous Silica Carriers for Enhanced Dissolution and Bioavailability of a Quinone Derivative
data.projectDigest: Various diseases are treated with chemical compounds, known as drugs. Malaria is one of the most dangerous and killer diseases worldwide. Drugs that are required to manage the disease conditions are usually administered orally (through mouth in the form of tablets and capsules) to patients. Once medicines are taken orally, it need to dissolve in the stomach or intestinal fluid (digestive system) and take a solution form which will be absorbed into blood, and only then it can show the pharmacological response. For a drug to be able to dissolve in the stomach or intestinal fluid, it must possess a good water solubility. But majority of drugs have poor water solubility and they do not dissolve efficiently. This makes them poorly absorbed in the blood, thus their effect will not reach and the disease will not be managed. Atovaquone is one of the efficient antimalarial drug but unfortunately it has very limited water solubility, thus it will not manage malaria efficiently. This project proposes a novel use of mesoporous silica materials which can efficiently enhance its solubility and in this way it can better absorb from the stomach or intestine into the blood to show its antimalarial effect.

data.projectName: Developing tools for formative assessment using learning analytics in online/blended learning Programs
data.projectDigest: The formative assessment (FA) is an essential source of informing about adequacy, relevance, and challenges of pedagogy, teaching-learning materials and ecology of teaching-learning environment in supporting student learning. The progress, feedback, and improvement of students’ learning reside in the formative use of data coming from different assessment tools. Until now, online/blended learning models use FA tools prevalent in Face-to-Face mode. The proposed research intends to develop and validate the learning analytics-based FA tools using learning-analytics to make data-driven decisions to improve pedagogy, learning process, learning ecology and documentation of the learning progress of students. The study is developmental in nature to be conducted in three phases. In phase, I, learning materials, learning analytics and framework for synchronization of both with learning ecology of AAGAHI-LMS will be developed. Phase II analysis of real-time data will produce FA tools related to pedagogy, learning process, learning ecology, and learning progress. The tools will be subsequently tested for their validity and reliability. In phase III, the final version of the FA tools will be implemented for examining the accuracy of tools for FA of learner outcomes. Besides producing FA tools, the study will open the FA as a distinct area in online/blended learning.

data.projectName: Co-delivery of Chemotherapeutics via Co-block Polymeric Nano-carriers: Combating Chemo-resistant and Recurrent Breast Cancer
data.projectDigest: Despite therapeutic advancements in breast cancer therapy, approximately 30% of the patients with breast cancer got their disease back due to resistance against the drugs. Surprisingly, the relapse due to drug-resistance is even higher among young Pakistani women, probably due to delayed clinical reporting at advance cancer stages and non-availability of modern chemo-therapeutic regimens – non-affordable for many. Thus, the current project is aimed at developing or up-grading already used combo-chemotherapeutic agents for the advanced breast cancer using MPEG-PLA amphiphilic co-block polymeric nanocarrier (NCs) containing doxorubicin (DOX), docetaxel (DTX) and cisplatin (CP). DOX-DTX and DOX-CP-loaded nano-carriers (NCs) will be synthesized and characterized using state of the art modalities, such as FTIR, DSC, Zeta-sizer, XRD, SEM-EDX, and drug release kinetic using dialysis membrane or dissolution technique. Thereafter, the NCs will be compared and tested with free drugs for cancer cell survival, migration and invasion, cell toxicity that would be helpful in identifying chemo-sensitive and chemo-resistant markers. To confirm in vivo relevance in animal models, these NCs will be tested in mouse models of advanced breast cancer developed using two different methods; mouse model developed using human breast cancer cells via subcutaneous implantation on right flank and assessing the effects of test drugs on tumor volume and a mouse model developed by chemical induction, i-e., MPA + DMBA, using repeated injections subcutaneously.

data.projectName: MANAGEMENT OF FUSARIUM WILT OF CHILI BY INDIGENOUS WEEDS
data.projectDigest: Plant diseases caused by fungi are major threat to food security and food safety. To combat these diseases, commercial fungicides are in use but these are associated with numerous ill effects. Search for eco-friendly method of disease control is very active now a days and weeds provide the cheapest alternatives. Herein, frequently occurring indigenous weeds will be investigated for their disease suppressing ability against wilt disease of chili under pot and field conditions. To achieve these goals, four weed species would be evaluated for their in vitro and in vivo fungicidal action against Fusarium oxysporum, the cause of wilt disease in chili. Based on pot experiments, the most effective weed will be selected for further experimentation in field experiments. On average, in Pakistan, this disease causes about 20% yield losses and If we can save this 20% yield loss, then we can save PKR 4163.6 million, annually. Moreover, natural antifungal compounds will be isolated from weeds by various chromatographic techniques. The structure of the most effective compounds will be determined by spectroscopic techniques. The structures of these compounds can be used as structural analogue to synthesize antifungal compounds in industrial scale.

data.projectName: Fault Tolerant Control of a Robot Manipulator with LuGre Model based Friction Compensation
data.projectDigest:
The advent of latest high-speed chip technology along with the requirement for highly efficient robots created realistic and significant place for control theory within the field of robotics. Robots are used extensively in trade services for humankind. A vital part of the robotic manipulator is correct placement of the target in the specified area. In robotics, diagnosis of a fault of actuators and sensors is of crucial importance. If any component in a system results in a failure, it affects the system stability and performance. Therefore, in autonomous system, identification of the fault and countering it while maintaining the system stability is of utmost importance. 
Proposed research work mainly aims at the fault tolerant control of a robotic manipulator with LuGre model-based friction compensation. Inverse and forward kinematics of the robotic manipulator will be modelled in the presence of friction and system uncertainties. Robust observer-based control technique will be employed to control the serial link manipulator. Furthermore, the effectiveness of the modeled based control strategy will be compared with model a free control approaches, such as, Neuro-Fuzzy control design.

data.projectName: Development of Haze Forecasting Model for Selected Pakistani Cities
data.projectDigest: Worsening air quality in Pakistan will take a long time to address, at a cost to human health and economic productivity. It is challenged by lack of air quality data (generated in silos) and nonexistence of any climate modeling in research and academia in Pakistan. This is causing serious lack of scientific confidence for policy makers to take decisions on how to tackle the environmental challenges associated with haze and bad air quality. Keeping in mind the existing gap between basic science and policy, the current proposal is prepared to address this issue by first generating and then expanding the critical nucleus of technical know-how and personnel development to resolve the issue of locally tailored climate models and their role in improving air quality assessments for policy makers and the general public. This project seeks to engage a remedial, short-term measure to reduce the exposure of the country’s vulnerable populations to haze. The development of a Haze Forecasting Model using weather stagnation processes, air quality and meteorological data can serve as a tool that provides warning to the citizenry and public administrators up to 24 hours in advance, so that they may reduce their exposure to bad air immediately.

data.projectName: Modification and characterization of phoenix dactylifera Linn mucilage for controlled release formulations
data.projectDigest:
The gums are vegetable exudates, composed mainly of carbohydrate polymers. Some of them swell while others form thick solutions. Keeping in view their availability, cost and safe and biodegradable nature and medicinal attributes, gums are the subject of intense research. Gums are being investigated for their intended use in food industry, medical applications and as a potent adsorbent. Native gums have certain drawbacks, such as lack of clarity and free flow properties, viscosity drop, turbidity in case of prolonged residence and the formation of larger microstructures. 
Purification and surface modification of native gums are expected to overcome above mentioned draw backs. Phoenix dactylifera Linn, a native (Indo-Pak) tropical medicinal plant, owning the herbal attributes in leaves, stem and bark. It also produces pieces of gum that are used in local herbal formulations. The proposed research implies a comprehensive plan for characterization followed by modification of the Phoenix dactylifera Linn mucilage for controlled release formulations. data.projectName: Improving Resource Use Efficiency and Productivity of Grain Legumes through Integrated Weed Management
data.piUniversity: Muhammad Nawaz Shareef University of Agriculture, Multan
data.projectDigest: Abridging the existing yield gap and increasing yield stability of pulses is crucial for food security. Pakistan is 4th largest importer of pulses in the world. Import of Kabuli chickpea valued at 465 million AU$ in 2018. National average production of chickpea in Pakistan (543 kg ha-1) is 40% less than that harvested (910 kg ha-1) in India. Likewise, the average productivity of lentil in Pakistan (567 kg ha-1) is far below than world’s average (936 kg ha-1). High productivity of these crops needs timely and effective weed management. Due to their herbaceous nature, slow initial growth and late canopy closure, winter legumes are susceptible to weed competition that is quite severe under irrigated environments. Yield reduction varies from 24-80% based on weed species and their relative proportions besides prevailing agro-climatic conditions. There is growing thrust to manipulate cultural practices in conjunction with herbicides as an integrated weed management (IWM) tactic. Sound knowledge of weed eco-biology and critical period of weed crop competition is also needed for successful IWM program. The proposed project intends to eliminate weed infestation as a major obstacle in realizing yield potential of grain legumes and devising site-specific efficient weed management practices for profitable crop production.

data.projectName: Computational Analysis of Data Science
data.projectDigest:
The new field of computational data science has begun as a third pillar of scientific investigation that balances between theory and testing. The skillset of computational data science is similar to skillset of machine learning engineering specialist on additional skills such as advanced tools of mathematics and statistics, R programing and SQL.
Theoretical Foundations of Computational Data Science (TFCDS) are fundamental for industrial applications and scientific understanding and there is demand for training students in this area. Academic institutions must seriously focus on how to define and shape this emerging field. It is well-known that data science problems do not respect the disciplinary boundaries that academic disciplines often tend to draw around particular domains. 
The objective of this proposal is to investigate of an important research challenges that strengthen and broaden the mathematical, statistical and algorithmic foundations of computational data science. We will briefly study such mathematical tools that are potentially needed to achieve necessary significant progress. We will also build collaboration between mathematicians and statisticians that could potentially contribute to workforce development by advancing and transforming the data science research of MS students and PhD researchers. We will suggest different infrastructures modalities that could significantly promote advance such collaborations.

data.projectName: Joint Pain Formulation with silver nano particles
data.projectDigest:
The present invention reveals Formulation of Acetaminophen (paracetamol) loaded Ag NPs and synthesis of the Ag nanoparticles for said formulation. Structural and morphological characterization of Ag NPs was made for their use for the miniaturization of facile, repeatable and reproducible said formulation. AgNO3 (sigma Aldrich 99.9%) CTAB (sigma Aldrich 99.9%) and Aniline (sigma Aldrich 99.9 %) are used. distilled and de ionized water is used as a solvent for preparing stock solutions of all reagents. Aniline solution is stored in amber colored bottle to prevent from Arial oxidation 500 ml of 0.01 molar AgNO3 solutions is prepared by dissolving 0.975 g of AgNO3 in 500ml of water, 500 ml of 0.01 molar CTAB solution is prepared by dissolving 1.75 g of CTAB in 500 ml of water, 500 ml of 0.01 molar Aniline solutions is prepared in numbered colored bottle. A transparent colorless mixture is obtained on mixing silver nitrate solution and CTAB solution. This mixture contains silver nitrate as metal salt precursor and CTAB as stabilizing agent .This transparent colorless solution turns to pale yellow color when aniline solution is added which acts as reducing agent. The appearance of pale yellow color is indication of silver nanoparticle joint formation. These pale yellow colored precipitate of AGNPS are filtered and dries. 
Then 10mg, 20mg, 30mg, 40mg, 50mg, 60mg of acetaminophen is accurately measured and mixed in 100 ml of AGNPS suspension. The mixture of acetaminophen and silver nanoparticle is incubated for 24 hours under stirring. The resulting mixture is centrifuged at 10000 rpm for 60 minutes .

data.projectName: Dynamics of Hybrid Naomaterials
data.projectDigest: The aim of this proposal is to discuss the dynamics of the hybrid nanomaterial in view of its application in the recent years. Recently, researchers have introduced the concept of hybrid nanofluid in nanotechnology. Hybrid nanofluids can be manufactured by dispersing nanoparticles of different materials individually or mixture of nanoparticles in base fluid. Hybrid materials combine physical and synthetic properties of different materials providing them in homogeneous phase which presents remarkable physicochemical properties. These hybrid nanofluids have practical applications in heat transfer, electronic cooling, transport industry, defense, bio-medical and spacecraft devices etc. Mathematical formulations will be performed and the physical system will be converted into set of mathematical equations which will be computed via numerical as well as analytical techniques. Behavior of involved physical quantities will be presented and discussed in details. Tables and bar-chart will be prepared to interpret the results.

data.projectName: “Design, Synthesis, Computational Molecular Modeling and Enzyme inhibitory Kinetics of Some New Imidazole Derivatives as Urease Inhibitors.”
data.projectDigest:
Urease enzyme catalyzes the hydrolysis of urea into carbon dioxide and ammonia. It is basically found in different types of fungi, bacteria and plants. The main source of pathology provoked by Gram negative bacterium (Helicobacter pylori) is found in stomach and which play a major role in the development of stomach and duodenal ulcers. Ureases play various functions and antiurease agents have attract worldwide attraction for the last few years.
•	Heterocyclic compounds display exciting medicinal properties and other important biological applications including urease inhibition. Some heterocyclic urease inhibitors are available in the market for the treatment of problems causes by ureases like as kidney stones, stomach cancer, peptic ulceration and pyelonephritis etc.
•	In the recent years, imidazole scaffolds their analogues & derivatives have attracted wide attention due to their useful biological and important pharmacological properties. By keeping in mind the broad spectrum of pharmaceutical applications of imidazole nucleus, a large number of therapeutic agents were synthesized with the imidazole moieties. 
•	These heterocyclic compounds have special significance in the field of medicinal chemistry due to their remarkable pharmacological properties. We basically plan to carry out research on the synthesis and exploration of their important biological application with special emphasis on their urease inhibition and protein interaction studies of these synthesized heterocycles. 
•	This two year project mainly focuses on the design and efficient synthesis of variously derivatized novel imidazole scaffolds by employing different substrates, there in vitro urease inhibition assay, molecular modeling studies and characterization by different spectroscopic techniques.

data.projectName: Effect of Feed and Supplementary Nutrients on Biological Parameters and Economic Traits of Silkworm (Bombyx Mori L) and Development of a Research Unit in UAJK for Promotion of Sericulture in AJK.
data.piUniversity: University of Azad Jammu & Kashmir, Muzaffarabad, Azad Kashmir, Muzaffarabad
data.projectDigest: Sericulture is a labor intensive cottage industry that occupies a place of pride in the rural economy of the country. It is an industry providing quick returns to the rural folk at lesser investment, having high potential for profit and foreign exchange. The silk is employed for varied functions since history in State of Jammu Kashmir. In Azad Kashmir production of silkworm has seen steady decline which is caused by factors such as lack of research work to identify better silkworm species and use of quality food and different food supplements. Silkworm rearing could be an important source of livelihood for a significant number of families in Azad Jammu Kashmir because the agro climatic conditions and natural resources are suitable for silkworm rearing in Azad Kashmir. Therefore, this project is proposed for establishment of an effective research unit in UAJK where students will identify and rear the best silkworm species. The best species of mulberry trees will also be identified as food of silkworms and different food supplements will also be identified and recommended after a comprehensive research work.

data.projectName: Management of sucking insect pest’s complex of cotton using silicon based induced resistance
data.projectDigest:
The insect pest scenario has changed due to widespread plantation of transgenic cotton derived from bacterium, Bacillus thuringiensis Berliner (Bt). The toxic proteins are target specific and provide protection only against lepidopterous resulted in outbreak of secondary species especially the whitefly, jassid and thrips.
As an alternate, silicon (Si) induced host plant resistance offers a long-standing, economical and environment benign solution to manage sucking insect pests (whitefly, jassid and thrips) population and is considered a vital component of different integrated pest management (IPM) programs. In our preliminary study on use of silicon revealed that maximum reduction in number of oviposited eggs (51.83) and increase in developmental period (18.1 days) of whitefly was recorded on plants treated with foliar applied silicon as compared to untreated control (107.22 eggs; 11.0 days).
Moreover, the integration of silicon will be crucial in pest management strategies in the arid and semi-arid regions like Pakistan, where water stress in field conditions is a common phenomenon affecting crop growth and ultimately yield reduction. Keeping in view the eco-destructive nature of chemicals, the present research will be carried out in both field and laboratory conditions to check the effect of silicon on sucking insect pests. Additionaly enzymes/genes involved in salicylic acid (SA)/methyl jasmonate (MeJA) biosynthesis pathways on molecular bases and the resistance mechanisms or susceptibility of cotton cultivars against insect-silicon based induced resistance will also be assessed that will be helpful for the screening of cultivars for future cotton improvements.

data.projectName: Human Cardiovascular Simulator (CSim)  for teaching and research purposes
data.projectDigest:
This project is divided into two phases:
Phase–I (CSim for teaching): in the first phase of the project the Cardiovascular Simulator (CSim) will be developed consisting all three types of blood circulations i.e. coronary, pulmonary and systemic circulations. Further, blood circulation will be coupled with complete model of the heart. In order to develop CSim, lumped-parameter approach will be used as it is simple and computationally efficient compared to the high (3D, 2D, 1D) and multi-dimensional models of cardiovascular system (CVS). The develop simulator will be a useful tool to study the impact of input parameter variations i.e. heart rate, elasticity, length, diameter and wall thickness of the vessel on pressure and flow throughout the body. 
Phase–II (CSim for research):  The progress in mathematical modeling, numerical techniques and image processing in medicine enabled researchers to develop different predictive mathematical models of the
human CVS. To achieve reliable mathematical models of different morphologies of the human CVS, the model simulations should be validated using the data acquired from the healthy or diseased subjects. In this phase of the project, Dr. Abdullah Alvi from Mufti Clinic Abbottabad will provide us the data of patients having vessel abnormalities (stenoses, aneurysms). From that data, we will develop patient-specific models of different morphologies, like carotid bifurcation, arm arteries, aorta, etc. Finally, patient-specific models of different morphologies can help medical professionals to improve their understanding of hemodynamics in healthy and diseased vessels.
