data.projectName: Positioning trade policy effectively and leveraging CPEC for trade and environmental gains
data.projectDigest: Trade liberalization has an inherent tendency to raise employment elasticity of economic growth thereby creating a better impact. Unfortunately, the Small economy of Pakistan is facing persistently deficit in balance of trade. The recent wave of globalization even widens the gap of negative trade balance. China Pakistan Economic Corridor (CPEC) is a $59 billion project focusing on energy and infrastructure development. Under CPEC project, Pakistan is developing nine Special Economic Zones (SEZs) equipped with all modern facilities. The study intends to explore the potential available in Special Economic Zones and how this available potential can maximize the economic gains. The study will focus the manufacturing sector in general and the textile sector of Pakistan in particular. For this purpose, the Computable General Equilibrium (CGE) model in its global version called Global Trade Analysis Project (GTAP) will be used. The study will design different simulations and formulate a trade policy that maximize the gains not only in terms of improved environment but also other economic goals like GDP growth, international competitiveness or employment.

data.projectName: PHYTOCHEMICAL SCREENING, ATIOXIDANT POTENTIAL AND COMPUTER-AIDED ANALYSIS OF DIFFERENT MEDICINAL PLANTS IN THE QUEST OF NEW DRUG
data.projectDigest: Medicinal plant are considered for their many advantages including their antioxidant properties and ability to treat several disorders. In this study the phytochemical constituents of methanolic leaf extract of different medicinal plants will be screened and invitro antioxidant activity will be investigated. The study also focus on the computational prediction to detect inhibitory potential of common phytochemical constituents against the different protein (receptors) through molecular docking. Fresh leaves of plants will be collected, washed and dried for 1 week. 250 grams finely powdered leaves will be extracted in a Soxhlet apparatus using methanol. The phytochemical screening and invitro antioxidant activity will be performed by standard validated procedures. The therapeutic activity of phytochemicals in medicinal plants against different (receptor) will be investigated using iGEMDOCK v2, Autodock vena and ADMET-SAR online tool.

data.projectName: Quantification of traffic load and vehicle-road interaction in Pakistan using experimental and computational techniques
data.projectDigest: It is perceived that the current traffic load quantification/evaluation does not reflect the actual loading regime on the highway infrastructure; consequently, the road deterioration has seen an exponential increase due to the uncategorized overloading. The road pavement performance has been evaluated but the research is limited only to the application of standardized axle load. The goal of this project is to study the cumulative damaging effect of heavy vehicles, and to quantify axle loads for improved road design guideline for Pakistan. This will result in substantial reduction in the lifecycle costs of road pavements. To accomplish this goal, vehicle load data will be acquired by installing weigh-in-motion (WIM) stations for development of truckload spectra. Truck factors will be calculated for different vehicle classes of local trucks. Statistics of overload occurrence and the damage potentials will be calculated, that will be helpful in estimating the portion of damage in pavements induced by overloads. Finite Element (FE) model will be developed for local road pavements as per calculated axle loads and vehicle passes. This study will yield cost effective solutions based on a scientific approach for the road pavement design in Pakistan considering the dynamics of local truck axle load parameters.

data.projectName: Investigating the antinematodal activity of natural honey proteins by targeting Lipid metabolism of C. elegans.
data.projectDigest:
Parasitic infection has been considered as the major contributing factor for anemia and child malnutrition. In rural Pakistan, 40–70% cases of malnutrition and anemia are associated with intestinal worm infestation in children, that leads to adverse health issues in children. Therefore, it has now become next step to reduce the nation’s worm index by eliminating the worm infections to achieve the sustainable developments goals (SDGs) set by world health organization. Several anti-helminthic drugs are available to treat parasitic nematodes infections. But there is a limitation that includes a limited spectrum of drug activity across worm species, as well as a threat of drug resistance. Therefore, natural sources such as honey, represent a major opportunity to discover new cost-effective drug. 
Lipid metabolism is essential for the rapid propagation of parasites and establishment of parasitic infection. Here, we will target the lipid metabolism of C. elegans and identify the effect of honey and honey proteins on the life span of C. elegans.  Alteration in lipid balance in C. elegans will provide evidence on nematicidal action of honey and honey protein on their lifespan. We hypothesize that, honey as the natural product can become feasible and effective agent against the nematode’s infections.

data.projectName: Arterial blood flow relevant to human physiology using numerical schemes
data.piUniversity: Mirpur University of Science and Technology (MUST), AJ&K
data.projectDigest: In human tabular organ functioning several diseases in different blood vessels of human body and in heart cause major drawbacks such as heart attack and stroke that is root cause of large mortality in whole world. The principal cause of such diseases is the formation of fatty materials in artery that produces plaque in artery, recedes the cross sectional area of blood passage and can restrict sufficient blood supply to each artery. The aim here is to explore the effects of different physical considerations in human physiology and report that to what extent the considerations (such as magnetic field, stenosis, nanoparticles, etc) effect the proper body functioning. Further, our research work play a vital role in biomedical engineering because catheter is a standard regular instrument to identify the diseases and treatment in modern medicine. Artery blood pressure is measure with transducers that is attached to a catheter. To reduce stenosis in artery, a catheter connected with a small balloon at the end is infused in an artery and that balloon is distended to rupture the flabby deposits and to enlarge the constrict part in artery.

data.projectName: Drone-based integrated disaster stage management decision support system
data.projectDigest: Major challenges during a disaster are; to accurately forecast the possibility of occurrence of a disaster, to react efficiently and effectively during the occurrence of a disaster, and after a quick assessment to restore and fix the damages caused by the disaster quickly. Irrespective the type of operation being performed in disaster management, logistics activity must be a critical component of it. In a post-disaster scenario unavailability of transportation is the major challenge. For these purpose currently, geographical information systems are being used. However, geographical information systems take some time to provide updated regional images. To deal with this issue, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV)/drones are being used which not only provide timely information but also are very cost efficient. Drones-based flight system has its own constraints, therefore, using drone for a disaster relief operations demands efficient planning. By incorporating the drones in all the phases of the disaster can significantly enhance the effectiveness of the disaster relief operation. The goal of this research is to propose an integrated disaster stage management decision support system so that decisions made in each a centralized manner and the efficiency of the disaster support system can be enhanced. Keeping in view the research gap, this project aims for a drone-based integrated disaster stage management decision support system.

data.projectName: Development of extremely thermostable alpha-glycosidases with improved activity through protein engineering, for industrial applications
data.projectDigest:
In 2017, global enzyme market was valued at approx. 7,000 million USD and it is projected to cross 10,000 million USD in 2024. The major share in the enzymes market is of Carbohydrases, which convert complex carbohydrate polymers to simpler monomers. Alpha-glycosidases including amylases account for 12% in this market.
Amylases break the starch polymers into small units called dextrins, which can further be broken down to maltose and glucose and therefore they are one of the main enzymes used in many industries e.g. such as fermentation, food, detergent and pharmaceutical etc. Amylases can be obtained from animals, plants, and microorganisms. Enzymes from bacterial and fungal sources have dominated applications in many industrial sectors. The properties of each amylase such as temperature stability, pH stability, pH profile, and metal ion-independency are important to consider when developing a fermentation process.
This project aims to produce highly thermostable and active form of microbial alpha-glycosidases/amylases through protein engineering approach using directed evolution and rational designing. The production process shall also be optimized to get optimum yield of enzyme at lab scale bioreactor. The produced enzyme shall also be tested for its industrial applications at high temperature.

data.projectName: Enhancement of fiber quality and yield traits by crispr-mediated phytochrome A1 gene inhibition in cotton (Gossypium hirsutum L.)”
data.piUniversity: Pakistan Institute of Engineering & Applied Sciences, Islamabad (PIEAS)
data.projectDigest: The influence of red/far red light ratio is critical for fiber quality and agronomic yield. The  manipulation of light absorbing machinery in crop plants will be prime factor in enhancing productivity of agricultural plants.  Cotton (Gossypium hirsutum L.) is called king due to natural fiber (90%) for textile sector and seed oil for edible oil industries (60%). During crop season 2018-2019, Pakistan hit record low cotton production (9.450 million bales) sliding down to 5th position globally. Due to climate change, cotton crop has faced unprecedented scenario of unsustainability in productivity and yield of cotton seed. Despite allocation of huge funds and efforts on extensive cotton breeding, present cultivars are unable to sustain cotton production but conversely, production and yield are showing negative trend for the last few years (Economic Survey of Pakistan, 2018-2019). Due to shortfall in production, Pakistan will have to import 2- 3 million bales of worth Rs. 3 billion to feed local textile industries. The PHY A1 is known to play role in plant response for sensing day length in plants. Moreover,  PHY A1 not only negatively regulates other phytochrome genes but also controls the synthesis and transport of a flower inhibitor becoming ptential target of gene downregulation technology. In present study, 3-5 sgRNA from important target areas of phytochrome A gene will be identified by using bioinformatics tools and cloned in Cas-9 vector. The DNA sequence of PHY A1 be retrieved from NCBI (Gene Bank accession no. P1471). The phytochrome  A / Cas-9  transgenic  cotton will be developed and evaluated fro quality and yield traist.

data.projectName: Optimization of Energy Product (BH)max of Exchange Coupled Rare-Earth Free Magnetic Nanocomposites for Energy Conversion Applications
data.piUniversity: Khwaja Fareed University of Engineering and Information Technology, Rahim Yar Khan
data.projectDigest: Hard magnets play a vital role in improving performance of devices used in energy conversions.  A figure of merit for magnets is energy product (BH)max displayed in applications, a larger (BH)max enables device miniaturization [Fig.1]. A superior (BH)max is displayed by rare-earth (RE) based magnets but recent crisis in RE-supply has raised serious apprehensions in producing RE-based magnets igniting research on RE-free magnets. The RE-free magnets are cost effective, oxidation resistant with high operating temperatures. Hybrid nanocomposites comprising RE-free hard-soft magnetic phases can exhibit exchange-coupling; a quantum effect active over short dimensions (~Å) is tuned by morphology, relative crystallographic alignment, interfacial settings and volume contributions of phases [Fig.2]. Enhanced (BH)max entails mastering the fabrication of intimately merged, well-oriented, magnetic phases. In this project, exchange coupled RE-free nanocomposites will be investigated for hard magnetic phase MFe12O19 (M= Sr, Ba) and a soft magnetic phase M'Fe2O4 (M'= Fe, Ni, Zn, Mn). Soft magnetic phase possesses high saturation magnetization, high permeability, easy magnetization, easy demagnetization, low coercivity and low remanence. The B-H loops for soft magnetic phase are longer along B-axis and narrow along H-axis whereas, the loops for hard magnetic phase have high remanence, high coercivity and large B-H loop area [Fig.3].

data.projectName: Analysing Class Talk and type of Questioning as a tool to Develop Higher Order Learning in Science Classrooms
data.projectDigest: The quality of education is based on classroom effectiveness in which interaction between teachers and students is vital to understand. In fact, the classroom research mainly focused on class talk considered responsible to students’ learning. The variation of talk patterns has an effect on the learning of the students. However, there is need to analyze class talk to see its effects on level of students. The varied nature of class talk may influence on students differently. The type of questions raised in the classroom, linguistic choices by the participants and use of phrases ending with inspiring words are catchy for students to participate in the class. Questing and linguistic choices in the classroom activate students to take part in discussions and share their cognitive view. The subject of science is challenging and mostly our students lacks in understanding of complex concepts. The flexible classroom organization provides opportunity to students to share their point of view and invoke their thinking process. Our students are passive listeners which never results in the form of learning. The purpose of science education in our education policies is clear to develop higher order thinking skills, among students which is only possible through classroom participation.

data.projectName: Cloning and Expressional Analysis of Hypothetical Proteins of Ricinis Communis: A Novel Approach to Fight against Skin Diseases
data.projectDigest: Pakistan is an agricultural land blessed with diverse variety of medicinal plants. Majority of Pakistani population in rural areas use local medicinal plants for treating both acute and chronic skin diseases.  There are number of factors that contributes to skin diseases. 1) Sun exposure, heat and cold act as environmental factors. 2) Family history, defective DNA repair mechanism and gene mutations cause nearly 44 disorders including skin cancer, acne and hives. 3) Immune system attacks its own tissues and contributing to skin pattern deterioration causing arthritis-associated diseases, psoriasis scleroderma and dermatomyositis Unfortunately, there is a lack of research to explore all therapeutic benefits of local flora to treat skin disorders. We have designed this project to scrutinize the beneficial pharmalogical properties of Ricinis communis commonly known as Caster bean. As the genome of this plant is very large so the function of a lot of hypothetical proteins are not evaluated experimentally. In order to shortlist functional candidates, proteins characterize by in-silico tools will be further cloned and expressed in E. coli and expressed in animal models. The successful completion of this project will pave new roads for young Pakistani researchers to work on drug designing combating skin disorders. Ultimately it will reduce national expenses of importing synthetic drugs having adverse effects and will provide cost effective and natural herbal medicine to treat skin diseases.

data.projectName: Computational Screening of Two Dimensional Layered Novel Materials And Their Heterostructures For Photocatalytic Properties
data.piUniversity: Abbottabad University of Science & Technology (AUST), Abbottabad
data.projectDigest:
The primary objective of this work is
i.	To explore Two Dimensional (2D) layered materials (Janus transition metal dichalcogenides, Transition metal dichalcogenides, MXenes Phosphorene’s, Graphene’s, Silicene, Germanene etc.) with specific band gap, band edges, to investigate the photocatalytic performance.
ii.	To modify the band gap and band structure by tuning the electronic structure with different ways, like by applying compressive and tensile strain, doping, creating vacancies, applying electric field and making heterostructures and investigate the photocatalytic performance.
iii.	Tuning the electronic properties with increasing number of layers, i.e. from monolayer to bilayer and multilayer’s etc., in the form of homobilayer and heterostructures.
iv.	 To generate type-II band alignment with application of external electric field and with engineering of heterostructure of TMDCs and MXenes.
v.	After generating type-II band alignment, to investigate the photocatalytic performance.

data.projectName: Techno-economic Evaluation of Carbon Capture for Co-firing of Coal and Biomass in a Supercritical Power Plant
data.projectDigest: The proposed research project deals with the modelling and simulation of the supercritical coal-fired power plant integrated with CO2 capture and compression to reduce the emissions from the fossil-fuelled plant making them competitive to renewables power sources. In order to meet the stringent environmental and climate change targets, the cofiring of the coal and biomass is evaluated to check the possibility of zero/negative emissions. The most understood process of amine-based CO2 capture has been investigated for baseload and part-load performance of the coal-fired power plant. Furthermore, the optimum heat and mass integration of the CO2 capture and compression plant with the steam turbine of the coal-fired power is examined. In addition, the technoeconomic analysis of the different configurations is assessed to reduce the penalty of integration of the CO2 capture and compression system with the coal-fired power plant. At each stage the data generated is validated and verified in collaboration with the industrial collaborator, Huaneng Shandong Ryui (Pakistan) Energy (Private) Limited to analyse real time commercial-scale application.  In conclusion, the proposed project will result in knowledge generation for the teaching and training of the manpower for the coal -fired power plant along with social acceptance by combating climate change.

data.projectName: Truancy among School Students: An In-depth Study Through Exploratory Sequential Design
data.piUniversity: National University of Modern Languages, Islamabad (NUML)
data.projectDigest: Understanding truancy as a global, longstanding, and unresolved educational problem, the present study is aimed to explore truancy among school children with a mixed-method sequential exploratory design (Phase-1 = qualitative part; Phase-2 = quantitative part). Qualitative part (Phase 1) will be aimed to explore contextual factors and consequences of truancy through in-depth interviews and focus group discussions with truant students of various schools of Rawalpindi and Islamabad. Purposive and snowball sampling methods will be used to collect data for this phase. Another objective of this part is to develop a theory of truancy in the indigenous context of Pakistan. However, quantitative part (Phase 2), being cross-sectional in nature, will aim to develop and validate an indigenous scale of truancy and conducting a prevalence study based on the same scale. Following cluster random sampling (for schools) and convenient sampling technique (for students), this phase of study will target general school children of various schools in Rawalpindi and Islamabad. The current study will significantly contribute to the existing literature as a very little work (to the best of our knowledge) has been conducted on truancy with such a rigor and depth in Pakistan. Moreover, the development of a quantitative measure of truancy will help to assess associated behavioral outbursts of truancy and will facilitate schools’ administration and educational researchers to devise appropriate prevention and intervention strategies to combat truancy in school children.

data.projectName: Deep Insights into the Genetic Diversity and Populations History of the Ethnic Groups of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa: A Molecular Approach
data.projectDigest: The strategic location of Pakistan and its presence at the crossroads of Asia has resulted in its playing a central role in human migratory events, both prehistoric and historic, in the process linking and facilitating contacts between the inhabitants of the Middle East, Central Asia, China and Southeast Asia. In the last two decades, the people of Pakistan have received considerable attention from anthropologists, archaeologists, geneticists and linguists due to their unique distinction, largest ethnic and linguistic diversity, cultural and biological characteristics. Despite efforts performed from various discipline to address questions regarding the origin uniqueness and heterogeneity of some Pakistani ethnic groups, the genetic studies from Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province (KPP) performed up to now have suffered from weak study design where populations are not analyzed in an adequate geographic and population context. In this project we will focus to address questions regarding the genetic history of the ethnic groups of KPP and to overcome these design limitations, we will analyze the whole mitochondrial DNA (mtDNAs) and Y-Chromosome of some major ethnic groups. The profound analysis of these two uniparental genetic markers will allow a fine scale comparison across and among the ethnic groups of KPP. Furthermore, the data obtained from both genetic systems will be compared with the neighboring populations from South Asia, Central Asia, East Asia, Middle East, Europe and the Caucasus to identify traces of historical movements that influenced the composition of the selected ethnic groups.

data.projectName: Domestication and value addition of indigenous Aromatic plants for essential oils and their bio chemical profiling
data.projectDigest: The aromatic flowers and herbs are playing their vital role by providing essential oil and other raw material for cosmetics and pharmaceutical/herbal industry. Pakistan is blessed with important natural flora of aromatic and herbal plants used for many medicinal purposes. This natural and wild aromatic flora is found in alpine and northern areas of Pakistan, providing livelihood for the local community. Pakistan is spending lot of money by importing those aromatic flowers and herbs which are already available wildly in various regions of Pakistan. The lack of organized cultivation is the main issue need to be addressed in the country. To domesticate, crops are usually bred to achieve high uniformity but for the wild grown aromatic plants, having naturally those herbal and aromatic characteristics, there is no problem in cropping. The proposed research project includes collection, identification and cultivation of aromatic flowers and herbs at aromatic garden to be established at Department of Environmental Sciences, COMSATS University Islamabad Vehari campus. Later the performance of aromatic flowers and herbs will be evaluated for their sustainable harvesting, bio chemical properties, anti-oxidant and anti-microbial activities. The proposed project will help diminishing the import by cultivating aromatic and herbal flora and provide guidelines regarding production technology for local farming community.

data.projectName: Niosome Based Trans-Dermal Drug Delivery System For Enhanced Absorption Of Class-II Drugs
data.piUniversity: Kohat University of Science and Technology, Kohat
data.projectDigest: Drug delivery through the skin protects the drug from the hepatic first-pass metabolism [1]. The main advantage of a transdermal drug delivery route over other types of medication delivery is that the patch provides a controlled release of the medication into the patient [2], usually through either a porous membrane covering a reservoir of medication [3] or through body heat melting thin layers of medication embedded in the adhesive [4]. Skin is a very effective barrier; as a result, only medications whose molecules are small enough to penetrate the stratum corneum (SC) of skin can be delivered by this method [5]. In the present project an attempt will be made to enhance trans-dermal absorption of drugs to get better pharmacological response with reduced side effects. Most of the newly invented drugs are lipophillic with pH dependent solubility and have erratic absorption after oral administration. Trans-dermal route is advantageous for such type of drugs as drug solubalization is not required and effect of variation of pH in GIT will be minimized. Furthermore, first pass metabolism will be avoided.

Moreover, the weaning of the male calves is done at very initial days. Ironically, a good proportion of these animals are managed at local and integrated commercial dairies under the use of oxytocin. data.projectName: Development of multi-epitope peptide vaccines against Helicobacter pylori
data.projectDigest: In this project, we aimed to develop efficient multi-epitope vaccines capable of generating immunogenic responses against all H. pylori strains. Epitope-based vaccines are considered as an effective strategy to elevate specific immune responses without any unfavorable side effects. Thus, safe and focused immune responses can be induced with increased potency and breadth by engineering the conserved epitopes together. Our study will focus on good reactogenicity, specificity, and sensitivity for the designed vaccine product, suggesting that it may be a promising vaccine candidate against H. pylori infections. Being prepared and tested within Pakistan, it will benefit our population being effective against strains inhabiting Pakistani population and if successful will be cost-effective for general public.

data.projectName: CAPITALIZING ON GLOBAL OPPORTUNITIES FOR COMMERCIALIZATION OF TRANSDERMAL DRUG DELIVERY BASED ON NANOTECHNOLOGY
data.projectDigest:
Administration of medicine through skin is termed as Transdermal drug delivery. It is one of the most promising pharmaceutical approaches since provides continuous treatment from hours to days, avoid frequent administration, painless, inexpensive treatment and less toxic reactions.
Challenge is getting the drug transported through skin barrier. Nano particulate systems have gained much interest in recent years. This system improves the transport of drug through skin due to high affinity for cell membrane. Cell membrane being dominatingly negative charged attract positive nano particles and hence quick absorption. Modulation of nano particles results in achieving desired outcome.
This project undertakes the investigation of drug compound, which is formulated with nano particulate system such as Halloysite Nanotubules (HNTs) and evaluated for its quality characteristics like assay, content uniformity, peel adhesion test, leak test, etc. 
In vitro drug release profile and drug permeation will also be studied thoroughly. Besides general rise in popularity of transdermal products by patients, the soaring demand for product is evident from the accelerating growth rate of Global transdermal market. Mentioning positive impact on medical practice, improves patient compliance as well as is cost effective solution for patients. Economically would bring about huge impact by replacing other dosage forms.

data.projectName: Development and integration of an IOT based system for real-time monitoring of primary vital signs of patients under Intensive care in healthcare centers
data.projectDigest:
In this project, a real-time system to monitor vital health signs like body temperature, blood pressure, ECG and breathing rate (respiratory rate) of the patients under intensive care in healthcare centers is being proposed.  The proposed system will not only ensure the availability of specialized doctors in remote areas but also lessen the burden of on-call doctors in overcrowded district hospitals. On the other hand, the system will also help the patients in critical conditions, where the doctor can instruct the duty staff of the hospital by observing the real-time condition of the patient. 
 In the proposed method, critical parameters will be continuously monitored and real-time information will be transmitted through the internet of things (IoT) to the terminal devices e.g., mobile app and Central monitor in the ICU room. The low-cost devices will be used for detection of respiratory rate, ECG, body temperature and blood. After design validation in simulations, the fabricated prototype will be tested in a real-time scenario. The prototype will be tested on volunteers first and then real-time measurements will be taken in any health care center. The final product can be a part of a centralized health care system in pakistan.

data.projectName: Study of fractional order parameter on Turbulent and Laminar MHD blood flow in Constricted stenosed arteries
data.piUniversity: Khwaja Fareed University of Engineering and Information Technology, Rahim Yar Khan
data.projectDigest:
An artery is a blood carrier that transports blood to all organs of the body from the heart.  Except the pulmonary and umbilical arteries which transport non oxygenated blood to the oxygenating organs, all other arteries transport the blood enriched with oxygen. Due to many physical and biological changes arteries can become constricted with many stenosis shapes and modes. Arterial stenosis is a serious medical condition which obstructs the blood in arteries leading to disturbance in the normal blood flow thereby give rise to several horrendous and alarming diseases that includes; brain hemorrhage, cardiac arrest, high and/or low blood pressure etc.

The comprehensive bio-mechanical properties are governed by vascular wall which is diversified soft tissue with which gradient across several arterial tree positions occur consisting of different parts. With the presence of electric and magnetic fields, it is experimentally proven that blood circulations can be controlled with the help of some physical parameters (like Hartmann number and Womersley frequency parameters).

Mathematical framework of constricted arteries is based on well-known Navier- Stokes equations in cylindrical geometry.  The blood is modeled as a Non-Newtonian fluid under the influence of Electric and magnetic fields. In our project we will impart our attention towards solving and controllability of blood flow mathematical model with stenosis, using fractional calculus approach. Mathematical aspect of existence and uniqueness shall also be considered with graphical and numerical study!

data.projectName: Development of Informative Multisystem Composite circRNA Biomarkers Predicting Early Stage Hepatocellular Carcinoma Presence Using Prospective-Retrospective Analysis
data.projectDigest: Being one of the most aggressive cancer, improved detection and treatment of HCC is right now the leading worldwide healthcare priority. Its prevalence is higher in patients suffering from chronic HBV or HCV related cirrhosis (El-Serag 2012). While liver transplantation and surgical resection are considered as potentially curative therapies for early-stage HCC, the majority of HCC diagnoses take place at advanced/ latter stages which limits the usefulness of available treatment options (Yang, Hainaut et al. 2019). Therefore, HCC has poor prognosis due to delayed diagnosis (Ayoub, Steggerda et al. 2019). According to “Hepatocellular Cancer Disease Coverage Forecast and Market Analysis to 2035” the incident cases of HCC are expected to increase by almost 30% during 2018–38. There is a need for novel biomarkers to improve upon the limitations of current clinical biomarkers such as AFP. With the recent technical advancement in laboratory science and dissemination of sophisticated bioinformatics tools, there is a great opportunity for the discovery of novel markers that ultimately lead to improvement in medical practice. Carrier rates are alarmingly high in Pakistan for HCV (4.8-14%) (Hakim, Kazmi et al. 2008) and hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) (10%) (Butt and Amin 2008). Identification of potential circulating biomarkers in body fluids will help in accurate diagnosis of early stage HCC which will significantly reduce the morbidity and mortality. With the aim to address the HCC related diagnostic challenge, we have endeavored to design a comprehensive integrative dry and wet lab approach to identify prioritize putative biomarkers for early stage HCC.

data.projectName: Advancements in 3D Printing Technique for Development of Semiconductor Embedded Filters for Treatment of Emerging Contaminants and Pathogens in Water (3DSEF-TreatWater)
data.piUniversity: Mehran University of Engineering & Technology, Jamshoro
data.projectDigest: In Pakistan, poor water quality is becoming a serious threat, as the 40% of deaths are due to the use of contaminated water and because of presence of environmentally concern emerging contaminants and pathogens (ECPs). The conventional processes mainly coagulation, biological and chlorination processes are failed to treat ECPs, while various alternatives like advanced oxidation, semiconductor materials (SMs) photocatalysis etc. are under development stages. Therefore, the proposed project is aimed to explore and advance the use of 3D printing technology (3DP) to make flexible 3D filters out of bulk SMs, with desired and reproducible features for targeted treatment of ECPs. Previously various SMs are synthesized at nanoscale for photocatalytic treatment of phenolic compounds and microbes. Now, the proposed research is aimed, to advance the 3DP and printing additives with SMs embedding, print innovative 3D printed semiconductor embedded filters (3DSEFs), to evaluate and tune their properties, systematic and advanced analyses for selective ECPs treatment and further development of demonstrative bench-scale device for validation of proposed concept. The aimed research and development will be collaborated with ORIENT WATER TECHNOLOGIES (OWT) with technical and financial support, collaborator from Environmental Sciences, SMIU, Karachi and with international collaborator from DISAT, Politecnico di Torino, Italy.

data.projectName: Language Shift from Lasi into Urdu
data.piUniversity: Lasbela University of Agriculture, Water and Marine Sciences, Lasbela
data.projectDigest:
Language shift means the process or the event in which a population changes from using one language to another. Language shift is the social phenomenon, whereby one language shifts into other in a given community for multiple reasons. It is due to social compulsion that people migrate from one area to another for different kind of purposes that can be Education purpose or trade purpose.
Language shift refers to a situation where a local community abandons their native language and shifts to any other dominant language. This shift may be either for a shorter period of time or may extent to permanent shift. Language shift is actually a replacement of a language to any other language for either social benefit or for just under the effect of surroundings (Garret, 2006).

data.projectName: Development of stable, low cost pervoskite solar cell
data.piUniversity: Ghulam Ishaq Khan Institute of Engineering Sciences & Technology, Topi
data.projectDigest:
An efficient way to fulfill the demands of energy without imposing burden on natural resources and further aggravating climate change is the need of the hour. Recently, perovskite solar cells have turned out to be one of the most efficient solar cells, reaching maximum efficiency of 23.7%. Mixed organic-inorganic perovskite solar cells, are known for their excellent electrical and optical properties; high absorption coefficient, high charge mobility and long diffusion lengths [2]. Despite such exceptional characteristics for these materials, the biggest hurdle towards commercialization of perovskite solar cells is their instability and related costs [3].
This project involves the fabrication of hybrid (organic-inorganic) perovskite solar cells in which stability issue can be addressed through compositional engineering, substituting/mixing cation A, and halide ion, X, separately in ABX3 with various elements which changes the crystal structure imparting stability to solar cell. Cost can be addressed by replacing the expensive hole transport material, Spiro-oMeTaD, with cost effective alternative Copper Thiocynanate.  
The proposed research topic will not only be helpful in developing relatively stable, efficient and cost effective new functional layers of hybrid perovskite solar cells but also a big step towards commercialization of perovskite solar cells.

data.projectName: Carboxylation of Organic Halides and Unsaturated Hydrocarbons with Carbon dioxide Catalyzed by Base-metals
data.projectDigest:
The proposed project involves base metals-catalyzed synthesis of saturated and unsaturated carboxylic acids via activation of carbon dioxide as one-carbon (C1) source. Since the catalysts (iron/ manganese/ Cobalt) to be used and the reactant carbon dioxide are all cheap, abundant and non-toxic, the proposed synthesis will greatly improve the overall economy and safety for their process industry. Use of carbon dioxide as one-carbon (C1) source for the production of industrial chemicals is a more sensible and sustainable resource management. Until now, most of the carbon raw materials are derived from crude oil, natural gas and coal. Due to these facts, utilization of CO2 has recently received increasing attention by the scientific and industrial community. However, there are more challenges regarding activation and utilization of CO2 because it is the highest oxidized form of carbon, thermodynamically stable and/or kinetically inert in some anticipated reactions. So, in most of the reported reactions highly reactive substrates (organolithiums and Grignard reagents) and/or strong reaction conditions are used to activate CO2, which limit the utilities of these protocols. 
The proposed project involves the base-metals-catalyzed synthesis of saturated and unsaturated carboxylic acids from alkyl bromides/ iodides, olefins, alkynes and CO2 as reactants. The alkyl halides used in this conversion are readily obtained from alkanes by halogenation or from alcohols and hydrogen halides, whereas the alkenes and alkynes are commercially available. 
The current proposed project results will be used to optimize an economical route for the synthesis of industrially useful acetic acid and acrylic acid.

The alkyl halides used in this conversion are readily obtained from alkanes by halogenation or from alcohols and hydrogen halides, whereas the alkenes and alkynes are commercially available. 
The current proposed project results will be used to optimize an economical route for the synthesis of industrially useful acetic acid and acrylic acid.

data.projectName: Indigenization of Diagnostic Kit for early stage dengue virus detection
data.piUniversity: National University of Medical Sciences, Rawalpindi
data.projectDigest: Dengue virus (DENV) infection is a tropical infectious diseases. In Pakistan, first case of dengue was reported in 1994 and later faced four dengue epidemics in 2006, 2010, and 2011 and recently in 2019. Unfortunately, still Pakistan is not able to control and manage dengue. WHO guidelines recommend treatment for dengue infection that is only early diagnosis and electrolyte replacement therapy. Early stage diagnosis made disease manageable. Major dilemma is no industry in Pakistan is manufacturing dengue diagnostic kits. Most of the diagnostic kits are imported in Pakistan from other countries. Due to which these tests are unaffordable to poor population and often maladapted to low resource poor settings which lacks basic health care facilities. There is an urgent need of indigenization of dengue diagnostic kits. We have designed a Diagnostic Kit based on electrochemical biosensor technology for Dengue NS1 antigen detection showing good sensitivity, specificity, and cost effectiveness. This innovative indigenous solution (prototype) will contribute to control and manage dengue outbreak through need based production in future in case of unexpected outbreak. Principal Investigator has obtained preliminary results and rest of the project is designed to complete prototype establishment.  Our industry partner will be responsible to commercialize nascent product.

data.projectName: Modeling the effect of Socioeconomic, Climatic Condition and Topography on Malaria and denguei Prevalence in different Districts of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
data.projectDigest: There are numerous tropical mosquito borne infection diseases recurrently augmented in the last five years  due to diverse climate scenarios   of southeast Asian countries including Pakistan  . Malaria and dengue are the two widespread mosquito infections that are adding to the morbidity and mortality of our community. Concurrent malaria and dengue infection is an important condition that is rarely reported and analyzed. In this explicit study, we will explore the effect of important factors including Socioeconomic, Climatic Condition and Topography on the Prevalence of Malaria and dengue. This study is planned to assess the population infection status of patients to facilitate in supporting strategies for better utilization of resources and implementation of programme interventions in a more integrated manner. Modern statistical approaches will be used to understand these mosquito infectious in temporal and spatial perspectives in the targeted areas. This will facilitate in supporting strategies for better utilization of resources and implementation of different interventions in more integrated and coherent manner. Situational analysis through proposed programme shall provide a view of the persistent infections for ascertaining the impact and implementation of short and long term measures for the public health well being of people belonging to targeted areas of  KP.

data.projectName: Synthesis of environmentally compatible and green three dimensional macroporous/ mesoporous catalysts and their use as a potable separation tools for the removal of air pollutant
data.projectDigest: The main aim of this research work is to introduce a green environmentally compatible catalytic technique that not only remove and clean the natural ambient environment from different pollutants such as aerosol particles and PM2.5, 10 but also provide regenerative potable green device on the demands of the modern technological world.  Now imagine a novel 3DOMM porous regenerative green catalyst system that not only clean the environment by society and small size community base but also reduce our exposure to polluted environment and prevent from respiratory, skin and early mortality diseases. The aim of this project is to synthesize environmentally compatible and green exhaust gas reversible switchable catalyst with comparative, economically viable enhance toxicant PM2.5 recovery from different environmental samples. Our goal to design and mechanize such kind of potable technology and green reversible solid phase macro-meso 3DOMM material method to purify environment to the EPA air standards set for a healthy society and minimize the environmental pollution impact on human being. Innovative and green reversible switchable solid phase macro-meso 3DOMM material for the potable removal system will be introduced for the elimination of toxic PM2.5 in different environmental samples. The proposed approach will be introduced a novel green potable approach that reduced aerosol air pollutant and PM2.5, 10 and opening-up a new environmental friendly horizon for removing pollutant from environmental samples.

data.projectName: Net economi welfare of residual burning

data.projectName: Potential of GO-Ag Nanocomposite against Pathogenic and Non-Pathogenic Bacteria
data.piUniversity: Khwaja Fareed University of Engineering and Information Technology, Rahim Yar Khan
data.projectDigest:
Present project is basic research project and deals with synthesis of Ag Nanoparticle-Grapheneoxide (Ag-GO) composite material and evaluation of their anti-bacterial activity against drug resistant bacterial strains. All living organism are always under attack of different bacterial strains since their origin. These bacterial attacks has caused a great monetary loss of livestock and also infected human health. It is also expected that composite material will show combinatorial effect and will behave as a more potent bactericidal agent.  
The research work of project can be divided into following steps.
a)	Collection, drying and grinding of plant materials.
b)	Extraction of phytochemicals from ground plant material.
c)	Fractionation of plant extract into hexane, ethyl acetate and water fractions.
d)	Synthesis of Ag NPS of different sizes, physiology and morphology with plant extract fractions at different experimental conditions of concentration, temperatura and pH.
e)	Synthesis and functionalization of grapheneoxide from graphite.
f)	imbibition of silver nanoparticles over grapheneoxide surface to synthesize Ag-GO composite materials.
g)	Characterization of Ag NPs and Ag-GO composite materials using techniques such as; X-ray differection, SEM, TEM etc.
h)	Evaluation of anti-bacterial activity of composite material against available bacterial resistant starains.
i)	The publication of results in peer reviewed journals.

data.projectName: Comparative analysis of resistant/tolerant genes expression against drought stress in cotton
data.piUniversity: University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Lahore
data.projectDigest: Drought is a major constraint to crop production in Pakistan where seasonal heavy rain, floods, or inappropriate irrigation are frequently encountered. Drought tolerance in cotton is a polygenic trait whose genes reside on regions called Quantitative Trait Loci (QTL). The progeny along with the parents selected for various drought tolerance contributing traits and crosses will be genotyped. The evaluation of drought tolerance based on leaf color will be performed for preliminary analysis of short-term drought stress. Then QTL analysis will be performed by using various markers and QTL map will be obtained. After this, to estimate the role of various genes in drought tolerance, genomic analysis will be performed using differential display technique. The identified genes can be cloned to get drought tolerant cotton genotypes. Analysis of sequence data and gene products will facilitate the identification and cloning of genes at target QTLs. Therefore, this study provides useful information in cotton breeding for cultivar selection for drought stress tolerance.

data.projectName: Biochemical and Metabolomic Screening of Various Medicinal Plants to Ameliorate the Risk Factors of Diabetes Mellitus through PreClinical Trials
data.projectDigest:
The project will be divided in two sections in vitro and in vivo trials. During in vitro analysis 15 medicinal plants would be selected and bioactive compounds would be extracted. The extracts of these medicinal plants will be screened through Biochemical and Metabolomic profiling. In biochemical profiling the antihypertensive and Antilipidemic potential of these medicinal plants will be evaluated through in vitro ACE inhibition and HMGCoA Reductase inhibition assay. The screened medicinal plants will be subjected to LC-MS and NMR for the analysis of bioactive compounds. These plants will be further evaluated for their antioxidants potential through FRAP and DNA Protection assay. The toxicological evaluation of these selected medicinal plants would also be performed through Hemolytic and Mutagenic assay. 
After in vitro analysis the antidiabetic potential of screened medicinal plants will be executed through in vivo analysis in rats. During in vivo analysis different doses of screened medicinal plants will be formulated through Response Surface Methodology to get the optimum dose of each plant. The combinations of these optimum doses will be formed to have a potent herbal formulation that would not only able to control the diabetes directly but also able to ameliorate the risk factors related to it.

data.projectName: Exploration and Evaluation of Celestitie Deposits in Southern Khirthar Range, Sindh, Pakistan
data.projectDigest:
Economically important minerals play an important role in the GDP of any country, if properly exploited. Like so many other countries, Pakistan is also rich in various natural resources including fossil fuels, metallic, non-metallic, and ceramic minerals. Though, at present, the mineral resources are not contributing so much in the GDP but it is the need of time that the available natural resources may be utilized at a profit and the exploration of new ones should be carried out to meet the future challenges of the country.
Though, a few of the explored mineral resource deposits are being used within country and likewise being exported but to meet the domestic needs, majority of the materials are being imported and a lot of foreign exchange is usually utilized. Keeping this thing in mind, we have to focus on the exploration and evaluation of the indigenous resources and their full utilization. So far, like other minerals, a few deposits of celestite are also reported from different areas of Pakistan but still we are importing the raw and final products of celestite to meet our country needs. Considering the scenario, the present research project is designed to explore and evaluate the deposits of celestite in the Southern Khirthar Range to meet the country’s demand of celestite, if the results will be promising.

data.projectName: Synthesis and characterization of 6-(3-hydroxy-4-methoxyphenyl)-4-oxo-2-thioxo-1,2,3,4-tetrahydropyrimidine-5-carbonitriles  for detection of toxic metal ions  at trace levels
data.projectDigest:
The discharge of metallic contaminated industrial effluents into environmental aqueous bodies is potential threat to human health due to its non-biodegradable nature. Excess intake of heavy metal ions through food chain and/or other means is toxin to the human and causes serious health problems. So ultra-trace determinations of toxic metal ions in industrial waste water before discharge to environmental water samples is mandatory. In routine, Flame atomic absorption spectrometer (FAAS) has been used for the determination of metal ions in water. But this instrument has problem of insufficient sensitivity, which cannot detect the ultra-trace amount of toxic metal ions in water samples. For solving this type of problems, this project is designed. 
In this project, new methods will be developed 
The proposed project we will focus on the synthesis and characterization of 6-(3-hydroxy-4-methoxyphenyl)-4-oxo-2-thioxo-1,2,3,4-tetrahydropyrimidine-5-carbonitrile and its derivatives for detection of toxic metal ions  at trace levels.  The synthesized materials will be characterized by FT-IR, 1HNMR, 13CNMR spectroscopy, Mass spectrometry, elemental analysis, TGA, XRD, EDX and SEM techniques. The materials possess hetero atoms (N, O and S) and different polar functional groups.

data.projectName: Independent and Additive effects of nutrient supplementation in the management of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome associated dysfunctions: A double blind randomized controlled clinical trial
data.projectDigest: Polycystic ovary syndrome is a condition which is manifested by certain polycystic ovarian morphologic features, hyperandrogenism and ovulatory dysfunction. As per the revised diagnostic criteria by National Institute of Health 2012, about 6 to 10% women of the reproductive age are affected by the classic polycystic ovarian syndrome. One important cause of distress in patients with this syndrome is the excessive expression of androgens (e.g., hirsutism) which leads to infertility. A number of reports based on PCOS suggest that genetic anomalies of follicular maturation and ovarian steroidogenesis also have a crucial role in the development and occurrence of PCOS (1). This disorder is polygenic in nature and contributes towards metabolic diseases like obesity. About 50 to 80% women having PCOS are obese. PCOS also has a connection with an elevated risk of cardiovascular disease. The first-line and previous treatment options for PCOS include Combine Oral Contraceptives and progestin-only contraceptives, and infertility drugs, such as letrozole or clomiphene, metformin, and spironolactone. The aforementioned drugs have been proven efficacious for treating symptoms but had diverse health effects like nausea (66%), mood changes (64%), breast tenderness or pain (60%), abdominal pain (59%), and back pain. This suggests that the majority of drugs exert gastrointestinal adverse effects and thus a need to explore the therapeutic potential of naturally occurring compounds like Resveratrol, L-Carnitine, L-Arginine etc. for PCOS treatment is direly required. Hence, our work could have potential clinical implications. The expected project execution time is 2 years. The outcome of the project will be used as publication in high impact international journals.

data.projectName: Development of Kevlar (Aramid) Fabric & Epoxy Based Adhesive For Polymer Fiber Reinforced Concrete (PFRC) Infrastructure
data.piUniversity: NED University of Engineering & Technology, Karachi
data.projectDigest:
Concrete structures currently in service have a determined service life and start to lose their structural-integrity as they age and are prone to hazardous accidents, in-order to provide maximum safety either replacement or reinforcement and repair of the structure is required.  Replacement of structures as bridges, flyovers and Sky-Scrapers are extremely costly. To deal with the deteriorating properties and maintaining structural integrity post construction reinforcing agents are in high demands. 
This project is concerned with the synthesis of a structural adhesive and in-house development of wraps and fabric of Kevlar and/or aramid fibers for used in Polymer fiber reinforced concrete (PFRC) applications. As prepared Kevlar and/or aramid fabric with various textures and fiber volumetric ratioswere used for Laminating on concrete substrate with the help of synthesized special structural adhesive to facilitate the effective bonding of these fabric to the concrete substrateact as reinforcing agent on already existing concrete structures. The adhesive is a two-part epoxy consisting of the epoxy and a hardener. data.projectName: Tracking of Bone Marrow Mesenchymal Stem Cells Transplanted in Skin for Wound Healing
data.projectDigest: Stem cells has ability to regenerate and differentiate into new cell type but proper healing require the survival of transplanted stem cells as hypoxic environment was found in the healing margin of burn wounds. This situation will create hindrance in survival of transplanted stem cells in burn area that’s why we plan to preconditioned stem cell with antioxidant N-acetyl cysteine to enhance the survival of transplanted stem cells at burn site. Further tracking of transplanted cells and counting the no. of live cells is important for proper wound healing. Keeping in view the all above information, the present study is designed to investigate the homing and survival of preconditioned BMSCs in normal as well as burn wound, and response of transplanted BMSCs that may contribute to cellular wound repair. This study will provide some new information regarding stem cell based wound repair and will ultimately help in modulating these cells in the clinical setting, particularly for enhancing transplantation effectiveness.

data.projectName: IoT and Android Based Architecture for Health Care Monitoring
data.projectDigest: The increased use of mobile technologies and smart devices in the health zone has brought extraordinary effect on the world’s health care. Health specialists and doctors are using these technologies to create critical change in medicinal services during clinical settings. Likewise, many users are being served from the upsides of the Mobile Health applications and E-Health to enhance, help and assist their well-being. The Internet of things is progressively permitting to share medical data with specialists such as doctors. The proposed work will utilize readings from sensors such as pulse, temperature, and ECG in Medical Care Unit and share it with doctors using IoT technology. Also, these measurements will be received through an android app. The doctor will be alerted when the readings exceeds from their normal values and after the alert the doctor will suggest the recommended action.

data.projectName: GERMPLASM IMPROVEMENT FOR DISEASE RESISTANCE, SHORT DURATION AND HIGH YIELDING LENTIL GENOTYPES USING RAPID BREEDING CYCLE METHOD
data.piUniversity: Pir Mehr Ali Shah Arid Agriculture, University Rawalpindi
data.projectDigest: Lentil (Lens culinaris Medikus), is the second largest grown legume Rabi crop in Pakistan. Fusarium wilt (Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. lentis) and Aschochyta blight (Aschochyta lentis) causes yield losses to about 40-70  %. Developing extra short duration lentil varieties with high yielding, disease and lodging resistant will be attractive choice for farmers. Genetic architecture of crop can be improved through conventional and non conventional techniques. Non conventional approachs (Molecular markers) have been successfully used in identification of resistant sources with improve plant architecture. In view of the above information, the proposed study is planned to identify potential disease tolerant genes involved in disease (wilt and blight) and early maturity. About 100 genotypes (local & exotic) will be screened against target traits by creating artificial disease condition. Several molecular markers (SSR) will be developed and checked for tagging of resistant genes. Highly resistant and susceptible genotypes with early maturity will be selected for hybridization. Selection will be done in F2 generation through field screening and molecular markers. Introgression of resistant genes in susceptible genotypes will be done through repeated backcrossing using speed breeding. The F5 –F6 plant population with improved resistance and earliness will be available to research and farming community.

data.projectName: Morpho-cultural and biochemical characterization of Streptomyces spp., their evaluation and applications as biocontrol against Fusarium wilt of cotton
data.projectDigest: Cotton either in the form of seed or waste is very useful for Humans and animals. Cotton is used in wide range of products i.e. clothing, home furnishing and medical products etc. These facts indicate the importance of cotton in Pakistan economy.  The strength and weakness of the economy depends upon cotton. Unfortunately, in Pakistan, the productivity of cotton is significantly low as compared to the world cotton production.  Instead of all other management issues and transfer of farmer’s interest towards sugarcane production, diseases are still the major concern. Until now, 17 fungal, 10 viral, 4 plant parasitic nematodes, 3 bacterial and 2 spiroplasmal and phytoplasmal diseases has been reported in cotton in the world. However, in Pakistan, reports of rots, anthracnose, leaf spots, leaf curling, stenosis, bad opening of bolls (Tirak) has been available. Keep in view these reports emphasizes the importance of initial growth of cotton plant. In this respect, cotton wilt is very important and dangerous disease causing sudden death of whole plant with increased severity leading towards ploughing out whole field. Prevalence of Fusarium wilt is common in sandy and acidic soils, synergistic mechanism with nematodes causing increasing in incidence. It is transmitted through seeds and prefer hot soil. It can infect the plant from seedling to any growth stage. Keeping in view the importance of cotton in Pakistan economy, this project will focus on developing environment friendly, persistent and more reliable method (Biocontrol) to manage Fusarium wilt of cotton. To achieve the project goals, comprehensive survey of cotton growing areas of Punjab will be done to monitor problem at farmer field level followed by isolation, identification and characterization of prevailing pathog

data.projectName: Beneficial effect of natural and synthetic flavonoids with learning and memory enhancing potentials associated with diabetes in animal model
data.piUniversity: University of Malakand, Chakdara, Dir, Malakand
data.projectDigest: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a complex neurodegenerative syndrome featured by a progressive decline in learning, memory, and other cognitive capabilities. It is important to discover new molecules with potential nootropic associated with Alzheimer’s disease activity. As per our previous research during our research group study we have screened different natural and synthetic molecules for diabetes band memory enhancement using animal models. Diabetes with its linked hyperglycemia leads to various type of peripheral damages and also harms the central nervous system (CNS). Streptozotocin (STZ, glucosamine-nitrosourea) which was originally identified as an antibiotic is a valid investigation model for researchers to assess the new treatments. It can escort to impairments of cerebral glucose and energy metabolism, Ab accumulation, hyperphosphorylation of tau proteins, increase of acetylcholinesterase (AChE) activity, inflammation  and oxidative stress that cause cognitive deficits.  Polyphenolic compounds have been extensively investigated and have shown as neuroprotective agents. Flavonoids correspond to an eminent group of polyphenols and till now, more than 9000 flavonoids have been reported. In conclusion, in this research work will be an attempted to explore the memory enhancement effects of flavonoids and will be characterized and evaluated In-vitro, In-vivo and ex-vivo to make it a drug substance.

data.projectName: Fostering a Sustainable Research Culture in Pakistani Universities: A way forward for Professional Development of Research Scholars
data.projectDigest:
Young scholars are the future of our research. To utilize their maximum potential they need to develop and flourish by providing a sustainable research culture at institutional as well as country level. This research project would be an effort to have an in-depth understanding of the problems and deficiencies faced by young scholars when they come to research and how these problems contribute in shaping a research culture which is unable to contribute a sustainable research in every walk of life for our country to prosper. 
This project will follow a multi phase mixed method design. It will be completed in five consecutive phases. In first phase researcher will conduct thematic analysis of scholars’ queries posed on facebook pages. In second phase interviews from scholars and faculty would be conducted to have more in-depth understanding of the problems and to prepare a research tool for generalization of the issues. In third phase a survey will be conducted from a large sample. In fourth phase experts opinion will be gathered through interviews to suggest a framework for sustainable research culture. In fifth phase final reports will be prepared by integrating the findings from different phases.

data.projectName: Geology and Genesis of Volcanic hosted Iron ore deposits in Chagai Magmatic arc, Balochistan, Pakistan, constrained from geophysical-geochemical characterization and Ore Mineralization.
data.projectDigest: In terms of mineral resources, Balochistan perhaps is an exception to other parts of country. The Province is endowed with huge mineral resources of minerals like copper, gold, lead, zinc, iron, marble, and a fuel mineral coal. The occurrence of aforementioned metallic mineralization have huge industrial prospects in the country. However, it is important to mention here that Saindak and Reko diq copper and gold deposits are giant deposits which have an immense contribution in the economy. These deposits were discovered in 70s. Since then, no such deposits have neither been discovered nor has any research in this domain been conducted ever. The province of Balochistan, particularly District Chagai is rich in mineral deposits such as copper, lead-zinc, gold, iron and rare earth elements (REE).In this regard this project is going to be first of its kind that will be carried out on genesis of Iron ore deposits, and this research project aims to study the origin of Iron ore deposits in context of Tethyan orogenic belt and find the relationship and prospecting zones within the Chagai. The results of this study would directly help the mining industry in the country which would ultimately uplift the national economy.

data.projectName: Cancer-Risk (CR) Assessment using Geostatistical and Groundwater Quality Models: A Case Study in Toba Tek Singh and Jhang districts, Pakistan
data.projectDigest: Health risk assessment (HRA) is an important evaluation tool that correlates speci?c environmental pollution with human health. The occurrences of arsenic in groundwater and mobilization have been found as one of the major groundwater pollutants in Punjab and Sindh provinces of Pakistan with potential health concerns. Chronic As ingestion via drinking water is associated with many human health conditions, including liver, lung, and bladder cancer. Jhang and Toba Tek Singh districts are irrigated by tail channels of the area. The commissioning of canals without subsurface drainage resulted in an increase of water table by 0.25 to 0.60 ft. annually. Groundwater deterioration got more worst since private tube wells are in operation. Cancer-Risk (CR) Assessment using Geostatistical and Groundwater Quality Models will be helpful for sustainable water resource management and water supply optimization for domestic purposes.

data.projectName: Mitigation of adverse impacts of climate change on agricultural productivity through management of soil and water resources in salt land agroforestry system
data.piUniversity: Pakistan Institute of Engineering & Applied Sciences, Islamabad (PIEAS)
data.projectDigest: Salinity is the most serious environmental problems that negatively affect growth of plants in arid/semi-arid regions. World population is increasing rapidly and will reach to 9.6 billion by 2050. Hence, global food demand will increase to cope future requirements.  In this context, salt-affected soils have gained significant importance for increasing global food production and safe guard food security distresses. Climate change is also a big challenge for abruptly growing populations. Climate change is further expected to have varying effects on intensification of salinity. Assessments have indicated that developing countries will have to face additional ecological and socio-economic stresses due to climate change. With food shortages and increased threats on climate change, interest in agroforestry is gathering for its potential as a climate resilient and restoration strategy. Agroforestry increase soil carbon storage, reduce greenhouse gases (GHGs) emission and help maintain production at desirable level. However, farmers, generally, do not like to adopt agroforestry systems due to fallacious perception. Hence, understanding of role in ecological restoration and economic performance of agroforestry systems is imperative. Therefore, project is aimed to address issues of climate change and loss in agricultural productivity through agroforestry to tackle these emerging challenges.

data.projectName: The beginning of digital Pakistan: where should fog services be deployed
data.projectDigest:
Real-time applications such as online gaming, healthcare, intelligent agriculture, and video conferencing have on-demand requirements to provide quality results within the agreed time. Using cloud platform to deploy similar applications offers several benefits including reduced operational costs, on-demand service allocation and management. However, these applications may become sensitive to the quality of networks. Therefore, their service requirements could, possibly, be addressed through the emerging fog computing technology. The rationale of commissioning this technology is to allow services allocated within the proximity of customers and closer to where computational results are desirable. This could be achieved through deploying small-scale datacenters closer to customers and connected to original cloud datacenters through dedicated or third-party networks. 
Besides missing their management systems, there are certain questions that needs to be investigated. For example; where these datacenters should be deployed; which services should be installed; where and how resources should be allocated to users’ applications; how user mobility should be handled; and how the system should be optimized to minimize various objectives. Major use cases for fog technology include: intelligent agriculture, healthcare, smart cities and traffic management. Some of these will be of utmost importance to service providers in the era of new digital Pakistan.

data.projectName: Does non-specific musculoskeletal pain in patients with functional hypoparathyroidism respond to vitamin D? A randomized control trial
data.projectDigest: Musculoskeletal pain is a common health issue encountered in healthcare settings. Studies have identified several potential factors which may contribute in the development of musculoskeletal pain, but data on a specific source is still lacking. A significant contributor that has been investigated in several clinical researches is vitamin D deficiency. Studies have suggested that deficiency of vitamin D can result in the development of bone and muscular pain. However, the data which is available cannot be generalized for all age groups as most of the studies have targeted postmenopausal women and have compared non-standard dosage regimen of vitamin D supplementation without clear justification. This this open label randomized control trial is aimed to assess effect of different vitamin D dosages on reduction in non-specific musculoskeletal pain among both men and menstruating females. The study will also assess nutritional marker and sunlight exposure for assessing potential causes of vitamin D deficiency.
data.projectSummary: Musculoskeletal pain is a common health issue encountered in healthcare settings. Studies have identified several potential factors which may contribute in the development of musculoskeletal pain, but data on a specific source is still lacking. A significant contributor that has been investigated in several clinical researches is vitamin D deficiency. Studies have suggested that deficiency of vitamin D can result in the development of bone and muscular pain. However, the data which is available cannot be generalized for all age groups as most of the studies have targeted postmenopausal women and have compared non-standard dosage regimen of vitamin D supplementation without clear justification. This this open label randomized control trial is aimed to assess effect of different vitamin D dosages on reduction in non-specific musculoskeletal pain among both men and menstruating females. The study will also assess nutritional marker and sunlight exposure for assessing potential causes of vitamin D deficiency.

data.projectName: Big Data Framework of Large-Scale Document Digitization and Analytics With Security and Privacy Preservation
data.piUniversity: Quaid-e-Awam University of Engineering, Sciences & Technology, Nawabshah
data.projectDigest: The manual handling of documents offers a dedicated challenge and has myriad of known issues such as requirement of manpower, human error, cost incurred on labor, latency in accessibility, and fraudulent manipulation. The growing volumes of paper archives in Pakistan government’s departments are making a large-scale data digitization inevitable. This will not only help the departments becoming fully automated and preserving old paper archives which are prone to damage over time, but will also enable predictive and prescriptive analytics to automatically extract useful information from the data. The results of this analytics can be used for a number of tasks including predicting anomalies and risks, providing better insights into an organization’s functional performance, efficient decision making, and maximizing an organization’s productivity. The big data archives generated by the large-scale digitization may also contain sensitive, critical and/or private information which is prone to exposure by the data analytics and big data management. At the same time, susceptibility to information alteration and breaching privacy are ostensible in the digitized big data archives, and require efficient mechanisms of data integrity, protection and privacy preservation. For this purpose, we propose a digitization and data analytic framework, equipped with data security and privacy-preserving mechanisms.

data.projectName: Synthesis of ZnO nanoparticles and the development of low cost Humidity Sensors
data.projectDigest:
We intend to development indigenous Humidity Sensor embedded with ZnO nano-particles. After the synthesis of ZnO nano-particles of different sizes through chemical route, characteristics of the samples will be undertaken till the required optimization for use in the Humidity Sensors. In the second stage, the Humidity Sensor will be designed utilizing inter digital electrodes (IDEs) to detect even the small change of humidity in the active layer made of ZnO nano-particles. Finally, a prototype will be developed followed by its validation and real-time testing.

The successful completion of this project will help the commercialization of the indigenous Humidity Sensors for wide range of applications both out- and indoor environment.
The PI and Co-PIs are experienced researchers with many success stories on their credit. One of the Co-PI is the Executive Director of the CAEPE, a research facility established with the help of international funding, at IIUI Pakistan. This research grant will help establish research facility in the institution of higher education established in the rural area. This joint project will pave path for establishing a research center of Energy in The Namal Institute Mianwali that will contribute to the socio-economic development of the Country

data.projectName: Artificial Intelligence based Dengue Larva Detection System using Drones for Urban Areas
data.projectDigest: The spread of dengue fever in Pakistan has increased significantly during the last year with more than 47000 confirmed cases and 75 deaths reported from July to October 2019. The prevention of dengue fever can be done by eradicating dengue larva at an earlier stage from clean and still water areas. Manual detection of dengue larva requires a large amount of manpower which is not feasible for an under-developing country like Pakistan. In this project, we propose an automated dengue mosquito larva detection system using the advancements in Artificial Intelligence and drone technology. Our system will use a high-tech drone for surveillance of a large urban area. We will develop an advanced deep learning-based workflow to detect the dengue larva in real-time videos. The proposed system will be able to detect dengue mosquito larva at open places such as rooftops, lawns, tires, bins, etc. where there is a high probability of the presence of dengue larva. We will also develop an android-based mobile application for home users to detect larva in indoor environments. The district health authority Bahawalpur has agreed to collaborate with us in developing this system. The proposed system will greatly help in eradicating dengue fever from Pakistan.

data.projectName: Sustainable land and water resources management for food security and livelihood of the local community in Pothwar region of Pakistan
data.projectDigest: Integrated land and water resources management are essential for understanding and analyzing the potential water resources issues associated with water supply for domestic and agriculture to ensure the food and water security for the uplift the socio-economic condition of the local community. The aim of present study will be to develop a sustainable integrated land and water resources management system as a new obtainable water resource for land resources management in Pothwar region of Pakistan. A detailed analysis and investigation will be performed to find out physical, hydro-climatic and socio-economic characteristics of the proposed project area from the available ground and satellite data by using an integrated approach of remote sensing & GIS and different time series models. The land capability and suitability on the bases of color, tone, texture, pattern and land use. The suitable sites with water storage capacities for water storage/harvesting considering different criteria will be estimated by integrated approach of remote sensing and GIS. The best management, land & water resources framework will developed by the detailed investigation of the strategies. This approach will overcome the issue of the food security and socio-ecological mobility of local people

data.projectDigest: Uncertainty and vaguness occurs very often in a number of areas. For example, in medical diagnosis there are chances that a person has or has not a particular disease. Lack of information makes some decisions difficult. If they are on national level, wrong decisions may effect the economy. To handle such situations Intuitionistic fuzzy sets (IFSs) and q-rung orthopair fuzzy sets (q-ROFSs) have been introduced. A big difficulty was how to define these sets for any given information.  This project will answer this question. The project also includes collection and analysis of a real medical data set. This will help doctors and physicians in diagnosis and treatment of cardiovascular diseases.
