data.projectName: CORRELATION BETWEEN SALIVARY STATHERIN AND CALCIUM LEVELS AND ITS INTERRELATIONSHIP WITH CALCIUM HOMEOSTASIS & BCL-2 IN ORAL PRECANCER AND ORAL CANCER PATIENTS
data.piUniversity: DOW University of Health Sciences, Karachi
data.projectDigest:
Oral cancer is the second most common cancer in males and females in Pakistan. Prevention and early detection of oral cancer is needed to reduce the burden of oral diseases in our population and improve of quality of life of patients. Currently the gold standard of oral cancer diagnosis is biopsy and histopathological diagnosis. Biopsy is an invasive procedure that is resource intensive and expensive. Development in the field of salivary diagnostics has created possibilities for early diagnosis of oral cancer.  Salivary diagnostics are used for point of care detection of oral and systemic diseases. There is a huge potential for the use of salivary biomarkers for the detection of oral cancer.
Salivary Statherin is a novel salivary protein involved with calcium homeostasis and its levels have been correlated positively with oral cancer. The diagnostic value of salivary Statherin as a salivary biomarker for oral cancer needs to be elucidated. 
In this study we aim to evaluate the diagnostic value of Statherin as a salivary biomarker for early diagnosis of oral cancer by exploring the link between Statherin and calcium levels and its relationship with altered calcium homeostasis  in oral cancer using apoptotic BCL-2 markers while comparing with healthy controls.

data.projectName: Discipline Specific Material Development and Technology Enhanced Learning Programme of the Functional English Courses for the BS Engineering Students in Pakistan
data.projectDigest: The discipline of Engineering plays a significant role in the development of any country in the modern era. The HEC has introduced Functional English courses namely Functional English, Communication skills and Technical Report writing for all BS level Programs. The HEC course outlines for the courses are general and almost replicated in all the disciplines. The guidelines are followed by the English Language Teachers of Pakistan and most of them teach general English in these courses. Many studies have recommended English for Specific Purposes for the English courses of engineering students. The aim of the project is to develop study material, in the light of HEC Course outlines,  Functional English courses of above mentioned disciplines from their respective fields at the Bachelors Level.  It means the students of BS Mechanical Engineering will study English which is used in their field. The material will be developed from their core subject textbooks and research papers of their respective field. The material for English courses will be developed for all the disciplines of engineering. An action group will be formed to finalize the material. The experts of engineering from all the major engineering universities will be included in the action group. The material will be developed keep in view the HEC course outlines for the Functional English courses of BS Engineering programmes. The second phase of the project will be technology Enhanced Learning Program. In this phase, the study material will be developed in the form of books, PowerPoint Presentations and videos will be available on the companion website of the project.  It will help the BS engineering students to improve written and spoken communication in their respective fields.

data.projectName: Security, Privacy, and Usability Evaluation of Critical Pakistani Websites
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest:
Critical Pakistani websites collect and process sensitive user data. These include websites belonging to the government, banking, ecommerce, education, and health sector. It is pertinent that these websites are secure, ensure the privacy of user data, provide good user experience and are accessible. However, recent cyber incidents demonstrate that Pakistani websites possess security vulnerabilities as well as privacy and usability issues. The goal of this project is to help improve the security, privacy, and usability of such websites by taking the first step of evaluating and scoring them on each of these areas based on established standards and guidelines from NIST, OWASP, FTC, Nielsen Norman Group, and US Department of Health and Human Services. The end-products of this project are as follows:
1.	An open-source vulnerability scanner for websites that generates a security strength score of each website and summarizes its vulnerabilities
2.	A database of critical Pakistani websites that support two-factor authentication
3.	A browser extension that can help a user detect if a website supports two-factor authentication
4.	Privacy policy analysis of websites in various sectors. e.g., what percentage of websites in each sector have a privacy policy, and if a website has a privacy policy what is its score based on the established privacy guidelines and accessibility of the policy
5.	A privacy policy summarizing tool based on user preferences
6.	An automated usability and accessibility assessment tool for websites

data.projectName: Balochistan University of Information Technology, Engineering, and Management Sciences (BUITEMS),Quetta
data.piUniversity: Balochistan University of Information Technology, Engineering and Management Sciences,Quetta
data.projectDigest: The demand for the synthesis of complex and bioactive molecules is growing both in industry and academia due to various health care issues facing by human beings. The proposed project is designed to synthesize medicinally potent intermediates which overcome such health care issues. In this connection, the work in this project will be initiated by synthesis of a multifunctional cheap substrates “Mrita-Baylis- Hillman (MBH) adducts” through a well-known Morita-Baylis-Hillman reaction. Then the MBH adducts will be converted to a range of respective bioactive advanced intermediates i.e. Oximes, Amides, Schiff bases, Hydrazones and their respective heterocyles. All these compounds will be achived by reported methodologies. The prepared intermediates will be further transformed into more advanced intermediates, paricularly the oximes and hydrazones will be transformed into heterocycles via  Buchwald-Hartwig reaction. After required chromatographic purification and spectroscopic characterization, all the synthesized compounds will be evaluated for different bioactivities. This simple, and straightforward stratagy will allow us a library of new MBH adduct based advanced intermediates (mentioned above) of high structural and medicinal importance. Additionally this work will demonstrate utilization of MBH adducts as a first example in synthesis of the above mentioned classes of compounds and will evalute scope of the MBH reaction.

data.projectName: Developing soymilk for ensuring food security under changing climate through soybean productivity and nutritional value enhancement by chemo-priming and foliage applied natural and synthetic growth promoters in Azad Jammu and Kashmir
data.projectDigest: Climate change and skyrocketing population have seriously compromised the food and nutritional security especially in Azad Jammu & Kashmir region of Pakistan. The existing production of milk is quite low compared to population growth rate and this scenario demands exploiting alternate sources especially for temperate hilly areas, where rough terrain makes forage production for dairy animals prone to natural climatic disasters such as snowfall, torrential rainfall etc. Soymilk which may be prepared by soaking and grinding soybean seeds, offers an unprecedented potential to fulfill milk demand. The nutritional quality of soymilk is directly depended on nutritional profile of soybean grains, while ample quantities of soybeans are required to prepare soymilk. However, soybean grain yield and nutritional value continues to remain suboptimal in Azad Jammu & Kashmir region, while growth promoter’s application may serve as biologically doable and economically viable strategy for enhancement of soybean grain yield and nutritional quality. Local food industry may get a potential food product with the great market potential leading to development of new brand and generating huge revenues through capturing market. General public may get good quality, nutritional, hygienic and economic milk supplement (although not alternate) of cow milk.

data.projectName: Construction of DNA barcode reference library for freshwater fishes of Punjab, Pakistan:  implications for systematic, evolution and  sustainable conservation
data.piUniversity: Government Sadiq College Women University, Bahawalpur
data.projectDigest: Reliable examine and record of current freshwater fish fauna is imperative for systematic and evolutionary studies. DNA barcoding is a versatile, simple and reliable species identification tool, the information from which can be used to monitor and recording the systematic data on species diversity of a region. Hence current study has been purposed at national level to create a standardised reference DNA barcode library for fish fauna of Pakistan. Launch of a comprehensive barcoding reference library of freshwater fishes of Punjab, Pakistan will permit proficient assessment of species, and smooth the progress for sustainable conservation and management of regional fishery resources. The IBOL (International Barcode of Life) avowed that ‘‘DNA barcoding can be apply to different species recognition, in the similar means, as a superstore scanner make use of universal product code (UPC) barcode black strip to identify the purchase items’’ Accordingly, the establish barcode sequence library will be confidently use as a point of reference for identification of freshwater fish fauna of Punjab, Pakistan. Moreover, freely available online DNA barcodes database of distinct vouchered reference sequences will be helpful for identification of both fresh specimens and market products such as frozen fish in the fishery industry for control of product authenticity and origin and for clearing potentially harmful exports and imports.

data.projectName: Pakistani Women in Higher Education: Work related issues and challenges
data.piUniversity: National University of Modern Languages, Islamabad (NUML)
data.projectDigest: The proposed study is aimed to investigate the antecedents of work family conflict and its outcomes among the female employees working in higher education institutions. The study is designed to examine the impact of work-family conflict on the physical and mental well-being of the female University teachers. Moreover, the study aimed to find out the role of contextual factors in managing the work family conflict. The most common problems because of the conflict are feeling stressed out and fatigued, feeling less qualified and job dissatisfaction. The work family conflict can be better explained by the work related variables (nature of employment, working hours, poor leadership relations) and family related variables (marital status, number of children etc). Organizational support in the form of policies that addresses financials(higher taxes ,less wages ,job security) and other related support (health benefits, annual leaves, entrepreneurial workplace support. The population for the current research will be the faculty member of higher education institutions working in public and private sector universities who are experiencing work-family conflict and suffering from health related outcomes in their lives

data.projectName: Strengthening connections between the Academia and Industry: Highlighting the geological research advancements in mining and construction industry
data.projectDigest:
The proposed research project is designed to strengthen the connection between academic institutions and commercial organizations i.e. construction and mining industry, which is scarcely established in our country. In this regard, liaison has been made with active engineering projects in regions of Swat, Chitral, Waziristan, DI Khan, Hazara, Indus Kohistan and Gilgit. The nature of projects covers the broader scope of Engineering Geology including highways and dam sites (comprising tunneling and ground conditions). The major emphasis of the project is towards the identification of cost and time effective methods for determination of mechanical behavior of rock materials using advancements in geological research.
The mechanical nature of rocks can be assessed by their exposure to varying physical conditions. The rocks from different project regions will be petrographically examined under normal field conditions followed by their exposure to different pressure and temperature ranges. The petrographic examination after the testing yields significant textural variations that can be used to understand the mechanical behavior of rocks under changing physical conditions. 
Frequent productive communications have been made with relevant and leading companies (e.g. NESPAK, AGES, GRC) of Pakistan working in active engineering projects in the mentioned regions. The major contributions of the industrial partners during the project include accessibility measures to the project sites and exposure to the mechanical and geological dataset already generated during the running project span. The said data will be tied with new dataset for the statistical and interpretative modelling for generation of novel petrographic indices for estimation of mechanical behaviour.

data.projectName: Thermal and Single Molecular Magnetic properties of Metal calixarene derivatives
data.projectDigest: Single Molecular Magnetism (SMM) is a new emerging field of study due to its diverse uses in many fields like fabrication of storage devices, quantum computing, spintronics etc. Metal derivatives with different set of ligands have been found with wonderful magnetism by utilizing its nuclearity. Few transition metal ions like manganese, Iron, cobalt reveal spin multiplicities and anisotropies but the spin multiplicities and anisotropies in lanthanides and actinides are large enough that warrant them to study for single molecular magnets. Calixarenes are bowl-shaped ligands and good candidates for synthesizing cluster compounds. Therefore lanthanides and actinides based calixarene macrocycles will be used for the possible exploration of single molecular magnets. Different macrocyclic calixarene derivatives will be synthesized and characterized through spectral techniques followed by their reactions with transition metal ions, lanthanides and actinides. All the compounds will be studied spectroscopically and if possible through single crystal diffraction analyses. Initial measurements for their paramagnetism will be studied using EPR spectroscopy followed by low temperature SQUID techniques. Magnetic anisotropies and hysteresis  will be manipulated for single molecular magnetism. The materials synthesized will also be thermally studied using TG and DTA analysis for their thermal cracking.

data.projectName: Alternatives Therapeutics to Curtail Multi-Drug Resistant ESKAPE Pathogens
data.piUniversity: University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Lahore
data.projectDigest: Antibiotics play a vital role in treating and controlling bacterial infections. However, over and misuse of antibiotics leads to development of resistance. Now a day’s antibiotic resistance has become a global challenge. Some pathogens are threat to public health due emergence of resistance to antibiotics used for treatment. These are ESKAPE (Enterococcus faecium, Staphylococcus aureus, Klebsiella pneumonae, Acinetobacter baumanni, Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Enterobacter spp. Enterococcus faecium) pathogens and called “Bad Bugs with no Drugs”. The infection of ESKAPE pathogens is associated with high morbidity and mortality, prolong illness and high cost on treatment.  There is a need to develop new drugs to curtail these pathogens. But drug development is a lengthy process and emergence of resistance to new drugs cannot be ignored. Penicillin was used in patients in 1940 and Penicillin resistance was reported in 1941. So, alternative therapeutics must be investigated to curtail these superbugs. Phytochemicals and phage therapy are the options. It is hypothesized that phytochemical may reverse antibiotic resistance and phages specifically kills bacterial pathogens. In present study Multi-drug resistance (MDR) ESKAPE pathogens will be isolated and identified from us/wound swabs, blood, respiratory and urine (n=25/each ) samples collected from tertiary care hospitals in Punjab Pakistan. The MDR will be confirmed by polymerase chain reaction using primers of resistance genes.  MDR-ESKAPE will be evaluated for resistance modulation by extracts of (Eucalyptus globulus, Aloe barbadensis, Calotropis procera, Syzygium aromaticum, Zingiber officinale and Moringa oleifera). For this experiment to be carried out antibacterial activity and Minimum Inhibitory Concentration against M

data.projectName: Formulation of surface-active saponins as potential food grade emulsifiers from food wastes
data.projectDigest: The industrially manufactured foods contain numerous additives like preservatives, emulsifiers and various others. These additives are critical during production process, since these directly affect the quality, taste and durability of foodstuffs. Among the emulsifier groups, mostly synthetic compounds are used that are esterified with various mixtures like, sorbinates, polysorbates, lactylates and polyglycerol esters. Recent, studies pointed their adverse effects even at low concentrations. Moreover, the addition of these compounds to functional foods limit their effectiveness. Keeping the synthetic origin and toxicity in mind, various food industries are looking for new and natural emulsifiers together with foaming agents. Recently, the booming industry of Halal and Kosher foods add further interest in finding plant based or natural emulsifiers. The main aim of this project is the characterization of different functional saponins from various fruits and vegetable wastes. The saponins are naturally surface-active agents and can stabilize the food formulations and dispersions comparatively like synthetic emulsifiers. Saponins as secondary metabolites are frequently present in different plants. The main hypothesis of this study is to evaluate the saponin fractions through different organoleptic properties, toxicological studies and to check the interfacial properties of extracted fractions through various emulsion formulations and characterization.

data.projectName: EAMIDS: Energy-Aware Multiple Intrusion Detection Systems for Wireless Sensor Networks
data.projectDigest: Wireless sensor networks are widely used in many application areas ranging from health care services, military surveillance, wildfire monitoring and other commercial applications. Due to the nature of wireless sensor networks and their exposure to unpredictable environments often leads to varying types of attacks on these networks. Various types of attacks and malicious activities occur in wireless that severely affects its functionalities and operations. Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) are used to overcome the security issues and counter various types of wireless sensor network attacks. In the literature, various types of IDS have been proposed to counter a variety of network structure attacks. Most of the proposed intrusion detection systems focus on one or two types of network attacks. Furthermore, IDS can be very effective in decreasing energy consumption. However, most of the proposed intrusion detection systems found in the literature rarely considers the energy aspect of wireless sensor networks. This research work aims to develop and implement (IDS) that can overcome the issues and shortcomings in the existing systems. This research work focuses on developing intrusion detection systems that will be able to counter multiple attacks. Moreover, the proposed IDSs will also consider energy consumption in the wireless sensor network.

data.projectName: Functionalized Graphene Oxide for Internal Sizing of Paper and Board
data.projectDigest:
Neutral/Alkaline Sizing Agents dominates the pulp and paper industry in Pakistan and effectively replaced the acidic rosin-alum sizing system in major paper manufacturing mills e.g. Bulleh Shah Paper & Board Mills, Century Paper and Board Mills, Pack Tech Paper and Board Mills, Premier paper mills etc. Sizing chemicals used in the paper and board mills in Pakistan involve of 1500-1600 tons/year imports of various sizing agents. All sizing chemicals (ASA, AKS etc.) used in Pakistani paper and board mills have been imported spending increasingly huge amounts of foreign exchange. It therefore becomes very necessary to develop/enhance the building of indigenous technology and utilize locally developed materials.
In this work, it has been planned to use hydrophobically functionalized Graphene oxide with Alkyl amines such as octadecylamine (ODA) and dodecylamine (DA) for the sizing of paper and board. This functionalized GO in combination with ASA, AKD and rosin-alum sizing agents, will be used for different paper and board furnishes containing bleached wood pulp and bleached softwood cellulosic fibers. Laboratory made hand-sheets will be characterized to evaluate the sizing efficiency of functionalized GO. We are expecting to reduce the consumption of costly imported sizing chemicals. Development and utilization of indigenous developed materials will save the import costs of sizing chemicals and reduce the dependence on imports.

data.projectName: Green synthesis of silver nano particles using Datura inoxia fruit extracts and evaluation of their pharmacological potential
data.projectDigest: In recent years, the synthesis of metal nanoparticles specifically silver nano particles have  gained quite an advent in modern material science due to their distinctive potential applications in various field such as electronic, magnetic, optoelectronic, information storage and drug delivery. Silver nanoparticles can be produced by a variety of methods, but usually environment friendly procedures such as green synthesis, are preferred to avoid the toxic chemicals in the synthesis protocols for avoiding adverse effects in medical applications. Datura innoxia is one of the very important medicinal plants having stupendous pharmacological profile. In this project, extracts of D. innoxia plant parts (leaves, fruits, flowers, roots) will be employed for the development of metallic nano particles. In order to do so, we will prepare crude extracts of D. innoxia plant parts, using aqueous medium. The crude extracts will be utilized for the preparation of nano particles using one-pot physical method employing various inorganic salts of Ag, Cu, Fe, and Zn. These nano particles will be utilized in in vitro antileishmanial assays against Leishmania tropica promestigotes and amestigotes. Afterwards, most successful samples will be exploited to determine antileishmanial activity specifically against cutaneous leishmaniasis, on BALB/C mice models, followed by genomic analysis of messenger RNA in mice using qPCR technique. Computational analysis will also be carried out to predict target genes and resulting proteins considering the phytochemical contents in the said plant. These nano particles will serve as more potent and less toxic moieties, which can be used as modern therapies for the prevention and treatment of leishmaniasis.

data.projectName: Utilization of ultra-sonicated protein extract from sunflower meal for the development of protein enriched instant drink to alleviate protein energy malnutrition
data.projectDigest: PEM (protein energy malnutrition) and micronutrient deficiencies are continuously being a major health risk with a very large number of pregnant women and young children being particularly affected by this. Pakistan is among the countries in the world with the highest rates of child malnutrition, and its progress in child nutrition and health remains slower than in other South Asian countries. In third world countries, elevation in human population and reduction in available food resources along with elevated utilization of animal based protein have prompted the interest of scientists for exploration of new protein resources from non-conventional raw materials. Sunflower meal/cake is a by-product that is obtained from oil extraction of sunflower seeds and have been reported to contain 30 to 50% of protein. Proteins extracted from sunflower are known as a valuable ingredient by food industry owing to decreased levels of toxic and anti-nutritional compounds. Extraction of these proteins from the meal through conventional techniques is expensive and may not supply the required yield of the product, thus it has become the need of the hour to switch to eco-innovative extraction techniques. Therefore, the researchers are focusing towards affordable, safe, effective, ecologically-innovative extraction techniques, such as, ultrasound assisted extraction.

data.projectName: Synthesis and Cytotoxicity Evaluation against Cancer Cell Lines of Thiosemicarbazones and their Cyclcic Derivatives.
data.projectDigest: Cancer is second leading causes of mortility across the planet which has had affected millions. In spite of massive efforts in producing new molecules and chemotherapeutic approaches for managing cancer, it continued to be the global threat. Cancer cells manipulate various key signaling pathways that allow them to continue dividing by overcoming tight controls that regulate cell death and proliferation in normal cells. TP53 tumor suppressor gene encodes for a transcription factor that is responsible for maintaining genomic integrity. Deregulation of apoptosis-regulating genes can lead to diseases such as cancer and has been related to pathogenesis and cancer progression. Heterocyclic 5-membered compounds are a diverse family of chemical compounds with many important biological activities. Thiazole is very important scaffolds in heterocyclic chemistry in drug design and discovery. Thiazolines are known as drugs, natural products, and pharmacologically active synthetic molecules. Thiazolidine-4-ones are well known for their pharmacological activities. Thiadiazoles are five-membered rings associated with diverse biological and pharmacological properties. Prompted by the observed biological activities, we have designed a project to to synthesize thiosemicarbazones and their cyclic derivatives; Thiazolines, Thiazolidine-4-ones, and Thiadiazoles in order to use them for biological research, e.g., concerning a possible in-vitro ant-cancer activity against tumor cell lines.

data.projectName: Nexus Between She Economy, Digital Enablement, and   Social Competence: A CPEC Based Perspective
data.projectDigest: The “She Economy” is an emerging phenomenon in the world economy. The first time in 2007, China introduced “She Economy” as an economic model. The fifty percent population of the world consists of females and they took more than 70% consumption decisions. In China, about 63.3% of the female population is employed and their contribution to the China GDP is 41%. On the other hand, 48% population of Pakistan consists of females. However, only 1% of Pakistani females are entrepreneurs while males are 21%. Given these facts, it would be imprudent and unjustified to overlook the women consumers/producers’ role in the development of the Pakistan economy. Considering the scenario of China-Pakistan Economic Corridor, the first objective of this study is to understand the She Economy model of China and its comparison with Pakistan s’ She Economy. Second, to evaluate the social competence skills of Chinese female entrepreneurs by comparing with Pakistani ones. Third, following the digital enablement strategy and Taobao Villages model of China, this study will develop e-stores based mobile application to facilitate the female entrepreneurs of Pakistan. Fourth, to perform experimental transactions through e-stores. Last, providing training to females’ entrepreneurs of Pakistan regarding digital technology and social competence.

data.projectName: Development and performance evaluation of heat-driven temperature and humidity control system for thermal comfort of dairy cattle
data.projectDigest: Pakistan’s economy is based on agriculture and livestock sector. Survival of rural areas’ population is directly linked with dairy farming. Available buffalo in Pakistan produce 2-3% lesser amount of milk compared to high-productive foreign cattle breeds. It is because of nature of the breed, climatic conditions, feed priorities, and associated technologies. Thereby, an experimental system will be designed and developed. Results will be thermodynamically analyzed to explore the applicability of the system for various climatic conditions of Pakistan. The introduction and/or replacement of high-productive cattle breeds in Pakistan is a kind of mission statement of the research project.

data.projectName: Task specific Ionic liquid catalytic co-pyrolysis of waste polyolefin and used oil for fuel generation.
data.projectDigest: Fossil fuel is non-renewable, costly and scares commodity in today’s world. Due to the increase in oil prices, research on polymer waste pyrolysis resulting in viable commercial technology is necessary. There is a high probability of converting plastic waste to fuel with high calorific values as a solution to shortage of conventional fossil fuel and a milestone in minimizing the environmental degradation effect of plastic waste. Polyolefin are most widely consumed commodity plastics in the world. Two main components of polyolefin are polyethylene and polypropylene, both constitutes of straight hydrocarbon chains. Thus they are excellent candidate for pyrolysis of plastic waste into fuel. The fuel obtained from this process requires improvement both in quality and quality. Current technologies employ thermal energy and harsh organic solvents rendering process expensive and contaminating. Dissolution of plastic waste in compatible biomass instead of harsh solvents and catalytic pyrolysis using ionic liquids will not only catalyze the reaction but will also render the process green. However, in array of numerous choices of cations and anions to develop ionic liquid, extensive research needs to be done for task specific right combination.Use of used oil as biomass will allow high dissolution and will improve thermodynamic and viscosity parameters. Overall design is to  optimize the process which will benefit in  up-scaling the process and make waste to wealth.

data.projectName: Anti-Cancer Treatment Using Promising Cold Plasma Simulations
data.projectDigest: The treatment of cancerous cells using cold plasma is relatively a new concept that has shown promising outcomes pointing out its potential in this field of plasma oncology. However, extensive research and clinical trials are still to be done for its use among other techniques. In this project, we will propose molecular modeling of the plasma-tissue interactions at microscopic scale and correlate them to their effect at macroscopic scale. Molecular modeling techniques can assist to the understanding of biological objects/systems by tracking them on the computer screen, and may save avoidable experiments/clinical operations. Modeling methods become growing more user/client friendly and various computations may be performed online by non-experts without deep knowledge of the fundamental methods, however, vigilant understanding by an expert is about forever needed to make sure that outcomes are certainly important, which call for a relationship between computer simulations and experiments. Furthermore, molecular dynamics will be simulated the destructive nature of plasma for the cancerous cells using more real and clinical relevant parameters and compare them with those obtained using experimental and numerical results. This proposal will identify the main research challenges that will be faced by the scientists in this fundamental plasma anticancer therapy.

data.projectName: Use of Allelopathy  as organic fertilizers and organic herbicides
data.projectDigest:
Use of Allelopathy  as organic fertilizers and organic herbicides 
	Chemical fertilizer and herbicide were introduced during 1960 in Pakistan. Continuous used of these chemical fertilizers and herbicides have increased the yield of different crops e.g. Wheat, Maize, Rice, Sugar cane etc. But these poisonous chamicals caused environmental hazards like extinction of wild animals and plants(Savci,2012., Marin-Morales et al.,2013)and also caused malignant diseases e.g. cancer  (Weisenburger, 1993).Gradual used of these herbicide and chemical fertilizer are alarming situation for human community and ecosystem. 
	So there is need to find out the substitute of these chemical fertilizers and herbicide. Allelopathy is phenomena in which chamicals are release from one plant and effect the growth of other plants. These chamicals are called Allelochemicals and these can increase or decrease the growth of target plants (Dilday et al.,1994).  Due this allelochemicals can be used as bio fertilizer  and organic herbicides(Kumar et al., 2019) and these biological agents are friendly to environment and non-toxic to human health. Bearing all these consideration in mind the main aim of this project is to find out the Biological fertilizer and organic herbicide by studying the allelopathic effect of some trees like Eucalyptus camaldulensis, Juglans regia, Olea ferruginea, Tamarix indica, Melia azedarach, Sapindus mukorossi and Aliantus altisemia on morpho-anatomical features of Wheat,Maiz,Mustard.

data.projectName: Integrated Sequence Stratigraphy: Implications for the Petroleum System analysis of the Upper Indus Basin, Northwest Pakistan
data.projectDigest:
In the oil and gas industry, construction of a reliable sequence stratigraphic model for a petroleum reservoir can improve the estimation of reserves and making decisions regarding the development of the field, predicting future production, placing additional wells, and evaluating alternatives. This requires developing an integrated reservoir model by integrating geological, geophysical, petrophysical and engineering information in a consistent manner.
Therefore, in this study we aim to use the integrated approach for the reservoir modeling of the Cambrian-Paleogene strata using geological, geophysical and geotechnical data in the study area. This study will help in better understanding of the reservoir characteristics of different Paleogene stratigraphic units and its spatial heterogeneity, variation of porosity & permeability in Kohat-Potwar regions of the Upper Indus Basin.  An integrated reservoir model based on geological, geophysical & engineering data from the Kohat–Potwar Basin would help in identifying the potential areas & reservoir potential for future planning of wells and field development. The model would delineate the thickness of the pay zone and its lateral variation across the study area that can help the Petroleum companies in planning total numbers of wells, reserve estimation & selection of well location with better success and production chances.

data.projectName: Determination of ?-1 acid glycoprotein by High performance Liquid Chromatography in different stress conditions and its effect on drug-protein binding
data.projectDigest: This project aims to find the concentration of ?-1 acid glycoprotein in different diseased and stress conditions, because it is believed that the concentration of ?-1 acid glycoprotein increases in different types of diseases and stress conditions, therefore the drug binding capacity of ?-1 acid glycoprotein also alters. This may lead to either toxicity of the drug if large amount of drug is available in free form of the drug or vice versa. This is a serious problem and needs proper attention on part of doctors and pharmacists to properly adjust the dose in those conditions where the concentration of ?-1 acid glycoprotein varies greatly. In order to asses these conditions we design this project to determine the concentration in different disease and stress conditions. For this purpose the sample from different patients will be provided by District Headquarter Hospital (DHQ) which will be our partners in this project. These samples will then be analyzed by high performance liquid chromatography by developing a high sensitive method for the determination ?-1 acid glycoprotein. The method will be fully validated according to international guidelines. The results will then be calculated and any possible increase in the concentration of ?-1 acid glycoprotein will be evaluated and then its effect on the binding of the drug will be assessed.  This data will then be shared with the hospital regarding the possible changes in the concentration of AGP. Then appropriate action will be taken on the basis of these results to do the dose adjustment according to disease and patient. So this project will help the health professionals to administer the correct dose to patients and improve the overall health of patients.

data.projectName: Seismic Assessment and Development of Design Parameters for Eco-Friendly/Green Energy Reinforced Geopolymer Concrete (RGPC) Frame and Shear Wall Structures
data.projectDigest: To achieve sustainable development in the concrete construction industry a technological turn around is needed to use industrial waste material in the construction industry i.e. decrease demand on the natural resources and to decrease the emission of CO2 in the environment. The Geopolymer binders are one of the efficient materials that can be employed to fully replace the Ordinary-Portland Cement binders in the general concrete construction industry. A great amount of research work has been conducted on the applicability and possible replacement of OPC with Geopolymer binder concrete to achieve green-energy and sustainable constructions.  The previous research shows promising results but most of them are only limited to GPC’s mechanical, thermal, durability, constituent mix proportion aspects, and have only considered member level behaviors. The current research proposal aims to perform seismic assessment and to develop practical design parameters for the Reinforced-Geopolymer-Concrete (RGPC) frame and shear wall structures. In order to assess and develop practical design parameters for RGPC structural systems, detail systematic experimental and numerical studies have been proposed on representative structural systems, built in Geopolymer Concrete.  The results of representative structural system will be used to assess seismic performance and to develop practical design guidelines for RGPC structural systems.

data.projectName: Sperm cryobanking for sustainable production of Labeo rohita (Rohu)
data.piUniversity: Pir Mehr Ali Shah Arid Agriculture, University Rawalpindi
data.projectDigest: The fish seed has been deteriorated over the years due to small number of brood stock, improper management and breeding practices in the hatcheries that started their production with a small founder stock and used the broods for many generations. Thus, the hatchery carps does not have chance of genetic exchange with wild and parental stocks. If any planned breeding program is not initiated, inbreeding and genetic drift may ruin our valuable fish population. Therefore, sperm cryobanking in combination with routine hatchery practices become one of the most urgently required component of conservation program. Sperm cryobanking enables quickly create repositories of sperm samples from individuals of genetically valuable strains for further use especially when semen is difficult to obtain, when low volume of semen is stripped, and importantly for breeding fish at distant hatcheries. However, for effective and sustainable sperm cryobanking activity, both artificial fertilization and sperm cryopreservation protocols should be developed. Therefore, the present study is designed to develop the protocols for cryopreservation of sperm of Labeo rohita with the objectives: 1) Physical and chemical characterization of milt 2) Chilled storage of milt at 4°C 3) Milt cryopreservation at -196°C and 4) First aquaculture oriented use of cryopreserved sperm.

data.projectName: PakAgri-IoT(Pakistan Agriculture-Internet of Things)
data.projectDigest:
Agriculture is an important source of the Pakistan Economy. Pakistan is an agribusiness nation and almost 60% of population relates to farming. Smart Farming and Precision agriculture techniques are being used worldwide, but Pakistan is lacking in the use of Smart Farming applications. Many problems, like diseases and pests, have become more hazardous while farming. Whereas, large number of Pakistani farmers remain unaware or lack in knowledge of the right cultivation techniques. These include pests and disease control, land preparation and irrigation, fertilizing utilities, crop rotation and multi-cropping techniques. IoT based Smart Farming with embedded sensors implemented in the farms while measuring the environmental data leads to the enablement of precision agriculture. Thus, results in improving the productivity, and increase in yields and profitability.  Smart Farming will help in monitoring and improve the major environmental factors within the farm, by applying different techniques such as more efficient system of irrigation, more precise use of the different fertilizers and as well as timely delivery of pesticides for the crop that are cultivated in the farm. Major areas which are famous because of cultivation of their crops such as potato are in Districts of Okara, Sahiwal, Kasur, Sialkot, Sheikhupura, Jhang, Lahore, Narowal, Pakpattan, Gujranwala, TobaTek Singh and Khanewal. Similarly rice is being cultivated in the regions like Gujranwala, Narowal, and Daska. Corn is farmed in areas like Sahiwal, Okara and nearby districts.
Currently the information about the progress of crops is collected manually and there is no centralized national database. Centralized national database where the progress of crops can be collected from the deployed sensors in real-time

data.projectName: Evolutionary review of grain developing  gene in rice
data.projectDigest:
What if know about a specific amino acids (e.g., 281 His), in a protein is involved in the development of grain in  rice. What if we know that if  281 His is to be mutated to 281 Arg, then the number of grains will increase 10-fold.
In our Lab we are studying the evolution of genes. In our study we Predict specific residues (Positive selective amino acids) that are involved in the evolution of genes. We use different software like MEGA, OBSM , PAML to connect the links among the DNA of different organism by looking at the National Priorities, e.g., in future we would like to explore the genes involved in size of grain. If we come up with good results then increasing the number of grain in a plant would be a good achievement and that is why we categorize it as Transformative research.

data.projectName: Crystal engineering of neutraceuticals to improve their  in-vitro bioactivities including anti-oxidant and anti-cancer efficacy
data.piUniversity: Lahore College for Women University, Lahore
data.projectDigest: Nutraceuticals (NCs) have many therapeutic benefits and have potential to delay or prevent diseases which can occur with age including arthritis, cancer, cardiovascular diseases, Alzheimer’s disease, osteoporosis and brain disorders etc. NCs include polyphenols, polyunsaturated fatty acid, dietary fibres, flavonoids, vitamins and pre and probiotics. Many of NCs have proven anti-oxidant and anti-cancer activities. But it is quite challenging to get adequate bioavailability from these NCs because of their low aqueous solubility, stability and/ or permeability in the gut. In the proposed project we are using co-crystallization, a crystal engineering technique, as a novel approach to improve the physicochemical profile and in-vitro bioactivities of NCs. Previously, co-crystallization has resulted in the modification of the physicomechanical and processing properties of drug substances. Co-crystals are multicomponent system formed by a NC or drug and a co-former bound within the same crystalline lattice through non-covalent and non-ionic interactions especially the hydrogen bonding. These co-crystals have distinctive properties from the parent compounds especially solubility and dissolution rate which are directly related with the bioavailability. Hence co-crystallization of NCs can enhance their solubility and facilitate intracellular delivery. These events can result in improved bioavailability and enhanced bioactivities including anti-oxidant and anti-cancer. Moreover, these new co-crystal forms will provide pharmaceutical industries to get intellectual property rights.

data.projectName: Study for Shock Wave Reduction Measure on Flat Slope Spillway Chutes
data.projectDigest: Shock wave typically occurs where fluid boundaries vary sharply on a spillway chute. A powerful shock wave can cross the spillway side wall and flood operation could be disturbed. Moreover, shock wave produces vibration in spillway structure which may lead to fatigue failure of spillway material (concrete). Research on the hydraulic characteristics of shock wave was extensively conducted by different researchers around the globe. But still there is gray area in field of shock wave reduction measures for spillways with flat slope chutes (5o to 10o). Considering the adverse impacts of shock wave and gray area, physical model study will be carried out. Partial physical model of Mohmand Dam spillway will be built up from plexiglas material in model tray hall of Centre of Excellence in Water Resources Engineering (CEWRE), Lahore. Model will be operated to assess shock wave height and study its generation mechanism. Afterward, a composite sloping tail will be designed, built up, installed and tested on physical model for elimination/reduction of shock wave.

data.projectName: Strategic Development to Mitigate the Impacts of Indian Intervention on Water Resources of Pakistan
data.projectDigest: In Pakistan,  94% of water is used in agriculture sector. Since 1971 there is 39 % increase in cropped area, whereas fruit crops increased 150% (FAO 2011). Despite the growing need for water, IBIS experiences water losses at nearly 55 percent. Growing risk due to climate, water storage by India for hydropower on Western rivers are often pointed to as the main contributor to flow reduction in river systems. The Indus Water Treaty (IWT) 1960, fixes water allocations in each of the rivers based on a volumetric basis and does not provide guidance on what will happen during periods of water scarcity. IWT also does not consider groundwater extraction, which can impact water availability in river system, nor does it mention environmental flows or ecosystem needs. The proposed study is planned to estimate changes in surface flows due to climate change or Indian interventions on western rivers. In addition to this, it will be helpful in estimating the severity of damages if Indian intervene the flow regulation by completing under construction and proposed projects. Moreover, it'll estimate the severity of damages if India release a huge quantum of water in wet season (Monsoon) without prior information to Pakistan.  For this research, historical discharge, topographic , satellite and climate data will be required. Storage capacity, energy production data will be estimated for each Indian hydroelectric project planned, under construction, and operation along the Western rivers and will be carried out. As the outcome of this research a mechanism would be develop to observe cross border activities on water bodies using remote sensing data. A monitoring system will be develop for estimation of preparedness time to mitigation flood damages due to Indian malfunctions of river flows.

Storage capacity, energy production data will be estimated for each Indian hydroelectric project planned, under construction, and operation along the Western rivers and will be carried out. As the outcome of this research a mechanism would be develop to observe cross border activities on water bodies using remote sensing data. data.projectName: Solar Energy use in Liquid Desiccant Air-conditioning, Drying Applications and Water Recovery
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest:
Coastal areas of Pakistan experience hot and humid weather during the extended summer season. This type of weather is not conducive for optimum human work output. These areas also suffer from chronic water shortages, hindering progress. Conventional Air-Conditioning (AC) consuming high amount of energy due to presence of compressor load in the system. Latent loads associated with the moisture removal for humidity control is responsible for major part of air-conditioning load in humid areas. Desiccant solutions i.e. aqueous solution of water and salts like LiCl, LiBr, Lil, MgCl2, CaCl2 attract water vapors from air stream, thus these can be used as dehumidifying agent. To reuse the same Liquid Desiccant, as a working fluid operating in a cycle, it needs to be heated to extract water vapors that can be achieved using solar thermal energy. The extracted vapor may be condensed to generate water for domestic applications. 
It is proposed to develop a pilot scale rig and carry out applied research on use of solar thermal energy in liquid desiccant /ionic liquids based Air-conditioning applications with water extraction. Components of the envisaged system will be manufactured locally using expertise of M/s Amin Agencies, acting as a sectoral partner in the project.

data.projectName: Indoor Positioning System to serve in Healthcare System
data.projectDigest: Health facilities of a country is an important indicator of stability and growth. Pakistan is facing acute shortage of healthcare facilities. Our hospitals are overcrowded with outdoor and indoor patients. Emergency care management processes are specialized according to the urgent service requirements. With paramedics, the timely availability of emergency treatment equipment is equally important. While dealing with emergency situation, the important emergency equipment is either not available or available delayed. We are proposing a wireless based Indoor localization system to automatically track the location of the equipment and mobilization path. The major issue in indoor localization system is localization accuracy. Most of the systems are affected by surrounding environment as well from interference from RF equipment. Therefore, an algorithm is needed to make the localization accuracy as maximum as possible.  The broader research objectives include selection of appropriate wireless standard for localization. Algorithm development to automatically display the location of the equipment on mobile or web-based application. The other indoor localization techniques include Fingerprinting, Triangulation, Trilateration, TDOA, Inertial Navigation system. The possible tasks for smart healthcare monitoring system is Traceability, Monitoring, Reactivity, Communication and data mining. The data generated by the sensors will be analyzed using Federated learning.

Therefore, this proposed study is design to synthesize Schiff bases of aminophenyl thiazole derivative and their complexes.

data.projectName: RHIZOBACTERIA AS BIOFERTILIZER AND BIOSTIMULANT AGAINST HEAVY METAL STRESS IN WHEAT
data.projectDigest: Soil contamination with heavy metal is becoming a major constrain now a day for plant establishment and development due to rapid urbanization and industrialization. Several rhizosphere microorganisms are known to play essential role in the management of HM (Heavy metal) stresses in plants. They can accumulate, transform, or detoxify HM to serve the purpose of phytoremediation. In general, the bene?t from these rhizobacteria can have a vast impact on plant’s as well as environment health. Plant–rhizobacteria associations targeting HM stress may provide another dimension to existing phytoremediation and rhizoremediation uses. So phytoremediation of soil with rhizobacteria may alleviate plant stress under these conditions and improved growth performance of important plants like wheat. An experiment will be conducted to elucidate the effect of toxic metals (Cadmium, Arsenic, Copper and Lead) on growth, ROS (reactive oxygen species), scavenging enzymes, and gene expression of Triticum aestivum L. grown under different metal and/or inoculation treatments.

data.projectName: Smart Drilling Mud Design
data.projectDigest: In petroleum industry, during drilling, mud is an integral part of drilling operations. It plays an important role regarding overcoming the formation pressure, lubrication and many other important factors. Without drilling mud, it is impossible to drill a well. Its preparation cost is very high due to the addition of imported components and eventually it increases the total cost of drilling operations. These products are added to achieve the required properties of mud which are necessary to continue drilling operation. This project is related to modify the conventional drilling mud in cost-effective manner. Few local products like eggshell, bagasse, banana peels and starch will be  analyzed and modification of drilling mud is to be suggested for shallow wells. All the properties of this modified mud will be studied at ambient/laboratory and static and/or dynamic conditions.

data.projectName: Consensus control of multi-agent systems over a communication network with industrial applications
data.piUniversity: Pakistan Institute of Engineering & Applied Sciences, Islamabad (PIEAS)
data.projectDigest: The consideration of communication for a cooperative control environment over a network of physical systems, like robots, swarms, unmanned air vehicles, underwater vehicles, satellite formation, and power plants, has emerged as a new field in the last two decades. This area has its applications in energy systems, smart systems, communication networks, avionics, robotics, military, surveillance, and industrial systems. These systems require advances electronic technologies, communication systems, networking, and computer processing. However, as for as Pakistan is considered, the design and application of cooperative control strategies over a network of multiple systems has been remained rare due to complexities involved in handling several and complicated systems. The energy sector improvement has been mentioned as an element of vision 2025 of Pakistan. In addition, micro-electronics, computers, telecommunications, and robotics have been considered as components of the six vital technologies in the same document. This research aims on the co-operative consensus control of multiple systems, called multi-agents, by incorporating the communication of information between them. For this purpose, the outputs or states of agents will be used as a feedback, based on the availability. Robust control strategies will be developed for dealing with the uncertainties and variations in a distributed fashion. A real-time computer-based prototype for testing the consensus protocols will be developed. The proposed consensus control framework can be applied to electrical systems, such as robots, electrical motors, micro-grids. A state-of-the-art embedded system approach, based on computer processors, will be provided for a real-time realization.

data.projectName: Fabrication of chbemical vapor deposition reactor for synthesis of multiwall caron nanotubes and formation of nano-composites for improved mechanical tribological properties.
data.projectDigest:
In the last decade, massive study has been done on synthesis of carbon nanotube (CNT). Different paths and precursor used result in miscellany of carbon nano materials. By tuning reaction specifications (reactor type, raw materials, reaction conditions), one can produce single wall or multi wall CNTs. 
In this project, a modified Injection vertical Chemical vapor deposition (IV-CVD) reactor for liquid feed system has been proposed which had been reported previously for CNT synthesis by Fahad et.al (PI Project). CVD method has proved its bench mark for the production of different types of carbon nanotubes. In this research CVD reactor is used for producing multi walled carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs) on multi-gram scale by using an improved ultrasonic atomizer as the CVD reactor head for evenly distribution of feed into the reactor.Atomization system will be used to increase the surface area of the precursor resulting into synthesis of high surface area MWCNT. Different experimental parameters affecting the quality and quantity of the produced CNTs will be investigated.

After finalizing the optimum parameters for MWCNT synthesis; new experiments will be designed for producing "Impregnated Metal oxide CNTs". Same design parameters will be set to find the optimum condition.  Both these products (pure CNT and Impregnated CNT) will be used to make polymer-CNT composites and mechanical properties will be studied by using Tribological measurement.

data.projectName: Pakistani Primary Teachers’ training for Using Maths manipulatives to develop students' conceptual understanding, engagement and positive attitude towards Maths
data.projectDigest:
Traditional teaching in Pakistan is focused on rote memorisation rather than active learning of the concepts. This action research aims to train primary school teachers for teaching Maths through hands on tools called manipulatives following Concrete Representational Abstract (CRA) approach. This method has been pilot tested in 2 schools of Karachi with great achievement results in students’ understanding of concepts, engagement and attitude towards Maths. The special need students were also a part of this pilot testing.
The primary objective for this action research is to train primary school teachers of public and private sectors of Karachi for using manipulatives for development of conceptual understanding in maths, improvement in engagement level and help them develop positive attitude towards of mathematics.
The duration of this proposed study is 12 months, divided into 2 phases. Twenty-four teachers, 4 teachers each from 6 districts of Karachi, will be trained, for 180 contact hours, during the first 6 months and 288 teachers during the next 6 months. Each teacher will instruct 12 students in their classrooms for 120 hours after the training. 3744 primary students will receive the intervention. The teachers will be selected from both public and private sectors’ schools of Karachi, Pakistan. The training will be held in collaboration with Concrete to Abstract: Mathematics Lab. using their research based basic Maths kit developed for Pre-k, KG, G1, G2 & G3. The required budget is 10.335 million.

data.projectName: RATING PLAYERS  AND TEAM SELECTION IN T20 INTERNATIONAL CRICKET MATCHES
data.projectDigest: In this research project, we will propose a new rating system to rate and rank players in T20 cricket international matches. These ratings and ranking will then use to make best possible team combination. In T20 Intentional cricket matches, a team consists of eleven players with the combination of blowers and batters and a wicket-keeper. Generally, the player, the players' performance in a match have been quantified using common measures, for example, batting averages and bowling strike rates and the number of wickets. The Reliance T20 players ranking is the official ICC rankings based on player rating points (ICC, 2019). These ratings are published on website by the end of every match or tournament, and they have different measures (points) for bowlers, batter, and all-rounders. There is very little focus on batting and bowling performances measured while the match is in progress. The official rating gives us information about the recent performance of players, but these rating measures have some drawbacks. Firstly, they do not regard the stage or position in which runs are scored or given away, and wickets are taken. Secondly, they cannot compare two disciplines (batting and bowling) due to incompatible scales. Thirdly, the Reliance rating system does not value fielding or wicket keeping contributions (Akhtar, 2011). With these points in mind, we propose a new rating and ranking system in T20 intentional players; which will be based on the player's performance (runs, wickets, and fielding contributions) over by over throughout the match. These measures have the potential to evaluate the man of the match, the man of the series, and the player of the tournament and also player ratings in general.

data.projectName: Frequency diverse array based Cognitive Dual Function Radar Communication (CDFRC) designs to efficiently solve spectrum congestion problem
data.projectDigest: For an optimal utilisation of an available frequency spectrum, multi-function designs have been proposed in literature. These designs, not only, reduce the installation and hardware cost drastically, but also work jointly without disturbing each other to reduce spectral congestion. Dual function radar and communication (DFRC) designs are one of these designs that are the need of recent time for getting the above mentioned benefits. Moreover, smart and intelligent utilisation of resources and protection from interference  with a shared bandwidth are very pressing challenges in DFRC designs. The applications of DFRC designs may include i) an intelligent transportation system which shares information in a rapidly changing environment ii) synthetic aperture radars based communication between medical equipment iii) target information dissemination among different radars in the network  etc. There is thus a large area of applications, which would possibly benefit from the availability of DFRC systems. However, the challenges to design conventional DFRC systems in the proposed design include i) joint efficient functionality of both designs without disturbing each other, ii) communication should be very fast, iii) unwanted signals should be compressed for both the designs, iv) communication information should be transferred without error, v) efficient sharing of spectrum for communication information.

data.projectName: Chemical Transformation of Sartan Family in Search of New Therapeutic Agents
data.projectDigest:
High blood pressure is quite common complication these days. For this several antihypertensive drugs are already available in the market. Most of these belong to angiotensin II receptor type 1 blockers (ARBs), also called Sartans. Currently there are eight sartan drugs present in the market that are USFDA approved, namely losartan, candesartan, valsartan, olmesartan, irbesartan, azilsartan, telmisartan, and eprosartan. With slight difference, they bear many structural similarities in them, for example, biphenyl ring, tetrazole, imidazole, and carboxylic groups.
This proposal describes the molecular modification in Sartan drugs to explore new therapeutic potential. In this connection we intend to acquire commercially available sartan drugs and perform some simple chemical transformation on the varied functional groups installed on the sartan molecules. These compounds will be fully characterized using different spectroscopic techniques and will be subjected to various biological screenings including enzymatic inhibitory activities.
The result of this research project will reveal the outcomes that will surely add a valuable entry in the field of drug discovery and development. All findings gained from the project will be published in reputed national and international journals. Such publications would definitely expose Pakistan among the scientific community of the world as a true scientific research hub.

data.projectName: New Contributions to the Theory of Discrete and Integral Inequalities
data.projectDigest:
In our proposed research we would like to contribute significantly in development Theory of Mathematical Inequalities. Researchers from almost every field of life encounter with mathematical inequalities. These inequalities are neither random nor accidental; they have a philosophy, a systematic doctrine and a powerful applicability. For instance, when a real-world problem is transformed via nonlinear mathematical function, instead of exact values of variables, usually their bounds in terms of inequalities are obtained. Thousands of examples can be found physical sciences and engineering. 
Among the many types of inequalities, integral inequalities are of supreme importance because over the last few decades this field has proven to be an extensively applicable field, as evident from the large number of publications on the subject [references]. The main aim of our proposed research is to study and give various new integral as well as discrete identities and inequalities with or without involvement of generalized convex functions.  As one can see in our detailed plan, we can do research in field of Mathematical Inequalities in more than 35 different ways.    
We would focus mainly on four types of inequalities and their variants and generalizations namely, Jensen’s inequality, Ostrowski’s inequality, Hermite-Hadamard inequalities and Popoviciu’s type general linear inequalities.  We would use different generalized and special functions such as FWNDI, delta- and nabla-convex functions, completely and absolutely monotone functions, log- and exponentially convex functions, functions of bounded variations,  absolutely continuous functions, Lipshitz  and Holder continuous functions and functions form Lp spaces etc.  We would  state plenty of applications of our proposed results

data.projectName: Mathematical Modeling and Prediction of Single and Two layer Turbulent Thin Film Flows Using Viscous, Giesekus, FENE, Pseudo Plastic, and Johnson-Segalman Fluid Models
data.projectDigest: Thin liquid films exist everywhere in nature so in this regards an understanding of their physical shapes and mechanics is important in many applications. Thin liquid layers are of central importance and has many industrial applications such as, geophysical applications, biomedical and biological. Further application can be found in micro and Nano fluidics, coating flows, falling film reactors, heat-exchangers and condensers, pipeline transportation of crude-oil, adhesives and foams production, surfactant replacement therapy, and the rupture of tear films, gravity currents and lava flows.

data.projectName: Assessing Impact of ’’Canal Lining’’ on Seepage, Groundwater Quality and Fluctuations
data.projectDigest:
It is generally perceived that the water saved through lining of canals can ensure equitable and reliable water supply to farmers for their crop production. Canal lining, can help controlling water logging, prevention of channel bank erosion and breaches, and reduction in operational and maintenance cost.
The proposed research project will assess the impact of canal linings on seepage, Groundwater levels, conveyance efficiency, crop production, operational and maintenance cost of canals. The scope of the impact assessment study will cover i) Calculation of pre-lining seepage losses and other relevant data ii. Measurement of current seepage losses iii. Hydraulic efficiency of lined channels iv. Data collection on water theft practices v) Assessing changes in cropping patterns and crop yields and vi. Changes in socio-economic conditions of project area.
The research project will clearly conclude the outcomes of the investment under this major initiative of the department to manage the water crisis being faced in view of exceeded irrigation intensities and multiplied demands. The research outcome will be a good tool available with the department which could be replicated to other canal commands.

data.projectName: Synthesis, structural characterization, electronic structure calculations, molecular docking study and biological study of diorganotin(IV) and triorganotin(IV) complexes with Schiff bases obtained from 1,3,4-thiadizole derivatives and 2-hydroxy-1-naphthal
data.projectDigest:
The project has been designed to study the chemistry of Schiff bases and their organotin(IV) complexes. Schiff bases have often been used as chelating ligands in the field of coordination chemistry. Schiff base organotin(IV) complexes have been widely studied because they have industrial, antifungal, antibacterial, anticancer and herbicidal applications. 
The characterization of the synthesized complexes by different spectroscopic techniques, mass spectrometry and X-ray study will confirm the formation of complexes and nature of bonding between the ligand and metal centre. The coordination of metal ions to ligand will increase their bioactivity. The complexes control the production of free radicals in living systems and behave as efficient antioxidant agents. The formation of biofilms of bacteria on substrata will be inhibited by organotin(IV) complexes which will save economy.
The present study will enhance the expertise of the PI based on synthesis of metal complexes. The project will produce one Ph.D student and 3-4 M.Phil students. These students will sever the country in practical life. It will strength my research lab with chemicals and equipments.

data.projectName: isomiR Expression and Functional Analysis in Breast Cancer
data.projectDigest: Cell is basic unit of a living system. Healthy cells means healthy organism.  A healthy cell comprises of coherent functioning of cellular processes. Any perturbations in normal functioning of these processes can have slight to severe outcomes, such as cancers. microRNAs (miRNAs) are small noncoding RNAs that modulate expression of numerous genes. Differential expression of miRNAs have been implicated in different cancers. In this study, we are interested in locating dysregulated miRNAs in general, and in particular, miRNA isoforms that play key role in breast cancer progression.

data.projectName: Carbon and water fluxes of some trees growing in Lahore, Pakistan
data.projectDigest: Trees are the important component of any landscape as they are the source of carbon and water fluxes against the climatic drivers. These fluxes of trees are among the determinants of healthy environment. Although, the introduction of diverse trees in the urban areas have been made to improve the urban landscapes but the cost of such introduction in the form of water uptake and the benefits in the form of carbon fixation apart from the other services, need to be assessed across a number of species. To explore these, this project will investigate the sap flow (water fluxes in trees trunk), leaf based carbon-water exchange abilities leading to estimate water use efficiency (WUE), leaf and wood traits of 98 tree species growing in Lahore. The project will address following main questions; 1) how much differences are exhibited by the trees for their water and carbon fluxes across different seasons ? ; 2) What are the possible mechanisms adopted by trees for the possible differences in their responses for carbon and water fluxes. Such comparative information across a number of tree species will be helpful in planning the afforestation programmes and water management in the urban areas of Punjab, Pakistan.

data.projectName: polymorphism and expression related to lumbar intervertebral disc degeneration
data.projectDigest: The IVD herniation is caused by degenerative changes or shattering of its exterior section that is annulus fibrous (AF), leading to pain and disability. Although, the pathophysiology of this degeneration is not well understood but growing research evidence suggests that genetic factors may be important contributing factors to this misery.The purpose of this study is to analyze the genetic bases of disc degeneration and to establish some new marker for lumber disc degeneration and to identify the polymorphism in our population.

data.projectName: Design and implementation of orthogonal signaling based synchronization scheme for Ultra-Wideband communication
data.piUniversity: NED University of Engineering & Technology, Karachi
data.projectDigest: Ultra-wideband (UWB) communication has been proposed as a solution for high data rate transmission in the current congested radio spectrum. Due to its wide bandwidth, UWB can be used at low power for data transmission. This enables it to underlay itself in the radio spectrum and coexist with other standards of communication. However, this technology has found limited application due to fast synchronization between transmitter and receivers. This project aims to study and implement UWB synchronization scheme using orthogonal signaling for reliable data communication. The advantage of this technique is accurate synchronization without compromising data rate.

data.projectName: Transformer Predictive Maintenance
data.projectDigest:
Power transformers normally have a long life when operated under appraised conditions. However, overloading decreases their life span resulting in unexpected failures. A transformer's failures can lead to disruption in power supply (affecting large number of customers), decrease in system reliability, and monetary loss to the utility and distribution companies. Overloading and ineffective cooling are the major causes for the failure and internal faults in a power transformer. To operate the transformers effectively, regular maintenance is required and it is performed traditionally through routine chemical tests. However, this method is costly and inefficient. This project aims to develop effective predictive maintenance of power transformers.
Predictive maintenance techniques for transformers are based on phasor measurement unit (PMU) data. The project is developing simulation platform for power transformers that can simulate the impacts of overloading, temperature, harmonics on the performance of power transformers. Subsequently the project will be developing a laboratory setup for development and practical implementation of predictive maintenance system, where the transformer is operated under different conditions and the data is recorded through PMU  relay. In parallel, the data will be recorded at 500 kV grid stations where PMUs will be installed on a 132 kV transformer. The recorded data and analyses of this data through pattern recognition techniques will help in ensuring the safety against permanent damages by detecting the fault at an early stage.

data.projectName: An evaluation of Competencies Possessed by Agricultural Extension Field Staff to tackle climate change for Olive Crop of Pakistan
data.piUniversity: Pir Mehr Ali Shah Arid Agriculture, University Rawalpindi
data.projectDigest: The prime purpose of the proposed project is to examine competencies possessed by agriculture extension workers to guide farming community to tackle climate change in the context of olive crop. Indeed, climate affect agricultural sector as large even olive crop which has ability to cope with the impacts easily. Moreover, the potential embedded in the Pothwar area also dragged present government to declare this area as Olive valley with the aim to motivate farmers to grow at large scale to mitigate negative influence of climate changes. However, it is not yet clear whether the agricultural advisory providers are competent enough to guide and facilitate farmers to not only grow olive at mass level but also handle climate risks. To this backdrop, the project is formulated with the specific objectives to: 1) examine competencies of extension field staff about olive crop in the context of climate change; 2) analyse the barriers to acquire competencies; and 3) suggest measures to enhance competencies of extension field staff about tackling climate for olive growers. Data will be collected through field survey and statistical findings would be generated. It is hoped that project would benefit various agricultural stakeholders’ particularly agricultural advisors.

data.projectName: NUSTAG Self Driving Car
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest:
Automation technologies are bringing fundamental changes in the life of the common individual. The field of autonomous driving has the potential of reshaping the entire transportation system. Reliable autonomous urban driving is an innovative technology which will enable improved vehicle and driver safety along with enabling better traffic management. Self-Driving Cars are poised for accelerated adoption with most of the World’s leading automobile manufactures having set up strategic plans for launching their versions of Self Driving vehicles within the next decade.
The objective of this proposal is to develop Self Driving Car in order to create a bridgehead for futuristic development of such vehicles in Pakistan, ultimately leading to self-reliance in this field. The project aims at conceptualizing autonomous driving technologies in Pakistan to bring this sector of state of the art research, at par with the rest of the world. To achieve this objective, a two pronged strategy consisting of development and research prongs respectively, will be adopted. In the development process, a Self-Driving Car will be developed through the implementation of existing technologies and state of the art algorithms. In parallel research will be conducted specifically to address prevailing issues impeding the progress of Self Driving Cars globally.

data.projectName: Solar nanophotocatalysis: An advance strategy for remediation of wastewater
data.projectDigest: The research investigations encompassing photocatalysis under Advanced Oxidation Processes (AOP), has provided the circumstantial progress in novel wastewater treatment systems. Especially the technique based on solar nanophotocatalysis involves no costly setup or toxic chemicals. This ecofriendly technique produces no secondary pollutants as product of photocatalytic reaction. In the present project Solar Photocatalysts with suitable optical and structural properties would be synthesized in powder and immobilized form.  Nanoscale solar photocatalysts capable of degrading water pollutants would be adhered / grafted on diverse substrates to get them immobilized keeping in mind the cost effectiveness, photoactivity and reusability. The residential and industrial effluent would be treated under natural sunlight using solar photocatalytic reactor (SPR) at lab and pilot scale. Evaluation of extent of degradation of persistent organic pollutants (POPs) and reduction of heavy metals would be determined to compare the efficiency of SPRs. The most efficient SPR would be employed at wetlands of Ibrahim Fibers to treat their effluent by solar nanophotocatalysis. The treated wastewater would be used for industrial operations. Investigation of water quality parameters of untreated and treated wastewater would be carried out. The reusability of the selected SPR would be determined at pilot scale reactor (FBIP-SPR) and wetlands of Ibrahim fibers LTD.
