data.projectName: Development of eco-friendly and sustainable fungicides for the control of Aspergillus flavus and aflatoxin
data.projectDigest:
Aspergillus flavus is one the most harmful pathogenic fungi of cereals crops throughout the world. It produces aflatoxins which are highly carcinogenic and have been grouped 1A carcinogens by International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC). In most of the tropical countries, one of the reasons of food crisis is the waste of food commodities due to the contamination of A. flavus. In Pakistan, maize and other grains got infected by A. flavus just before harvesting time thus synthetic fungicides treatment at this stage could have adverse residual effects. There is dire need to develop eco-friendly products for the control of this severe pathogen which causing food security risk in major part of the world. In this proposed study, plant based fungicides will be developed that will inhibit the fungal growth as well as aflatoxin production. In the course of this project a number of studies will be done such as biodiversity of A. flavus on maize growing in different climatic regions of Pakistan. Aflatoxigenic capability of various A. flavus isolates from different regions of Pakistan. The chemo-diversity of some aromatic plants those are wildly growing in Northern areas of Pakistan. 
Aromatic plants will be collected from different districts of Northern Pakistan. Essential oils and solvent extracts will be extracted from shade dried plants through steam distillation and maceration. Gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) and HPLC-UV will be used to determine chemical diversity in plants species growing in different areas. The quantification of aflatoxins produced by fungal strains will be assessed by HPLC-UV. The anti-fungal activity of essential oils and extracts will be tested through agar and broth dilution methods. Aflatoxigenic inhibiting potential of plant extract

data.projectName: Unlocking the potential of pathogenic fungi for the production of bioactive metabolites; Future Bio economy
data.projectDigest: Fungi are one of the important components of the biosphere, having much biotechnological importance. Therefore fungi research is attracting scientists and researchers towards its applications. Fungi produces a number of products of high economic value, e.g. anticancer, antifungal, antibiotics, food additives, organic solvents and enzymes. Already available drugs are losing their function, so it is the need of the day to search new and reliable drugs from novel sources.  Fungi are described as a novel source of bioactive metabolites. The class of fungi causing different infections and survive in plants are called phytopathogenic fungi, are comparatively unexplored and have the potential to produce within the cells a variety of novel natural compounds of pharmaceutical values. Thus the study is designed to explore phytopathogenic and endophytic fungi for the production of novel bioactive compounds. It is hypothesized that Taphrina species may produce some novel bioactive compounds of high medicinal values.  These pathogens mainly infect the plant leaves; however they may also affect blossom, young twigs and fruits. Beside their pathogenicity they could be an important source of economically important metabolites. Therefore it is necessary to explore its beneficial aspects beside its disease causing potential.  In current research phytopathogenic/endophytic fungi known as Taphrina species isolated from peach plant in Pakistan will be explored for the production of active secondary metabolites. The pure compounds produced by fungi will be isolated and characterized by sophisticated spectroscopic techniques. The characterized novel compounds will be screened for various activities both in in vivo and in vitro.

data.projectName: Cosmic Inflation in Modified Theories of Gravity
data.projectDigest: This project is mainly proposed to study the most important cosmological aspect the so-called cosmic inflation (the early-time era) in the background of Modified Theories of Gravity including hybrid-metric-Palatini f\left(X\right)-gravity and f\left(\tau,B\right)\ formalism, where \tau\ be\ the\ torsion\ scalar. Additionally, our aim is to explore the accelerating cosmic expansion (the late-time era) and compact stellar configuration in these backgrounds. We prefer the specific modifications, which can relate the torsion-based and curvature-based scenarios, it would be handy to pursuit the early and late-time cosmic issues. In previous studies, we have explored the cosmic issues in standard Einstein’s theory and in curvature-based theories, current project will help to make comparison with the developed results and more consistent modifications based on curvature-matter, curvature-scalar-field, torsion-matter and torsion-scalar-field couplings.

In anaerobic treatment either mixing is done through some inert gas bubbling or through mechanical mixing inside the reactor. It has been observed that for proper mixing inside the reactor the mechanical shear force is increased. But due to its increase, the average floc size decreases with increase in the production of extra polymeric substances (EPS) inside reactor. In only anaerobic reactor these substances may affect the sludge settling properties. In hybrid anaerobic reactors, like anaerobic membrane bioreactor AnMBR, these EPS may cause immediate membrane fouling and less water flux through the system. So, the main objective of the proposed research is to completely understand the effect of hydrodynamics inside anaerobic reactor with special emphasis on microbial profiling. In anaerobic treatment either mixing is done through some inert gas bubbling or through mechanical mixing inside the reactor. It has been observed that for proper mixing inside the reactor the mechanical shear force is increased. But due to its increase, the average floc size decreases with increase in the production of extra polymeric substances (EPS) inside reactor. In only anaerobic reactor these substances may affect the sludge settling properties. In hybrid anaerobic reactors, like anaerobic membrane bioreactor AnMBR, these EPS may cause immediate membrane fouling and less water flux through the system. So, the main objective of the proposed research is to completely understand the effect of hydrodynamics inside anaerobic reactor with special emphasis on microbial profiling. The methodology includes running four setups in parallel. Each with a two liters glass beaker with lid to cover and maintain anaerobic conditions. Lid will have spaces for sampling of sludge and adding or decanting synthetic wastewater. A volume of 500 ml of synthetic domestic wastewater in all 4 reactors will be added daily. data.projectDigest: Cardiac diseases are one of most common causes of death whereas World Health Organization reported that 31% of worldwide deaths are caused by cardiovascular deaths. Pakistan is a developing country with variety of ethnic groups and cast to cast as well as cousin marriages are very common (65%) which makes our population at the high risk of genetic diseases development. The current project will provide us a set of genetic data base which will help to identify the susceptible communities/individuals by genetic testing. Ultimately preventive measures and control programs will be used to reduce the social and economic burden from the society.

data.projectName: Building Corpus of Spoken Pakistani English for Academic and Professional Purposes (CSPEAPP)
data.projectDigest:
The Corpus of Spoken Pakistani English for Academic and Professional Purposes (CSPEAPP) project will develop a corpus of spoken Pakistani English (CSPE) by collecting samples of Pakistani spoken English across different fields of life, including: academia, judiciary, bureaucracy, politics, media, tourism and business. The Spoken corpus will also include demographically balanced orthographic transcriptions of recorded Pakistani English from different age, sex, education, profession, region and ethnic classes. Initially, the CSPE will contain a spoken corpus of one million words, having its own unique web interface, with phonetic, semantic and grammatical annotations and tag-sets to study the particular patterns associated with the phonological, lexical and grammatical features for further linguistic analysis. To standardize the CSPE -according to international standards prescribed by the Linguistic Data Consortium (LDC) -it will be developed using XML and TEI (Text Encoding Initiative). Building the CSPE will involve two academic collaborations and a sectoral collaboration.
The practical applications and implications of the project extend to a variety of disciplines and fields including digital humanities, social sciences, applied sciences and computer sciences. Its pedagogical implications contribute to language learning, material development, language teaching, classroom discourses, and literary pedagogy.  The applied implications of the project contribute to the fields of Digital Humanities, English for Specific Purposes (ESP) Data Science, Speech Processing, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Computer Assisted Language Learning (CALL) and Mobile Assisted Language Learning (MALL).

data.projectName: Enhancing crop productivity for anticipated climate change and food shortage
data.projectDigest:
Global warming and climate change are influencing not only the socio economic sector but also the agriculture sector thought out the world. Wheat production is required to be doubled by 2050 in order to facilitate the global food assurance. 
To perform strategies for food security and to combat country malnutrition in changing climate.  Productivity of cereals crops are severely affected due to climate change effects like irregular rainfall pattern, drought stress due to increasing in temperature and improper time of sowing. Due to excess use of inorganic fertilizers productivity of crops and soil fertility is disturbed day by day. The proposed project is mainly focused on improving the productivity of wheat and maize without disturbing soil fertility and its properties. Drought stress caused severely reduction in wheat and maize growth and yield. Giving irrigation at critical growth stages having positive response towards growth and yield productivity. The response of exogenous application of moringa leaves extracts as a foliar improve growth and yield components of wheat and maize under drought stress condition. The aim of proposed research is improving wheat and maize productivity through moringa foliar application under drought stress condition with proper time of sowing. Increasing nutritional enrichment of wheat/maize grains through nutritive status of moringa leaf extracts.

data.projectName: Seismic Evaluation of Existing Bridges in Karachi at Component Level (SEEBKCL)
data.piUniversity: NED University of Engineering & Technology, Karachi
data.projectDigest: The quantification of seismic risk associated with the existing structures is of primary importance in developing countries. Past earthquakes record revealed the need for the seismic up-gradation of existing infrastructure and particularly bridges in Pakistan. To this end, the proposed study will focus on the evaluation of the seismic residual capacity of existing reinforced concrete bridges particularly located in Karachi and explore the cost-effective retrofitting schemes to upgrade the seismic capacity of deficient bridges at the component level. The proposed research will comprise of multiple phases, in phase-01 three case-study bridges selected and their point clouds collected from various stations using 3D scanning technology and ultimately transform into as-built 3D and 2D CAD drawings by employing Tekla structure. In the second phase, a rational nonlinear computational model will be developed in the OpenSeesMP interface incorporating different sources of nonlinearities and process through incremental dynamic analyses-IDA. In the third phase, the scale down prototype structure particularly sub-structure will be developed and process through a series of dynamic and pseudo-dynamic tests employed with and without retrofitting. In the fourth and final phase, a comparative evaluation of computational and experimental results needs to do and the application guidelines of cost-effective retrofitting scheme share with local practitioners and bridges regulations authorities such as Karachi Development Authority (KDA) and National Highway Authority (NHA).

data.projectName: Surface modified biodegradable nanoparticles of nutraceuticals with enhanced therapeutic benefits and reduced toxicity in arthritis
data.projectDigest: Rheumatoid arthritis is an inflammatory disease of joints restricting the patient’s mobility hence compromising his/her daily routine tasks. This is a chronic illness and patient have to take medication for a prolonged time period or rather lifelong treatment. Numerous adverse effects are associated with the use of anti-arthritic drugs, including gastric ulcer, hepatotoxicity and bone resorption. There is a strong need to develop such treatments which have better patient compliance, reduced dose and frequency and very less toxic effects. Nutraceuticals are well-known for their marvelous health beneficial effects.  However, they have limitations due to poor solubility, shorter half- life and reduced bioavailability. These limitations can be overcome by nanoparticle based drug delivery. Nanotechnology is emerging field and has played wonders in pharmaceutical sciences. This proposal is based on the use of Nutraceuticals by encapsulating them in a biodegradable polymer, poly-lactic-co-glycolic acid (PLGA) which is approved for drug delivery in human. The surface of these nanoparticles will be subsequently modified by using Chitosan which will not only stabilize PLGA NPs, but also promote the gastrointestinal absorption of nutraceuticals. These surfaces modified NPs will be characterized and subjected to anti-arthritic potential in induced rat arthritis model.

data.projectName: Hybrid nanocarriers for enhanced oral bioavailability and efficacy of sirolimus-tacrolimus combination:  Development, characterization and evaluation
data.projectDigest: The immunological barrier still remains the major obstacle in successful organ transplantation  leaving life long immunosuppressants the only hope. Among several immunosuppressants, sirolimus (SM), and Tacrolimus (TM) have shown significantly superior results in case of solid organ transplant as monotherapy and adjuvant therapy. Both SM and TM belong to BCS II drugs showing poor aqueous solubility, high log P, substrate of the intestinal P-gp and undergo hepatic first pass effect that limit their oral bioavailability to 15% or even lesser. The present study is designed to mitigate these problems through a polymer(s) enveloped nanoliposome drug delivery system (ENLs) encapsulating SM and TM. The  SM and TM loaded nanoliposomes enveloped with thiolated chitosan and ?-cyclodextrin will facilitate intestinal permeation, inhibition of P-gp and escape hepatic first pass effect thus improving the oral bioavailability. The optimized formulation will be  characterized for particle size, zeta potential and polydispersity, FTIR, TEM, EDX, compatibility, drug loading, release kinetics, ex vivo permeation, in vivo pharmacokinetics, biodistribution, immunomodulation and toxicology in animals. The study is expected to show significant improved pharmacokinetics and immunomodulation, that will be of great interest for huge population across the globe.

data.projectName: PHYSIO-CHEMICAL AND MOLECULAR ASPECTS OF GALACTOMANNAN INDUCED DROUGHT TOLERANCE IN CLUSTER BEAN ([Cyamopsis tetragonoloba (L.) Taub]
data.projectDigest: Global warming is telling upon crop productivity. Drought stress is one of the most serious worldwide threats to agriculture. Drought stress adversely affects morphological, physio-chemical processes and reproductive performance in plants causing a number of physiological responses at cell/tissue or organism levels. A common facet of environmental stress, including drought stress results in altered gene expression, inhibited protein synthesis and its degradation. Transcriptional study shows that the drought stress stimulates many genes encoding transcriptional factors, which are involved in drought tolerance and response. On the other hand, galactomannan (GM) is a growth-regulating substance, which influences the enzyme activities and metabolite production usually involved in the induction of stress tolerance in plants, but the addition of GM has been shown to improve the guar gum in the endosperm of guar seed. The most dramatic beneficial effect of GM in plants is the mitigation of biotic and abiotic stress. However, processes such as dose-response relationships, physio-chemical and molecular mechanisms involved in GM-induced drought tolerance is not well understood. The proposed study will increase our understanding about the galactomannan biosynthesis at biochemical and molecular levels using cluster bean as a model crop. The major focus of the project is identification of target genes such as ManS (mannosyltransferase/mannan synthase), UGE (UDP- D-glucose 4-epimerase), and Cellulose synthase D1 (CS D1), Galactomannan galactosyltransferase 1 (GMGT1), which which involved in galactomannan biosynthesis .The project is likely to generate substantial data for the understanding of GM-induced drought tolerance in clsuter bean.

data.projectName: Extending Machine learning algorithms towards the prediction of DNA-binding Protein
data.projectDigest: DNA-protein interaction is a critical biological process that has an influential role in diverse biological activities like DNA repair, recombination, and slicing. Some DBPs are indispensable for understanding many types of human cancers (i.e., lung, breast, and liver cancer) and chronic diseases (i.e., AIDS/HIV, asthma), while other kinds are involved in antibiotics, steroids, and anti-inflammatory drugs designing. Several experimental and computational methods have been reported for DBPs prediction. However, a more accurate computational system is still highly desirable. This study presents a deep learning-based method, named DBP-CNN for identification of DBPs. In this work, different multi-perspective features are encoded by DDE (dipeptide deviation from expected mean), BiPSSM (bigram position-specific scoring matrix), and a novel protocol PSSM-TS-DCT (position-specific scoring matrix-tetra slices-discrete cosine transform). PSSM-TS-DCT explores the local discriminative features by applying tetra-slices notion into PSSM and encapsulates decisive information by a compression scheme DCT. Four models were trained using RF (random forest), ERT (extremely randomized trees), XGB (eXtreme gradient boosting), and 2D CNN (two-dimensional convolutional neural network) classifiers. 2D CNN-based model with PSSM-TS-DCT attained 2.80% and 6.34% higher accuracies than the recent predictor on both training and independent datasets, respectively. The superior performance of our novel predictor would also be fruitful for establishing more effective therapeutic strategies for human cancers and other fatal diseases treatment.

data.projectName: Synthesis of Multiporphyrin for Photonics Application
data.projectDigest: Inspired from the natural role of porphyrins, the presented research proposal describes the synthetic strategies for the synthesis of multiporphyrin systems. Porphyrin molecules will be connected through conducting bonds. The resulting multiporphyrins will behave like a conducting wire by absorb maximum light from the visible portion of the spectrum. These multiporphyrins will be anchored over glass, silicon and titanium surfaces in such a way that the light absorbing molecules form a uniform layer over the solid supports. The absorption of light or the interaction of atmospheric molecules such as water, carbon monoxide with the anchored porphyrin molecules will change their electrical properties or will eject electrons from the supporting semiconducting surface . These electrical changes will be used for the fabrication of field effect transistors, photodiodes and/or other photonics devices.

data.projectName: Synthesis of dually cross-linked bio-polymer based hydrogels with high mechanical and self-healing efficiency for bio-medical applications
data.projectDigest: In current years, soft and smart bio-originated hydrogel materials with 3-Dimensional structure have achieved much attention due to hydrophilic and bio-compatible behavior. These materials can be widely applied in drug delivery, wound dressing, smart sensors and actuators, robotic science, transplantation of human organs, electronic skin etc. But lack of mechanical strength, load bearing and self-healing efficiency, restrict their application in bio-engineering and bio-medical fields. Therefore, to overcome these problems a number of different hydrogels have been made e.g double network, core-shell, reinforced etc. Every hydrogel has shown a superior performance in a single property, but behave below the acceptable limits in other properties. Therefore, the synthesis of hydrogel materials having superior multiple properties is still a challenging task and is the main focus of the polymer scientists to work with. Keeping these problems in mind, we are proposing a new idea for the development of chitosan based dually cross-linked hydrogels which could be applied for bio-medical applications due to their high stretching, load bearing and self-healing performance. The dual linking points (physical and chemical) will introduce the mechanical strength in hydrogel network and can be best fit to utilize in the development of muscles, nerves, tissues etc. Furthermore, the occurrence of Fe3+ on the surface of hydrogels will enhance its self-healing ability. This study will be performed at laboratory scale, and will be extended to industrial level in future. We are much convinced that completion of this project will enable us to prepare hydrogels that can replace the existing materials used so far in bio-medical applications.

data.projectName: Economic Valuation of Biodiversity and Environment Along the CPEC Corridor (Western Route)
data.projectDigest: This project will valuate the impact of biodiversity and environment along the western route of CPEC project using spatial Techniques. Patch Analyst in Arc GIS 10.2 will be used to assess landscape alteration states and integrated valuation of ecosystem and tradeoffs to identify habitat quality. Database will be prepared using GIS data complementing with ground-based surveys and data collected from all available sources. Data regarding ground water level due to the major construction work initiated in selected study area will also be incorporated in the Database. Potential areas map with a buffer of 5 km will be produced. “InVEST” software will be used to conduct economic valuation of the biological resources and suggest some effective policies. For the identification of the high-risk areas from construction activities, the data regarding fresh water depreciation points, areas of rain water management and the data of air quality will be analyzed and linked with geographical locations. These risks will be verified through available secondary data and also by conducting hot spot analysis on densely populated areas. Satellite images classification will be used to develop LULC and change analysis in the 5 km buffer zones using geo-spatial techniques.

data.projectName: Nexus between sustainable supply chain quality management (SSCQM) and supply chain operational risk, for organizational performance. Evidences form Automobile Industry.
data.piUniversity: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science & Technology (SZABIST) University, Karachi
data.projectDigest:
Recent studies on firms’ performance and supply chain management (SCM) have indicated the need to explore the understanding of the integration of SCM and quality management (QM) (Fernandes, Sampaio, Sameiro, & Truong, 2017; Vanichchinchai, 2014). This is referred as supply chain quality management – SCQM. (Fernandes et al., 2017; Uluskan, McCreery, & Rothenberg, 2018). 
Organizations have started developing strategies to respond more adequately to supply chain risks (SCR), (Ouabouch & Lavastre, 2015). It is because these SCRs undermine not only efficiency of supply chain but it also affects firm performance as well (Tummala & Schoenherr, 2011). Among various classifications of supply chain risk, generally SCR can be divided into two dimensions: SC Disruption Risk (SC_DR) and SC Operational Risk (SC_OR). (Wakolbinger & Cruz, 2011). 

Many SC scholars identified SCQM as a tool for enhancing firm’s performance. There was no research found addressing these aspects of SCQM. More than that, Bastas and Liyanage (2018) found in their study that incorporating sustainability into SCQM (SSCQM) is a highly emerging area to address the sustainable organizational performance. 
Hence, the purpose of this research study is to address the critically specific research proposition that explain the nexus between two domains of sustainable supply chain management i.e. quality management and operations risk. Therefore, this study firstly investigates and explore SSCQM and SC-OR to identify its various aspects, and then propose the framework to address for their interaction and firm performance. This proposed framework will cater different dimensions of SSCQM and SCOR. In the later stages, this frame work is validated by industrial implementation and the results will be generalized.

Among various classifications of supply chain risk, generally SCR can be divided into two dimensions: SC Disruption Risk (SC_DR) and SC Operational Risk (SC_OR). (Wakolbinger & Cruz, 2011). 

Many SC scholars identified SCQM as a tool for enhancing firm’s performance. There was no research found addressing these aspects of SCQM. More than that, Bastas and Liyanage (2018) found in their study that incorporating sustainability into SCQM (SSCQM) is a highly emerging area to address the sustainable organizational performance. 
Hence, the purpose of this research study is to address the critically specific research proposition that explain the nexus between two domains of sustainable supply chain management i.e. quality management and operations risk. Therefore, this study firstly investigates and explore SSCQM and SC-OR to identify its various aspects, and then propose the framework to address for their interaction and firm performance. This proposed framework will cater different dimensions of SSCQM and SCOR. In the later stages, this frame work is validated by industrial implementation and the results will be generalized.

data.projectName: SYNTHESES AND CHARACTERIZATION OF 2-ACETOXYBENZOIC ACID DERIVATIVES BASED SUPRAMOLECULES
data.piUniversity: Khwaja Fareed University of Engineering and Information Technology, Rahim Yar Khan
data.projectDigest:
The project is aimed at synthesis of compounds, pharmacological screening of synthetic compounds, inoculation of host molecules to guest ligands as supramolecules and synthesis of luminescent material. 2-Acetoxybenzoic acid (commonly known as Aspirin) is a Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NASIDs) is a recognized as anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic drug. A library of compounds will be synthesized by coupling reaction of aspirin with amino esters or different amines to generate new coupled bond (C-N). These amide derivatives of aspirin have ability to form supramolecules and to coordinate with metals of different d-block and f-block elements (M= Eu3+, Tb3+, Yb3+, Gd3+, Er3+, Ho3+, Cu2+, Co3+, Mg2+, Fe3+). 
The synthesized compounds will be characterized on the account of their physical data such as solubility, thin layer chromatography (TLC), melting points, colors and spectral analysis like Ultraviolet Visible (UV), Infrared (IR), Proton and Carbon Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (1H & 13C-NMR), Mass Spectrometry (MS), X-rays Diffraction, elemental (CHN) analysis, SEM/TEM, Flourescence as well as TGA. 
The lanthanide nanoparticles have the property of luminescence (red, green color etc). These will be studied by absorption and emission spectra with mono-ligand (simply ligand plus metal) and bi-ligands (ligand with TTA or ACAC plus metal). These bi-ligands complexes are expected to have more luminescent property. So, can at as pharmocophore for photodiodes or as OLEDs materials.
This library of compounds will be also screened for anti-bacterial, antifungal, antioxidant, enzyme inhibition studies, anti-inflammatory activity, cytotoxicity and anticancer studies.

data.projectName: A Geometric Approach to Robust Nonlinear Attitude Estimation & Control for Aerospace and Robotic Systems
data.projectDigest: The proposed project involves theoretical developments, algorithmic implementations, and experimental verifications of novel estimation and control techniques potentially suitable for certain aerospace and robotic systems. The central hypothesis is that an intrinsic (i.e., coordinate-free) approach to nonlinear attitude estimation & control can be employed to yield robust and more effective algorithms for attitude motion of aerospace and robotic systems. The research activity will extend the theoretical/mathematical results achieved during the ongoing work, on geometric nonlinear robust attitude estimation/control, to more practical cases. The resulting formulations will be directly applicable to attitude estimation problems in spacecrafts, aircrafts, UAVs/drones, and quadrotors. The proposed formulations & algorithms are expected to be considerably superior to the standard methods / algorithms currently used for these applications, as shown by recent papers for some special cases.

data.projectName: Evaluation of micronutrient carrying chitosan nanoparticles as abiotic stress emulators in wheat
data.projectDigest:
Drought and salt stress reduce the availability of essential micronutrients to the plants including wheat. Such nutritional disorders consequently adversely affect the yield of crops due to their key involvement in a number of cellular and sub-cellular mechanisms like the biosynthesis of compatible solutes, improved mineral uptake and assimilation, and maintenance of water balance etc. So, the proper availability of micronutrients ensures the smooth functioning of these cellular pathways thus helps to mitigate the adverse effects of afore-said abiotic stresses. 
Recent nano-technological developments have transformed the field of agriculture and crop production. In this context, the chitosan-based nanoparticles (CNPs) have found promising applications as nontoxic, safer and eco-friendly carriers of agrochemicals, pesticides and growth promoting agents in plants.  
Over the years, priming has emerged as an alternative approach in which seeds are pre-treated with minimum amount of agrochemicals in order to avoid the undesirable soil contamination through drenching and foliar sprays. This facile pre-treatment technique enhances quality of seeds for fast germination, stress tolerance and high productivity of crops
Considering the above facts, the present study has been designed to evaluate the stress mitigating effects of micronutrient carrying chitosan nanoparticles (as priming agents) on wheat under salinity and drought stress.

data.projectName: Characterization and commercialization of anticancer compounds isolated from medicinal plants used traditionally in District Swat and Dir in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
data.piUniversity: Shaheed Benazir Bhutto Women University, Peshawar
data.projectDigest: Plant oriented natural products are considered very potent drugs against diseases and infections.These herbal drugs are very safe with negligible side effects and are cost effective along with ease of availability and preparation and processing. Pakistan is very rich in terms of medicinal plants which are used traditionally by local people and healers. District Swat and Dir are very rich in medicinal plants used by the local people to treat diseases, infections, tumors and cancer. There is an intense need to dig out the active principles present in these traditional plants. Keeping in view the significance of these plants, this project is designed to focus on the development and commercialization of compounds isolated from twelve medicinal plants which are used to treat cancer and tumors by local inhabitants. This will strengthen the economy of country along with ease of availability to end users for the treatment of cancer.   The main objective of this project is to develop and commercialize the new herbal anticancer drug leads through collaboration with pharmaceutical industry. The development and commercialization of these anticancer drug leads will be beneficial to the end users for cancer treatment.

data.projectName: CONCOMITANT USE OF PREEMPTIVE ANALGESIA WITH LOCAL AND GENERAL ANESTHESIA IN RAT UTERINE PAIN SURGICAL MODEL
data.projectDigest: Remedies for the pain resulting from surgical procedure is still a debatable issue. Patients feel severe pain post-operatively due to tissue damage resulting from injury during surgery. In a quest of pain relief, new concept of preemptive analgesia (painkillers) emerged, which suggests that the postoperative pain might be reduced significantly if the pain transmission is blocked before the application of painful stimuli. Since general anaesthesia alone can’t relief pain, using it in combination with local anaesthesia and analgesia may attenuate pain transmission. Post-operative pain leads to activation of pain receptors, which are distributed throughout the body surface and organs.  These activated receptors send pain signals to the spinal cord and to the higher brain centers causing activation of a signalling protein called c-fos in the neurons in the nervous system. In short whenever a pain is felt, it results in the expression of c-fos is within 30-60 minutes in the neurons. Hence the identification of c-fos expression in both brain and spinal cord may be used as a reliable method for assessing the efficacy of pain producing and preventive measures such as pre-emptive analgesia with local and general anaesthesia. Therefore, further research is required to explore these aspects in detail.

data.projectName: Conduct Training Need Assessment (TNA) of Faculty Members of University of Sindh, Jamshoro
data.projectDigest:
Education is human growth, doing and undergoing socialization, a social enterprise and a social activity. The dynamics of education related to the standard & Quality of Teachers. 
The teacher is central element in the educational activities. The world is dynamic and the boundaries of knowledge are extending in all directions. Similarly the methods and manners of giving/imparting knowledge are also changing. The teachers should be aware of the new developments and technology in the educational field. In the education policy of 1969 and subsequent polices to 2009, teacher education and pedagogy is mostly emphasized.

In these policies teacher is considered to be the PIVOT of the entire education system. Effective teaching demands that besides possessing, adequate knowledge of the subject matter and techniques of teaching, our teachers must also exhibit full commitment to the ideology of Pakistan.
 
Pakistani Government have never given high priority to educational sector. Students and Faculty morale is extremely low. Research is practically nonexistent. Classes scheduled are not respected and there is frequent interference of Political parties, thereby, disrupting the academic year. Foreign trained Faculty is seen as guarantee of quality. Private Sector too expensive and public sector of Higher Education is disastrous. Provision of education to its citizen is clearly not a priority for the Government of Pakistan. Low investment in girls Education also imposes a high cost on society.
Meeting the challenges in 21st Century, Pedagogical, management & assessment and research competencies are considered essential competencies for university teachers along with a number of other competencies. 
The hypothesis is that there is no systematic way to gather the needs of teachers

data.projectName: Sustainable management of sugarcane borers using entomopathogenic nematodes
data.projectDigest: Sugarcane is the fourth largest crop of the country. Pakistan ranks 5th worldwide regarding its production. Its yield in Pakistan is less than other countries due to the attack of insect pests and diseases. The sugarcane borers e.g. stem borer and root borer are important pests causing heavy quantitative and qualitative damages. These are controlled by pesticides. The pesticidal usage has residual effects on environment and human health. Therefore, alternative measures are required for their effective management. Entomopathogenic nematodes have desirability to be used as an alternative to pesticides and good choice for IPM programs. These beneficial nematodes with their symbiotically associated bacteria usually kill their insect hosts within 48-72 hours. Many insect pests are susceptible to them yet non targeted insects are not affected. These are safer to environment and sustainable. They do not require specialized application equipment and are compatible with existing application equipment. These can also be applied via irrigation. The proposed project will deal with the evaluation of native EPN species and their symbiotically related bacteria for effective control of sugarcane borers. The opportunities of commercialization and technology dissemination of the developed product will be facilitated among farmers and pesticide industry.

data.projectName: PSYCHOSOCIAL PERPETUATION AND REPERCUSSIONS OF DOMESTIC VIOLENCE AGAINST WOMEN THROUGH DIGITAL MEDIA: AN EMPIRICAL APPROACH FOR THERAPEUTIC GUIDELINES
data.projectDigest: Women constitute almost half the population of Pakistan. The access to and control over resources, power sharing, decision-making, and entitlement to rights for women are still unequally distributed between men and women. Overall, women face discrimination in almost all spheres of life whether it is the public, private, or community setting. Among other detrimental factors, an overwhelming majority of women have been the victim of patriarchal mindset, feudalism, adverse socio-cultural stereotypes. This state of affairs could possibly result in feminization of poverty.  There are rampant short term and long term adverse repercussions on family dynamics that are likely to affect the future generation in subtle discrete forms. This quantitative research is designed with the primal goal of exploring the role of digital media in perpetuating and normalizing domestic violence and how deeper divulgence of this phenomenon could help in devising the psycho-education cum therapeutic guidelines; thus indirectly also addressing the policy making ends of digital media. Quantitative content analysis and Survey research design will be used in order to expose and explicate the perpetuation of domestic violence in Pakistani Drama.

data.projectName: Students’ Cognitive Skills Prediction via Deep Bayesian Neural Network
data.projectDigest:
Parents’ accessibility to social media is one of the major phenomena, which reshape the expectation of parents about students’ academic achievements. Parents notice the wonderful achievements of other students, which increase their expectations. Ultimately, they try to prepare their children for competition. Such expectations push unessential pressure on students, which eventually increase the severity of anxiety, stress, and frustration [1-4]. Such negative emotions profoundly influence the Cognitive Skills (CS) of students. On the other hand, excellent academic achievements are only possible with good CS level because students’ CS is the capacity to perform cognitive processes, such as reasoning, problem solving, understanding, and remembering. CS is mostly considered the ability to accomplish any task that requires reasoning, memory, and problem solving technique. Resultantly, with weak CS, students cannot achieve good learning, memorizing, and understanding skills to performance cognitive tasks, i.e., assignments, quizzes, and written examination. These tasks require a student to mentally process new information (use CS), organize knowledge and allow them to retrieve that information (from memory) for later use (e.g., so, CS is accepted as a payment for good academic achievement or performance). Therefore, timely prediction of students’ CS is essential not only for academic teachers but also for parents to fulfill their desires.
To detect the knowledge state of students’, we need to iteratively estimate CS under the profound impact of frustration severity, and Student Basic Attributes.  The particular deep network will calculate the final posterior probability of students’ CS under the impact of Student Basic Attributes.

data.projectName: Preparation and Characterization of Drug Impregnated Patches through Iontophoretic System
data.projectDigest: The accurate administration of the desired dose of a medicine to the patient with safety and efficacy has always been a vital interest for pharmaceutical formulators. In view of this fact, recent developments have been made in the field of medicine for the administration of a variety of drugs using rapid, non-invasive, convenient and cost-effective methods. Among them, iontophoresis is a relatively new technique to deliver a large quantity of medicine to the localized site of action without causing discomfort, trauma or pain to the patient. Since the drug would be administered through the skin, only a small amount of the drug is absorbed into the blood and rest is all available at the desired site of action. The patients suffering from severe pain conditions in various diseases, such as arthritis, cancer, etc., may be benefitted from this system of treatment due to the rapid and accurate delivery of a drug to the desired site of action resulting in maximum efficacy and minimum side effects.

data.projectName: Neurochemical and Pharmacological Studies of Nutraceuticals Properties of Herbal Diets
data.piUniversity: Sir Syed University of Engg. & Technology, Karachi
data.projectDigest: Nutrition can affect the brain chemistry in humans and animals. Everyone experiences the fact that food and nutrition can alter mood and behavior. Nutraceuticals are food or part of food that provides medical or health benefits including the prevention and/or treatment of a disease. Nutraceuticals has advantage over the medicine because they avoid side effect, have naturally dietary supplement, etc. Nutraceuticals; on the basis of their natural source, chemical grouping, categories into three key terms -nutrients, herbals, dietary supplements, dietary fiber, etc. Dietary supplements and herbal medicines are gaining popularity in many developed countries. Herbal medicines do not usually produce immediate relief of symptoms as most of them are generally concerned with homeostasis. For patients taking multiple medications and dietary supplements or herbal medicines, physicians should look out for herb-drug interactions. The brain is sensitive to change in diet. Nutrition can alter brain function in short time frames, for example, by altering neurotransmitters and neuronal firing and in the long term, such as by altering membrane structure. Neurotransmitters and neuromodulators are basic units of chemical communication within the nervous system. Coriander leaves and Coriander seeds are selected for the proposed study as herbal diets. For experimental model, Albino Wistar rats will be used. After extraction of these herbal diets and applying them on animal, behavioral activities will be monitored using different techniques. After behavioral activities monitoring, rats will be decapitated to collect and store plasma and brain samples. These samples will be used to investigate the biochemical and neurochemical nutraceuticals properties of coriander.

data.projectName: Effect of Magnesium and Potassium Supplementation on Insomniac patients with Diabetes and Hypertension
data.projectDigest: The proposal is aimed to determine the effect of magnesium and potassium supplementation on insomniac patients with diabetes and hypertension. Total 584 patients will be enrolled in the duration of twenty-four months for the trial. Adult insomniac patients with diabetes and/ or hypertension will be selected. Patients will be divided into four groups randomly 73 each, and four different treatments; placebo, magnesium, potassium and magnesium potassium combine will be provided to the patients for two months. Their pre and post body weight, body height, nutrient intake, random blood glucose level, blood pressure, serum electrolytes and sleep hormones will be measured. All the essential materials, chemicals, laboratory equipment, supplements, tablets, serum analysis kits will be procured from the market and will be supplied to the research officers for the smooth execution of the trial. Then after first annual report will be prepared and all the findings will be reported. To remove any ambiguity or biasness in the results confirmatory trial will be run in the year two.

data.projectName: SCREENING OF TOMATO GENOTYPES AGAINST LOW TEMPERATURE STRESS AND ITS MANAGEMENT THROUGH PLANT GROWTH REGULATORS
data.projectDigest: Tomato is a major vegetable crop and its availability throughout the year, at reasonable rates is a necessity for being an important ingredient of Pakistani cuisines. It is a warm season crop and its availability declines with the onset of winter season as it is cold sensitive crop. At that time, off season cultivation is normally at its initial stages so market demand increases with less supply from farm lands. To cope with this situation, a project is being forwarded to screen the available tomato germplasm for low temperature stress tolerance. In first phase, tomato genotypes, collected from different research institutes will be screened for their low temperature stress tolerance. In second phase of project different plant growth regulators (Brassinosteroids, Melatonin, Salicylic acid) will be supplemented to the screened tomato germplasm to improve their low temperature stress tolerance ability.  A series of experiments will be set to manipulate a cultural practice like mulching to extend the life span of crop in field. The project experiments will be planned at lab and field level, aiming at morphological, biochemical and antioxidant response of tomato plants.

data.projectName: Multilayer Flows of Immiscible Non-Newtonian Fluids in Cylindrical Tubes
data.projectDigest:
We frequently encounter flows of mixtures of immiscible fluids in the design of a variety of equipment and industrial processes. Examples range from reducing oil transportation and pumping costs by adding a layer of inexpensive, less viscous fluid to combining two or more melt streams to produce polymers of desired specifications. Certain biomedical fluid flow problems like movement of chime, when there is already a thick layer of mucus on the inner surface of gastrointestinal tract, can also be categorized under multiple layer fluid flow problems. 
Most of the works present in current literature deal with two-layer flows with limited applicability. In the proposed study, we shall consider the analysis of flow of multiple layers of different fluids in cylindrical pipes. These fluid flows, when modeled for complex fluids, result into mathematical differential equations that are mostly nonlinear in nature and very challenging to solve. We shall obtain the solutions using approximate analytical and numerical techniques. The solution for velocity and volume flow rates for these multiple fluid layers, dependent on pressure gradients, are then used to analyse heat transfer analysis. The results can then be applicable to certain flow and thermal heating/cooling processes in these industries.

data.projectName: Isolation, Identification and Mass production of noval bacterium from Entomopathogenic nematode (Oscheius) use for biocontrol of major crop insects
data.projectDigest: Insect pests in agriculture crop an annual loss of 15 - 20 billion rupees in Pakistan. Intensive use of chemical insecticides for pest control resulted not only in high production cost but also in serious problems for environment and human health. Bio-pesticides based on entomopathogenic bacteria (EPB) have been used globally to minimize dependence on hazardous synthetic chemical pesticides and control the crop pests. Symbiotic bacteria (Seratia, Bacillus) isolated from entomopathogenic nematodes (Oscheius) were found effective as bio-control agent against insect pest having non-polluting properties. The role of nematode metabolites is to produce the toxin for breakdown the resistance of insects. This research opens new vision for effective bio-control agent against insect pests. The application of aqueous suspension containing bacterial symbiont represents a new type of bio-control agent. It is possible that suspension of EPB could be used to reduce the pest damage in field condition, and become an important component of integrated pest management against different insect pests. Accurate and prompt identification /diagnosis of these taxa require the implementation of appropriate taxonomic tools. Molecular characters were quickly adopted and became useful tools for species identification and systematic  of nematodes as well as bacteria. Specially molecular approaches became essential tool when dealing with taxonomic ambiguities and it also helps resolving problems such as identification of species that are morphologically similar. The proposed project will produce the bacterium based  bio-pesticide which will be improve the quality of life by helping farmers and home gardeners to control insect pests by using EPB which is replacement for chemicals.

data.projectName: Lanthanides and Heterometallic (3d-4f) Complexes with Magnetic and Photoluminescent Properties
data.projectDigest:
Nanoscience and nanotechnology is a multidisciplinary research that permits the treatment of materials to fit for the existing needs and to tackle different critical issues in the area of energy, medicine, protective equipment and consumer goods. To synthesize and development of molecular materials (also called complexes or co-ordination compounds),  it is necessary to continue the struggle by all field researchers. In synthetic inorganic chemistry, an investigation through coordination chemistry is a big source to synthesize these molecular materials and find their useful applications. Coordination chemistry deals with co-ordination compounds that are formed between metal ions and ligands; metals are deficient of electrons and ligands are electron donor atoms. Coordination compounds are not attractive only due to their structural diversity but also because of their potential applications in various fields such as gas storage, catalysis, molecular separation, sensing, luminescence and magnetism etc. Therefore, coordination chemistry based molecular materials are an emerging class that can play significant role for industry as well as in our daily life.
We have plan to synthesis novel co-ordination compounds based on lanthanides with N- and O- donor sites ligands and to investigate their magnetic and luminescent properties.

data.projectName: DEVELOPMENT OF PINK BOLLWORM (PECTINOPHORA GOSSYPIELLA) RESISTANT TRANSGENIC COTTON (GOSSYPIUM HIRSUTUM L.) BY RNAI-MEDIATED JHBP GENE INHIBITION
data.piUniversity: Pakistan Institute of Engineering & Applied Sciences, Islamabad (PIEAS)
data.projectDigest:
Cotton (Gossypium hirsutum L.) holds incredible position in the economy of Pakistan due to major contribution in fiber raw and oil industry input. During crop season 2018-2019, Pakistan hit record low production going to 5th position globally underpinning the earnings of foreign exchange (60%) by export of cotton related commodities. In Pakistan, cotton faces major challenges particularly control of insect pests, disease, salt/drought complexes and fiber quality. Conventional breeding has developed commercial varieties with high yield but possess a limited gene pool to resist insect pest infestation. Due to climate change, global warming and irrational use of pesticides, cotton crop has witnessed unprecedented scenario of insect attack. Cotton breeding and production are at stagnant position despite using all input resources and production has gone down to 9 million bales (Economic Survey of Pakistan, 2018-2019). 
Among insect pests, chewing complex i.e. pink bollworm (Pectinophora gossypiella), american bollworm (Helicoverpa armigera), spotted bollworm (Earias spps.) and armyworm (Sdodoptera spps.) are major reproductive part attacking insect pest. At present, pink boll worm is most devastating to cotton crop every year and remain uncontrolled despite heavy use of insecticides. Moreover, transgenic cotton plants expressing Bt toxin are ineffective to withstand the attack of pink bollworm.  At present, development of pink bollworm tolerant cotton varieties is being emphasized by stakeholders. RNA interference (RNAi) is a promusingtechnology of gene silencing in homology dependent manner. To supplement existing pest control technology, innovative agricultural pest control strategies are being sought for effective management of cotton pink bollworm.

data.projectName: Molecular prevalence and whole genome sequencing analysis of drug resistant clinical Mycobacterium tuberculosis from the District Narowal Pakistan
data.piUniversity: University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Lahore
data.projectDigest:
Tuberculosis (TB), caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis bacteria, is a leading infectious cause of mortality worldwide, including in Pakistan. Drug resistant M. tuberculosis is an emerging threat for TB control, making it important to detect the underlying genetic mutations, and thereby helpful in treatment decision making and prevention of transmission.  The present  project was designed to determine the molecular prevalence of resistance level of tuberculosis in the district Narowal and the whole genome sequencing of these resistant strans. The research goals of this project are; 
1. Determination of percentages of multi drug resistance (MDR), extensively drug resistance (XDR) and total drug resistance (TDR) in the district Narowal. This will be helpful for the local body government to go for treatment plan according to the status of resistance lies in the district Narowal.
2. Whole genome sequencing (WGS) is newly emerging diagnostic technique and its deployment will have the greatest impact on TB control in highly endemic regions. Moreover, it will enable us to evaluate the mutations leading to drug resistance and to assess for evidence of the transmission of resistant strains.
3. Phylogenetic analysis with WGS data will be useful tranverse the transmission route of TB in district Narowal.

data.projectName: Synthesis and Characterization of 2D-TMD Thin Films for Renewable Energy Applications
data.projectDigest:
The project is about the synthesis of atomically thin semiconducting two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenide (2D-TMDs) thin films via an in-expensive and very simple thermal vacuum coating and their structural characterization by analytical techniques. This project falls in the field of “thermoelectric materials for renewable energy”; which is an emerging field in physics around the globe and is largely lacking in Pakistani institutions. There is a dire need to introduce such areas and let the students explore this new field from the plate forms of Pakistani institutions.
The project involves preparation of thin films of tungsten disulfide (WS2), tungsten diselenide (WSe2), tungsten ditelluride (WTe2), and molybdenum ditellurides (MoTe2) on Si(100) and Cu(100) surfaces using a unique and novel thermal approach which according to the best of my knowledge has never been adopted before in Pakistan. Studies on the structural, morphological, thermoelectric and performance-property relationship will be carried out by spectroscopic ‘Swiss-Army Knife’ (Raman Spectroscopy) as well as other characterization and measurement techniques. It will greatly contribute in the new knowledge in basic sciences. The outcome of the project will be very informative (nationally and internationally) and it will be a great contribution from Pakistan in the International Scientific knowledge.

data.projectName: Mechanically induced transparency and luminality control  in Nano Electro-Opto Mechanics
data.projectDigest: The opto-mechanical interferometers, consisting of high fineness optical cavities with moving-end-mirror and of the size of a few kilometers to few nano-meters, have opened up new ways to foster macroscopic mechanical systems to quantum regime by using the developed quantum optical laws. The motion of the end mirror in itself can be treated quantum mechanically. So achieved mechanical interferometers are largely used in engineering devices, sensors and actuator in electrically integrated circuits, optics and opto-mechanics. At nano meter scales interaction of matter waves with optical fields expand the subject as hybrid electro-opto-mechanical systems (NEOMS). In the proposed research project we develop electro-optic switch based on  mechanically induced transparency, and four-wave-mixing using using NEOMS . The research project focus on the  super-luminal, sub-luminal effects in NEOMS, in addition to continuous variables entanglement, cooling mechanism.

data.projectName: Eradication of Leukemic Stem Cells by using Novel Organometallic compounds: A novel strategy to combat Leukemia in Pakistan
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest:
Leukemia is a group of white blood cancers (WBC) that usually begin in the bone marrow and result in high numbers of immature and abnormal white blood cells called leukemic blasts. This results due to mutation in hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells. Hematological tumors contain immature cells with self-renewal capacity so called leukemic stem cells (LSCs).  These LSCs are responsible for leukemia progression, maintenance and relapse after treatment resistance. Conventional chemotherapies and other targeted therapies are failed in the treatment of leukemia because of these therapies are unable to target LSCs, so there is need of other therapies that can efficiently target LSCs and overcome adaptive resistance.
A range of organometallic compounds/complexes exhibit potent anti-inflammatory, anticancer activity and are becoming increasingly popular in medicine.  We have designed novel organometallic compounds which showed strong anti-proliferative activity in various leukemic cell lines. Therefore we want to further explore their anticancer potential in leukemic cell lines and patient derived primary cells, their role in eradication of LSCs and chemo-resistances, the main causes of relapse in leukemia. This project will result in  discovery of new drugs and new candidates for therapeutic intervention and will enhance the prognosis of the patients.

data.projectName: The design and synthesis of quinoxalinone derivatives for multi-targeted enzyme inhibition and docking study
data.piUniversity: Khwaja Fareed University of Engineering and Information Technology, Rahim Yar Khan
data.projectDigest:
IIn the last few decades, diabetic complications treatment and cancer chemotherapy has made major advances in the field of medical. However, the drugs used for this therapy have a narrow therapeutic index, and often the responses produced are unpredictable.
Diabetes mellitus (DM) is a complex and chronic metabolic disease caused by hyperglycemia. This disease is very common in the world and has major health problems in public. In case of hyperglycemia condition the significant portion of the glucose enters into polyol pathway which is considered as the primary cause of pathogenesis of long-term diabetic complications, including retinopathy, nephropathy, neuropathy and cataract. Aldose reductase  is a member of aldo-keto reductase  which catalyzes the NADPH-dependent reduction of glucose to sorbitol  in the rate determing step of polyol pathway. The accumulation of sorbitol causes the oxidative stress inside  the cells are thought to be major causes of cellular damage that develop diabetic  complications. 
Recently, growing studies and evidences reveal that ALR2 plays a pivotal role for diabetic complications. 
Thus inhibition of ALR2 represents the strategy and an attractive approach to prevent and delay the progression and development of diabetic complications.

data.projectName: In-silico multi-target identification in-vitro and in-vivo validation of ?-tocopherol derivatives for cost-effective Alzheimer treatment
data.projectDigest: Alzheimer disease (AD) is most common type of dementia and progressive disease which causes problems with memory, planning, & behavior. New drug molecules are always the challenging task for the scientist. Computational studies play a prominent role in the discovery of the new drug candidates. Computational studies reduce the cost and workload without compromising the discovery of new promising compounds. These compounds will be analyzed computationally to find out the new targets. These computationally derived compounds will be validated through in-vitro analysis by using the different enzyme assays. From the last few decades FDA only approved few drugs. The reason behind the failure may be the toxicity, unprofitable barriers and not available readily due to the lengthy and laborious processes. In this project our main focus is on cost effective & cheap synthesis of the new molecules that will be multi-targeted. Alzheimer is a complex disease and only the ACHE inhibitors are reported. But literature showed that decrease level of acetylcholine is not the main reason behind AD. Beta amyloid and tau plaques, neuro-inflammation and neuro-degeneration are also the leading cause of AD. The drug candidates that have the capability to show their functions on multi-targets are highly appreciated with low toxicity.

data.projectName: Solar Energy as an alternate to Electricity in Poultry Houses
data.piUniversity: University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Lahore
data.projectDigest:
Intermittent supply of electricity is a major problem for all but poultry in particular because birds cannot survive even for few hours without electricity and when backup generators are operated it enhances the cost of production that hampers the farmer cost of production. Therefore, the development of more efficient and economical alternative means of electricity are the need of the hour. 
Use of solar system to operate the major equipment and operating floor heating system (FSH) by using solar energy can be a future prospect considering the energy crises of the country. As it was found more economical and environment friendly for human and chicks. Floor heating system is considered best when compared with other conventional brooders as it decreases bacterial load and minimize obnoxious gases in poultry house. Moreover, it also reduces the incidences of necrotic enteritis, coccidiosis and E-coli. As there is no CO2 and CO production in this system, farmers can grow more birds per sq.ft with higher stocking density than conventional systems. Moreover, FHS is 30 percent more economical as compare to conventional brooders.

data.projectName: NUTRITIONAL AND ANTIMICROBIAL PROFILE OF HONEY PRODUCED BY VARIOUS HONEYBEE SPECIES AND GENETIC DIVERSITY AMONG HONEYBEE SPECIES (GENUS: APIS).
data.piUniversity: University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Lahore
data.projectDigest: Beekeeping is an age-old tradition in Pakistan but it is not considered as a profit making venture. Thus, while beekeeping has been part of normal agricultural enterprise among some communities in the country, honey production has largely been at a subsistence level. However, honey is found in beehives in large quantities in Pakistan and it has been recognized that honey production (beekeeping) has the potential to develop as a prime agro-horticultural and forest-based industry. Natural honey, a product prepared by the bees (Genus Apis) is a nutritious viscous liquid and also has medicinal importance. It is considered very important commodity in international market; aiding in foreign exchange earnings for many countries and literatures are rife with ancient uses of honey as complementary and alternative medicine. Honey is not only important for its medicinal attributes, but also useful as food source due to its nutritional profile. The honeybee species belonging to the genus Apis will be collected from various honeybee farms in Punjab and from their natural colonies and will be identified on molecular basis. Study will aid in understanding nutritional profile and medicinal importance of honey produced by native and introduced Apis species in Pakistan.

data.projectName: Rehabilitation and modeling of large diameter recharging wells at Junaid Jamshed Stadium, UET, Lahore
data.projectDigest: For the purpose rainwater harvesting , four large diameter recharging wells (each of 15 ft dia. & 30 ft depth) were installed by the Lahore Development Authority (LDA) in the four corners of Junaid Jamshed Cricket Stadium, UET Lahore for groundwater recharge in July, 2018. The design was such that during any rainfall event, the surface water of the quarter stadium enters in to the recharging well through the appropriate sewerage system. To monitor the performance of the installed recharging wells (inflow rate into the recharging wells, and improvement in the water table levels), an M.Sc. study was assigned to the Muhammad Ashiq Masood in 2018. He installed a flowmeter and two piezometers for monitoring of recharging well ‘RW2’. It was observed that all four recharging wells were choked and almost no water is entering the recharging wells. Moreover, one of the installed observation well was also tempered by someone and readings from that well were stopped. Considering that scenario, it was felt appropriate to rehabilitate the existing huge facility for recharging the ground through NRPU funding. Objectives of research will be to rehabilitate the recharging wells and already installed equipment, to monitor recharging wells by installing new flowmeter and piezometer, and to determine the impact of recharging wells on reducing the groundwater depletion rates. To fulfill the objectives of research work, firstly, filter media of the recharging wells will be changed to make them workable. Then, flowmeter and piezometer will be re-installed for monitoring of all the recharging wells. After this, software Visual MODFLOW will be used to do the analysis of depletion ratesand subsequently future predications will be made.

data.projectName: Assessment of genetic architecture of micronutrients accumulation in grains by multi-locus and multi trait genomeAssessment of genetic architecture of micronutrients accumulation in grains by multi-locus and multi trait gen wide association studies (GWAS)
data.projectDigest: Improvement of the nutritional quality of staple crops to combat with essential micronutrients malnutrition which is now referred as ‘hidden hunger’ is an important research challenge. Understanding the genetic basis of accumulation of micronutrients in the grains and mapping of the quantitative trait loci will unravel the genes underlying the natural variation and provide the basis for devising the plant breeding strategies for improving grain micronutrient content through marker-assisted selection. The wild relatives of wheat serve an important genetic resource that has greater potential than common wheat cultivars for micronutrient biofortification. The present study is designed to explore genetic diversity in indigenous wheat germplasm in Pakistan for multi-traits including grain size, morphological and yield attributes, grain protein and phytate contents along with the accumulated concentration of macronutrients and micronutrients (N, P, K, Ca, Mg, Fe, Mn, Mo, Cu, Zn, Co, Na, Cd, As, Pb and Ni) in seeds. This study will also focus on effect of optimal mineral fertilizers on seed ionome under deficient and sufficient micronutrient supply. Finally, this study is to assess the genetic architecture of grain micronutrients accumulation by using GWAS. Detailed study with respect to wheat seed ionome linked with genome wide markers will provide us information to identify the specific gene(s) families involved in micronutrients accumulation in grain.

data.projectName: Designing Nano-devices for the removal of hepato and neuro toxins
data.projectDigest: We are being exposed to these toxic chemicals day by Drugs, hepato/neuro/ cyto/uremic toxins pose harmful effects to liver, nervous system, kidneys, and entire metabolic system of human body. To maintain the integrity of vital organs responsible to drive important body functions, there is strict need for check and balance of these hazardous chemicals in our environment. Creation of nanodevices/membranes for the detection/removal of such harmful substances from biological or environmental systems is the main focus of current research project. Thanks to nanotechnology, that enabled researchers to introduce new materials for enrichment and separation of analyte from complex samples. Expeditious progress in the synthesis of nanomaterials is leading towards the development of novel nano oxide composites, nanopolymers, Nanofibers and nano conjugated adsorbent membranes with controlled morphology, size and composition. In the following proposed project, Novel nanocomposites, nanodiscs  electerospun nanofibers and membranes will be prepared for the removal of toxins in real samples. Primary aim of this research is; to synthesize sorbents, to create electerospun nanofibres, to fabricate membranes from these electerospun fibers, to characterize the synthesized sorbents/fibers/membranes by FTIR, XRD, SEM, TEM, TGA, etc. and to utilize them for the removal of hepato/nephro/neuro/cyto toxins. Adsorption/ enrichment conditions, thermodynamic parameters and reusability of sorbents will also be investigated. LC-UV, LC-MS, LC-MS/MS, etc. will be used to carry out detailed analysis

data.projectName: Study of Interactions between Hydrophilic Drugs and Surfactants
data.projectDigest:
Small hydrophilic drugs have toxic side effects and unsuitable bio-distribution. Moreover, they are soluble and freely dispersed in water. Aqueous solubility of hydrophilic drugs is appreciably good and can readily dissolve but they do not pass easily through lipid membranes. Membrane permeability may be the main factor which limits the penetration of these drugs rather than the rate of dissolution . So, there can be some alternative ways to deliver these hydrophilic compounds across the brain blood barrier. The possible strategies include use of chemical transporters, use of chemotherapeutic agents in high dose or implants from biodegradable substances. There are major limitations of these methods because of loss of efficiency and toxic side effects. Procedures to achieve these targets may be invasive lowering the efficiency of the system. 
A strategy most commonly used to enhance lipophilic character of hydrophilic therapeutic drugs is entrapping the hydrophilic agents within the lipid spheres which form a structure like the liposomes. The main problem arising by the use of liposome type structures is that after the intravenous dosage, these liposome structures are rapidly vanished from the blood stream. On the other hand, it was observed that hydrophilic drugs when converted to lipophilic analogues ought to pass the brain blood barrier more easily because there is a strong correlation between lipophilicity and the permeability across the brain. eg ; Morphine has poor penetration across the brain but its diacyl derivative, heroine just by being lipophilic penetrates the brain blood barrier very easily as compared to its parent compound.

data.projectName: Mechanical Characterization and Machining Challenges of Aluminium Matrix Composites (AMCs) fabricated by Squeeze Casting
data.projectDigest: Aluminium matrix composites (AMCs) have been extensively used in several engineering and structural applications due to its inherent properties such as better wear and corrosion resistance, good hardness, high strength-to-weight ratio, excellent creep behavior and design flexibility. Characteristics of aluminium matrix composite are greatly affected by; (i) type, size, shape and weight percentage of reinforcement; (ii) selection of processing technique, and (iii) type and properties of matrix. Numerous challenges have to face during the fabrication of AMCs for example the ability to process into desired geometrical shapes, reinforcement mixing, higher processing temperatures and reinforcement-matrix interface bonding issues. Squeeze casting amalgamation the forging and die casting with near-net shapes, improved tribological, microstructural, mechanical and machining characterization. It conquers inherent defects (micro cracks, shrinkages cavities and gas porosities) may cause by liquid conventional casting techniques. Appropriate selection of key process parameters is very important for improving the mechanical characteristics of AMCs. Thus the aim of this research work is to examine the effects of the process parameters (reinforcement weight%, squeeze pressure, melt and die temperature) on the mechanical characteristics (ultimate tensile strength, hardness and percentage elongation) of AMCs. While machining challenges for AMCs is also concern of this work.

data.projectName: Forecasting to Adaptations: Risk from Extreme Meteorological Events under Changing Climate to Downstream Water Uses
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest: This project is based on different phases. First phase is based on the estimation of water availability in rivers due to climate change at the end of century (21st or 2099). Second phase is based on change in reservoir operation due to water resources under climate change. the third phase is based on the analysis of water peak availability and demand at downstream level for agriculture purpose and flood risk management. This study is to connect the upstream river watershed system to the end water user community at downstream level under climate change scenarios.  Therefore it is essential to investigate the climate change impacts on hydrology of the rivers, reservoir operation, floods and agriculture system.

Utmost used of Packed-bed reactors in chemical engineering because of rapid conversion and usefulness in oil, gas and petroleum fields. In the reactive chromatography, the chromatographic column behaves as a reactor itself. Reactant in form of pulses are periodically injected the reactor which converts into products. If the strongly adsorbed reactant produces weakly adsorbed product or weakly adsorbed reactant gives strongly adsorbed product then separated peaks of reactant and products can be collected at the reactor exit.

data.projectName: Iron Nutrition and Biofortification of Mungbean through Agronomic approaches
data.projectDigest:
Iron (Fe) deficiency is considered to be one of the main human nutrition problems all over the world including Pakistan. The intake of low dietary iron is a more prevalent problem that causes iron deficiencies in human health. The major proportion of pulses and cereals is utilized in the countries prone to micronutrient deficiencies. Mungbean being a good source of edible proteins and vitamins can fulfill the demand of food for increasingly growing population. Among pulse crops, mungbean is an important crop mainly in developing countries like Pakistan where people can’t afford the meat requirement therefore may use mungbean as an alternative source of protein. It is estimated that the pulses and cereals have comparatively low quantities of iron. The crop cultivation in iron deficient soils may further reduces the iron availability in crop grains. The most cost-effective solution to recover the crops from mineral nutrients deficiencies is biofortification. In the process of biofortification, the use of agronomic strategies, crop breeding and modern biotechnology can improve nutritive value of food crops. Therefore, our proposed study will focus primarily in improving minerals concentration of grains and productivity of mungbean through agronomic biofortification, comprising four approaches viz. soil treatment, seed priming, seed coating and exogenous spray.
During 1st year, the pot experiments will be performed to select the optimum level of iron (Fe) to improve the germination and productivity of mungbean. 
During 2nd year, pots and field experiments will be conducted to estimate the potential of Fe nutrition in improving grain biofortification of mungbean. 
3rd year study, Screening of genotypes for Fe potential ii) Evaluating the potential of Fe nutrition in mungbean

data.projectName: E-leadership for quality education in public sector higher education institutions of Pakistan: Prospects and challenges
data.piUniversity: National University of Modern Languages, Islamabad (NUML)
data.projectDigest: Educational institutions are complex ecologies and dynamic organizations that require a change in the domains of academics and leadership. Transformational potentials of information and communication technology demand that educational leaders enhance their competencies to meet the demands of 21st century quality education. 7th outcome target of the Sustainable Development Goal 4(Quality Education) highlights that by 2030 all learners must acquire the competence needed to promote sustainable development. Furthermore, this goal requires that global citizenship for sustainable development must be created. All these aspects demand that our higher education institutions provide conducive, competitive and quality learning environment for attaining the required targets. For rationalization of quality education, learning environment will be transformed as nerve centers where educational management will have to emphasize more on practice along with the theory. Educational leaders have to enhance their competence and envision prospects and challenges for quality education at higher level. We cannot deny the significance of technology incorporation in teaching-learning environment. So, the educational leaders need to shift towards becoming e-leaders to cope up with the changing organizational patterns facilitated by the digital revolution.
