data.projectName: Introduction of nano-modified alkali-activated concrete using locally available waste material and recycled aggregate
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest: Concrete has wide application in construction engineering and most of the civil infrastructure, which represents the development of any country, is made from this material. However, the main ingredient used in making concrete is cement. This material generates CO2 gas during its manufacturing making it an eco-unfriendly material. Furthermore, concrete experience some problems related to durability under extreme exposure conditions like freeze-thaw, acid and elevated temperature.  The main aim of this project is to reduce the carbon footprint of the concrete to minimal value by incorporating alkali-activated concrete which is made from industrial waste materials like fly ash, slag, metakoalin and is cement free. Moreover, this project will also incorporate the recycled aggregate instead of natural aggregates to preserve the environment and to utilize the available construction waste. The durability of these refined concrete will be assessed under different environmental conditions like freeze and thaw, acid and elevated temperature. Furthermore, nano materials will also be incorporated in this research project to study the engineering properties of these concrete and to compare the performance of these cement free with conventional concrete. This new research will facilitate and motivate the infrastructure development agencies to utilize the industrial waste materials with alkali-activators and to reduce the carbon footprint of these infrastructure development projects.

data.projectName: Template assisted fabrication and characterization of 3D nanostructured materials for sustainable catalysis in Fuel Cell applications
data.projectDigest: In this project, the Principle Investigator (Dr Samina Akbar) will utilize technology she developed in her PhD in the University of Reading, UK, as a route to high performance electrodes with three-dimensional nanowire network structures exhibiting unique high electrocatalytically active surface area. In her PhD she used a versatile approach to fabricate platinum materials with unique nanoarchitecture , and has led to a number of high profile publications, (Samina Akbar, Joanne M. Elliott, Martyn Rittman, and Adam M. Squires, Facile Production of Ordered 3D Platinum Nanowire Networks with “Single Diamond” Bicontinuous Cubic Morphology, Advanced Materials, 25(8):1160-4, 2013. Impact factor: 25.8); and a successful patent application (WO 2012/ 131296 A3, application number PCT/GB2012/000279). The current proposal will produce the first such a morphology in a Pt/Ru composite, and we anticipate that this project will led to flourish the research and innovation in energy sector and will yield similar high-profile publications and has potential for commercial application of the proposed fabricated nanomaterials.

data.projectName: Spectral and Energy Efficient Ultra-dense Networks for Beyond 5G and Towards 6G
data.piUniversity: NED University of Engineering & Technology, Karachi
data.projectDigest: Ultra-dense networks (UDNs) have attracted wide attention in the recent years to address ever-growing traffic volume by densifying the number of base stations and/or the number of communication links in a unit area. Network densification is considered as a paradigm for the successful distribution of IoT (Internet of Things) services towards smart cities, smart health, smart education, industrial automation, and smart agriculture, to name a few. The goal of the project is to analyze UDN models with state-of-the-art massive multiple input multiple output (MIMO) and simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) techniques to meet the demands of increased throughput capacity and reduced energy consumption. Stochastic geometry tools will be used for modelling and analyzing the proposed UDNs, and the performance is evaluated in terms of spectral and energy efficiency. The expressions obtained from the analysis govern system performance and enable the understanding of network operation, hence provide insightful design guidelines to the cellular mobile operators for deploying future wireless networks.

data.projectName: Studying Genomic Diversity of Pakistani  Pathotypes of Puccinia striiformis through Whole Genome Sequencing
data.projectDigest:
Stripe rust is caused by a fungal pathogen called Puccinia striiformis tritici. This pathogen is of great economic importance in Pakistan. Wheat growing areas of Central Punjab, Khyber Pakhtoonkhawn and some parts of Baluchistan are considered hot spots for stripe rust infections. Stripe rust population monitored on regular basis in Europe and USA for virulence pattern and population structure under natural conditions. Unfortunatly, this type of monitoring is missing from Pakistan.  Due to this many strip rust epidemics have been observed in Pakistan with different magnitudes of losses. A huge loss was observed when an epidemic of stripe rust was observed on local white in province Baluchistan during wheat cropping season of 1991-92. Two varieties of similar genetic back-ground Pak-81 and Pirsabak-85 carry  Yr9 gene were badly hit by stripe rust in 1995 and created an epidemic situation in Pakistan. Epidemic on the Inqilab-91, in which Yr27 gene was postulated, during the 2003-04 was one of the most devastating epidemic. In a study of Sharma Poudyal et al., 2013, 46 isolates were analyzed and out of these 46, 42 races were identified. This indicates that high diversity if present in Pakistan. These 46 isolated were collected only from few wheat growing areas. 
So, the current study is designed to analysis stripe rust pathotype structure pattern in Pakistan and their genome sequencing. There will be two main out comes of this project, one, the race structure of Puccinia striiformis will be determined. Since growth chamber will be purchased in this project, the monitoring will be carried out on regular basis. Second, with the whole genome sequencing we will be able to find out the genetic variation and also the effectors molecules related to pathogenicity of the Puccinia

data.projectName: Influence of Tanoli Hindko Causing Miscommunication in Speaking English:  A Solution Focused Approach
data.projectDigest: This project, ‘Influence of Tanoli Hindko Causing Miscommunication in Speaking English:  A Solution Focused Approach’ will be carried out in Tanawal, Hazara. The students of the elementary and the secondary schools will be trained to pronounce correct English words which cause miscommunication in their academic and professional life. The activities will be conducted in 20 schools, around 50 from each. This issue of wrong pronunciation of English words among Tanoli the interlocutors was identified during a doctoral project. The findings related to wrong pronunciation will to be applied practically to minimize the influence of the first language on the second language. For example, the word, /pen/ is pronounced as /pin/, and the word /pin/ is also articulated as /pin/; thus, miscommunication occurs among speakers and listeners. There are number of other English words which are wrongly pronounced due to the place and manner of articulation of consonants and vowels. In addition, Tanoli Hindko speakers also break the consonant cluster word finally. For example, the English words alarm, film, horn, and shaft are pronounced as alaram, filem, horen and shafet resulted as miscommunication. A team of five members will identify and develop a list of problematic words and carry out the training of the students in the presence of the English teachers. So the teachers can apply the same methodology on the rest of the students in the schools. In this way, the issue can be overcome effectively. This project will not only be helpful for the trainees in their current academic life, but also in their higher studies and professional life.

data.projectName: Development of stable and efficient dye-sensitized solar cells (DSSCs) based on polymer gel electrolytes for wireless electronics applications
data.projectDigest:
Dye-Sensitized solar cells  (DSSCs) have a reliable power output in a whole range of lighting conditions, including indoor fluorescent or LED lighting. They can even work in diffuse sunlight. Silicon solar cells perform poorly under these conditions.  DSSCs can be applied in wireless sensor networks (smart buildings, smart cities and smart homes), medical and sports devices, security sensors and cameras, and wearable electronics (bracelets, watches, armbands, etc.). A significant portion of these wireless sensor networks/smart electronic devices  is a part of the Internet of Things (IoT) ecosystem that promises large networks of connected devices collecting the big data upon which our medical, manufacturing, infrastructure, and energy industries will be monitored and optimized. Thus, DSSCs can be the potential candidates for the IoT applications. 
The aim of this project is to buid in-house capability to fabricate and test DSSCs for IoT applications. The proposed research will directly cater to the need of the solar energy technology. It will addresses problems related to expensive manufacturing of silicon solar cells, their rigidity and relative difficulty in application. These attributes will give PV an edge over the existing technology. This project will generate intellectual property in this important area which will eventually benefit the Pakistan. The targeted use of this research will be the solar industry inside  and outside the Pakistan.

data.projectName: STRENGTHENING FAMILY INSTITUTION
data.projectDigest:
This project aims to strengthen ‘Family Institution’ in Pakistan. In the face of ever increasing divorce rate this project is crucial. Growing divorce rate is destroying the social fabric of our society leaving women in stress and financial problems and the fear of raising their children as a single parent, numerous problems faced by men and children undergoing psychological problems and displacement. This research will target population of Punjab province. Initially a survey will be conducted on the growing divorce rate by administering questioner to the sample and carrying out interviews of selected sample. Awareness of sample regarding ‘Family Laws’ as stated in Muslim Family Laws Ordinance of 1961 (MFLO-1961) and its application will also be assessed. This data will help in assessing the reasons of increasing divorce rate.
After carrying out initial survey its findings will be analyzed and codified. On the basis of findings an awareness campaign will be launched in the form of conferences, seminars, lectures to educate the public on importance of ‘Family Institution’ in a society and the rewards it brings towards social harmony and healthy upbringing of children. Public will also be informed about the family laws prevalent in Pakistan. Pakistan being Islamic Republic and all laws to be in conformity with Quran and Sunnah, the religious percepts and precedents form Islamic history will also be informed to the public. This will help in bringing a wealth of research on the issue under concern.
Parallel to this a study will be conducted on the research material and suggestions proposed by Council of Islamic Ideology (CII)  on the problem under consideration. Findings of initial survey will be put up to the Council for further deliberation from an Islamic perspective to

data.projectName: Unmanned aerial vehicles for automation of inspection of tall industrial infrastructure to enhance safety and reliability in the power and communication sectors
data.piUniversity: National University of Computer and Emerging Sciences, Islamabad
data.projectDigest:
Inspection of tall industrial infrastructure components is necessary to ensure reliability and continuity of service. This is all the more important in the case of power generation, transmission & distribution and communication industry where a failure has direct impact on the consumer. These industries use tall infrastructure on top of which there are mounted numerous components. The health of these components is of utmost importance when it comes to the continuity of service.
The conventional method of retaining these components in good condition is to perform regular inspections and maintenance & repair whenever deemed necessary. These inspections are performed by humans who risk their lives climbing up such structures. Sometimes, low-flying helicopters are used which are also risky operations and also add to cost and environmental pollution and greenhouse gas emissions.
This project proposes to develop tools and methods to use unmanned aerial vehicles to autonomously acquire image data and a software program to autonomously analyze this data to save on cost and improve safety in industry. It will also have the added benefit of development of cutting edge technologies that could make the country a leader in computer vision and automatic condition assessment.

data.projectName: Fabrication of Metal Oxide thin films for Optoelectronics and  Optomagnetic Applications
data.projectDigest:
The research project focuses upon the synthesis and structural characterization of metal-organic compounds which shall be applied as single source molecular precursors (SSPs) in aerosol assisted chemical vapour deposition process for the preparation of nanostructured metal Oxides in different forms including nano-thin-films and nano-powder. It is a known fact that the solubility of the metal organic compounds to be used as SSP is very important in obtaining the desired MOs nanostructures by AACVD process. Therefore, the metal-organic molecular SSPs will be designed and developed having higher solubility in the common organic solvents such as toluene, benzene, THF, DMF, ethanol, methanol etc. A series of homo and hetero-metallic complexes will be synthesized using state of the art schlenk tube and vacuum line technique. The micro analysis and structure of ligand-metal complexes in solution will be analyzed by spectroscopic techniques such as Melting point, CHN, FTIR, and 1HNMR spectroscopy. While in solid state the structures of ligand-metal complexes will be established using single crystal X-rays diffraction technique. Once the SSPs are developed in their molecular form will be used for the preparation of MOs nanostructures by AACVD in the form of nano-thin films, and nano-powder under varying parameters. 
The microstructure optimization will be obtained by the characterization of thin films using different analytical techniques including FTIR, powder XRD, SEM, EDXS, BET and UV band gap calculation. The optimized nanostructured thin films will be as semiconductor for their potential high-tech applications in optoelectronic and optomagnetic devices.

data.projectName: Serum Visfatin and Vaspin concentration in pregnant Pakistani women of different BMI along gestation; A hospital based study
data.piUniversity: National University of Medical Sciences, Rawalpindi
data.projectDigest:
Improving maternal health is amongst the eight goals of United Nations Millennium Development Program. Currently, 20–40% of women gain more than recommended weight during pregnancy, resulting in an increased risk of maternal and fetal complications. The health risks to mother and baby of excessive weight gain pose significant demands on health-care system. These consequences of obesity for pregnancy and childbirth are not always mechanistically understood, but are the subject of increasing research interest. In recent years, the controversial role of adipocytokines such as Visfatin and Vaspin has been the focus of research in normal and complicated pregnancies.  This has led us to investigate the maternal levels of serum and cord blood Visfatin and Vaspin including its expression in myometrium and placenta along gestation. Further we will investigate the histological and morphological changes in myometrium, placenta and umbilical cord associated with altered levels of Visfatin and Vaspin with varying body mass index. 
This study will provide a novel approach of using adipokine to reduce obesity and treat its metabolic complications including diabetes mellitus, hypertension and decreased risk of all causes of mortality. Identification of novel obesity reducing drugs will revolutionize the treatment options and patent filing of our pharmaceutical industry.

data.projectName: Development of Mental Health First Aid Training Manual for Teachers:  Implementation of a Preventive and Health Assistance Model in Academic Settings
data.projectDigest: Recognizing the grassroots barriers in mental health awareness and access to mental health services in Pakistan, there is dire need to offer wide spread and viable alternate health care options. As adolescents and young people spend a great deal of time in school/ colleges involving heavy interaction with teachers, we believe that inclusivity of teachers in health assistance may have long lasting effects on young minds. Development and delivery of an assistive specialized literacy based mental health care model in schools as a preventive measure is the basis of the project. Introducing the “Mental Health First Aid Training” for teacher is based on the idea to treat young people with specialized care through equipping teachers with knowledge and skills of identifying and managing mental health issues as a mean to minimize the problematic behaviour patterns and to help them face life challenges more positively. The information pack will be available in schools addressing awareness and management of most common mental health issues including anxiety, depressions, life and academic stressors, developmental issues, substance use and self-harm. A planned sustainable programing with element of capacity building of significant change agents can prove effective in context of low cost institutional based health care.

data.projectName: Facilitator or an exploiter? Evaluating role of Arhti (commission agent) in farmers' production and marketing outcomes
data.projectDigest: Marketing of farm products constitute the major activity once crops have been successfully raised by the farmers. If the sales receipts are handsome, farmers do plan future activities on sound basis while any mishap in the marketing process may lead to shaky decision and problematic outcome. Role of commission agent (Arhti) is crucial in safeguarding the farmers while disposing the produce. Many a times he is left with no clue how to market his produce if such an intermediary is unavailable or non-functional. An Arhti has multiple roles to play in the success of primary production at farm level - by providing informal credit to the farmers both in the form of cash and kind and then by procuring his produce at the time of harvest - although some issues/malpractices are reported frequently. This research will explore the role of Arhti in influencing farmers' choice of enterprise mix, crop husbandry practices, level of input use and their source of purchase, and finally his marketing decisions in terms of disposing final produce either to Arhti or other supply chain actors.

data.projectName: Modeling and Validation of Futuristic Supply Chain Management: CPEC Perspective
data.projectDigest:
China Pakistan Economic Corridor (CPEC) is a $62 billion mega project consisting of transportation (highways and railways), energy and economic zones across Pakistan to create a link between China and Central Asia. This study would develop a model for supply chain practitioners and policy makers to better govern and enhance performance of organizations connected with CPEC in the following setting:
Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) model was developed by supply chain council in 1996. Since its inception, it has been used by many organizations such as GE, DuPont, IBM, Intel, Philips lighting and Airbus with significant improvements in processes. SCOR model describes hierarchically structured framework of standard Processes, People, Practices and Performance intended to be an industrial standard. It has accumulated 170 practices differentiating them as Emerging, Best, Standard and Declining practices. This research would rank and model emerging practices (23 in total) of SCOR model with the help of SCM experts by establishing the criterion of ‘strategic supply chain performance’. After this, driver practices of the model would be identified to form the constituents of final parsimonious model. Lastly, this model would be validated by collecting data from companies directly involved in CPEC projects.

data.projectName: Identification of Microfinance addiction and development of an effective counteragent framework
data.projectDigest:
1.	Project Title:                   Identification of Microfinance addiction and development of an effective 
                                                        counteragent framework
2.	Theme:                          	 Action research in microfinance
3.	Discipline:                         Finance
4.	Justification:                   Banks are increasingly identifying microfinance addiction symptoms in                                                        repeat clients of Microfinance schemes. Bank clients are using microfinance to support consumptive use rather than employing it productively in small business and entrepreneurial ventures. This microfinance addiction phenomenon has proven to be a deterrent to social mobility rather than being an agent of financial and social stability.
This study focuses on identifying addiction tendencies in microfinance consumers and developing a counteragent framework to avoid addiction and increase effectiveness of microfinance as a tool of poverty alleviation and social mobility in people of South Punjab.
5.	Objectives       
i.	To identify factors leading to microfinance addiction.
 ii.	To develop counteragent framework to ensure effective use of microfinance 
          for social mobility and sustainability objectives. 
iii.	To initiate microfinance literacy hub for training and counseling users of microfinance.
iv.	To monitor and evaluate individual microfinance experience using counteragent framework.

6.	Estimated Cost & Tenure	Rs. 8.484 million over 3 years.
7.	Beneficiaries	
•	Present and prospective Microfinance consumers (Individuals and Small & Medium 
        Enterprises)
•	Community
•	Microfinance Banks
•	State Bank of Pakistan

data.projectName: 4.	Extraction and characterization of natural colorants from plants  for their potential application in the  sustainable development of colored lip cosmetics
data.projectDigest: There is an increasing demand of natural cosmetics based on plants colorants due to their sustainability and eco-friendly and healthy effects. Different types of plant based colorants such as carotenoids and anthocyanins have been reported to have anti-microbial, anti-cancer, anti-inflammatory and anti-oxidant activities[1]. These colorants have been applied in textile and food industry [2]. However, a limited work has been done about their application in colored cosmetic formulations. Owing to the public awareness of the side effects of synthetic chemicals and heavy metal contamination of colored cosmetics, there is increasing demand of the cosmetic ingredients that are biodegradable, eco-friendly and sustainable. These natural cosmetics have additional multifunctional effects such as UV protection, anti-aging, anti-oxidant and anti bacterial [3, 4]. Recent research work has been designed to investigate and evaluate the characteristics of plant based colorants and their application in the formulation of skin coloring cosmetics such as lipsticks and lip balms.  The actual work is to identify and explore the stable and highly beneficial plant based natural colorants. Then employ their beneficial properties in the formulation of stable and healthy topical coloring formulations. Lipsticks and lip gloss will be formulated using high quality waxes and oils. Different color shades of the lipsticks will be developed using combination of various natural colorants under optimized conditions of pH and color shades. data.projectName: Characterization and functional analyses of genes involved in Verticillium infection and drought stress in cotton using next generation sequencing coupled with virus induced gene silencing
data.piUniversity: Sardar Bahadur Khan Women University, Quetta
data.projectDigest: Cotton is an important crop around the world, and it also has a potential to serve as a model for polyploidization and studying genome size evolution. Efforts have been made for enhanced virus resistance, sustainable yield and quality through development of improved cotton varieties and cultivation practices. The recent developments and advances in cotton genomics have generated significant interest in the molecular breeding of new cotton varieties. Apart from conventional breeding an alternative approach is offered by genetic engineering for the incorporation of novel genes in cotton for useful traits. Till today genomes of four cotton species are available i.e Gossypium raimondii, Gossypium arboreum, Gossypium hirsutum and Gossypium barbadense. Therefore, it has become essential that molecular tools should be developed for high throughput analyses of gene functions at the genome-wide level. We have optimized a method to silence any gene in cotton using Tobacco rattle virus (TRV). In the proposed project we shall focus on two characters i.e Verticillium resistance and drought stress tolerance. Both these stresses will be given to selected cotton cultivars and transcriptome analyses will be done using next generation sequencing (NGS) platform. Genes which behave differentially will be identified and their functional analyses will be done using TRV. The outcome of the project will be list of candidate genes that can be used for the development of drought and Verticillium resistance germplasm/ varieties for cultivation in the field.

data.projectName: Design and Implement Technology Integrated Formative Assessment Model: Multiple case studies of Urban Less Privileged Areas in Karachi, Pakistan
data.piUniversity: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science & Technology (SZABIST) University, Karachi
data.projectDigest: The study aims to design, implement and evaluate technology integrated formative assessment model. The researchers will employ sequential embedded experimental design to conduct the study. The population of the study will be students, subject teachers teaching languages (English, Urdu or Sindhi), Science and Mathematics and heads of three types of schools, which will be public, low cost private and community supported schools. The study is comprising in five different phases. In first phase, perception and practices of assessment feedback will be explored through semi- structured interviews with teachers and head and FGDs with students. In the second phase researchers will design customized software applications for the generation of assessment feedback in local languages. The third phase will be focusing on development of assessment material. The fourth phase will focus on implementation of technology integrated formative assessment model in targeted schools. The last phase of the project will be focus on evaluation of project.  The experimental design will be used for measuring the impact of assessment feedback on student achievement. Student achievement test of targeted students. The qualitative data will be analyzed using thematic analysis whereas quantitative data will be analyzed through one sample T test.

data.projectName: Development of eco-efficient pilot scale wastewater treatment wetlands system for industrial estate effluent in Faisalabad-Pakistan
data.piUniversity: Pakistan Institute of Engineering & Applied Sciences, Islamabad (PIEAS)
data.projectDigest: Wastewater generated from an industrial estates is usually characterized by high pollutant concentrations, is generally toxic to soil, plants, and water bodies. The conventional physico-chemical wastewater treatment methods are not suitable in Pakistan due to high operational cost. However, “bacterial assisted phytoremediation using floating and constructed wetlands” technology is an innovative, low cost, environment friendly and self-sustainable wastewater treatment approach. Our research group has successfully established these wetlands for the remediation of sewage wastewater, hydrocarbons contaminated water and dye rich textile industrial wastewater. However, this approach has not yet been tested for the treatment of wastewater generated from industrial estates in Pakistan. Therefore, it is need of the day to adopt this novel remedial green technology to reclaim such polluted wastewater. The main aim of this proposal is to develop an indigenous technology and its evaluation for the treatment of wastewater from Faisalabad industrial estate to make it fit for agricultural use. For this purpose, the floating and constructed wetlands will be developed by the vegetation of wetland plants in floating mat and gravels bed respectively, which will be augmented with the selected bacteria. The outcome of project will render several benefits to Pakistan, including wastewater treatment, conservation and abating water pollution.

data.projectName: Biochemical Monitoring and In Vivo Study of Milk Adulterants
data.piUniversity: Pir Mehr Ali Shah Arid Agriculture, University Rawalpindi
data.projectDigest:
Milk is one of the best sources for protein, fat, carbohydrate, vitamins and minerals. Milk adulteration is a very common food fraud and is posing a big social problem in today’s world. In Pakistan water is the most common milk adulterant as 76% followed by detergent 25%, rice flour 22 %, caustic soda 18%, salt 17% and cane sugar 14 % (1).
Unfortunately, milk is being very easily adulterated throughout the world. Possible reasons behind it may include- demand and supply gap, perishable nature of milk, low purchasing capability of customer and lack of suitable detection tests (2). The motivation for food fraud is economic, but the impact is a real public health concern (3-5). The situation is significantly worse in developing and underdeveloped countries due to the absence of adequate monitoring and lack of proper law enforcement.
Most of the times, the adulteration is intentional to make greater profit, but sometimes it may be due to the lack of proper detecting technology and confusion regarding appropriate drug administration practices among the dairy farm workers. It is observed that after mastitis treatment of dairy animal there are traces of antibiotic residues in milk; and in absence of proper guideline about the lactation time and user-friendly detector, often lactation is done in wrong time leading to antimicrobial residues in milk (if lactation performed early) or wastage of milk (if lactation starts late) (6)
However, there is a need to study to know the extent of various adulterants in milk that is affecting its quality and safety parameters. This study will enable the policy makers and Government functionaries for better profiling of milk adulterants on basis of chemical and biochemical parameters.

data.projectName: “Role of antioxidants supplementation in the semen extender on cryopreservation of buffalo (Bubalus bubalis) bull semen”
data.piUniversity: Cholistan University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Bahawalpur
data.projectDigest:
Total buffalo population in Pakistan is 31.7 million (Anonymous, 2010-2011) that produces 68% of total milk in Pakistan (Bilal et al., 2006). As human population is increasing, therefore, it is needed to uplift per animal milk production. Artificial insemination (A.I.) with frozen semen can increase buffalo milk production in short time being valuable biotechnology. 
Buffalo has lower fertility rates with cryopreserved semen than cattle due to their higher vulnerability to cryodamage (Raizada et al., 1990) and one major factor for this damage includes higher oxidative stress because of higher concentrations of spermatozoa membrane poly unsaturated fatty acid (Chatterjee and Gagnon, 2001; Agarwal et al., 2003). Furthermore, semen dilution and freezing decrease semen natural antioxidants and results in oxidative stress. So, addition of external antioxidants in semen is essential (Andrabi et al., 2008). Therefore, present study covering almost all categories of antioxidants was planned with succeeding objectives,
•	This study will not only investigate effect of a variety of novel antioxidants but also conclude previous work done on antioxidants addition in semen 
•	To select different novel antioxidants best concentration for frozen buffalo semen
•	To select best antioxidant for frozen buffalo semen
•	Ultimately to achieve enhanced fertility rate with frozen semen in buffalo

data.projectName: Sustainability in sales management for less privileged countries
data.piUniversity: NED University of Engineering & Technology, Karachi
data.projectDigest: Sales is the important aspect of every business as it is associated to the revenue, and the revenue is the fascination of every business]. It is because of sales that the business cover its expenses, create stable production/operation, attract talent and creates prospect for growth .  In short it is on the top of any financial document and indicates the stability of the business/organization. This study attempts to identify the key factors in which the sales impact the business. The aim is to identifies the ways in which sales can influence the sustainability of a business not only in term of revenue but also on brand recognition/loyalty, customer retention and business growth. For this, a questionnaire base survey will be performed on national and international scale to grasp the idea of customer buying pattern. This data will help to conduct the simulation study to predict the factors that are associated with sustainable sales. This research study will be beneficial to the manufacturing industry of Pakistan by providing insights on business growth by acquisition, sustainable sales through distribution models and an innovation driving globalization. The research will facilitate the economy of Pakistan as it will lead Pakistan to preserve its position in global market by gaining the sustainable sales strategies in businesses.

data.projectName: Establishing a clinical CVD risk repository – Examining predictive accuracy of CVD risk-stratification models in a longitudinal cohort of patients at screening clinics at Aga Khan University, Karachi.
data.projectDigest: Pakistan’s investment in universal health coverage to fulfill sustainable development goal 4 (SDG4), “health for all”, will provide support for hospitalizations and catastrophic events. However, countries with long-standing, publicly-funded health care systems recognize the cost-effective and wide-ranging impact of disease prevention and health-promotion for optimal utilization of limited resources. Risk stratification can lead to early identification of those at highest risk of CVD with timely management and cost-effective care.The substantial evolution in information technology infrastructure and data management techniques has led to the use of routine clinical information for health-outcomes research. The Executive Clinic (EC) at Aga Khan University Hospital Karachi was established in the early 1990s and delivers comprehensive care (including preventive, health-promotion and curative care) to patients.Creating a CVD risk repository of the EC-AKU cohort, who consistently receive similar baseline work-up; and longitudinal follow up at AKU will offer a unique opportunity to  compare predictive ability of existing risk-stratification models and to explore sex-specific CVD risk burden and its association with CVD outcomes in a Pakistani cohort. Such a framework can then be used for population-based implementation research to help utilize Pakistan’s limited health resources in improving the health status of its population.

data.projectName: Controlled synthesis of drug encapsulated metallopolymer nanocomposites using microfluidic platform for anti-cancer applications.
data.piUniversity: Pakistan Institute of Engineering & Applied Sciences, Islamabad (PIEAS)
data.projectDigest: Pakistan is far behind in the medical research field as compared to rests of the world specially life threatening diseases such as cancer and tumor. The lack of advance research and training results some times in inappropriate diagnosis and treatment. The microfluidic chip will be utilized for  nano engineered drug carrier systems to encapsulate the required pico to micro gram ranged drugs . The currently available methods suffer from inappropriate drug loaders. For instance, cancer patients after treatment with chemotherapy suffer from several side effects by killing the healthy cells along with cancer cells such as loss of hair, irritation of stomach etc. This project aims to provide smart on chip drug delivery system to the medical centers which could be able to deliver drug encapsulated in drug carriers to the localized and targeted site without interacting with the normal cells. This advanced and efficient drug formulation technology ultimately eliminated toxic effects, side effects and causes comfort to patients.

data.projectName: Deep Learning Enabled Smart Radio
data.piUniversity: NED University of Engineering & Technology, Karachi
data.projectDigest: 5G, 5G+ and Internet of Things (IoT) based wireless services pose serious challenge towards implementation especially due to spectrum scarcity. Government agencies and the wireless industry observe that the major issue towards successful implementation of these standards is requirement of RF spectrum. Deep Learning Enabled Smart Radio (DLESR) algorithms can be used to enable opportunistic usage of RF spectrum. This project will develop both dataset for Karachi and novel algorithms for successful utilization of RF spectrum. The proposed project will establish a state of the art laboratory at NED University for developing novel algorithms and experimentation in 5G and 5G+ technologies. This will benefit both academia and Research & Development (R&D) activities in the country.

data.projectName: Preventing Effects of N-(2-Hydroxy Phenyl) acetamide (NA2) on Neuroinflammation: LPS-induced Murine Neuroinflammation Model
data.projectDigest: In Pakistan, most of the population is suffering from the minor to major neurological disorder most commonly are depression, stress, anxiety and the memory loss and stroke.  Upon finding the scientific reasons for these conditions and pathologies, the studies suggest that the most common cause is the inflammation of the brain either specifically or in general.  Various treatments are available to treat the neurological disorder but so far none of the treatment is completely curing the brain inflammation or reverse the degradation of the neurons successfully. In search of the better treatment option, we suggest that NA-2 which is the analogue of the acetaminophen could be the option. As we have reported in our earlier studies  that the candidate NA-2 has most promising effects in balancing the redox state during inflammation, further it decreases the proinflammatory cytokines levels, also decrease the cell surface expression of cell differentiation markers and TLRs , CDs on immune and neuronal cell, oncogenes and BDNF expression, in epileptic and arthritic brain.  Keeping these in mind the present study is designed to assess the potential of NA-2 on neuroinflammation particularly LPS-induced murine neuroinflammation model to reveal the underlying mechanisms and any possible potential efficacy against neuroinflammation.

data.projectName: Problematic continuous univariate models and generalized classes: A critical appraisal
data.projectDigest: One of the main objectives in modern distribution theory is to propose and study new flexible models which may prove helpful to the applied researchers. Basically, this objective is fulfilled by introducing new distributions, developing distributions from well-known mathematical functions, induction of parameters through modifications, extensions, generalizations (compounding and mixing) and composition of different generalized (G) classes. Publishing novel models with innovative methodology, strong motivation, rich mathematical rigor, and fruitful empirical investigation is ever appreciable but the literature is also filled with weak, unjustified, misleading and problematic models with improper citations, weak mathematics, without use of modern intensive methods, misreported facts and manipulated results. The curiosity to publish a large numbers of articles on new probability models within short span of time has dominated the true representation of genuine work and has minimized the recognition of the contributors who spent their valuable time and life in proposing novel ideas and in  uplifting (or enhancing) the repute of effective statistical modeling.  The aim of this project is to find out deficiencies in published work on probability models and G-classes, and to point out weaknesses and drawbacks in this dangerous and rapidly growing activity.  Timely reporting of such critical issues, highlighting consequences, addressing proper procedure and providing guideline are necessary to flourish the subject in right direction, is the urgent need of today.

data.projectName: Effect of Super absorbent Polymers on wheat (Triticum aestivum L.) under rainfed condition
data.projectDigest: Water scarcity is one of the major challenges to the survival of life as world population is increasing in a geometric fashion and water resources are depleting rapidly. These global climate changes are environmental risks to people especially in terms of food supply by affecting the plant growth and yield particularly. Plants growing in rainfed areas are more vulnerable to climate change. Strategies for increased food production need to be developed to cope these challenges. As population pressure is increasing continuously so there is a dire need to increase production potential by improved crop growth through adopting new management practices to ensure future food security. Wheat (Triticum aestivum L.) is a dominated food crop but its growth in rainfed areas is affecting due to variation in rainfall pattern. The effect of super absorbent Polymers (SAP) on wheat growth and productivity in rainfed farming is not yet studied much. Therefore this project is designed to evaluate the effect of Superabsorbent Polymer on wheat growth under rainfed conditions. Super absorbent are also called Hydrogels that are hydrophilic polymers and have the great potential to absorb water thus help in improving the growth of plants. A field experiment will be designed in rainfed conditions of district Chakwal in Potohar region of Pakistan. The effect of hydrogel will be analysed on different morpho-anatomical and physiological characteristics of wheat. The proposed project may be helpful for the socioeconomic wellbeing of famers by increasing wheat productivity in rainfed conditions. Currently the average production of wheat is almost half in rainfed conditions as compared to irrigated one so SAP may help in increasing output of wheat crop under water limited conditions.

data.projectName: Synthesis and characterization of polymeric membranes using bio-additives for dialysis applications
data.piUniversity: Ghulam Ishaq Khan Institute of Engineering Sciences & Technology, Topi
data.projectDigest:
Membrane processes are increasingly used and gained important place in industrial and medicinal field because of its easy function, efficient performance and low cast. Hemodialysis is an extensively used medical treatment for renal failure and dialysis membranes are vital components of hemodialysis assembly. The critical properties of a dialysis membrane are maximum protein rejection ability as well as moderate water flux high mass transfer of toxic solutes (urea and uric acid) to reduce the dialysis time. Polymeric hemodialysis membrane made-up of cellulose, regenerated cellulose and synthetic polymers have already been acknowledged.
In this proposal Asymmetric Cellulose Acetate (CA) membranes will be synthesize through phase inversion method. These membranes further modified by blending various inorganic and organic (biomaterials) additives. The addition of these additives will effects the membrane’s morphology which will be investigated using different characterization techniques. The performance of these fabricated membranes will be studied in terms of water uptake, pure water flux, porosity, urea clearance and Bovine Serum Albumin (BSA) rejection tests. To find the interaction of synthesized membranes towards cell culture and blood comparable fluids, biocompatibility and blood mimic tests will also be conducted.

data.projectName: Synthesis, Characterization and applications of dopped transition metal oxides for the removal of organic colorants in the waste water
data.projectDigest:
Nanotechnology is a field of research and innovation concerned with the science of engineering and technology on atomic and molecular scale. This area of research has a broad scope ranging from cleaning of the water bodies to solving the major health issues. There is a complexity in synthesis of metal nanoparticles by conservative procedures which requires expensive resources. Biological approach can be used for the synthesis of dopped metal oxide nanoparticles for environment sustainability and to address other complexities. The bio-dopped metal oxide nanoparticles (BMONPs) will be characterized using different spectroscopic techniques like UV-Visible (UV-Vis) spectroscopy, Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy, Scanning electron microscopy/Energy dispersive spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), X-Ray diffraction (XRD), Atomic absorption spectroscopy (AAS) and Zeta analyzer.
 The bio-synthesized NPs will be applied for the removal of industrial colorants (Azo Violet, Methyl yellow, Pincea-2R, Sunset yellow, Methyl orange, Methylene blue) and inks from the polluted waste water. An efficiency of removal process will be evaluated at various conditions like dose of nanoparticles, different exposure time of UV light, time of contact of reaction mixture and effect of pH.

data.projectName: CRITICAL ANALYSIS OF JOURNALISTIC FUNCTIONS AND AUTONOMY IN PAKISTAN
data.projectDigest:
Summary

Apparently, Pakistani media is considered as one of the vocalists in the South Asia but military and  media regulations, commercial, Security of state, editorial policy, owners of media, senior journalists  are the detrimental factors for journalistic autonomy in Pakistan. Other factors that affect journalists’ autonomy in the journalistic functions are access to information; acquaintances and family, religious considerations; time limit; and relationship with other media organizations, public relations, business people, pressure group, government official, profit expectation, feedback from the audiences, competing with other media organizations, colleague in media, peer of staff and personal belief. Journalists at higher positions usually enjoy greater autonomy as compared to journalists in lower positions. Besides, Journalists’ low salary, meeting deadline, taking lead on other media outlets for breaking news, the power of media owners are also causing unprofessionalism and low journalistic autonomy in Pakistan.? This study also analyses  the function of journalism in Pakistan and how do Pakistani journalist bring these functions in the practice. The study will concentrate on the function of journalism in Pakistan as how the journalists perceive  News as Social Goods, People Journalism, Government Policy support, Development and Culture and, Image of Country, Government Developmental project, narrative on Government Policy, and the role of Watchdog  as important. How far these functions the journalist bring them into practice

data.projectName: DEVELOPMENT OF PHAGE THERAPY FOR THE CONTROLA ND TREATMENT OF SALMONELLOSIS AND COLIBACILLOSIS IN COMMERCIAL AND BACKYARD POULTRY- AN ALTERNATIVE APPROACH TO OVERCOME DRUG RESISTANCE
data.projectDigest:
Poultry industry  is one of the largest agro-based segment of Pakistan summing  billions of investment with over 8 million people directly involved in the business. In Pakistan the poultry sector is playing a key role in bridging the gap between the supply and demand for protein. Commercial poultry farming started in Pakistan in the early 1960s and showed rapid growth over the decades.
With the production of broilers (about 1.25billan) a year, poultry in Pakistan enjoys 2nd position as the biggest industry in the country after textile manufacturing. Poultry production is one of the most dynamic and well organised sectors contributing 26.8, 5.76 and 6.4% respectively to total meat production, agricultural sector and overall GDP. Presently turnover of Pakistan Poultry Industry is about 1000 plus billion rupees. despite this, poultry industry is constantly facing threats challenges such as persistence of chicken enteritis and early chick mortality caused by salmonellosis and colibacillosis. Chicken enteritis and early chick mortaility caused by Escherichia coli and Salmonella species is one of the biggest challenges farming face it in the beginning of rearing. To avoid these diseases, antibiotics, including those which are clinically important for human health, are constantly added to feed and drinking water of poultry thereby providing trigger for the emergence of drug resistance. This is evident in the form of frequent outbreaks of salmonellosis and colibacillosis and failure in treatment. There is an urgent need to call off this practice and adopt new and safe strategies such as application of bacteriophages that could efficiently kill E. coli and Salmonella. 
In this project, we propose to isolate bacteriophages against the predominant E. coli and Salmonella species

data.projectName: Step toward early-stage diagnosis of neuronal degenerative disorders: Highly thought-out protocol for fabrication of photoelectrochemical sensor of 6-nitrocatecholamines
data.projectDigest: Monoamine neurotransmitters such as dopamine, norepinephrine and epinephrine play a key role in functioning of human metabolism, renal, cardiovascular, hormonal systems and involved in motivation, reward, and reinforcement. Thus, in recent decades, wide range of monitoring techniques including fluorescence microscopy, high-performance liquid chromatography, capillary electrophoresis, spectrophotometry, electrochemical and photo-electrochemical method have been successfully applied for precise monitoring of these neurotransmitters. Despite these, very little attention has so far been paid to the control monitoring of 6-nitrocatecholamines, which are putative product of nitric oxide with catecholamines under oxidative stress conditions. 6-Nitrocatecholamines (nitronorepinephrine, nitroepinephrine, and nitrodopamine) involved in several biological activities including inhibition of neuronal nitric oxide synthase activity, catechol-O-methyltransferase activity and neuronal norepinephrine uptake. Additionally, these neurological disorders have much more devastating effects in poor populations. These conditions are very alarming in the developing countries such as Pakistan due to the facts including Illiteracy, unawareness, large numbers of people who are untreated and most important unavailability of low cost but effective interventions. To the best of our knowledge, no any photo-electrochemical sensor for the precise monitoring of 6-nitrocatecholamines has been reported yet.

data.projectName: Development of Microwave Components in Portable, Low-Cost, Wideband Microwave Neuroimaging System for Brain-injury Assessment and Early Diagnosis of Stroke at Hospitals and Polyclinics in Pakistan  (Acronym: MicrowaveNeuroScan)
data.projectDigest:
Pakistan has the world’s highest rate of stroke per capita. With 350,000 individuals suffering stroke each year, the demographics of this disease is a major challenge in the medical spheres of Pakistan. Unfortunately, the current imaging technology like MRI, CT Scan etc., remains expensive and non-portable. As per Gallup Pakistan there 14,000 health facilities in Pakistan, with only a few of them with the costly, gold-standard MRI/ CT-Scan facilities. For stroke patients, the earlier the treatment is started (within 4.5 h), the greater the chances are for recovery.  Moreover, for the patients with traumatic intracranial bleeding, the time from injury to surgery is the most important factor for survival. 

This multidisciplinary project, to be executed by the PI and Co-PIs from ITU, NUST and LUMS, in collaboration with the 1st Acute Stroke Centre, Punjab Institute of Neuroscience at Lahore General Hospital, aims to develop microwave components of a prototype device that is particularly suitable for pre-hospital use at primary and secondary healthcare centres in Pakistan. The developed technology will enable the development of an imaging device in compact and portable formats at a relatively low cost than MRI /CT scan and will be easy to use, particularly for non-specialists, and can also be used for diagnosis of life-threatening conditions in ambulances or at the scene of injury.

Apart from Lahore General Hospital, a London based multinational R&D company, the Umbria Bioengineering Technologies (UBT) is our foreign research collaborator. A Lahore based health-tech company, HopCure, is our commercialization partner.

data.projectName: Efficient Resource Management for Cloud-hosted Microservices
data.projectDigest: Cloud computing offers distributed computing facilities by providing a wide range of different Virtual Machines (VMs) with different configurations, including the number of cores, memory, storage, bandwidth, and I/O operations. However, this introduces a challenge to select an appropriate VM type to host and deploy the application to maximize the performance at minimal cost. The recent advancement in cloud computing offers Containers, which is a lightweight virtualization compared to the VMs. Nowadays, microservice architecture is gaining popularity as the primary choice to build large-scale applications. This architectural style decomposes an application into a collection of loosely coupled services that are independently developed, tested, deployed, and managed. Containers are attractive to deploy microservices as compared to VMs because of their lightweight virtualization. In this project, we propose to build an efficient resource management service to identify the appropriate Container resources for microservices automatically. The proposed solution ensures application performance with minimal cost using machine learning techniques. Building such solutions to utilize expensive computing facilities efficiently can help reducing millions of dollars at scale for enterprises.

data.projectName: Antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects of green synthesized nano-structures (Zinc oxide and silver oxide) against Staphylococcus aureus associated bovine mastitis
data.piUniversity: Pir Mehr Ali Shah Arid Agriculture, University Rawalpindi
data.projectDigest: Bovine mastitis, inflammation of mammary glands of cattle and buffalo is economically the most important disease of dairy animals all over the world. In addition to causing loss in milk production, it also possesses public health risk due to zoonotic in nature in some cases.  Staphylococcus aureus (S. aureus) is the most important bacteria associated with bovine mastitis in Pakistan. The efficacy of antibiotic therapy in case of S. aureus mastitis is usually less than 50%. In Pakistan, as there is no system to observe milk with-drawl period recommended for antibiotic usage, the presence of antibiotic residues in milk is causing serious human health issues including toxicity and antibiotic resistance. A study is therefore, proposed with an objective to  evaluate  zinc oxide and silver oxide nano-structures prepared by green method using turmeric roots for the treatment of bovine mastitis as alternate to antibiotic therapy. To achieve this objective, zinc oxide and silver oxide nano-structures will be prepared by using turmeric roots extract. In-vitro and in vivo  Anti-microbial activity will be measured by microdilution method. The treatment will provide an effective alternate for antibiotic therapy thus reducing the import bill for antibiotics. This treatment will also be helpful in reducing antibiotic residues in milk and its products thus making these safer for human use and reducing the problem of antibiotic resistance.

data.projectName: Poverty Alleviation through Women Empowerment and Social Development in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa
data.projectDigest: Women empowerment is a complex concept, to understand it; we have to study the past published work on the topic in the context of microfinance. Hashemi, Schuler and Riley (1996) took eight indicators of women empowerment like economic security, involvement in major household decisions, freedom from domination by family, small purchase decision, political and legal awareness, mobility, participation in politics and protest and large purchase decision. They collected data from 1300 female clients of Grameen Bank and Bangladesh Rural Advancement Committee. According to World Bank (2001) empowerment is a process which enhance individuals and group’s competencies for acting according to their wishes by choosing from different alternatives. Women empowerment is as much important as men empowerment, according to their report slow economic growth, weak governance, low life standard and greater poverty is caused by gender discrimination in the contest of empowerment. Microfinance also provides additional power to women to take part in household decision making and it improves women bargaining power due to access to information and credit.

data.projectName: Development of novel ELISA Kit for the detection and molecular characteriation Theileria in Cattle in District Punjab
data.piUniversity: University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Lahore
data.projectDigest: Pakistan’s economy is an agro based and large ruminant population being a major component. Pakistan earns heavy economic benefits from by exporting large number of live animals and birds, products, byproducts and value added products of plant and animal origin. This growing sector is hampered by a number of infectious and non-infectious maladies. Among infectious problems, Theileriosis is causing huge economic losses to cattle population in Pakistan. Status of different Theileria species causing disease has not been confirmed in this region. Identification of the problem is based on conventional techniques on diseased animals encountered off and on. Many times the disorder is identified at late stage at which time therapy is mostly successful. Losses due to this disease can be limited by in time and accurate diagnosis. This is possible only if prevalent species of protozoa are known and their specific identification tools had developed. Present research plan is to have comparative analysis of conventional identification techniques, serological and molecular tools. This will help in the development of authentic, accurate, sensitive and efficient technique for early confirmation of specific Theileria species responsible for disease in cattle. Outcomes of the project will assist to develop line of treatment in order to curtail the wide spread of protozoa on mass scale. Development of diagnostic kits using antigens extracted from prevalent Theileria species in this region will be more beneficial in relation to the specificity of diagnosis in comparison to imported ones. Ultimate goal is to reduce economic burden of import and production losses

data.projectName: Wideband Multi-Stage Mach-Zehnder based Photonic Integrated Delay Line for Microwave Photonics application.
data.piUniversity: Mehran University of Engineering & Technology, Jamshoro
data.projectDigest:
Optical true-time delay lines allow to arbitrary control the propagation delay of an optical signal and can be exploited for a variety of applications. Typical examples includes synchronization and buffering of optical signals; optical signal processing in microwave photonics systems; optical coherence tomography; optical beamforming networks for phased-array antennas used in 5G and beyond networks, where the use of optical true-time delay lines increases the bandwidth of the antenna and avoids beam squinting. In photonics the attractive possibility of on-chip integration of such a tunable delay line allows reducing size and cost of the device and ease of integration with other optical functionalities and led in the last two decades to a collection of devices which can be used in a plethora of applications. 

In this project, we will design and realize a prototype of a continuously tunable non-resonant integrated delay line based on a multistage Mach-Zehnder interferometer. The device allows for a reduced dispersion, generalized simple and hitless control scheme with a large tuneability range and bandwidth-delay product. The aim is to successfully demonstrate the use of the proposed prototype for microwave photonics application so that the device can be exploited for example in beamforming of phase arrayed antennae for 5G network and beyond.

data.projectName: Biodiesel production from Waste Cooking Oil (WCO) by Microwave assisted and Supercritical Process: Process Optimization and Commercialization Potential
data.projectDigest: Biodiesel utilization has been rapidly growing worldwide as the prime alternative to petrodiesel due to a global rise in diesel fuel demand along with hazardous emissions during its thermochemical conversion. In Pakistan, this problem has turned out to be more serious as production and transportation sides of the country are more reliant on diesel fuel delivering negative impacts on the national economy and additionally creating environmental. The current project focuses on biodiesel production in Pakistan using indigenous waste resources such as waste cooking oil through microwave and super-critical processes. The overall goal of this research is to produce heterogeneous catalyzed microwave-assisted and super-critical process mediated biodiesel production with improved reaction parameters in a feasible and sustainable way. The project activities involve synthesis of heterogeneous catalyst for microwave assisted transesterification and super-critical process facilitated transesterification along with the reaction parameters optimization to maximize biodiesel yield. Furthermore, the quality of produced biodiesel must meet international standards provided by ASTM and EN.  Alongside, working on commercial feasibility  of synthesized biodiesel is also the main concern considering national oil import scenario. The main energy providers in the country such as diesel and gasoline ought to be superseded with renewable fuels like bioethanol and biodiesel which can reasonably lessen the dependence on fossil fuels.

data.projectName: Three dimensional (3D) cardiac differentiation and regeneration potential of epigenetically modified human mesenchymal stem cells from umbilical-cord
data.piUniversity: DOW University of Health Sciences, Karachi
data.projectDigest: Cardiovascular diseases are the biggest killer in Pakistan. Following heart attack, the myocardium becomes damaged, hence its repair to restore its function, is of paramount importance, which is difficult with conventional therapies. Stem cell (SC) therapy is a gaining attention around the world. It has remarkable clinical application and has good potential for regenerative capacity of injured tissue. There are various sources from where stem cells can be isolated. An umbilical cord is considered as medical waste, and gaining immense attention providing better source for stem cell isolation. Umbilical-cord is a waste material so it has no ethical issues with obtaining biomaterial; and also it has high immunomodulatory activity. There are lots of studies reported in the improvement of left ventricular function by transplanting stem cells. However, they are limited to two dimensional culture conditions, providing three dimensional environment in vitro provide in vivo like environment will increase the differentiation potential and further improve function of heart after transplanting them. In the present study isolation, culturing, characterization and differentiation of mesenchymal stem cells will be performed in 3D environment isolated from umbilical cord.  Further modified cells will be transplanted into rat model of myocardial infarction to check the regeneration potential.

data.projectName: Simulation Modeling and Optimization of Smart Cardiovascular Disease Expert System
data.projectDigest: Heart is one of the vital organs of the human body and the chances of death because of heart attacks are always high thus, it is very important for the patient to get first aid treatment as soon as the symptoms are observed and a confirm diagnosis of heart attack or a heart problem is made. Unfortunately, in the remote areas of Pakistan, the basic health necessities are not available to the people and thus the rate of deaths because of heart attacks is always very high. The number of cardiology center in Pakistan are few as compared to a number of heart patient which may cause the delay in treatment of patient. Most of the patients are treated on the basis of first come first serve. If the patients are treated on the basis of seriousness instead of first come first serve it save more lives. To overcome this issue, we proposed smart cardiovascular expert system. This system assists to the medical professionals as well as non-professionals (information desk) regarding patient appointment.

data.projectName: SYNTHESIS AND BIOLOGICAL EVALUATION OF CYCLOOLIVIL DERIVATIVES BEARING BENZIMIDAZOLE MOIETY
data.projectDigest:
Natural products contribute greatly to the history and landscape of new molecular entities. Modification of natural products played a vital role in drug discovery.  The modification of natural products increase efficacy, safety and/or delivery relative to the parent compound. In the year 2013, FDA approved about 43 % of approved drug of modified nature. (+)- Cycloolivil (poly phenolic compound) is a secondary metabolite isolated from ethyl acetate extract of Olea ferruginea. Cycloolivil has potent antioxidant activity, and moderate antileishmanial and antibacterial activity.
Benzimidazole and Hydrazone are important pharmacophore for antimicrobial activity. Literature survey shows that Some widely used antibacterial drugs such as furacilin, furazolidone and ftivazide are known to contain these groups. Extensive biochemical and pharmacological studies have confirmed that its derivatives are effective against various strains of microorganisms. In past decades, hydrazone have received much attention and many studies have been reported due to their chemotherapeutic value in the development of novel antimicrobial agents.
In the current study Cycloolivil will be isolated from the ethyl acetate fraction of Oliva plant by the already reported method.  Due to the presence of benzylic and phenolic alcoholic groups in their structure various benzimidazole derivative will be synthesized. The structure of the compounds will be determined by various spectroscopic techniques, i.e., Electron Ionization mass spectrometer and Proton Nuclear Magnetic Resonance spectroscopic techniques. The antimicrobial, antioxidant and anticancer activity of synthetic derivative will be studied to develop new synthetic derivatives of cycloolivil, which would have potent activity.

data.projectName: Innovation of efficient fertilizers with polymeric microsphere containing DAP, boron and plant growth promoting rhizobacteria for higher oil seed crop production and quality
data.projectDigest: Oil seed crops are an important source of edible oil; however, their production is very limited in Pakistan. Consequently, Pakistan spends a huge amount of budget to import edible oil annually. Therefore, production of good quality oil seed crops, have great economic value for the country. However, due to various environmental factors, climate and soil characteristics, about 80–90% of phosphorus could not be assimilated by plants and lost into the environments resulting in huge economic loss. Additionally, ignorance of micronutrients application to soil, especially of boron (B), is a major constraint for higher oil seed crop production as it is deficient in more than 50% Pakistani of soils. Hence, new fertilization strategies are needed for sustainable oil seed crop production to feed 7 billion people around the globe. Hence, we propose here to develop novel nano-fertilizers with controlled release delivery mechanism, higher nutrient utilization and minimum losses to the environment. Slow release PGPR-P-B fertilizers will be developed by coating the DAP with plant growth promoting rhizobacteria (PGPR) and nano-boron particles via linking through alginate polymers. Various formulations will be produced to identify the best fertilizer product with lower cost and higher efficiency which could maintain continuous P and B supply for sustainable production of oil seed crops to fulfil higher food demand. The P and B release and transformations studies will be conducted in laboratory scale incubation trials and the best formulations will further be tested in various greenhouse and field trials to investigate its effects on yield and quality of oil seed crops. The best formulation will be proposed for commercialization.

data.projectName: Heterocyclic Portable Fluorescent Sensors for rapid, selective and on site detection of metal cations: Synthesis, characterization, optimization and applications.
data.projectDigest: Metals are all around us. Some metals are allowed and essential within certain limit. If they exceed this limit, they cause pollution and have very harmful impacts on environment and living organisms. Metals may be in fertilizers, cosmetics, toys, metal-based batteries, sewage sludge, waste water, industrial effluents, drinking water and edible food items. To maintain metals within allowed limits monitoring is samples is required. Variety of instruments are available for this purpose that are costly and not suitable for on site applications. Different types of Sensors have been developed for this purpose. In this connection, to develop portable kits the concept of fluorescent sensors is very attractive. So, during this project we will develop a new class of ligands, characterize them to confirm their structure and will study their sensing properties. Optimization of conditions will be carried out to make these ligands as selective and sensitive sensors towards certain metals. Then these sensors will be applied on real samples and methods will be developed for their applied use. By the end of the project we aim to have variety of selective and sensitive sensor for rapid and accurate estimation of metals from real samples.

data.projectName: Section-wise Indexing and Retrieval of Research Articles
data.piUniversity: Kohat University of Science and Technology, Kohat
data.projectDigest: Since the advent of WWW, the scientific literature grows at exponential rate, which results huge scientific knowledge repositories. There are a number of options through which this scientific knowledge is disseminated such as publishing research in online conferences, journals and creation of scientific knowledge through socially maintained databases.  Further, the publishing venues e.g. journals, conferences, and etc are also increasing that results in a tremendous growth research publications. This information overload complicates the task of extracting relevant articles. Researchers have a number of options for accessing this huge digital repository, scientific community has a number of options such as (a) search engines, (b) citation indexes, and (c) digital libraries etc. However, in most of the cases, these systems result long list of irrelevant information mainly due to the unstructured indexed information.  In this research, we aim to design, implement, and evaluate a technique that attempt to create semantic version of articles. The proposed work creates article ontologies which will help researcher to find fine grained level of information.

data.projectName: Mitigation of toxic effects of mycotoxins in chicken: Use of probiotics and local herbs
data.projectDigest:
Mycotoxins are a common contaminant of cereal based food and feed products throughout the world. These are produced as a secondary fungal metabolites from toxigenic fungi whenever a favorable conditions are available. Aflatoxin B1 (AFB1) and Ochratoxin A (OTA) are most common and lethal types of mycotoxins. Frequent occurrence of these toxin have been report in the poultry feed. Both of these toxin have deleterious effects on the poultry health and leads to performance and production losses to the poultry industry. These toxins are known not only for their direct toxic effects but also for indirect losses in terms of immunosuppression and exposing the birds to other diseases. Poultry fed on mycotoxin contaminated diet can transmit the residues in tissue and get possible entry in the human food chain.  In Pakistan different report are available for the occurance of AFB1 and OTA in poultry feed and their associated economic losses to the poultry industry. The poultry industry of Pakistan is the 2nd largest after the textile industry and contributing almost 60.5% of the Agriculture share (18.5%) in national GDP. The overall contribution of livestock in national GDP is 11.2% during last year (2018-19).  Different imported toxin binders have been used as a control measure across the country by spending a heavy amount of revenue.  
Keeping in view the importance of subject in terms of economics present project has been design to evaluate the local herbs (Curcumin/Moringa) and Probiotics for mitigation of toxic effects of the mycotoxins and to compare its efficacy with the commercial available toxin binders. It will facilitate to develop not only preventive but also curative strategy minimizing economic losses of the poultry industry of Pakistan.

data.projectName: Telerehabilitation: A cost effective intervention to prevent  pressure ulcers among spinal cord injury patients in Pakistan
data.projectDigest:
Despite the fact that pressure ulcers are preventable,yet 80%-95% spinal cord injury patients in Pakistan develop pressure ulcers. Many international guidelines are available for the prevention of pressure ulcers;however, due to cultural barriers and lack of resources, these international guidelines are not applicable in Pakistan. The purpose of current project is to develop guidelines for the prevention of pressure ulcers in spinal cord injury patients,keeping in mind the local natural, human and capital resources of Pakistan and implementation of those guidelines through telerehabilitation approaches. 
The guidelines will be developed by a team of health professionals and targeted spinal cord injury patients. These guidelines will consist of cost-effective preventive strategies for pressure ulcers prevention,which will not only consider the physical and psychological aspect of patients,but also take into accounts the specific cultural, economical and religious factors prevailing in Pakistani society.On the basis of final approved guidelines, a mobile app will be developed in Urdu language which will contain written information, images and videos about prevention of pressure ulcers. To validate the content and design of the app,a pilot study will be conducted while to determine effectiveness of the app in the prevention of pressure ulcers,a clinical trial will be conducted.

data.projectName: Deciphering hepatoprotective potential of Moringa oleifera in chronic metabolic hepatitis and hepatocellular carcinoma in mice
data.piUniversity: University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Lahore
data.projectDigest:
Non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH) is a world-wide disease with increasing burden, characterized by steatosis, inflammation, liver damage, hepatomegaly with varying level of fibrosis. NASH can further progress into hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), 3rd leading cause of cancer related deaths worldwide.  Globally, about every 4th person is suffering from NASH. Sedentary life style and increased fast food intake contribute crucially in the progression of NASH in human. 
The use of medicinal plants as therapeutic agents in various diseases is on the rise in recent years. Moringa oleifera has various therapeutic properties such as anti-inflammatory, anti-oxidative, antibacterial, anti-cancerous and lowers adipose deposition. Based on these properties, we hypothesized that it could be a good therapeutic candidate in NASH.
To mimic human NASH and HCC for clinical relevance, diabetic mice will be experimentally fed high fat diet (HFD). Various doses of Ethanolic extract of Moringa oleifera will be administered in these mice through oral route during the course of development of NASH and HCC. The liver damage will be assessed through biochemical, histopathological and immunological approaches.
The results of this project will provide proof of concept for therapeutic efficacy in NASH and NASH related HCC that could be translated in human cases.

data.projectName: A LIFE CYCLE ANALYSIS OF SOLAR PV PANELS FOR THEIR EFFICIENCY, COST AND ENVIROMENTAL PERFORMANCE
data.piUniversity: Mehran University of Engineering & Technology, Jamshoro
data.projectDigest: With the increasing demand for energy, renewable sources of energy have achieved premier importance in the last few years. Amongst other sources, solar energy is a leading renewable source which is utilized substantially and capable of meeting the energy need of humanity. In the case of meeting electricity demand, solar PV standalone units have increased penetration during last few years in Pakistan. This study proposes to undertake a detailed Life Cycle Analysis (LCA) of locally available/in use PV panels for their efficiency, cost, and environmental performance. There are three most important parameters considered during the operation period of PV panels, which are maximum output power, short circuit current, and open-circuit voltage. All these parameters are affected by temperature, shadowing, and accumulation of dust, and hence the overall performance of PV panels is affected. It is, therefore, essential that the life cycle analysis of these panels be undertaken using the available tools. The data collected from various locations, for different panels and considering their operating period shall be analyzed using GaBi software, which is widely used for sustainability and LCA. The study results are anticipated to provide key insight pertaining investigated parameters and guidelines for renewable energy policy development in Pakistan.
