data.projectName: Calibration and Validation of Micro-Simulation Models for Motorways in Pakistan
data.projectDigest: Motorways are the highest functional classification of roadways in Pakistan. Globally various transportation agencies (both at national and local level), universities, and consulting firms use traffic simulation tools for analysis of transportation systems to aid in the analysis of evaluating the system performance and management of transportation networks. Traffic Simulation techniques are being extensively used in the fields of traffic engineering and transportation planning.  Most of the time, usual practice among engineers in Pakistan is to develop the simulation model according to the site geometry, traffic volumes, signal timings, vehicle mix, speed etc. and use the default parameters for rest of the parameters such as related to driver behaviors, vehicle characteristics etc. While the term calibration is known to many however, it appears that the knowledge on calibration parameters as well as application of the calibration, validation process is not very well understood/defined particularly in the context of traffic characteristics in Pakistan. The project tasks will involve (i) a detailed analysis of both the software capabilities, underlying formulations, methodology utilized for moving vehicles in the model, driver behavior models, calibration parameters and their default values etc. (ii) collecting traffic data at different local locations on various roadway geometric and traffic parameters.

data.projectName: Climate Change Adaptation: To Develop Methodology to calculate rainwater harvesting for sustainable development in Lahore.

It will lead to propose collection system for different sizes as per their open roof areas and will lead to minimize water stress of that area. It will also lead to propose strategies for rain water harvesting and can get benefit to recharge our ground water level in Lahore.

data.projectName: Development of DeepFake Detection Model – A deep learning algorithm to detect fake videos and images developed by Artificial Intelligence
data.projectDigest:
Until recently, it has been challenging to modify video content in any substantial way. But deepfake models, developed through AI, can create a realistic fake video. Deepfake is an AI-based technical model which generates a video material representing something that didn’t occur in real. 
This is shocking technology because deepfakes can be used to effect public opinion during an election, or to involve someone in a crime they didn’t commit. People with high profiles are victimized because their public profiles provide enough material to learn. However, considering the number of average pictures taken by a person and rapid advancements in technology anyone can become a target in near future.
Deepfakes depend on a neural network called autoencoder and GANs and these models are evolving day by day making them difficult to combat. The techniques commonly employed for its detection involve using the similar algorithms that were used to build the deepfake in this way the algorithm can figure out delicate inconsistencies such as irregular blinking patterns of lighting. 
Deepfake technology is forthcoming threat to whole world including Pakistan. It is need of an hour to participate and effectively contribute to make our homeland more secure and safe.

data.projectName: Characterizing the nutritional and Functional Properties of Cereal Based Therapeutic Foods
data.piUniversity: Muhammad Nawaz Shareef University of Agriculture, Multan
data.projectDigest: According to estimation a massive number of children under the age of five are malnourished and Pakistan ranked among the leading countries in the world. Iron deficiency is a severe nutritional problem in the world which prevails in both developing and developed countries. Wheat flour used as staple food in different means at household level and processing of baking products on commercial scale. The addition of micronutrients in this staple food could be a better solution to deal the micronutrient deficiency. By altering the composition of wheat flour and addition of micronutrients from natural sources enriched with iron content for biscuits and cookies preparation and cereal products with addition of probiotics could be used to cater the problem. In this proposed project baking and fermented products will be prepared from wheat flour with enrichment of natural iron dense foods and probiotic sources and will be marketed with special focus on school going children. The aim of this study is to produce innovative baked and fermented products to cater the problems of malnutrition. This approach will create new products range in the market that will promote the business of baking industry and bring prosperity in the area in terms of economic gains through entrepreneurship and job placement.

data.projectName: Potential of Halal Food Exports in Pakistan: A Qualitative and Quantitative Analysis
data.projectDigest: The Muslim consumers are now very much concerned about halal brand, halal certification and global halal standards. The provision of cheap Halal products is a big opportunity for Pakistan as the "Islamic Republic of Pakistan” has an advantage of cheap labor and raw material availability. Pakistan is already involved in the export of fresh, frozen and processed halal food products though there still exist opportunities for Pakistan to increase its export in the growing Halal food market by enhancing and  exhausting its current potential and competitiveness in production of halal food. The major objectives of this research are estimation of comparative advantage, identification of socio-economic and religio-cultural factors that contribute in exports of halal food products and market-capturing potential of Pakistan's export of selected Halal food items in the Global market. The final and foremost objective is to provide policy suggestions to the industries related to production of halal food, exporters and government officials relevant to live stock and external and commercial sectors.  By increasing and exhausting export potential government can generate foreign reserves, create opportunities for concerned individuals firms & officials that are engaged directly or indirectly in activities related to production and exports of Halal Food and Beverages.

As these materials are reported to be more stable and possess wonderful electrical conductivity. Hence these materials will be beneficial for to produce energy in Pakistan.

data.projectName: Investigating the effect of SHAPES (Spatial Households And Population Epidemiological Structures) on the transmission and persistence of TB in Sindh, Pakistan
data.piUniversity: NED University of Engineering & Technology, Karachi
data.projectDigest:
Tuberculosis(TB) is an air-borne infectious disease that is prevalent in the Pakistani environment. Modern approaches for studying TB tend to utilize geographical information systems (GIS) and geo-spatial mapping techniques to identify clusters or 'hubs' which are areas with high incidence of TB; these either propagate or maintain TB in a population. In order to curb TB transmission in a certain area, site-specific interventions are planned and executed. However, to date no studies in Pakistan have considered the specific features of communities that contribute to TB persistence. These special features include geographically distributed household/community structures that are usually seen in areas where TB is persisting. 
Thus, in this project, we aim to investigate the dynamic behavior of TB in Sindh through mapping and evaluation of different geographical structures in which TB is persisting. In turn, a proxy measure of persistence for other similar structures can be predicted.

data.projectName: Development of Graphene/Graphite oxide reinforced Natural Fiber filled Phenolic Resin Nano-composites for High Performance Automotive Applications
data.projectDigest: Phenolic resins have found multifarious applications ranging from common adhesives and coatings to high performance materials and structures in automotive and aerospace industries. Their ubiquitous influence is because of their flame resistance, less smoke during burning, chemical and dimensional stability, high specific strength, low density, low heat conduction coefficient and relatively low price. However, their relatively lower thermal stability than polyimide and brittle behavior hinders its applications as high performance material.  Phenolic resins are an effective lightweight alternative to heavier conventional steel and aluminum die cast products with comparable properties. Hybridization that is the incorporation of more than one filler in a single matrix is interesting as single filler is unable to fulfill diverse properties. In this proposed study, graphene/natural fiber will be used as reinforcement in phenolic resins and boron phenolic resins to address their shortcomings.

data.projectName: Commercial cultivation of Stevia plants to overcome the problems of sugar industry in Pakistan
data.projectDigest: Processed or white sugar used in our country is not only expensive but it is also dangerous for health. According to international medical associations, it not only causes blood sugar levels but also is the main reason for obesity and cardiovascular diseases. Therefore; it is suggested to replace the sugar with some natural source. The present research work is proposed to encourage commercial cultivation and propagation of Stevia plants which can be used as artificial sweeteners in human diet. Stevia plant is reported as 200 time sweeter than processed sugar with zero calories and no side effects. Stevia plants will be obtained from market and propagated through plant tissue culture. The cultured plants will be acclimatized in green houses followed by field transfer, A healthy disease free nursery will be developed and the plants will be used for further propagation as well as for processing. The plants will be available for sale as well.  The remaining plants will be harvested, processed and stevia powder will be prepared and marketed   for local consumers. It will be helpful to minimize the chances of different diseases caused  by white sugar moreover, cost of imported sweeteners will be reduced.

data.projectName: fuctionalized metal doped ferrites for magnetic Hyperthermia and temperature dependent drug release
data.projectDigest: The main purposes of this project is to investigate the heating capabilities of metal-doped ferrite nanoparticles to cure cancerous cells and also to investigate drug release at the site of cancer cells. Main challenges encountered in this treatment include advancement of the magnetic nanoparticles (MNPs) as heating powder and maintaining the temperature at the target site in a secure range of 42 oC to 47 oC. Tuning of this temperature range mainly depends on the changes in the Curie temperature of MNPs and on the variation of strength of magnetic field. Variation in magnetic field strength causes evasion of healthy cells from the site due to increase in the heating capabilities of the targeted area. MNPs will be coated with a polymer to achieve the temperature dependant drug delivery at the target. This required polymer which have a glass transition temperature (Tg) in the range from 42 oC to 47 oC. It becomes crucial to tune Curie temperature by dopant concentration in ferrites and to synthesize a polymer having a glass transition temperature between 42 oC to 47 oC so that MNPs may be utilized in chemotherapy and magnetic hyperthermia. Application of alternating magnetic field causes the coated metal-doped MNPs to produce heat to therapeutic limits. Coated polymer at this temperature softens and drug in released at the targeted site. Therefore, primary goal of this project is to prepare a metal doped ferrite system and synthesize coating polymer (human biocompatible polymer) such that both Curie and glass transition temperature of MNPs as well as polymer lie in the therapeutic range i.e., 42 oC to 47 oC.

data.projectName: Anti-Islamophobia Discourse and Pakistani Diasporic Literature
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest: In the post-9/11 world, Islamophobia has posed such great threat for the Muslim communities around the globe that Prime Minister of Pakistan, in his UNGA 2019 address, had to point out, “Islamophobia since 9/11 has grown at a pace which is alarming,”. This situation demands serious efforts to build and explore a counter narrative that has the power to subvert islamophobia. In this backdrop, the present study will explore and critique contemporary Pakistani diasporic English fiction with an aim to see how these literary voices encounter, subvert or conform with the Islamophobia discourse. A qualitative textual analysis of the fictional works written by Nadeem Aslam, Tariq Ali, Mohsin Hamid and Kamila Shamsie will be carried out. Qualitative content analysis method will be used to code and analyse the selected texts while purposive sampling will be carried out to select the texts of the authors that deal with themes related to Islamophobia. The research will establish how Pakistani diasporic writers see, react to, conform with or subvert the Islamophobia discourses prevalent in the Western media. The study will provide significant insight into ways in which Islamophobia affects the cultural identity of the characters and how it should be conceptualized and subverted.

data.projectName: Relationship of carotid artery calcifications in panoramic radiograph with the severity of carotid stenosis in Doppler ultrasound and future ischemic heart and cerebrovascular diseases – a cohort study
data.piUniversity: DOW University of Health Sciences, Karachi
data.projectDigest:
The proposed project seeks to lessen the burden of cardiovascular diseases (CVD) by early detection, thereby, decreasing mortality and morbidity rates associated with these diseases. It focuses on early detection of CVD by detecting the presence of atheroma plaques or calcifications in the common carotid artery through dental panoramic radiograph (also known as Orthopantomogram – OPG). OPG is the most commonly requested dental radiograph. It can be utilized to detect the presence of carotid artery calcifications (CAC) around the first, second and third (C1-C3) cervical vertebrae  that can easily be assessed via OPG

The aim of this research is to determine the relationship between presence of carotid artery calcifications (CAC) in panoramic radiograph (OPG) and future ischemic heart diseases (IHD), cerebrovascular diseases (CVD) or both. The objectives of this research are to 1) determine the prevalence of CAC in OPG of patients who will be visiting the dental department of DUHS 2)  determine the sensitivity and specificity of OPG in the detection of CAC by comparing with the presence of carotid artery stenosis in Doppler ultrasound 3) to correlate the presence of risk factors (hypertension, diabetes mellitus, obesity, hyperlipidemia and smoking) of ischemic heart diseases/ cerebrovascular diseases, level of cholesterol in lipid profile and carotid artery stenosis in Doppler ultrasound with the presence of CAC in OPG. 

The research is first of its kind to correlate the radiometric density of the CAC in the OPG with the level of cholesterol in lipid profile and and severity of carotid artery stenosis of Doppler ultrasound. . Furthermore, to determine the relationship between presence of CAC in OPG with CVD, cerebrovascular diseases or both, prospectively.

data.projectName: Taxonomic studies of whiteflies (Aleyrodidae: Homoptera) from Pakistan
data.projectDigest:
In this project Aleyrodid (Whitefly) fauna of  Pakistan will be Collected and identified. Different food and host plants will be identified. Furthermore, Taxonomic keys for all the Pakistan’s  species will be constructed, their original photos or images will be given to facilitate their future identification for their effective control.
In view of this, the present taxonomic studies of the diversity of the whiteflies have been planned. For this purpose, the 4th  instar nymphs (pseudopupae) or their exuvia will be collected from different localities of the Punjab. After preparing the permanent slides of these specimens, they will be identified up to the species level with the help of available literature.
Despite their great economic importance, very little taxonomic work has been done on these insects in Pakistan. Martin and Mound (2007) listed 1556 species from different countries of the world and various workers have identified nearly 180 species from India, Gillespie (2012) identified and published a list of 22 whiteflies species from Australia,but in Pakistan only 43 valid species have been reported. Besides, the excessive use of agrochemicals and the changes in climatic factors have resulted in changes in the biodiversity in the agricultural landscapes. The present research will be undertaken to further investigate and understand the whitefly fauna in Pakistan.

data.projectName: Green and sustainable Ammonia Production for utilisation in fertiliser and energy sectors of Pakistan – A way forward to reduce carbon-based energy-mix dependence to 40% by 2030
data.projectDigest: By 2030 Government of Pakistan set a target to achieve 30% renewable energy and 30% hydropower in its energy-mix. As per today’s standing, Pakistan needs to reduce carbon-based energy-mix by two times within period of ten years. Therefore, massive changes are required in trends of energy usage in power, domestic, commercial, transport, fertiliser and general industry sectors. However, renewable energy is intermittent, seasonal and harvested in decentralise manner, thus energy storage is required, so energy can be supplied and use without any interruption. Among several energy storage possibilities, ammonia provides high round trip efficiency, scalability, availability of transport network, high energy density, conserved safety records, low energy storage cost, last but not least usage as a fertiliser. Over a period of a century, a conventional ammonia process has been developed for steady state operation and larger capacity, due to possibility of hydrogen reactant production in bulk and economically from fossil fuel. For power-to-ammonia, physically Haber-Bosch synthesis process remains the same, however operational and design requirements changes. This proposal brings together, the ammonia synthesis loops’ flexible operational possibilities along with enhanced efficiency and yield percentage. Additionally, strategy for power-to-ammonia production in accordance to Pakistan’s requirement will be recommended.

data.projectName: Dynamics and Control of HIV/AIDS in Pakistan via age-structured Epidemic models
data.piUniversity: University of Malakand, Chakdara, Dir, Malakand
data.projectDigest:
Acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS) is a chronically transmittable disease which is caused by human immunodeficiency virus (HIV). The main roots of transmission of the virus are sexual intercourse and contact with contaminated blood which attacks the immune system. The epidemic HIV/AIDS is the real source of fear for humanity around the globe and specifically in Pakistan due to its unpredictable nature. Researchers from different fields including Biology and Mathematics are trying to study the behavior of the disease and its control. Mathematician used the tools of modeling and control theory in order to understand the traits of HIV/AIDS and its possible prevention strategies.
In the proposed project, the investigators will investigate, analyze and control the HIV/AIDS epidemic by using age-structured mathematical models in the form of mixed and PDEs models. The use of mathematical models will help us to detect and identify novel and unknown infectious agents. This project will also help to identify age-groups that are at most risk. As a result, health authorities may target only those age-groups in any HIV/AIDS control program, ultimately it can save a lot of money and time. The project aims to develop an appropriate management structure for observing and controlling the disease.

data.projectName: inorganic phosphors for LEDs applications
data.piUniversity: Kohat University of Science and Technology, Kohat
data.projectDigest:
The invention of bright-blue LEDs (light emitting diodes) by Nakamura and others in the mid-1990s has led to the development of devices capable to produce white light in a reliable and efficient way, based on inorganic phosphors [1-3]. White LEDs can save approximately 70% of the energy used for incandescent light bulbs and do not need the hazardous mercury commonly used in luminescent tubes. Compared with these, which require excitation at 254 nm, LEDs also save energy by using a longer excitation wavelength of 330 to 450 nm [4].
Currently, the application of LEDs has been extended from signal indicators initially to automobile light, traffic light, street lighting, landscape decoration, backlight of liquid crystal display (LCD) for TV sets, computers and mobile telephones. Converting phosphors are essential components for LEDs [5].
Luminescence is the non-thermal emission of visible photons. In luminescence phenomena, major portion of the incident energy is converted to light photons due to the fact that no heat energy is produced during the process. 
The UV or blue light emitted by semiconductor diode is incident on phosphor. Which converts the UV/blue light to visible light through luminescence phenomena. Mostly inorganic materials with wide band gaps are chosen as host, which is doped with a small amount of rare earth which act as the emissive center (excitons) [6, 7]. Phosphors will be synthesized by solid state reaction method and then its luminescent properties will be characterized by the UV-Vis spectrophotometer analysis. This study will help us to develop inorganic phosphors for LED lighting applications.

data.projectName: Computational Chemistry & Molecular Docking
data.projectDigest: Drug re-positioning  or re-purposing is the most emerging technique for the identification and prediction of the new chemotherapeutic potential of the already existing drugs replacing the old method of target based approach. This is the most rapid, cost effective and less risky technique than the trivial techniques for the identification of the drug. Though the genomic-based approach using the genetic information for the identification of potential drug remained quite successful during the last few years but did not get popularity due to some shortcomings and was replaced by the phenotypic-cell-based method as an efficient method. The study has been deigned to screen thousands of compounds available in the library through in-silico study as potential drug candidates for various cancer carcinomas. The information will be retrieved using various available databases such as Therpeutic Target Database (TTD), Connectivity Map Data Bases (CMAP). The information regarding pathogens will be obtained from OMIM and PubMed databases. In-silico based ranking and validation of newly predicted targets will be done through molecular docking studies. The drugs showing the potential will be purchased from the market and will be subjected to in vitro and in vivo studies using various animal models for the confirmation of the potential of repositioning.

data.projectName: Co-occurrence of Mycotoxins in Animal Feed and its Mitigation Strategies
data.piUniversity: University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Lahore
data.projectDigest: Foodstuffs are very prone to contaminants like bacteria and fungi in the pre-harvest and post-harvest stages especially, during storage when executed in poor conditions. Exposure of mycotoxins is a worldwide concern due to the globalization of food trade and its toxic nature. Occurrence of multiple mycotoxins (co-occurrence) now gains much attention worldwide owing to it’s more toxic capacity (synergistic) as compared to single mycotoxin. According to the Biomin mycotoxins survey of 2018, more than 70% contaminated samples contained multiple mycotoxins in feed and risk of mycotoxins exists more heightened in Asia (78%) comparatively to other continents because of the favorable environmental conditions. Frequency of mycotoxins comprising Aflatoxin, Fumonisins, Ochratoxin and deoxynivalenol are more common and co-occurrence of these mycotoxins can result severe detrimental impacts. Therefore, the current study is planned to check the existence of multiple mycotoxins (co-occurrence) in animal feed (Poultry & Cattle) and then find out its mitigation strategies. Firstly, occurrence of different mycotoxins will check quantitatively and then its detoxification procedures will be optimized to minimize the mycotoxins in animal feed. Mycotoxins contamination data including their possible detoxification approaches will be very helpful for livestock industry and stakeholders.

data.projectName: The Threat of Global Grid Lock and Pakistan: The CPEC factors
data.projectDigest: Pakistan is one of the key country for global economic corridor and it serves as a gateway to the international trade. Improvements in logistics and shipment industry offer a lucrative and promising future to the country. However, the lack of infrastructure, the exhausting resources have created a grid locking situation for Pakistan over the years. The pivotal resources including time as a resource are squandering due to lack of deliberation and consideration. In the recent, Pakistan joined China in its project of one belt one route as the part of CPEC. The development of CPEC depicts a prosperous Pakistan but the time utility of is important parameter. The research is intended to determine the key factors of timely completion of CPEC mega project and the benefits it will reflect as a result. Quantitative analysis technique is planned to measure the effects of these determinants on CPEC success which will eventually drive logistics and transportation success. Data will be collected from multiple cities to measure the strength of the projects. Meanwhile, all those industries will be considered who will be beneficiary as a direct impact.

data.projectName: Targeting Diabetes at Molecular Level Using Natural Compounds And Peptides: New Trends In The Development of Antihyperglycemic Agents
data.projectDigest: Diabetes highlights a rising epidemic striking severe socioeconomic crisis to the world and specifically to the developing countries, like Pakistan. Although scientific discoveries, improved healthcare services, and increasing literacy rate, diabetes continues to burden numerous sections, especially the developing countries. It is suggested that none of the available synthetic antidiabetic drug has ideal therapy, besides these drugs have side effects. Therefore, Natural bioactive compounds would be a better alternative and can be considered safe. The natural bioactive compound(s) are of great interest to us that need to be explored as Pakistan is rich in diverse natural resources. Therefore, the main objective of this project is focused on the isolation and purification of antidiabetic bioactive compounds and to study their mechanism of action at cellular/molecular level. We will isolate novel bioactive compound(s) from the natural resources and validate their mode of action at molecular level. Such innovation in the field will open the ways to utilise the natural sources of Pakistan wisely, which will not only provide protection to the society, but save the foreign reserves as well. Moreover, the natural bioactive compound(s) will be highly valuable from all aspects, i.e. cost, clean/green, easily accessible at market place, etc.

data.projectName: Evaluation of photo assisted sonoelectrochemical process for accelerated and cost effective mineralization of textile dyes
data.piUniversity: Ghulam Ishaq Khan Institute of Engineering Sciences & Technology, Topi
data.projectDigest:
The presence of toxic and hazardous compounds (used in dyeing and textile industries etc.) in natural water resources are a major sources of water pollution resulting in harmful consequences to both marine life as well as human health. For textile dyes, costly electrochemical treatments are largely reported for decolourization with complete/incomplete mineralization. Thus, some assistance is required in electrochemical treatments to reduce the operational cost and shorten treatment duration. A promising assistance can be made by utilising the hybrid photo-sonoelectrochemical process for the oxidation of such organic contaminants. Synergy of both techniques with electrochemical process will allow residual dyes to be decolourized at reduced cost and time. In the sonoelectrochemical process, ultrasound waves produce acoustic cavitation bubbles in electrolyte that can contribute to the direct oxidation of organic substances.  However, stand-alone application of ultrasound does not result in complete mineralisation of complex mixtures. Similarly, photo-electrochemical process can effectively reduce organic/inorganic contaminants.  However, studies reporting effective decolourization by photo-electrochemical are still very incomplete and scary.
The main goal of this project is to (1)- study the effect of electrode materials and different operating factors for decolourization of textile wastewater, (2)- optimization for complete mineralization to have the most desirable conditions.

data.projectName: Rethinking Research Supervision Framework of Doctoral Programs in Pakistani Universities
data.projectDigest: Our project titled “Rethinking the Framework for Improving Standards of PhD Programs in Pakistani Universities”  probes the academic and administrative issues confronted by doctoral scholars, supervisors and administrative authorities in the public and private sector universities of Pakistan. This project would explores the nature of the issues adversely impacting various aspects of the quality of PhD dissertations in multiple domains as well as to find out the main reasons for the delay in the completion of the doctorate degrees of students. It proposes practical policy restructurations for the HEC that could reduce the impact of these adverse influences. This project endeavors to comprehensively analyze the ground realities in various doctoral degree programs in Pakistani universities and would suggest a strategic framework for improving the quality of doctoral programs with particular reference to the processing mechanism of doctoral dissertations. The objectives of this study include: (1) identifying academic issues faced by scholars in completing doctoral dissertations in Higher Education Institutions, (2) exploring administrative issues pertaining to the processing mechanisms of doctoral dissertations at HEIs (3) analyzing the problems underlying academic and administrative issues at HEIs (4) developing a strategic framework for bridging loopholes in the PhD programs, especially in the research phase. (5) Streamlining the research practices with international research ethics and student rights.

data.projectName: IODINE BASED, SELF NANO EMULSIFYING DRUG DELIVERY SYSTEM (SNEDDS): A UNIQUE TOOL FOR TREATMENT OF BACTERIAL VAGINOSIS
data.projectDigest:
Nanotechnology has become a buzzword in pharmaceutical sciences and efforts are ongoing to extend its applications in various streams of pharmaceutical sciences. Nanotechnology has dramatically influenced drug delivery research and several nanoscale technologies/carriers have been and are being explored for improving therapeutic performance of drugs. The self nano-emulsifying drug delivery system (SNEDDS) is a nanocarrier that forms spontaneously from the mixture of oil, surfactant, co-surfactant, and an active drug compound in a homogenous ?ne oil-in-water nano-emulsion liquid form. The ability of this system to improve the solubility, provides a larger interfacial area while enhancing the rate of absorption of insoluble drugs. 
Nowadays, the growing resistance against antibiotics and antiseptics has become a worldwide and increasing problem.  The widespread use of antiseptics and disinfectant products has prompted some speculation on the development of microbial resistance, against antibiotics, antiseptics and disinfectants. Iodine has well known antibacterial activity but still no formulation has developed for diseases like bacterial vaginosis. The study aims to improve the solubility of elemental Iodine in aqueous solvents specific for the treatment of bacterial vaginosis by preparing Nano-micelles based mucoadhesives to be able to spread and penetrate the mucus layer efficiently.

data.projectName: Adaptation and Implementation of Triple Parenting Program for Pakistani Youth and Families: A Randomized Field Trial
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest: Parenting is a very important element that influences all aspects of children’s life including social, emotional, physical, and psychological. Effective parenting which includes warmth, supportiveness, encouragement, affection, rules, and monitoring helps the child to develop  and grow in positive ways for example emotional stability, social intelligence, physical health, good relationships and academic success. On the other hand, ineffective parenting, which includes harsh disciplining, lack of affection/ overindulgence, lack of monitoring and rules, impedes social, emotional, physical and psychological health of the child. Therefore, efforts has been made to improve the parenting practices of parents across the world through different mechanisms including seminars, workshops, programs, lectures and campaigns. Positive parenting program (triple p) is a parenting program that helps parents to learn effective parenting through different activities across 24 different countries. The aim of present project is to translate some of components of triple p program in Urdu for using in Pakistan to improve parenting practices. Different modes will be used to deliver the program in community for example group seminars for parents, individual session, group discussions, and dissemination of information through media (print, electronic, social media).

data.projectName: Experimenting S&T Policy Advocacy to Achieve SDGs and Socioeconomic Development in Gem and Jewelry Sector
data.projectDigest: Pakistan has committed to achieve SDGs under the millennium development goals and lacking behind other developed and emerging markets too. The science and technology interventions have contributed significantly in achieving SDGs. The china has lifted 40 million people out of poverty by S&T interventions like enhancing agriculture yield many folds, converting deserts into green fields and producing economical electrical wheels.Pakistan has achieved some milestones in late 1960s like green revolution. Pakistan has developed varieties of rice, cotton and wheat to increase economics of farmers, export and achieve economic growth. Unfortunately, in spite of good policy formulation Pakistan has failed to implement those policies and register S&T policy fruits on SDGs indicators. The project proposed to experiment S&T policy advocacy to achieve SDGs indicators and measure the impact. The project will select SDG 09 of industrial innovation and infrastructure and pilot it in the sector of Gem and Jewelry. The project will conduct a base line survey to report current situation of SDG 09 in gems and jewelry sector will identify right policy interventions, will launch policy advocacy for the development and measure post interventions impact in terms of achieving SDG 09 in Gems and Jewelry Sector of Pakistan.

data.projectName: Development of a Seismic Retrofitting System for Large (1000kvA to 5000kVA) Power Transformers
data.piUniversity: Balochistan University of Information Technology, Engineering and Management Sciences,Quetta
data.projectDigest: The main objective of this study is to develop an economical seismic retrofitting technique for the large power transformers. Transformers are one of the essential components of electrical substations that perform a key role in electrical power transmission and distribution for industries and urban cities.  Many components currently installed in the main grid station are without considering seismicity of an area. Due to which even an earthquake with low magnitude can cause severe damage to the transformer. In this project, several prototypes of the damping system will be developed by combining different energy dissipation techniques. The simplified analysis model of transformer and damper is carried out in a structural analysis software to understand the dynamic behavior under different ground motions. The advance finite element techniques will be used for the shape optimization of the damper to maximize its dissipation capacity. The damping system can be implemented in transformers of numerous power plants and substations located in earthquake-prone areas. Power sector manufacture can in-build the damping system in their transformer to enhance their structural performance. This can play a crucial role in the case of a catastrophic event by keeping the components of the power plant in working conditions.

data.projectName: IDENTIFICATION OF POTENT ANTI-VIRAL ACTIVITIES OF NATURAL PRODUCTS AND SYNTHETIC COMPOUNDS AGAINST HEPATITIS B AND C VIRUS
data.projectDigest:
Globally, the major health concern is chiefly associated with the Hepatitis B (HBV) and Hepatitis C (HCV) viral infections because these two viruses are mainly responsible for 96% of mortality in hepatitis patients annually.  The chronic viral hepatitis is among the top ten fatal infections worldwide.  Pakistan is a developing country with the inadequate resources and increased frequencies of viral diseases. Therefore, there is a strong need for accurate diagnosis and treatment options as it is hard to endure extraordinary exceeding treatment cost since the therapies for this threat are limited in the clinical context because of side effects and the development of viral resistance to the nucleoside/nucleotide inhibitors. 
As a result, there is an urgent need to introduce new and safe molecules with the anti-viral potential which might be helpful to fight against the viral hepatitis. During the proposed study anti-HBV and anti-HCV properties of different compounds will be evaluated. Furthermore, selected compounds will also be evaluated for their ability to inhibit the viral resistance.  Moreover, the potential of compounds at time intervals will also be evaluated. The project will help in identifying new lead molecules, which would further support the development of new effective drugs.

data.projectName: Management of Hypertension and Prevalence of Depression among Hemodialysis Patients in Twin Cities of Pakistan
data.projectDigest:
Hypertension is very common, quiet complex to diagnose it properly and usually uncontrolled among hemodialysis (HD) patients. Almost 90% hemodialysis patients are hypertensive. Lifelong dialysis therapy is also directly linked with mental stress and poor quality of life among dialysis patients which ultimately leads to depression. Depression is very common neuropsychiatric disorder among HD patients. This project is about hypertension control and to evaluate the prevalence of depression among hypertensive hemodialysis patients. 
Cardiovascular mortality can be reduced by controlling hypertension and quality of life can be enhanced by regular psychiatric monitoring and better management of depression among hemodialysis patients.

data.projectName: "Study on supply chain and value addition of grapes in Pothwar"
data.piUniversity: Pir Mehr Ali Shah Arid Agriculture, University Rawalpindi
data.projectDigest: One of the main challenges faced by Pakistan today is to ensure food security for its highly increasing population growth. Although the country's grapes production is much lower than the national demand, there are high post-harvest food losses due to the narrow harvest period and creation of glut in the market. Several factors play an important role in quantitative and qualitative losses of mainly fruits. This study will be initiated to investigate postharvest losses (qualitative and quantitative) of grapes value chain produced under different areas of Pothwar. Quantitative post-harvest loss assessment along the supply chains, qualitative loss and shelf life estimation at retail market will be investigated using standard methods. So, the goal of this project will be to quantify the amount of losses and waste across the entire grape supply chain from agricultural production (harvesting) to final consumption in different areas of Pothwar

data.projectName: Synthesis of Fluoroquinolones Derivatives for Enhanced Antimicrobial, Antibiofilm Activities and their use in other Diseases: A Biology-Oriented Drug Synthesis (BIODS) Approach
data.projectDigest:
This proposal describes biology-oriented drug synthesis (BIODS) approach to transform commercially available pharmaceutical drugs to new chemical entities via simple organic transformations. Discovery of microbial drug-resistance and the less availability of potential drugs with toxicity and resistance of antimicrobial agents encourages the scientists to discover new antimicrobial agents with promising therapeutic potential, having various modes of activity or effectively influence different sites in the microorganism. We aim to design and synthesize libraries of compounds based on the main skeleton of commercial antimicrobial drugs fluoroquinolones such as ciprofloxacin, enoxacin, norfloxacin, and ofloxacin by incorporating medicinally important pharmacophores such as hydrazide, oxdiazole, thiazoles, oxazoles, carbazines, thiocarbazines, thioamides, and sulfonamides. The synthetic structural analogues will be screened for their antimicrobial, and cytotoxic activities.
Since, a range of biological assays is available the International Center for Chemical and Biological Sciences (ICCBS), University of Karachi including monoamine oxidase A, monoamine oxidase B, xenthinoxidase, ?-glucosidase, ?-amylase, ?-glucuronidase, acetylcholinesterase, butyrylcholinesterase, lipoxygenase, and urease inhibitions thus these synthetic compounds will also be screened for other biological activities. It will be an extra benefit of this project which may open-up new avenues of research on these molecules.
data.projectSummary:
This proposal describes biology-oriented drug synthesis (BIODS) approach to transform commercially available pharmaceutical drugs to new chemical entities via simple organic transformations. Discovery of microbial drug-resistance and the less availability of potential drugs with toxicity and resistance of antimicrobial agents encourages the scientists to discover new antimicrobial agents with promising therapeutic potential, having various modes of activity or effectively influence different sites in the microorganism. We aim to design and synthesize libraries of compounds based on the main skeleton of commercial antimicrobial drugs fluoroquinolones such as ciprofloxacin, enoxacin, norfloxacin, and ofloxacin by incorporating medicinally important pharmacophores such as hydrazide, oxdiazole, thiazoles, oxazoles, carbazines, thiocarbazines, thioamides, and sulfonamides. The synthetic structural analogues will be screened for their antimicrobial, and cytotoxic activities.
Since, a range of biological assays is available the International Center for Chemical and Biological Sciences (ICCBS), University of Karachi including monoamine oxidase A, monoamine oxidase B, xenthinoxidase, ?-glucosidase, ?-amylase, ?-glucuronidase, acetylcholinesterase, butyrylcholinesterase, lipoxygenase, and urease inhibitions thus these synthetic compounds will also be screened for other biological activities. It will be an extra benefit of this project which may open-up new avenues of research on these molecules.

data.projectName: Eco-friendly, energy efficient and sustainable next generation cellular network
data.piUniversity: University of Kotli Azad Jammu and Kashmir
data.projectDigest:
The major technological developments cause global warming due to the emission of harmful greenhouse gas. Information and Communication Technology (ICT) is one of the fastest growing sector and has the greatest impact on almost all other technologies. Currently, there is rapid technological changes which leads to the high demand for data flow. This trend of technological changes and high data demand is not expected to drop in recent years. To meet this demand, mobile network operators (MNOs) need to upgrade and extend their network infrastructures in order to increase their capacity. 
 Network infrastructure deployment and maintenance is very much expensive, this requires heavy investment from MNOs. MNOs deploying infrastructures to the rural area become a challenge; consequently, most of the rural areas are unconnected. About 4 billion people globally have no access to the internet, the majority of being from developing countries of Africa and Asia. Therefore, the need for network access to all, calls for innovative modes of infrastructure deployment and management for mobile network systems. Network infrastructure sharing (NIS) is considered as a promising practical solution for MNOs to reduce both the capital expenses (CAPEX), operational expenses (OPEX) and get along with the technological changes to meet the fast-growing demands of data traffic.
In addition, energy efficiency and reduced global warming are now the wish and attainment of all the important stakeholders that are linked with technology. Information and communication technology not only provides room for green energy efficient systems but also help other industrial sector to improve their basic functionalities in the management of energy efficient systems.

data.projectName: Impact of pretreated indigenous agro-waste on biocomposites
data.projectDigest:
Depletion of fossil fuels and environmental sustainability worldwide have directed researchers to use lignocellulosic fiber in composites and value-added products. Lignocellulosic fibers that are produced in huge amount around the world, can provide an alternative to synthetic fiber reinforced composites. Use of lignocellulosic biomass as a reinforcing material for biocomposite appeals various investigations due to its good physicochemical properties and socio-economic benefits. However, non-cellulosic constituents in the biofiber such as lignin cause poor interfacial bonding between fiber and polymer. Hence, different pretreatments could be used to pretreat the fiber for improving the fiber/matrix interfacial adhesion that ultimately alter the thermal and mechanical properties of biocomposite. Chemical pretreatment has appeared as the encouraging technology towards eco-friendly conversion of the fiber into cellulosic-rich fiber (CRF) as sustainable raw material for the fabrication of biocomposite.
Main goal of this research is to study the impact of chemically treated lignocellulosic fiber on the thermo-mechanical properties of biocomposites. The fiber will be pretreated with different chemicals prior to synthesis of biocomposite using thermal press. Thermo-mechanical properties of biocomposite will be investigated and compared with those fabricated from untreated fiber.

data.projectName: Synthesis, Characterization and Optimization of Lipid- Polymer Hybrid Nanoparticles of Clarithromycin to Combat Antibiotic Resistant Helicobacter Pylori Infections
data.projectDigest:
The resistance patterns acquired by the bacteria over the period of time, has become a worldwide threat, to cope up with this problem one needs to revolutionize the mechanism of antibiotics delivery to overcome all the barriers developed by bacteria.
Antibiotic-resistant bacteria that are difficult or impossible to treat are becoming increasingly common and are causing a global health crisis. Antibiotic resistance is encoded by several genes, many of which can transfer between bacteria. New resistance mechanisms are constantly being described, and new genes and vectors of transmission are identified on a regular basis. This article reviews recent advances in our understanding of the mechanisms by which bacteria are either intrinsically resistant or acquire resistance to antibiotics, including the prevention of access to drug targets, changes in the structure and protection of antibiotic targets and the direct modification or inactivation of antibiotics.
Clarithromycin: Clarithromycin is a macrolide antibiotic, used to treat various infections. This includes strep throat, pneumonia, skin infections, H. pylori infection, and Lyme disease, among others. Clarithromycin is primarily used to treat a number of bacterial infections including pneumonia, Helicobacter pylori, and as an alternative to penicillin in strep throat. Other uses include cat scratch disease and other infections due to bartonella, cryptosporidiosis, as a second line agent in Lyme disease and toxoplasmosis. It may also be used to prevent bacterial endocarditis in those who cannot take penicillin. It is effective against upper and lower respiratory tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections and helicobacter pylori infections associated with duodenal ulcers

data.projectName: Cardioprotective and antioxidant effects of physiologically active polyphenols
data.projectDigest: Epidemiological studies have often shown relationships between vegetable/fruit intake and reduction in degenerative processes, hence lowering the mortality rate from cardio- and cerebro-vascular diseases. These relationships are not clearly attributable to major macronutrients or known vitamins and minerals but suggests that other components of plants like flavonoids, phenolic acids and carotenoids that gained much recognition due to different biological activities including lowering risk of cardiovascular diseases. Our research group has had an interest in bioactive polyphenols for more than 5 years and recently our attention has focused specifically on their cardio-protective effects. Despite efforts by many groups around the world big questions remain: how are selected phenolic acids, flavonoids and carotenoids absorbed, and what effect do they have on metabolic processes that may be associated with cardeo-protective effect? This project is aimed at working towards providing answers to all these questions. The polyphenols (phenolics, flavonoids, carotenoids) will be isolated and purified from different species of pumpkins. Antioxidant and cardio-protective potentials of isolated compounds will be studies using various in vitro and in vivo analysis using different diseased models. Moreover the bioavailability and effectiveness of formulations will be studied individually and in different combinations to investigate the synergistic effects.

data.projectName: Rational Development of Potent Novel Natural Chemosensitizers: A Strategy to Augment Anti-tumor Efficacy of Clinical Drugs and Circumvent Drug Resistance
data.projectDigest: Cancer is one of the most devastating and life threatening disease and represents the 2nd leading cause of death worldwide. Current treatment modalities include surgical resection, radiation therapy, hormonal therapy, immunotherapy and chemotherapy. Since most of the patients are diagnosed with cancer at advanced stage, chemotherapy remains the only treatment option for advanced stage cancer. Chemotherapeutic drugs are equally toxic to both cancer cells and normal cells.  In the last two decades, Scientists and pharmacists focused on development of highly selected and targeted therapies based on genetic differences between cancer cells and normal cells. No doubt, introduction of such targeted therapies which specifically bind with a specific target in cancer cells and thereby kill cancer cells while sparing normal cells, have brought a major revolution in the treatment of cancer. However, soon after their introduction into cancer clinics, chemo-resistance developed against these therapies as well. Drug resistance has become the major limitation of anticancer drugs. The proposed project aims to identify and develop potent novel natural and cost-effective multi-target chemosensitizers with special emphasis on increasing the therapeutic efficacy of clinical drugs in drug resistant cancer cells and simultaneously inhibiting the activation of genes involved in chemo-resistance development.

data.projectName: Assessment of public acceptance and willingness to pay for renewable  energy with an emphasis on climate change protection: An empirical evidence from Punjab Pakistan
data.projectDigest: Mainly the research is aligned with one of the basic agendas of current government e.g. climate change protection. The prior studies shows that solar energy has a large potential to reduce the GHG emission. The federal government of Pakistan aimed to enhance its capacity to generate green energy according to its vision 2030. Solar energy is one of the cheapest green energy source. IPCC report, (2014) suggests that energy sector is contributing nearly 50% in GHG emission. Therefore, enhanced awareness, acceptance and willingness to pay for solar energy  will importantly strengthen the climate change perspective. From broader perspective, this research to aims to switch the consumers from electricity to solar energy for two reasons: a) for reducing the GHG emission to protect the environment and b) to bridge the demand supply gaps so the additional units can be used in production. In this context, the research will initially target the WAPDA consumers consuming less than 300 units. The data will be collected from four major cities of Punjab including Faisalabad, Lahore, Multan and Rawalpindi using a face-to-face survey method. A questionnaire is designed to measure the people responses on acceptance, willingness and affordability. The research is significant for Government, private investors and general community from various perspectives.  Citizens may opt green energy at cheaper prices and can lessen the burden from government to produce electricity using expensive fossil fuels. Can mitigate the gaps between demand and supply of electricity. After choosing the green energy by household with electricity consumption up to 300 the excessive units can be given to industry to fasten their production process.

data.projectName: Nutrient management for reducing hydrocyanic acid (HCN) production in diverse forage sorghum germplasm of Pakistani origin under arid and semi-arid environments
data.projectDigest: Sorghum is an important fodder crop grown widely under rainfed and irrigated conditions of Pakistan due to its ability to withstand drought conditions better than other cereals. However, one of the disadvantages of sorghum fodder is that the production of anti-nutritional factor Hydrocyanic Acid increases under limited water supply which is lethal for animals. During last few years, such cases of animal mortality due to sorghum feeding have been reported widely in Pakistan due to drought problem. Thus, there is a need to screen the available sorghum germplasm in the country for HCN production and the management strategies to reduce HCN production in sorghum through agronomic techniques. From this project we will screen low HCN producing sorghum genotypes under drought stress which will be helpful in future breeding strategies to produce the sorghum genotypes with good forage quality and low HCN production under water shortage scenarios. Furthermore, the optimization of NPK will serve as short gun approach to improve forage quality and reduce HCN production in sorghum under water deficit conditions. Finally, development of sorghum genotypes with good forage quality and low HCN contents will be helpful to reduce the animal mortality and enhance livestock production in country.

data.projectName: Entrepreneurship and Pakistan vision 2025: Promoting Small Business for Sustainable Development
data.projectDigest:
SMEs play a backbone role in both developed and developing countries. There is consensus among governments, policymakers, industry and scholars around the world, on SMEs crucial role towards sustainable development. Several studies report that SMEs category of businesses dominates the business arena worldwide; for example, a study of World Bank (2019) revealed that more than 90% of the businesses worldwide are small and medium enterprises (SMEs) which employ more than 50% of the total workforce in developing countries. According to Small and Medium Enterprises Development Authority, in Pakistan, SMEs represents about 90% of all businesses, employing 80% of the nonagricultural labor force and contributes 40% to GDP per year. 
The relationship between SMEs and sustainable development is interdependent; the successful achievement of SDGs is conditioned with SMEs, while the growth and performance of SMEs cannot be achieved without incorporating sustainability principles and practices in SMEs’ strategic framework. Despite the significance and crucial role of SMEs, Pakistani SMEs lack sustainability implementation and are far behind on the road towards sustainable development. Moreover, Pakistan’s Vision 2025 is being implemented in sync with the SDGs. Since the SDGs are more universal and comprehensive in approach, localized home grown solutions, policy frameworks, and sustainability frameworks need to be developed and implemented in the context of SMEs to accelerate the pace in economic, social and environmental development.
In light of the above discussion, this project aims at unlocking and enhancing the role of SMEs in Pakistan’s economic, socioeconomic, environmental as well as sustainable development. The objective of the project is to develop sustainable business mode

data.projectName: Exploration of potential hits from FDA and phytochemical screened compounds against Parkinson disease by targeting multiple receptors through drugs repositioning approach
data.projectDigest: Novel drug development is onerous, time consuming and overpriced process with particularly low success and relatively high enfeebling rates. To overcome this burden, drug repositioning approach is being used to predict the possible therapeutic effects of FDA approved drugs in different diseases. Herein, research work will design a computational approach as well as the preclinical trial using albino rat model to fetch the promising drugs against Parkinson’s Disease from the pool of FDA approved drugs. The binding interaction patterns and conformations of screened phytoactive drugs within active region of protein receptors were confirmed through molecular docking and simulation approaches. The possible associations of selected drugs with Parkinson’s proteins will be checked by pharmacogenomics analysis and confirmed through data mining. Taken together, this computational approach will display a comparable result which can be used as possible therapeutic agent in the treatment of PD.

data.projectName: Anomaly Detection System in X-Ray Baggage Security Imagery
data.projectDigest:
To ensure the safety of the public,  X-ray baggage screening devices have been placed at the entrance of several public places such as airports, railways, hospitals and important government buildings. The images produced by these screening devices are visually inspected by security personnel to detect any suspicious objects such as firearms or explosives.   Since abnormal activities do not happen quite often, watching these ‘boring’ X-ray baggage images is quite tiring and mostly the suspicious objects get unnoticed. Furthermore,  criminals usually transfer objects in the form of unknown parts to avoid being caught.
To automate the X-ray baggage screening process, we propose to analyze X-ray baggage images using computer vision. Specifically, we pose x-ray baggage images analyses as a weakly supervised anomaly detection approach.  The proposed approach will need less annotation work for training, perform image analysis efficiently and it will be straightforward to use. 
We hope that our project will facilitate the security personals to do better inspection of security baggage and make people and important building more secure.

data.projectName: Design and Development of Blockchain-Based Document Issuance and Verification System (BlockDoc)
data.piUniversity: CECOS University of Information Technology and Emerging Sciences, Peshawar
data.projectDigest: Currently, degree/certificate issuance and verification in Pakistan are performed manually at universities, organizations and HEC. There is no foolproof mechanism to find the authenticity and originality of the degrees in a fast and efficient manner. The HEC Pakistan have introduced an online system for degree attestation and verification, however, the online system is limited, where users can only create their online account and upload their scanned documents. This practice allows the involvement of the human factor, which sometimes results in delays, errors and inefficiencies in the system.  Similarly, employers and other institutes and organizations, too have no secure and fast mechanism for document verification of their potential employees.  In the present era of information technology, it is possible to design a secure, smooth and convenient degree issuance and verification system. Blockchain is one of such concepts which can be used to develop a secure, transparent and integrated system where involvement of human factor can be minimized. In this project, we proposed to conduct a rigorous and robust research feasibility to design and develop an online document issuance/verification system based on the blockchain technology.

data.projectName: Design and development of drive train for electrical vehicle applications
data.projectDigest: The main objective of the project is to design and develop a drive train that encompasses an electrical motor, its drive and final gear coupling to the wheels of an electrical vehicle (EV). Due to excellent speed to torque linear relationship, BLDC motor is selected to be designed having capacity of 3000 watts. A computer tool ANSYS and Maxwell is used to model the mechanical structure of the motor. After applying the boundary conditions, static and transient solutions will be obtained and various design iterations will be evaluated for optimized motor design and that will be used for prototyping phase. A motor drive (input power smoothing, commutation signal generation and inverter phase) will be designed and simulated in MATLAB/Simulink environment. Power converter and control stages will be checked for motoring and regeneration modes of operation. Final design will be translated into hardware development and prototyping of the drive. At last, all modules, motor, its drive and coupling gear will be concatenated together to form a drive train and will be installed on a vehicle for evaluation purpose. Based upon the experimental results of field test, a comprehensive concept paper describing the pathway to commercialization will be proposed.

data.projectName: Development of a rapid detection method for the molecular genetic diagnosis of congenital and hereditary limb defects
data.projectDigest: Congenital and hereditary limb defects (HLDs) are one of the most prevalent types of genetic defects in the Pakistani population. Being a major source of physical disability, these defects put a tremendous amount of burden of the subjects, their families and the society. An estimated 20% of newborn with HLDs die before the age of 6 years mostly due to the associated anomalies. In this context, the proposed project intends to contribute towards the development of a rapid molecular diagnosis tool kit for HLDs. First, we intend to develop multiplex PCRs systems and amplification-refractory mutation systems for the detection of common mutations and copy number variations in the candidate genes of limb development. Then, with the help of our collaborator, we intend to develop a customized panel of for next-generation sequencing (NGS). We anticipate to bring the cost of multiplex PCRs test below Rs. 10,000/sample and Rs. 30,000/100 gene panel for NGS. These developed methods can be implemented in routine medical diagnostics on cost-effective means. We anticipate that the quality of life of majority of the subjects with HLDs could be substantially improved with the intervention methods guided by the molecular diagnostics.

data.projectName: Commodification of Values and its Degenerative Effect on Pakistani Youth in Universities
data.projectDigest: This research corroborates the commodification of social, ethical, cultural and educational values and its degenerative effect on Pakistani youth resulting in drug addiction, pedophilia (Child Abuse) and perverted behaviors. This research elaborates that the misconception of consumer culture has gravely commodified everything including belief, social and educational values in Pakistani culture. Pakistani youth have got entangled in the vicious circle where the core and intrinsic values have no importance for them. Moreover, the proposed project will correspond to “Zindagi App” that Prime Minister Imran Khan launched on 06-01-2020 to sensitize the people of Pakistan regarding the above mentioned issues.  Furthermore, it will arrange   seminars, workshops and awareness drives. It plans to add an awareness chapter about the drug and child abuse in the curriculum of elementary schools. Further, it aims to devise a strategy to get rid of the malaise like drug and child abuse by employing the AGIL model paradigm (societal functions to maintain stable social life) by Talcott Parsons. So, keeping in view the sensitivity of the matter the project will conduct an All Pakistan Intervarsity Drama competition against Drug and Child Abuse in Pakistan. The proposed project has received the full Academic support from Quaid-i-Azam University, Islamabad.

data.projectName: Theoretical Tuning the Properties of Graphene Quantum Dots (GQDs) for the Development of Nano Devices
data.piUniversity: Government Sadiq College Women University, Bahawalpur
data.projectDigest:
A conduction of experimental researches is indispensable for every nation to make progress and compete the world. But, it requires a lot of potential financial resources. Therefore, theoretical researches is gaining attraction over experimental studies even in developed countries including USA, as it provides the facilitations for conducting the experiments by giving predictive conditions as well as  overcome the financial limitations of experimental researches. Similarly, to pursues the theoretical studies is a promising opportunity for a  limited resources country like Pakistan, especially its deprived and remote areas higher education institute such as The Govt. Sadiq College Women University Bahawalpur. 
Graphene quantum dots (GQDs) is a promising material for the development of nanodevices due to having unique physic-chemical properties and these properties can be tuned both experimentally and theoretically. Many theoretical and experimental researches have been reported to tune the GQDs electronic, and optical properties for development of nano-devices such as adsorption, doping, and co-doping. But the theoretical studies of functionalization of the surface of GQDs for optoelectronic properties is not reported yet as well as its optical and electronic properties has also been studied less. 
Therefore, considering the theoretical aspect of tuning the surface of GQDs for development of nano-devices in Pakistan, especially at GSCWU, is ours strong motive to write this project, as this project will not only overcome the funding issues, but also increases the ranking of GSCWU in world. Moreover, this study will also provide the opportunities to extend my PhD. based theoretical research work as well as for the research scholars of GSCWU to train themselves.

data.projectName: Socio-Economic Contribution, Biochemical Analysis and Conservation of Different Medicinal Plants from the Rural Areas of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Pakistan.
data.piUniversity: University of Kotli Azad Jammu and Kashmir
data.projectDigest:
Medicinal plants are main sources of herbal product all over the world. Unfortunately these plants are decreasing day by day at high speed due to rapid economic development and unawareness of community and demand of medicinal plants is increasing day by day in the underdeveloped and developed countries. Due to high cost and unsatisfactory performance of modern medicine demand of herbal medicines is increasing. The peoples of remote areas used medicinal plants mostly to cure different diseases through traditional knowledge. 
In order to document the traditional knowledge of medicinal plants through local inhabitants, medicinal plant collection, identification and their uses, a detailed study is required to explore the hidden wealth of the area. This research proposal is designed on the bases of these ideas. In this study a comprehensive survey will be carried out during April to September 2020-22 to focus on the collection of the medicinal plants and traditional knowledge of local inhabitants of selected rural areas of Azad Jammu and Kashmir. Collected medicinal plants will be identified with the help of flora. During the social survey for collection of data for medicinal plants will give information regarding the uses and selling of these plants for increasing their livelihood. This collected data will also provide the information how we recognize these medicinal plants on folk taxonomy. Important medicinal plants will be used for further study through extraction of organic compounds and to check their biological activities against common bacterial and fungal pathogens. Finally a green house will be established for conservation of selected important medicinal plants in the University of Kotli for further studies.

data.projectName: Multi-use Nanoparticles Based Sensors aimed at the determination of organic substances in complex samples of food, industrial and environmental origin
data.projectDigest: Nanomaterials should be explored from the point of view of analytical chemistry as sensor in order to take advantage of their unique physicochemical characteristics to develop analytical methods that have outstanding performance over more traditional analytical methods for environmentally and health-relevant substances. In this project we intend to explore the properties of different nanomaterials, especially optical but also electrochemical, in order to use them as probes or analytical sensors for health and environment critical substances. The project aims to achieve some of the requirements of Green Analytical Chemistry by reducing the number of reagents used for nanoparticles synthesis analysis, use of systems (synthesis and measurement) in aqueous media, production of less toxic waste by replacing traditional procedures based on chemical derivates of analytes with expensive and toxic reagents. The proposed sensor and protocols will helpful in reducing diseases due to water, food and other environmental compartments and hence will have a good impact on social and economic development of the country.

data.projectName: English language teaching effectiveness evaluation based on Fermatean fuzzy information in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province’s School: A case study of Mansehra and Mardan Schools (Urban Areas)
data.projectDigest: Schools, colleges and universities in our country keep on increasing the number of new students’ admission at par with the growing population. As a result, serious problems appear in the grooming of students. Under such circumstances, the topic of education effectiveness becomes a very hot issue. To deal these issues in schools, colleges and universities, classroom’s instruction still is the main teaching method. Its effectiveness, to a large extent, reflects and determines the education quality of schools, colleges and universities. And, teacher’s classroom instruction is the most important part, which determines the fostering level of talents, affects teachers and students’ life quality. Hence, evaluation of teacher’s classroom instruction effectiveness of schools, colleges and university has a very important influence on propelling teaching reform and improving the education quality. In this project, we tend to investigate the multiple attribute linked to decision making with Fermatean fuzzy information. Motivated by the idea of dependent aggregation, we develop the dependent Fermatean fuzzy Einstein weighted average (FIFEWA) operator,  in which the associated weights only depend on the aggregated Fermatean fuzzy arguments and can relieve the influence of unfair Fermatean fuzzy arguments on the aggregated results by assigning low weights to those “false” and “biased” ones and will apply to develop some approaches for multiple attribute decision making with Fermatean fuzzy numbers. Finally, an illustrative example for evaluating the English language teaching effectiveness will be constructed to verify the developed approach and to demonstrate its practicality and effectiveness.

data.projectName: PRODUCTION OF HIGH QUALITY COMPOST FROM OFFALS WITH IMPROVED SUSTIANABLE ECOSYSTEM SERVICES IN IN PAKISTAN
data.projectDigest: About 714,840 ton of offal, a biological waste with very high N contents, is wasted every year on Eid-ul-Adha either by burying in the pits or through putrification at open municipal solid waste dumps. Recycling N from this biological waste is a big challenge as biological locked organic N cannot be made readily available to plants. This can be done by composting of offals that requires a bulking agent of high C-contents such as wood chips. However, due to very low forest cover in Pakistan provision of large quantity of wood chips on Eid-ul-Adha has not been possible so far. The proposed project is aimed at developing short-rotation wood forestry of conocarpus, paper mulberry, salix and poplar in wastelands for provision of wood chips from its trimmings during autumn. The nuisance of offals will be connected with short-ration wood forestry over marginal lands resulting in multiple sustainable ecosystem services in Pakistan i.e. highly mineralized compost with high NPK, carbon credits through C-sequestration in multiple tiers viz. compost and forestry, converting marginal lands into productive lands and enhancing agricultural productivity while improving air quality. The proposed project will promote agroforestry in Pakistan while creating opportunities for new businesses and employment generation.

data.projectName: Development of high-performance cathode and anode materials for next-generation sodium-ion batteries
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest: The 2019 years Nobel award for chemistry went to the prominent developer of Li-ion batteries (LIBs). LIBs have played a vital role, especially in electronics devices in terms of lightweight, high energy and power density, and long cycle life. However, due to cost and availability limitations, LIBs cannot be used in large scale applications. Thus, in order to fulfil the future requirements of energy storage such as electric vehicles and energy storage system, there is a need to develop alternate energy storage devices. In this regard, sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) are emerging as a competitor with the advantages of abundant and low-cost resources. However, SIBs are still in the development stage and need high performance electrode materials for their realization. Electrode materials, named as anode and cathode, are crucial in the performance of any battery system. The development of cathode is quite challenging due to their high voltage and structure. Therefore, this project will particularly focus on the development of high capacity and voltage cathode materials. Also, we will work on the development of carbon-based anodes due to their low cost and lightweight in the battery.

data.projectName: Anti-Prostate specific antigen aptamer (PSMA) modified nano-carriers: A targeted approach for photodynamic therapy
data.projectDigest: Aptamers are DNA or RNA sequences and naturally present in combination with ribosomes. Targeting the tumor tissues using aptamer modified therapeutic nano-carriers is becoming one of the most accepted approaches. These carriers after targeting the required tissues decrease the generalized toxicities of chemotherapeutic agents. Curcumin is naturally occurring compound getting interest of the cancer treating professionals alone or with other therapeutic agents. Currently research is focused on enhanced tumor activity of curcumin in the presence of red or blue colored light known as photodynamic therapy. This point of view will be kept in mind to prepare different nano-carrier systems loaded with curcumin and surface modification will be carried out using prostate specific antigen aptamer (PSMA).  These carriers will specifically target the prostate specific antigen and thus will decrease the generalized toxicities of curcumin. Moreover, photodynamic therapy will enhance the toxicity of localized nano-carriers.  In this way, this project will be helpful in targeted cancer therapy and will change the face of chemotherapy in future

data.projectName: CFD Analysis of Fluid-Solid Interactions and Flow Control Around Bluff Bodies Using the Lattice Boltzmann Method
data.projectDigest: Interaction of fluids with solid bodies is a subject of intense research due to its relevance with many industrial and engineering applications like aircrafts, bridges, high rise buildings, chimneys, cooling towers, electronic equipment and devices etc. These structures mostly interact with fluids like air or water and experience flow induced forces. These forces can be damaging for such structures under several unfavorable conditions. For example, when the fluid interacts with a solid body, it exerts unsteady forces like drag and lift which may damage the body. Similarly, the interacting fluid forms vortices of different shapes and frequencies. If the shedding frequency of vortices coincides with the natural frequency of solid body the resonance phenomenon arises which damages such bodies. Therefor to avoid such losses the analysis of the interactions of fluid with solid bodies is very important. The focus of present research will be the computational analysis of flow structure mechanism and variation of flow induced forces around multiple bluff bodies under the effect of different influencing parameters like Reynolds numbers, gap distances, inflow conditions and computational domain sizes using the lattice Boltzmann method. In addition, this research will also focus on suppression of flow induced forces and control of vortex generation phenomenon using different flow control strategies.
