It may have happened due to construction of large number of buildings in the city center and street surface material that absorbs and stores high heat radiations during daytime and emit these radiations gradually in the night time. data.projectName: Development of Microbial Fuel Cell for Sustainable Energy Generation and Wastewater Treatment
data.projectDigest: Recently, microbial fuel cell (MFC) technology has emerged as an attractive option for wastewater treatment as well as sustainable energy generation. In a typical set up, a microbial fuel cell has two compartments separated by a proton exchange membrane. The technology utilizes the application of electroactive microbes which consumes the organic load in the wastewater as the substrate and  produce a flow of electrons and protons in the anode compartment.  The protons are moved to cathode compartment across the membrane where they are converted to water by reaction with oxygen. Pulp and paper industry is water and energy intensive sector. The application of MFC on pulp and paper's wastewater may not only produce treated water which may be reused  but also valuable energy in the form of electricity.

data.projectName: Emerging viral threats and Rapid detection of respiratory viruses and toxins.
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest: The rapid identification of prevailing and emerging viruses especially related to respiratory system is crucial in combating outbreaks and epidemics. Matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization time-of-flight mass spectrometry (MALDI-TOF MS) is a rapid and reliable identification method in the diagnostics (bacterial infections), but has not been used in virological diagnostics. Mass spectrometry systems have been investigated for the identification of respiratory viruses. However, methods for the sample preparation are laborious and time-consuming. In this project proposal, a reliable and rapid sample preparation method will be developed allowing identification of cultured and air borne respiratory viruses. Subsequently, we will use the MALDI-TOF MS and liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry (LC–MS/MS) to identify to the subtype level within approximately 3 h with MALDI-TOF MS and 6 h with LC–MS/MS, excluding the culturing time. Furthermore, we will identify the specific strains and level of speared or amplification under pandemic situations. The development of an improved and rapid sample preparation detection system will allow the generic and rapid identification of respiratory viruses by mass spectrometry and will be utilized to further prevent the outbreaks.

data.projectName: Improving Physiological and Psychological Health of Construction Work force in Pakistan- A Longitudinal Case Study of Pakistani Construction Industry
data.piUniversity: NED University of Engineering & Technology, Karachi
data.projectDigest: Qur’an is abundantly clear on the issue of one’s protection from any kind of harm whether it is self-inflicted or externally caused. Qur’an (2:196; 4:29) says, "Let not your own hands throw you into destruction"; and "Do not kill yourselves". The enlightenment has led to the creation of the proposed project. The key strategic dimensions to be explored are: i. Since maintaining good health is obligatory, then why do we have alarming levels of chronic diseases in general society and construction industry in particular? ii. Where does the construction industry stand in terms of its contribution in the disease burden of the country? iii. What interventions can be made with respect to technology, behavior modification aided by religion, moral and ethical concerns to help lessen the disease burden of the country? With the onset of CPEC and its distributary projects, the importance of local construction industry has increased exponentially. Worryingly, Pakistan is ranked 6th amongst 22 high disease burden countries of the world. Medical care costs, productivity losses contribute 37% and 58.97% of the economic burden respectively. This project hopes to strengthen local industry capacity regarding safety, to become curious about improving their safety performance on a sustainable basis.

data.projectName: Diversified Materials and Functionalized Materials: Viable Platforms as Solution to Energy, Health Crisis and Environmental Control
data.projectDigest: Materials of diverse nature with their inherent nature and their modified/functionalized forms have applications in almost every area of research. In this project , they are being focused on energy, climate and health sector for contributing toward national needs and improving economy through exporting functionalized materials and value added products thereof. Thematic(s) targeted here involve scaling up of energy sector for economic and social development. Harnessing sustainable, clean and renewable energy represents green growth. Project incorporates use of materials in their composite forms and dopants with appropriate bandgaps for photocatalytic energy harnessing, e.g. through water splitting. Furthermore, materials will be employed to photo-catalytically reduce CO2 into utility products, solving inevitable disasters leading to global impacts. Functionalized materials will be used for enrichment of targeted disease biomarkers for earlier disease diagnosis and prognosis. Particular focus will be on cancer. World over medical fields will be beneficiary of outcome,. Therefore, such materials with developed methodologies will be exported for revenue generation. Plastics of degradable nature  will be fabricated to replace non-degradable plastics.  Biosensors will be developed for viral diseases like corona virus for point-of-care testing. Conclusively, expertise of PI and collaborators regarding  materials maneuvering  will solve energy, climate and top-most economical issues.

Administrative challenges included the dissemination of powers between federal and provincial authorities. Environmental challenges included the crop management under pre- and post-harvest constraints in terms of diseases and disorders. Moreover, it has been reported that, changing climate will offer several new pathological challenges to the oil palm all over the world (Paterson et.al., 2013). data.projectName: A Smart and Cyber-secured Energy Information Management Solution (SCEIMS) for smart grids in Pakistan
data.projectDigest: One of the main issues of Pakistan is energy shortage. Almost everyone working in office, home, industry and business is a victim of energy shortage. Though Pakistan is relatively underdeveloped country, efforts are made to overcome energy shortage by generating energy from renewable energy sources such as solar, wind and tidal energy. As per Energy Policy of Pakistan (2013, amended in 2018), private entities are allowed to sell energy to CPPA and participate in the energy market. The participation of private entities in the energy market requires the integration of Internet of Things (IoT) devices with conventional power grid. This integration of IoT devices brings its own challenges in terms of commercial implementation. The integration of IoT devices in conventional power grid give rise to smart grid. Among the important challenges in the realization of smart grids is the development of cyber secured framework, distributive energy information management, power mismatch estimation, reliability and improved power quality. Motivated by these research challenges, this grand research project addresses the energy challenges faced by Pakistan and will try to find solutions to those challenges.

data.projectName: Development  and Evaluation of Early Disease Diagnosis Applications for Livestock and Poultry using modern Artificial Intelligence technologies to increase the food security in Pakistan
data.piUniversity: University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Lahore
data.projectDigest: Recent inclusion of the agriculture sector in the long-term plan of China Pakistan Economic Corridor (CPEC) provides Pakistan an opportunity to significantly reduce its huge trade deficit of around $9 billion with China by exporting more value added agriculture products like meat. On the same side, the global halal market is estimated at $1.5 trillion and is forecast to reach $2 trillion by 2023. Pakistan is currently in the list of top 5 countries for livestock production; however, it is unable to break into the top ten for halal meat exporters. By increasing our meat production, we can get a considerable share in halal market from $163 million to $350 million. The productivity of livestock in Pakistan is generally low.  One of the main reasons of the low productivity is the frequent episodes of infectious diseases. The main challenge for veterinarians and animal owners is the establishment of an accurate and timely diagnosis of ill and dying animals to minimize and control diseases. The technological advancements make it possible for farmers to manage the health status of animals with fewer resources. Such technologies include biosensors, wearable technologies, and non-invasive approaches using artificial intelligence tools for disease surveillance.

data.projectName: IoT enabled Intelligent 5G Sustainable Infrastructure for Pakistan Railways
data.piUniversity: Mehran University of Engineering & Technology, Jamshoro
data.projectDigest:
Pakistan Railway is one of the most technologically ignorant units existing in the government sector. Every year, a massive amount of budget is spent on infrastructure and rail track reforms; however, the current communication procedure consists of VHF/UHF technology and does not keep any compatibility to existing cellular setups such as 4G. The customers use the pre-installed WIFI connection in the green-line through telecom company dongle device, but, the internal train infrastructure lacks modern IoT sensory facilities to detect abnormal events.
This proposal presents an IoT-enabled intelligent 5G sustainable infrastructure that will revolutionize Pakistan railway infrastructure by applying a multiple functional tier to establish a robust foundation for analyzing any activity and accidental happenings through timestamped data. This intelligent infrastructure consists of four parts, i.e., 1) IoT-enabled train management, 2) Sustainable SDN-enabled 5G station management, 3) Edge-node-aware station data management, and replica system, and 4) Persistent intelligent analytics ecosystem. 
This proposal addresses the mentioned issues in such a way that if applied, Pakistan Railway would jump to a new hype of modern infrastructure and could lead to neighboring countries’ rail infrastructures. We aim to achieve this goal through involving academic collaborators from foreign world ranking institute, and Pakistan Telecom Authority.

data.projectName: Pakistan Food & Nutrition Program for underprivileged children, Mothers and families to diminish Malnutrition
data.projectDigest: Malnutrition has emerged as one of the world’s leading challenge for under developed countries. The nutritional well being of children would indicate the healthy generation over the next life years. In Pakistan, 40.2 % children are stunted. This project aiming to diminish malnutrition & enhance educational performance in young children as well as provide nutrition education to their mothers and families. Food &Nutrition program  for children will be launched in  10 randomly selected Government Schools in urban and rural areas of district Faisalabad. The significant goal of the Pakistan Food & Nutrition Program for children, mothers and families is to safely plan and serve nutritious meal and snacks to sojourn malnutrition in the marginal communities. There will be Health Screening, nutritional assessment through  Anthropocentric measures (Body Mass Index ,BMI) of children age 6 -12 years and baseline survey with their mothers and families. Sample of 400  extremely malnourished children  from Govt. schools will be selected to plan, cook and train for everyday Healthy manu planning (10 days plan, options of meals & snacks). Meal plan and cooking prep workshops will be given to the school children, their mothers and teachers for two week by the faculty and students of Food & Nutrition of the Department of Home Economics  GC  University Faisalabad to create healthy meal planning, best food choices and cooking methods. Education Department of GC University will assist for project;s pre and post learning assessment of school children  Akhwat foundation, Prime care Hospital and Iowa State University USA will be active collaborator to diminish malnutrition in Pakistan. The project research findings will be share with all stakeholders at local and international level.

Beam-column joint components, especially non-seismically ones, are of primary importance in the seismic performances of RC structures. Vertical forces from a ceiling and stories to foundations are transferred by columns, while joint transmits moments and shears of beams to the columns. Columns and joints are exposed not only to gravity load effects, but to variable moment, shearing, and axial loading due to seismic loads such as earthquake loads and winds. Lateral loads in the columns induce axial stress on one hand and a compressive axial strain on the opposite. Accordingly, columns as well as the joint core would experience variable axial load levels during lateral loading.
Experimental studies have confirmed major axial load effects on inelastic actions of RC joints. On the other hand, few researchers experimentally examined the seismic efficiency of RC joints under different axial loads. data.projectName: Development & evaluation of climate adaptation packages by using decision support system in mix cropping zone of Punjab, Pakistan
data.projectDigest:
The environmental changes are unavoidable and threatening the productivity of agriculture. Pakistan is more vulnerable to climate changes, though having nominal contribution to the factors causing these changes. There are three major cropping systems being followed in Punjab-Pakistan i.e. wheat-rice, wheat-cotton and mixed cropping. A number of districts in Punjab e.g. Faisalabad, Jhang, Chiniot, Sahiwal, Okara Sargodha, etc. are under mixed cropping system. Overall, the small-scale farmers of mixed cropping system are likely to be the most severely impacted by the effect of climate change. In this system cereals, oil seeds, pulses and sugarcane will be projected to decrease in yield. 
With the Governmental initiatives, particularly toward oil seeds and pulses, have encouraged the large number of farmers to shift toward the mixed cropping system. Previously, in Punjab, climate adaptation packages were developed under Agricultural Model Inter-comparison and Improvement Project (AgMIP), funded by DFID of U.K., for wheat-rice and wheat-cotton cropping systems. There is dire need to develop adaptation packages for mix cropping zone also. The will trigger to take steps in research, education, training, decision support and policy making and farming community to tackle the inevitable effects of climate change before onset threats to food security.

data.projectName: Automated Optical Inspection for Qualitative Fruit Grading for Export
data.projectDigest:
Pakistan exports only 5% of its 1,732 thousand tonnes of Mango produces each year to UAE, UK and Japan, ignoring US & European market as later have stringent quality checks. Trade organisations attributes country's poor performance is because of exporters “inability to supply high quality mangoes” consequently, losing in US market. Mangoes must be inspected and graded on the requirements/ regulations of importing countries, requiring visual inspection to determine if they are free from diseases and defects. Current practice of manual inspection fails to produce consistent quality and the solution is to use technology that improves pre-shipment qualitative grading and inspection.
Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) based grading/sorting machines are available internationally focusing on international varieties but due to varietal uniqueness, different texture and size of Pakistani mangoes existing machines are unsuitable. The aim is to develop and fabricate a prototype machine that uses AOI for qualitative grading/sorting against export order specifications. International Islamic University is collaborating with National University of Computer and Emerging Sciences for this project with sectoral support from M/S Acme Scales (Pvt) Ltd, Federal Seed Certification Department of Ministry of Food Security and Research, Government of Pakistan, Mango Grower Association of Pakistan, Horticultural consultants and Industrial experts.

data.projectName: Self reliance in detection and surveillance of food-borne viruses for food security: Step ahead to meet international standards of trade
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest:
Food-borne illness is a problem of global health concern and poses serious economic burdens worldwide. Several food-borne illnesses are caused by viral diseases. Interventions focused on the three major priority routes of viral contamination of foods including human sewage and feces, food handlers and animals for zoonotic viruses could help to perform risk assessment and aid in the development of local diagnostics. Under-reporting due to the lack of surveillance systems is a major challenge for the current global food security agenda. Therefore, bringing expertise and data together from veterinary, food, and clinical microbiology may help unravel these complexities and identify areas amenable to intervention and prevention. 
Achieving food and nutritional security for its population has remained one of the core underlying objectives of all the policies, programs and strategies of Pakistan since its independence. Current proposal focuses on the capacity building of Pakistan for the detection of food borne viruses by developing cheap diagnostic assays. Development of indigenous and cost effective diagnostic tests will greatly enhance the surveillance capabilities of the country. The enhanced surveillance capacities will ensure Pakistan’s trust as reliable import partner in international trade marker.

data.projectName: Analyzing and Minimizing the Impact of Industrial  Pollution on Respiratory and Cardiovascular Health of Local Population
data.piUniversity: Lahore University of Management Sciences (LUMS), Lahore
data.projectDigest:
Over the last few years, there has been an alarming rise in smog and atmospheric pollution in Punjab. The air-quality index remains poor as smog blankets much of Punjab during the winter months. There is however a lack of reliable and up-to-date data on the sources of pollution. This project aims to identify a wide range of medium to small scale industries (including brick kilns, steel re-rolling, plastics etc) using satellite imagery. A two-phased approach will make use of quantitative and qualitative evaluation to measure the efficacy of our proposed models. 

This project builds on novel research conducted by the Computer Vision lab at LUMS that uses satellite imagery to identify population clusters, factories, buildings and houses etc. Smoke emitting factories, brick  kilns, power plants will be identified by automatically classifying each patch of satellite imagery. The project will use advancements in Machine learning and Computer Vision to locate and identify industrial activity(brick kilns, factories etc.) that is harmful for public health and the environment. Such data will be spatially explicit and scalable to allow governments to monitor such harmful industrial activity. We also intend to study the environmental and public health impact of industrial pollution on health and human capital.

data.projectName: Fragmented Internet to Safeguard Digital Pakistan
data.piUniversity: NED University of Engineering & Technology, Karachi
data.projectDigest:
Fragmented internet to safeguard digital Pakistan - This proposal is based on the novel idea of implementing a national level internet that is well equipped with all the relevant services that are staple of twenty first century for the entire internet related task, unaffected by the internet outages internationally.
This grand challenge encompasses the study of the Global Internet Infrastructure, Internet Infrastructure of Pakistan and comprehensive analysis of the full spectrum of services being accessed within and outside Pakistan, feasibility of local services, proposals for local industry towards self-sustainable Internet / Intranet services. This implementation of local services will help in capacity building of the youth of Pakistan as this will expose them to technical problems that were mostly built and handled by international organization.
Fragmented internet in Pakistan will help to achieve better privacy as all the data generated by the users of Pakistan would be stored on localized services, managed by Pakistanis and governed by Pakistani law. This local hosting of data generated by Pakistan would also serve to create services that will ingest this data and help make informed decision and tailored services, catering to Pakistan's citizen.
The outcome of the project would be the resultant of above study proposing a road map for the local infrastructure (physical and logical) along with necessary services which would enable the people of Pakistan to work without hassle in case of Global Internet outage. The benefits would include self-sustainable network, boom in local IT industry leading to enormous growth in SAAS sector in addition employment incentive to existing generation of National Engineers, Scientists and Technicians.

data.projectName: Enhancing food safety and security through control of bovine mastitis
data.piUniversity: Pir Mehr Ali Shah Arid Agriculture, University Rawalpindi
data.projectDigest: As milk and its products are considered to be one of the common sources of zoonotic diseases in human. In developing countries the indiscriminate and irrational use of antibiotics is creating antibiotic resistance in the microorganism. The resistance is particularly important in case of pathogens which have the potential to cause diseases both in animals and humans.  Mastitis is the most important reason for antibiotic use in dairy animals. In Pakistan, antibiotics for veterinary use are available to dairy farmers  freely without any requirement of veterinary prescription.  Moreover, the  antibiotic withdrawal period is not being observed by  the farmers while marketing milk .This antibiotic residues containing milk when used by humans, lead to antibiotic resistance. Through this collaborative project we are interested to document antibiotic usage and  zoonotic pathogens present in the milk and milk products meant for human use. Secondly we are also interested in antibiotic resistance profiling and its molecular basis in  these zoonotic pathogens in particular and other milk pathogens in general.  Moreover on the solution side the  proposal is focused on the development of on farm  diagnostic tool for early detection of most  bovine mastitis and development of inactivated vaccine against most prevalent mastitis causing pathogens.

data.projectName: Modern Genomics and domestication program of the endangered Caralluma tuberculata of Pakistan using CRISPR and NGS based methods
data.projectDigest:
Caralluma tuberculata  is a memeber of the family Asclepiadaceae which is mostly found in the mountainous regions of Pakistan. The plant is used as vegetable in cooked form, consumed as tea or used in the dry powder form or chewed fresh and have important medicinal aspects. Many communities have used this plant as folk medicine for years to cure various ailments such as stomach problems, diabetes, muscle pain and skin treatment and as appetizer. The plant has also been tested for anti-cancer, anti-diabetics, ant-fungal and anti-microbial activities and have been found effective. It is also a rich source of mineral and fiber, thus, can be used against cholesterol accumulation.
 The crop, however, is still wild and is at the verge of extinction specifically in Pakistan generally in the other countries. We, in the current project, aim to collect germplasm from different parts of Pakistan and Egypt and to test their growth potential under different climatic conditions. we also aim to sequence the whole genome and transcriptomic analysis of Caralluma tuberculata to better understand its medicinal value and adaptation behaviour.  Genome sequence will also allow other scientist to expedite the research in right direction. Finally, the promising lines will be disseminated among the farmers to fulfill the objectives of the study

Rehabilitation of 2-stroke petrol-driven rickshaws: Converting into environment friendly solar-electric hybrid vehicle
data.projectDigest: Around 60,000 two-stroke rickshaws (tricycles) run on roads of the province of Sindh illegally even they are officially banned by the Government since 2012 because they are major contributor to environmental pollution. Although the ban was rightly imposed to reduce noise and air pollution, however, this ban created another adversity by throwing thousands of poor rickshaws drivers out of business and pushing their families into poverty. Also, CNG rickshaws which were supposed to replace two-stroke rickshaws, are not only costlier but also they are poor in quality. Owners of the old two-stroke rickshaw consider their rickshaws more durable and cheaper as compared to CNG rickshaws. One of the solutions to this problem is to convert two-stroke rickshaws into electric rickshaws. Not only these converted rickshaws will be environmental friendly, less noisy, use no fossil fuel, easy to maintain and are easy to operate, but also they will have greater socio-economic impact as thousands of family will have mean to survive and this will help in eliminating poverty.

data.projectName: Adding green value to CPEC through enterprenueship using local resource concentration and smart entrepreneurship
data.projectDigest: Pakistan is facing two critical challenges related to its small and medium enterprise development in the context of CPEC. First, individual level challenges related to the recognition, evaluation and exploitation of entrepreneurial opportunities. Second, Pakistan has a relatively poor position of in innovation, technology, infrastructure and market function efficiencies. This may hinder cross border shifting of market functions like production sharing and vertical integration along value chain from China to Pakistan. This research, based on the concept of green value added and crowding along local resource concentration, looks forward towards boosting sustainable entrepreneurship to address the aforementioned key challenges. Taking agriculture and mineral extraction sectors as primary targets, the research aims to identify and explore key personal, social, economic and institutional factors that may encourage the ‘pursuit of entrepreneurial opportunities’. In addition, this research also aims to develop a smart phone app for creating a shared database of entrepreneurs and businesses in the two sectors to facilitate in crowding along the local resources for green value addition and smart specialization. Finally, the project, based on empirical inquiry aims to identify key contextual success factors for women entrepreneurs so that to develop  training and coordinating platform for their active participation. The platform may also ensure knowledge sharing and coordination for adequate entrepreneurial capital to facilitate them in the effective pursuit of CPEC based opportunities in the target sectors.

data.projectName: Transfer of appropriate technology in relation to climate variability in Rice-wheat and Cotton-wheat cropping systems of Punjab Pakistan using crop simulation model and remote sensing
data.projectDigest: Technical developments in agricultural informatics and precision agriculture associated social developments are providing environment where scientists from developed and developing countries can collaborate to address real problems of food security and development. In  this  context,  data  science  includes  (big)  data  management  and  manipulation  techniques;  data integration from e.g. satellites, unmanned aerial vehicles (drones), sensors, and surveys; statistical and mechanistic modeling techniques; and basic software development techniques (analytical scripts, web- based interfaces to data  and analytical results).  The agronomy curriculum in many countries has not been adjusted to this new reality. The project will focus on monitoring and management of Rice-wheat and Cotton-wheat cropping system. Scientists predict significant global warming in the coming decades arising from increasing atmospheric CO2 and other trace gases. Effect of weather variability on yield of such cropping systems can be assessed by various models because crop simulation models are run through weather data downscaled from general circulation models (GCMs). Differences in temporal and spatial scales of any crop and various climate models may introduce some uncertainties into assessments of effects of climate variability. Working with national and international collaborator to improve management practices by using crop modeling with the help of remote sensing

data.projectName: Study and Fabrication of  Low Cost Denim Dyeing Effluent Treatment and Dye Recovery Systems for Zero Discharge
data.projectDigest: This project is concerned with development of denim textile wastewater treatment and dye recovery techniques to comply with Zero Discharge of Hazardous Chemicals and National Environment Quality Standards for textile wastewater. Denim textile industry is the major exporter, and consumer of water/chemicals in wet processing, however, it discharges untreated effluent. Denim industry uses Indigo, a vat dye insoluble in water, made water soluble through toxic sulfite/sulfate producing sodium hydrosulfides. This project combines the effluent treatment techniques of electrocoagulation and advanced oxidation to treat wastewater and convert it into non-toxic water and sludge. The sludge contains the indigo dye which will be adsorbed using three techniques of activated carbon, clay minerals and ionic liquids in order to develop a comprehensive technology for denim textile Zero Discharge controls. Three Universities from Karachi and Faisalabad are coordinating in this project to synergize expertise and bring to fore an indigenously developed denim dyeing effluent treatment system for saving country foreign exchange on heavy imports of modern machines, producing low- cost and efficient technology.

data.projectName: Blockchain Technology Interventions in Health, Agriculture, and Governance
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest:
Blockchain and smart contracts technology has emerged in recent years as a revolutionary new paradigm enabling unprecedented new dimensions of trust, security, and efficiency. We propose three initiatives to harness the revolutionary potential of this technology for significant societal and national impact. We specifically propose to build blockchain-based solutions to enable users to track and identify fake drugs, enhance our agricultural supply chains, and secure election processes and systems. Our work stands to improve health outcomes, add value to Pakistan’s agricultural produce and manage food security issues, and mitigate key problems and restore citizen confidence in democratic electoral processes. Furthermore, our work will contribute to a culture of technological and research excellence, accelerate uptake of cutting edge technologies in the national interest, and improve technical self-sufficiency.

Our team consists of prominent researchers from various schools of NUST, LUMS, and Air University, along with foreign collaborators from UK and German universities. Our local partners include leading stakeholders including the National Agricultural Research Council, Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences, and the Islamabad High Court Bar Association. Our industrial partners include Integry Pvt. Ltd and Remington Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. who will directly assist with pilots, commercialization, and scaling up operations.

data.projectName: Development of Microwave System for Early Stage  Detection of  Breast Cancer Tumor
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest:
Breast cancer has become very common in women worldwide and the mortality rate due to such disease is increasing day by day throughout the world.  A varietyof the equipment like  X ray mammography  and MRI have been developed to detect the cancer tumor but not at its  early stage.  of cancer disease.  The best defence against breast cancer is its early stage detection and only then the  proper treatment is possible. 
Mammography which is very common  for breast cancer tumor detection,  has following major  problems;    
                 1.   Hazards of exposure to ionization radiation.
                 2.   When the cancer tumor is detected by this machine, generally the treatment 
                         becomes very difficult.  
                 3.    Patient is not very comfortable in machine.
                  4.   Test is very expensive.

The proposed developed system  " Microwave System for Early Stage  Detection of  Breast Cancer Tumor"   will have the following features.
                    1.    No hazards of exposure to ionization radiation.
                    2.     Early breast cancer tumor detection which is very significant for the longest 
                             survival and the greatest patient cmfort.

data.projectName: Development of recombinant probiotic vaccine against local NDV pathotypes; potential bio control and vaccination trials in chickens.
data.projectDigest: Virulent strains of NDV are widely distributed and leads to 100% fatalities in susceptible flocks posing heavy economic losses and biosafety threat to the poultry industry of the world particularly South Asian countries. Due to this it is amongst the list of notifiable disease on World Organization for Animal Health (OIE).  Prevention of Newcastle disease remains challenging due presence of viral reservoirs in wild birds and the ability of virus to mutate.  The vaccines that are used in Pakistan such B1 and LaSOta are either killed or attenuated strains of NDV which are phylogenetically similar to velogenic NDV (vNDV) isolated in USA in 1940s. However the emergent vNDV strains that are phlogentically distant from the vaccinal strains which are responsible for the most recent out breaks of ND worldwide. The proposed recombinant probiotic cell vaccine will effectively cover wide range of NDV strains and in comparison to other recombinant vaccines the probiotic cell vaccine will be significantly cost effective which may easily administered through drinking water. Our strategy will permit to evaluate the potential of recombinant probiotic cell vaccine versus commercially available vaccine to provide protection and to bring more effective and economically viable vaccine against different circulating vNDV strains in Pakistan.

data.projectName: Create online portal, and knowledge base to achieve optimum export potential using artificial intelligence and trade analytics.
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest:
The recovery of decreasing competitiveness of Pakistani exports in the international market has become a national challenge. Development of advanced marketing strategies employing AI models to identify potential export markets is emphasized to improve trade. Machine learning models depend on big data to train the AI algorithm. Pakistan lacks the knowledgebase, which could be used for in-depth trade analytics, prediction of trade patterns and collaborative filtering at company level. Finally, the exporter requires an online portal, which could share analytical insights and assist in market penetration.

The objective of this research is to:

a.	Develop a big-data repository by structuring data acquired though online sources, government and non-government databases, international datasets and news feeds, which would act as a knowledgebase for government organizations, exporters and academia.
b.	Develop advanced machine learning models using created knowledgebase to predict trade flows, identify trade opportunities and deliver insights to government bodies to assist in development of trade policies.
c.	Identify export competitiveness at firm level through SWOT and newsfeed data from the knowledgebase using AI models, and connect exporters to potential buyers.
d.	Design and Development of an online portal, to connect with knowledgebase for the assistance of the exporters.

data.projectName: Smart Aquaponics: A Technological Leap to address National Food Insecurity
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest: Aquaponics integrates aquaculture (i.e. fish farming) and hydroponics (i.e. growing plants in a soilless medium). The objective is to provide an alternative to the traditional food production on industrial as well as private sectors. The proposed system is particularly useful for urban areas with low land and overpopulation. The key research challenges include the feasibility study of aquaponics for Pakistani climate, suitability of marine species, analysis of single/multi-loop systems, smart sensor based IoT network, development of machine/deep learning algorithms for modelling predictive neural networks for aquaponics and efficient/green power system. An industrial scale commercial aquaponics farm will be developed which will be monitored via smart sensors based IoT network and machine learning techniques will be used to optimize the farm food production. The final product will include cheaper organic food and fish. This system will give us first mover advantage in the market, since this technique is new (i.e. from commercial point of view in Pakistan) and better than available/traditional farming techniques in the local market. The market demand of this system is naturally going to increase in a country like Pakistan where water shortage is a major issue in addition to low/expensive agriculture land and overpopulation. The proposed system will also result in a larger crop yield per meter square and payback time will be decreased.

data.projectName: Industry Revolution 4.0: Assessing the Readiness of Pakistani SMEs Towards Sustainable Competitiveness
data.projectDigest:
The term Fourth Industrial Revolution was introduced by Klaus Schwb in 2015 that state this is the era where artificial intelligence, genome editing, augmented reality, robotics, and 3-D printing, are rapidly changing the way humans create, exchange, and distribute value. It is rapidly effecting the way we do business, interact and live.  In the context of Pakistan, IR4.0 has both opportunities and threats. Going slow is not an option for Pakistan especially when it is going such financial crisis. Therefore, it is utmost important to conduct a rigorous in-depth research to find our SMS's readiness this digital transformation, what would motivate SMEs to go on this challenging journey and what are the obstacles.

SME’s are playing pivotal role in the development of Pakistan’s economy as these constitute nearly 90% of all the enterprises in Pakistan; employ 80% of the non-agricultural labor force; and their share in the annual GDP is 40%, approximately. In addition, the current government is stressing a lot on developing and strengthening SME’s making this research even more critical.

data.projectName: Harnessing of waste materials to sustainable bio-refinery products
data.projectDigest: This project addresses the thematic areas of Sustainable Energy and Climate Change and Environment. Waning energy and solid waste management are burning issues in Pakistan. There is a need to find alternative fuel sources to avoid the rapid diminishing of natural resources. The disposal and handling of solid waste, especially, plastic bottles and waste tires which are non-degradable and accumulate in the environment have become a major environmental concern. Burning of agricultural waste produces smog which causes severe pollution of air, land, and water on local as well as regional and global levels. These solid waste materials have abundant intrinsic energy in form of boding energy which could be converted into valuable products by pyrolysis process and can solve both issues (environment and energy). This project aims to produce efficient catalysts with good selectively towards valuable and sustainable bio-refinery products and controlled catalytic pyrolysis of the solid waste. The solid waste including plastic, waste tire, municipal solid wastes, and agricultural waste will be used as raw material in order to control environmental pollution and energy issues. Solid waste would first processed through torrefaction process to remove moisture and upgrade the properties followed by catalytic pyrolysis to get the bio-refinery products.

data.projectName: Metagenomics to understand environmental and human dynamics of Neglected tropical disease in Southern Pakistan
data.projectDigest: Neglected tropical disease (NTDs) are infections caused by bacteria, viruses and parasites and are strongly associated with poverty in tropical and subtropical countries. People living in low-income and middle-income countries fell victim to NTDs due to limited access to health services. One in five people worldwide are at risk of NTDs, and approximately 37 million people living in Pakistan are at risk of contracting the disease. Eight out of 17 WHO recognized NTDs are endemic in Pakistan. The most commonly reported from Pakistan are gastrointestinal parasites, mycetoma, leshmaniasis, malaria, dengue and chikungunya. The communities effected by NTDs face disability, financial and psychological pressures and death and often considered as litmus tests of progress in poverty alleviation. To address the menace of NTDs traditional approaches such as individual disease control programs, rapid case identification, mass drug administration or vector control were found less effective due to coverage. We suggest to address this issue by integration of existing disease-specific methods and indicators, and utilize new genomics based approaches to address the NTDs transmission, susceptible age groups and gender and micro geographic locations in Pakistan. In summary, Pakistan is ideal site for building the expertise and implementation of genomic technology to improve population health. This study will build a foundation to develop program to complement other public health and policy measures.

data.projectName: Indigenous biodiesel production, and its utilization for energy and power sectors aimed at better economic opportunities  and improved life cycle impact
data.projectDigest: Heavy reliance on imported fuels to meet the energy requirements coupled with inefficient energy conversion apparatus is one the most serious issue Pakistan is facing. Incompatibility from productivity perspective and emissions of unregulated exhaust into the atmosphere are two of the serious consequences. Unless addressed immediately, this situation has potential to create permanent economic paralysis and extremely degraded environment.   Diesel engines are widely employed in agriculture and power production industry. Being an agriculture country, primarily, Pakistan can exploit this resource, in the form of land, to progress towards indigenization in field of energy production and conversion.  Indigenous production of biodiesel and its use in unmodified or slightly modified diesel engines is route towards economic independence and prosperity as well as sustainable environment. During this research, biodiesel shall be produced from the waste cooking oil and from the edible/non-edible oils. Thermo-physical characteristics of the biodiesel shall be investigated to make it comparable to diesel. Water in diesel emulsions shall also be investigated in addition to mixing of nano-particles in diesel/biodiesel fuel for improved combustion and emissions characteristics.  New vistas for supply chain management, indigenous fuel production and engine development shall be opened resulting huge economic and employment opportunities.

data.projectName: Green technology for the robust water splitting using nonmetal induced Co3O4 nanowires
data.piUniversity: Mehran University of Engineering & Technology, Jamshoro
data.projectDigest: The improvement in surface area and conductivity of cobalt oxide nanowires is planned to carry out using cost effective and facile methodology. The enhancement in conductivity and tuning of surface area can be made by doping nonmetal into Co3O4 nanowires using hydrothermal/low temperature aqueous chemical growth method. The selection of nonmetals such as boron, sulfur, phosphorous, carbon, and halides is based on their environment friendly and high Earth abundant nature. The nonmetals can create oxygen vacancies in the cobalt oxide which further lead to the defects in the nanowires of cobalt oxide and this oxygen vacancy will play a vital role in the water catalysis. The doped cobalt oxide nanowires will be characterized by SEM, EDS, XRD, FTIR, HRTEM and XPS in terms of morphology, composition, and crystal structure. The water splitting of these nonmetals doped cobalt oxide nanowires will be investigated in alkaline and acidic media. The amount of catalyst, reproducibility, stability and durability will be optimized. The mechanism of nonmetal in catalysis will design in order to develop efficient and stable nonprecious catalysis for water electrolysis. Further Faradic efficiency in terms of gas production such as O2/H2 will be monitored by coupling the proposed catalysts with gas chromatography and finally commercial water splitting electrolyzers will be proposed.

data.projectName: The Project for Promotion of Sustainable 3R (reduce, reuse, and recycle) activities in Quetta
data.projectDigest:
Quetta, the largest metropolitan city in Balochistan, faces major environmental challenges associated with the ever-increasing rate of waste generation and an inadequate municipal solid waste management (MSWM) system. It is, therefore, imperative to address the MSWM issues with modern, comprehensive and interdisciplinary approaches.  
The major objective of this project is to revisit and develop environmental, private sector, financial, institutional, technical, legal, and public involvement frameworks to support Government of Balochistan to improve MSWM system. The project will be carried out in three phases: baseline surveys, interventions, and impact evaluation. The objective of study one (year 1) is to explore prevalent deficiencies and challenges in the existing MSWM System in Quetta including quantification of all types of waste. The main objective of study 2 (year 2) is to identify, design, and implement pilot interventions (e.g., technical, legal, institutional, behavioral etc.) that can help in addressing the MSWM crisis in Quetta. We intend to pilot interventions for each stage of the solid waste chain including storage, collection (primary and secondary), transportation, treatment and disposal. Finally, an impact evaluation of the overall project will be carried out to assess the impacts of pilot interventions (end of year 3).

data.projectName: Development of high energy density next-generation battery technologies
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest: Rechargeable batteries are the universal solution to rectify the world energy crises and to overcome climate change and greenhouse gases emission. Lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) are a key technology to meet future requirements for electric vehicles (EVs), robots, drone, etc. Current LIBs face the challenges of high production cost, low mileage and long charging time for EVs. The USA Department of Energy has set a goal to reduce the cost to less than $100/kWh, increase the range to 300 miles, and decrease the charging time to 15 minutes for suitable EVs. Recently, Pakistan has approved EVs policy and aimed to produce 30% EVs by 2030 which is appreciated by several environmentalists to reduce the pollution.  However, in order to launch EVs, indigenous production of LIBs is necessary to accommodate future needs as the import of expensive LIBs will cause a huge burden on the country’s economy. The aim of this project is to produce high performance LIBs and engage local industry at the commercial level. The participating researchers are experienced in developing high energy density electrodes for next-generation battery technologies.

data.projectName: Experimental Investigation and CFD simulation of thermal conductivity and viscosity of Nanofluids for heat transfer applications
data.piUniversity: NED University of Engineering & Technology, Karachi
data.projectDigest:
Heat dissipation is a key requirement from many devices. The amount of heat flux that needs to be dissipated is increasing many folds with the passage of time. The miniaturization of devices has also increased the heat transfer requirement from the miniaturized devices. The usual techniques for heat dissipation are unable to meet this massive challenge. The major issue is the poor thermal conductivity of the existing heat transfer fluids. The thermal conductivities of these fluids are several times lesser than the metals. Increasing thermal conductivity by adding metal particles of micro to millimeters size particles were not successful due to their abrasive action and clogging problems. In addition there were large pressure drop caused by these particles. To overcome these problems nanometer size particles were added to the heat transfer fluids. The suspension of the nanosize particles resulted in higher thermal conductivity without the problems of clogging and pressure drops. Many researchers have shown that adding nanosize particles in the heat transfer fluid can enhance the heat transfer coefficient and viscosity of the base fluid. The nanosize particles suspended uniformly in the regular heat transfer fluids has attracted lot of research due to the phenomenal increase in thermal conductivity property. The current work is to investigate the thermal conductivity and viscosity of base fluids such as mineral oil or polyolester  oil. This could benefit in many heat exchanger devices in refrigeration and automobile industry. 
The main objectives of this research will be :
1)	Determine thermal conductivity of Polyol Easter Oil (POE)/mineral oil containing a different concentration of Al2O3, TiO2, and SiO2 nanoparticles experimentally with the help of KD2 Pro instrument.
2

data.projectName: Indoor thermal comfort, air quality and energy management of selected hospitals in Islamabad Capital Territory
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest: Thermal environment is linked with human comfort, health and productivity. Precise control of temperature and humidity is vital in sub-tropical hospitals for better health and comfort of hospital occupants, which indirectly influence diseases, infections, allergies, fungus, and mould growth. Hospital poses a challenge to building service engineers to satisfy varied thermal comfort requirements of different occupants. Hospital in the commercial sector consumes enormous amount of energy worldwide due to around-the-clock operation. Pakistan has been facing a severe energy crisis for last decade and energy shortage has adversely affected all sectors of economy. There is a need for adoption of energy-efficient considerations in all and commercial sector specifically to promote energy-efficient HVAC and lighting practices in buildings. Unfortunately, thermal comfort and indoor air quality in sub-tropical hospitals has not been studied much and not a single study in Pakistan has been conducted so far. Therefore, this study will be a pioneer in Pakistan to investigate indoor environment conditions at in-and outpatient wards and thermal comfort requirements of ward occupants (patients, visitors, and nurses) in hospitals of Islamabad Capital Territory. Energy measurements of HVAC system in hospital wards will also be conducted and analyzed for exploring energy savings potential.

data.projectName: Detail study of Photo-oxidative degradation of polyolefin and its potential applications in  agriculture, food and packaging industries
data.projectDigest:
In this project novel thermoplastic nano-composites will be prepared. These composites can be used primarily in packaging, food and agriculture sector. In this study thermoplastic polymers will be reinforced by nano-materials in the form of nano-particles or organically modified clay for enhance physical properties. The photo-oxidative degradation will be carried out through pro-oxidant/photosencitizer. These

data.projectName: Economic Empowerment of Rural Communities: Capitalizing on the potential of High-Value food production in Peshawar Division
data.projectDigest: The present research is designed to collect data about the existing production of High-Value food products in rural areas of Peshawar Division. Two kind of production of High-Value food is going on, one is on organized level through farms and the other is on household level where villagers keep cattle and devote a portion of their land for High-Value food production. The present research will consider both the organized and on household level. After knowing the existing production, the capacity of increasing the production of High-Value food will be calculated and also the demand in the urban areas for absorbing the production will be measured. The study will produce different research papers on economical, social and environmental hurdles in increasing the production of High-Value food in Peshawar Valley. In the final stages the researchers in collaboration with the government institutions, Agriculture sector and Calgary University Canada will produce papers for the remedy of economic, social and environmental hurdles which can culminate into a thorough policy for High-Value food production in Peshawar valley and also then can serve as a case study for the policy on the national level.

data.projectName: Developing  Integrated Precision Farming Model through GeoSpatial Techniques
data.projectDigest:
Agriculture is becoming increasingly knowledge intensive. Knowledge derived from combining data from various sources can be used to derive valuable actionable insights. At the farm-level, the farmers of today have to deal with a myriad of data to be able to make livelihood-based decisions on a regular basis. Unfortunately, as of today, Pakistan is deprived of such big data opportunity to facilitate data driven decision-making. 
The main objective of the proposed research project is to demonstrate socio-economic impact of integrated modern practices in the agriculture sector of Pakistan. To achieve this goal, high spatio-temporal satellite imagery, UAS based aerial imagery, on-ground sensors and farmer practices/local perception alongwith survey data will be acquired to generate various crops field insights. Furthermore, Artifical Intilegence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML)/Deep Learning (DL) based prediction models will be developed. Based on data driven prescription generation, targeted autonomous application of pesticides and fertilizer will be performed to calculate impact of using aerial solutions in agriculture. This will not only generate models of various crops in well distributed regions of the country but will also reveal the redeemable inputs (pesticides, fertilizer, water, labor) per acre. After completion of this research project, the potential of developed solution will be disseminated in local languages. In addition, the challenges to be faced and recommendation for public and private sectors will be published and shared through various medias of communication.

data.projectName: Remote Imaging Station with Artificial Intelligence (AI) enabled diagnostic measures (RISE with AI)
data.piUniversity: DOW University of Health Sciences, Karachi
data.projectDigest: RISE with AI project aims to provide credible radiological reporting service center with the assistance of artificial intelligence, intelligent network and advance imaging technology specifically to patients living in remote and rural areas of province Sindh. To facilitate patients and improve governance, RISE with AI team will provide means for central management of imaging health records and work on development of customize imaging software with innovative solutions by working with various imaging modalities for e.g. X-Rays, CT-Scans, Ultrasound, MRI and EEG’s.  The digital health record of patient when integrated with imaging software is then layered up neatly into a web based portal which enables patients to access their reports from their own mobiles, laptops and computers. Integration of location based services enhances the facility and governance by routing trauma patients to nearest possible basic health unit or hospital depending on reliable imaging diagnostic and reporting. The mentioned features will save cost as centralized and digital management eliminate the need of repeating X-Ray, CT-Scan or other imaging investigations with in specified time frame. The imaging history of patient can also be accessed from imaging station on request. Such AI enabled solution will improve ground efficiency; reduce queues outside major government hospitals, discourage fake or fraud reporting, improve quality of health care by providing timely information about trauma diagnostic and treatment at patient’s doorstep.

data.projectName: Development of Honeybee Farming in Punjab: a step towards economic development of rural community
data.piUniversity: University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Lahore
data.projectDigest:
Pakistan is an agricultural country, where commonly poor people, predominantly from rural areas, depend on smallholder livestock farming and subsistence agriculture for their income. Being the backbone of agriculture, the livestock sector contributes much (60.54%) in the economic growth of the country. Peoples of rural areas of Pakistan mostly depend on livestock for their daily need of food, milk and cash income. However, the performance of agriculture has not always impressive; figures supporting the said statement are low growth rate i.e. 0.85% recorded as compared to the target of 3.8% from last few years (Economic Survey 2018–19). This poor performance of agriculture badly affect livelihood of the rural community of such a country where 24.3 % of the population of the country lives below the poverty line (The World Bank 2018). There is a dire need to explore additional sources of income as livelihood of these rural peoples and ultimately economic development of the country. Apiculture/honeybee keeping is the best option as an alternative income source of the rural community and economic development of the country. Apiculture has been implemented in poverty alleviation as an additional/alternative source of income in many mountain areas of Pakistan and many other countries. Apiculture provides financial, social and nutritional benefits to poor peoples without demanding heavy investment and ownership of land (Wolff et al., 2015; Yap and Devlin, 2015; Ahmad et al., 2017).
There is a dire need to produce skilled persons in rural areas of Pakistan. This target can be achieved via vocational training of local communities by universities/research institutes of those areas. For this purpose, now it has become inevitable to establish honeybee research facilities in new Inst

data.projectName: “Assessment of Climate Change and its Effects on Health of the Nomads of Cholistan, Punjab-Pakistan”
data.projectDigest: Climate change is one of the major global issue and threat to all humanity. The impacts of ongoing climatic variations   are being experienced by both developed and less developed regions of the world. In order to take urgent action to combat its multifarious impacts one of the important parameter to be followed is sustainable goals declared by United Nations in 2015. In terms of climate vulnerability and its likely effects, Pakistan is at higher risk and facing hostile impacts of changing climatic conditions over the last two decades because of its low adaptive capacity. Effects of climate change are diversified and damaging ranging from the structural to the health of population. This proposed research is from the theme of “Climate Change and Environment” as demarked by Grand Challenge Fund. Its basic objective is to analyze the combine effects of climate change, environment and socio economic conditions on the health of marginal and indigenous population of Cholistan desert of Southern Punjab. Nomads of Cholistan are already striving to survive in the harsh climate and unhealthy environment of desert. Wide range of highly rationale indicators [1-7] is chosen for this project first to analyze the possible consequences of climate change on the health of nomads and secondly to formulate the sustainable strategic adaption and mitigation plan to improve the quality of health of this marginal population. A team of national and international experts will be selected to execute this project.

data.projectName: Sustainability and Growth of Micro-Enterprises: Role of Technology, Business Training and Social Norms
data.projectDigest:
This project proposes to provide support to small entrepreneurs for the growth and expansion of micro-enterprises. While there is a lot of focus on providing access to finance them for which the microfinance institutions have mushroomed in Pakistan, there is paucity of research on how these small businesses are to be expanded.

Majority of these small entrepreneurs belong to poor households with low human capital. They lack the knowldge of business practices and use of technology. Moreover, a large proportion of these entrepreneurs are women who in addition to socio-economic constraints face limitations due to restrictive patriarchal social norms. 

This project will launch programs to support the microenterprises by following three methods:
 1)entrepreneurship knowledge support – encompasses trainings regarding business practices – how to manage the business finances, brand their product, and advertise it. 2) adoption of social media - training them how to use Facebook and Instagram to setup online business and expand the business outreach. 3)to bring behavioral change the participants and their families will be shown inspirational videos of successful female entrepreneurs. Literature shoes this may increase their awareness and acceptance of female entrepreneur’s work in their social network.
Expansion of micro-enterprises will help in reducing poverty in the long run.

data.projectName: Bridging digital divide using user-centric cloud services on SDN-enabled 5G Networks
data.projectDigest: This proposal aims to build an Software Defined Network (SDN)  framework conditioned for the local environment by presenting a 3-tier solution divided among the three contributors of the project. (i) With the emergence of 5G, the future network will enable far-away wireless devices/sensors to instantly provide updates about their surrounding that will increase the requirement of real-time processing. Considering multimedia traffic, big data management, and mobile usage are big source of revenue generation, novel SDN based wireless routers will be incorporated to handle topological dynamicity along with network traffic. (ii)To ensure multi objective Service Level Agreements (SLA) requirements, the traffic processing load on SDN devices must be managed depending on the traffic flow characteristics. This demands integration of smart job scheduling and load balancing techniques using edge devices in SDN-enabled 5G networks for routing and implementing buffer management schemes based upon flow attributes.  The close proximity of the edge nodes to the end users will help retrieving accurate information about each flow. The component will help to alleviate the control layer issues such as, decision regarding the optimal number of controllers, their workload and placement. (iii) The storage and computation requirements of Bigdata systems demand the correct mapping of Cloud jobs to the compute resources. This proposal envisions machine learning based heuristics to develop technique that is both resource and application aware.

data.projectName: Prototyping of a Precision agriculture monitoring system using Remote Sensing via Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
data.piUniversity: Ghulam Ishaq Khan Institute of Engineering Sciences & Technology, Topi
data.projectDigest:
The increase in population with a continuously decreasing area available for agriculture asks for new ideas and techniques for enhancing agriculture productivity and making it sustainable.  The sector of agriculture holds a share of about 20 percent in our GDP whilst supporting about 40 percent of the total labor force. Whilst many countries have improved their yield per hectare by adopting new methods and technologies, Pakistan stands at a dismal below 100 rank in terms of yield per hectare because of non-adoption of novel methods in agriculture 
In this project we aim to apply some of the recent ideas and technologies which can help to improve crop yield, production efficiency and sustainability. In particular, by making use of drone technology and remote sensing technology, we plan to develop a prototype for a precision agriculture monitoring system. Precision agriculture concept is based on the premise that regular monitoring of soil, water, environment conditions and crop health can lead to timely, tailored, areas-specific and problem-specific interventions from the farmer which not only leads to yield enhancement but also results in efficient usage of resources and can reduce the scale of damage from a crop disease outbreak because of timely intervention.

data.projectName: Development and Poverty Detection using Satellite Imagery
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest: The elimination of poverty worldwide is the first of 17 United Nations Sustainable Development Goals for the year 2030. This project aims to track progress towards this goal by employing machine learning techniques on satellite imagery to map poverty impoverished and developed areas in Pakistan, and proving this approach to be a feasible alternative. The final project output will be heat maps indicating poverty and development levels over the years in Pakistan. These heat maps can be overlaid on digital maps for easy visualization. Techniques from computer vision and machine learning will be employed to extract indicators such as geographical and man-made structural features from high-resolution satellite imagery. For a developing country like Pakistan, this project is useful because the approach uses publicly available data and is a scalable and inexpensive alternative to traditional surveys. The results from the project will aid policy makers and NGOs to distribute their funds to areas that are most deserving, and enact and assess policies more effectively.

data.projectName: Conservation Agriculture: a way forward to enhance crop productivity, soil health, and food security in multiple cropping systems of Pakistan
data.projectDigest: The productivity of multiple cropping systems is declining with every passing day because of worn out natural resources. It is due to intensive cropping and soils of multiple cropping systems are losing their health, productivity, sustainability at great speed owing to exhaustive crop sequences. Generally, the farmers of rice-wheat cropping system perform the conventional tillage and burn the rice crop residues. Burning of rice stubbles and remnants leads to great loss of plant essential nutrients. Moreover, this faulty practice hampering the soil microbial activities, rigorously cutting down the organic matter contents in soil along with severe environmental pollution.  In cotton-wheat system the sowing of wheat is delayed for greed of more cotton picking. Moreover, the improper management of wheat residues for early sowing of cotton degrading the soil. Whereas, in mixed-wheat cropping system all combinations of exhaustive crop sequences have severely degraded the soil health. In recent decades, the developing communities including politicians, policy makers, institutional leaders as well as academics, scientists and extension workers have been highlighting the need for the development of low inputs high yielding conservation agriculture. Conservation agriculture (CA) provides opportunities to farmers to reduce the cost of production, save water and nutrients, increase yields, increase crop diversification, improve efficient use of resources, and benefit the environment.

data.projectName: Smart Video Description in multiple domains
data.projectDigest: The Islamic republic of Pakistan is the world's sixth most populous country. In Asia, Pakistan has a lot of geographical and natural blessings i.e., strategic location, sea, deserts, mountains, rivers and weather seasons. Despite all these blessings, still Pakistan is a developing nation because it is engulfed with a number of problems including terrorism. From technological perspective, different tested technologies can provide protection against terrorism, patient health details, sports commentary by analyzing video sequences. The development of these systems is useful especially for surveillance data over the last couple of years . In Lahore, there are around 8000 cameras installed across the city which are producing huge amount of surveillance video data. People are loaded with abundant information and at the same time they have difficulty learning what they need in a short period of time. This project addresses these problems by using image processing methods for automatic understanding of video streams. These video streams can be different for all scenarios i.e., a CCTV video for activity surveillance, a patient’s video in hospital or live coverage of any sport. In addition, proposed research work opens new horizons for statistical explanation of the video sequences. These statistics will be helpful in taking precautionary measures for eradicating terrorism, carelessness in patient health monitoring and complex sports analysis activities.

data.projectName: Condition Health Monitoring assisted with AI and IOT
data.piUniversity: Ghulam Ishaq Khan Institute of Engineering Sciences & Technology, Topi
data.projectDigest: Sustainability is to increase life of something with decrease in damage to environment. Everything made by humans should work in the way it is made for and should last for the time designed for. If it stops working properly or it fails earlier, both are undesirable. The proposed research is to design and develop measurement systems for selected entities related to government Infrastructure, Industry and human health.  These systems will be measuring important physical quantities using sensors against known acceptable levels for specific working unit. The information of various similar machines will be interconnected through IOT to interact in a proper way with the decision authority. All the data transmitted to the head quarter will be trained using AI techniques to assist the authorities to take proper decisions. The example system is already made by PI where a distribution power transformer is being monitored for losses, temperatures and oil levels. The data is continuously shared with headquarters through cloud, GSM and other telecommunication techniques. It has closed feedback system where in case of any fault transformer is shut down. Other selected entities for monitoring are Electrical/Mechanical machines and Bio implants in humans.

data.projectName: Development of nanomaterials based novel solar driven water purification and air conditioning system
data.projectDigest: According to UNO's report, one third of the world population will be under severe water scarcity by 2025 due to exponential increase in population, industrial growth and climate change. On the other hand, one of the most dominant part of the power consumption is refrigeration and air conditioning (RAC) for better performance, productive activities and storage purposes, thus, intensifying the power crisis. Solar energy can play an important role in meeting potable water and RAC needs if its availability is property utilized. This project is focused to develop a commercial model and its entrepreneurial framework to produce potable water and generate cooling effect for RAC using freely available solar energy. The ability of most of the working fluids used in RAC and water treatment to capture solar energy is very low which can be exponentially increased by successfully suspending various nanomaterials in them. So, this project targets a bigger challenge of meeting the potable water and RAC needs by developing a system driven by solar energy. Various nanomaterials will be purposely developed to maximize solar energy absorption to make the system efficient. Two solar driven commercial products: one for desalination and the other for RAC, will be developed and an entrepreneurial framework will be established for their commercialization in this project where researchers, scientists and industrial collaborators (seven  relevant industries on board) with multidisciplinary expertise and skills are gathered from five countries including UK, Switzerland, Brazil and China for collaboration and successful execution.

data.projectName: Establishing Infrastructure for Computerized Detection and Internet-Based Treatment of Common Mental Disorders among College Students in Pakistan
data.projectDigest:
Mental disorders affect millions of people worldwide. The global burden of depressive disorders has increased by 37.5% between 1990 and 2010, predominantly in developing countries. As per WHO estimates, of the 1.53 million people that will die by suicide in 2020, 73% would be in developing countries. Most mental disorders have their first onset in early adulthood. The college years are a developmentally crucial period for young people in which they transition from late adolescence to emerging adulthood. These years (17-24) are a peak period for the onset of mental disorders with strong evidence that mental disorders during this period can have profound negative effects on the development of college students, including long-term adverse effects on later adult labor market functioning, relationship functioning and health.
Pakistan like many other low- and middle- income countries is severely under-resourced in terms of mental health infrastructure and resources. At the same time, 55.31% of Pakistani population is under 25 years of age with 15-24 years old making up 19.3% of the country’s population. While currently, its practically impossible to meet the mental health needs of our population and specifically our college students, through one-on-one, in-person therapies, new technologies are making it possible to conduct epidemiological research and research on preventive and early interventions relatively easily through online surveys. 
Through this proposal, we propose to develop a nation-wide infrastructure for mental health screening and inexpensive treatment delivery for college students and beyond, through online platforms. We have partnered with the World Mental Health-International College Student Initiative and Harvard University.

data.projectName: Precision livestock breeding using dairy animals as a model
data.piUniversity: Pir Mehr Ali Shah Arid Agriculture, University Rawalpindi
data.projectDigest:
Although, Pakistan is considered among the leading milk producing countries however, we are still lagging behind in term of per capita availability of milk. Moreover, milk production systems in Pakistan mainly based on small animal holders (about 90%) leading to no sustainable livestock in general and in particular dairy genetic improvement program. Thus, despite the some golden characters like disease and climatic change resistance still the production is low on per animal per annum basis. This genetic improvement is not possible with out proper recording system that should primarily based on proper identification of animals coupled with accurate records. It is envisioned that the productivity and profitability of the dairy industry in Pakistan can be sustainably enhanced via two distinctive ways. Firstly, the intervention of available technologies i.e. RFID based animal identification and herd recording will lead to food safety and traceability improvements as well as better herd management. Secondly, applied research focused on improving the production potential of existing livestock breeds will provide the information that can permit farmers to make cognizant decisions around which animals are most suitable for their farm.
Thus current proposal is focused on development of: 1) a prototype precision livestock-breeding model initially will be designed for the dairy sector with participation of collaborators from Livestock & Dairy Development Department (L&DDD) and farmer i.e. Breeder Societies (BS) 2) a prototype computer program/software and/or mobile app related to livestock management for data collection, storage, dissemination, analyses and generation of management reports for farmers and relevant public and private stakeholders with help of collaborating partners
