data.projectName: Drug and Therapy Innovation (COPD and COVID-19)
data.projectDigest:
‘The Coronavirus disease-19 (COVID-19) has been recently identified as a type of beta coronavirus… It is widely distributed in human and other mammals, and its genome is more distant from severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus (SARS CoV)’ (Wu, et al: 5). Through this proposed project the team working with Sukkur IBA and health care professionals across Pakistan will collate the latest academic and epidemiological data and research to support a national capacity building and technology transfers from UK and other countries to Pakistan. 
One of the key focus areas for the team will include those suffering from COPD who are more vulnerable to the COVID19 pathogen and are more likely to succumb to any infection, placing extensive pressure on health services. ‘Severe symptoms of acute respiratory infection appeared within the early stage of this pneumonia, with exacerbating cases where patients developed acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), septic shock, metabolic acidosis and coagulation dysfunction that are difficult to correct Wu et al: 5) 
The proposed study and capacity building exercise aims to collate the body of literature (very limited) regarding COVID 19 and COPD, especially, and to create a capacity building exercise build around hackathons and creation of a digital eco-system to allow the Pakistan health care sector to garner lessons from international partners and health care practitioners from the frontline in the United Kingdom and learn lessons from countries that have been significantly impacted by COVID19. 
Our work on this grant will consist of 6 work packages (WP1-6) overseen by Prof Altaf Hussain (Pakistan) and Dr Stuart Gibson, CEO of Athos Medical Technologies Ltd (UK), and Dr Tim Pascoe CICUK DICE Consortium.

data.projectName: COVID-19 Spread Prediction and Relief Effort Analytics based on Telecom Data
data.piUniversity: National University of Computer and Emerging Sciences, Islamabad
data.theme: Development of Infectious Diseases Surveillance Systems using big data analytics and artificial intelligence
data.projectDigest:
In this proposal, we want to investigate, solve, and produce a working technological solution to
•	monitor how COVID-19 has spread-out in our country
•	predict the persons who are most probably going to be infected
•	identify the localities which are already infected which ones are vulnerable
•	how to help the Government to effectively plan the relief efforts

For this purpose, we will use mobile phone data of COVID-19 patients. This data will provide us list of persons who were contacted and hence are likely patients. The mobile phone usage and calls history will also provide us movement/navigation routes of the patient, which will provide further information of prone places.

data.projectName: RAPID LATERAL FLOW CHROMATOGRAPHIC IMMUNOASSAY KITS
data.projectDigest: In this situation of GLOBAL CORONA PENDAMIC/EMERGENCY, the utmost potential threat to this nation is the spread of the disease which needs to be stopped. However, large scale screening is one of the best possible approaches to stop the spread of the disease after isolating them in quarantine area. Real time PCR is the only testing options available in the country which is very expensive, sample collection methods are highly unsafe where nasal and oral secretions are volatile in nature prone to spread the virus in the lab. PCR technique also needs skilled/trained technicians, very expensive equipment for testing, tedious sample collection process and it also takes hours for the results to be obtained. To solve all these problems and reduce the chances of future spread of the disease there is a dire need for the availability of RAPID TESTING KITS for corona patients which can give results in 5-10 minutes for the qualitative detection of IgG and IgM antibodies to 2019-nCoV using whole blood/serum/plasma without establishing a professional laboratory. We have contacted the Biotechnology Laboratories around the world already produced such RAPID n-CoV-2019 testing cassettes/strips. Similarly, we have collaborated with local commercial diagnostic organizations for the initial transfer of the technology and they are happy to spend money for the transfer of technology to help the people of Pakistan. Using proposed technology can be available at each point of care healthcare settings and screening of corona patients can be performed at large scale which will surely stop the spread and save the life of millions.

data.projectName: Intelligent GIS Based COVID-19 Live Simulated Hot-Spot Analysis and Outbreak Predictions for Emergency Management
data.piUniversity: National University of Computer and Emerging Sciences, Islamabad
data.theme: Information Collection and Dissemination IT platforms)
data.projectDigest:
The whole world is currently in an epidemic situation due to COVID-19.  The world economy has been severely hit; businesses have gone bankrupt, massive layoffs have occurred. Governments, organizations, and individuals all are in action or active to handle the emerging situation in the best possible manner. This is an emergency situation, and Governments are trying to execute every possible plan to fight this pandemic. But the Government is facing a lot of problems regarding the identification of affected areas, resource management for the health centres and to devise a future plan to regain the pre-COVID normalcy in the country.

Our proposed project ‘COVID-Trace’ is mainly concerned with the identification and control of the causes of COVID-19 spread by using GIS-based modelling and machine learning. We need to correctly identify the areas of spread using technology. Project output shall comprises a live simulation analysis tool that allows users to analyse potential impact of government decisions related to certain controllable parameters, given a set of ground-truth location/road/street and demographic data of a region and a probabilistic model for activity of individuals (outdoor movement of healthy, susceptible, suspicious individuals) comprising a rule-based disease spread simulation. Moreover, other modules such as complaint handling, reporting silent cases, identification of needy people based on affected areas, precautions and symptoms system and droplets simulations in different areas shall be integrated with this project. Hence, a precise and integrated GIS-based model is necessary for the Government to accommodate infected areas and also to control the further contamination of particular areas of Pakistan.

data.projectName: Remote and Rapid Temperature Detection System for Public Places
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.theme: Development of Infectious Diseases Surveillance Systems using big data analytics and artificial intelligence
data.projectDigest:
It is the need of hour to monitor and effectively screen out the COVID-19 affected person both in temporal and spatial manner. A tiniest delay and negligence in tracking or screening may lead to heavy spread of COVID-19 among the community. Moreover, physical interaction should be minimal while handling the people both medically or administratively. Currently, the authorities monitoring at hospitals, public spots, roads etc. lack the proper screening and patient tracking equipment and is risk prone. Moreover, fear lies that there are chances that COVID-19 may reborn once the life is back to routine as virus can incubated unnoticed  for weeks in living beings. Hence, an efficient, real time, automated solution for suspect screening and tracking is required. 
We proposed to develop an advanced kit to scan body temperature of person from a distance. The developed kit will be able to monitor more than 60 persons in a single minute. The hardware of kit will be portable and can be deployed at specific public places, adjusted on police helmet and can be carried by the concerned authorities. This hardware will be backboned by an AI based application compatible to work with existing smart devices. This will perform thermal imaging using advance techniques and algorithms based on Deep Learning and Machine Learning tools to acquire and highlight temperature patterns, notify abnormalities to the user / authorities. The kit will also able to extract other features of person which include facial recognition and from a rich database which can further help in localization, travel history and its movement in past days along with marking the multi-layer family details.

data.projectName: Establishing and evaluating the efficacy of Convalescent Plasma based therapy in COVID-19 patients in Pakistan
data.projectDigest: Coronavirus disease caused by COVID-19 is a deadly diseases which takes away lives of thousands of people in a less than three months, hence declare as pandemic by World Health Organization. Due to its novelty and mostly asymptomatic in its initial stages, it threatens the global world including Pakistan because of its diagnostic problem and lack of availability of the treatment. Since its first case reported on 26th of February 2020, in Pakistan, the case tally is on rise and cross the figure of 2000 in just few days. Till date no drug, no vaccine no treatment is available therefore we are on the mercy of that deadly virus. Passive immunity i.e Convalescent Plasma (CP) based therapy is considered to be one of the possible and quick response solution to such pandemic conditions. It is the administration of antibodies against a certain antigen (obtained from the blood of a successfully recovered patient) to a susceptible patient for the purpose of preventing and treating of an infectious disease. Now on one hand where the efficacy of CP based therapy is unknown there the facility for conducting such experiments in Pakistan is also lacking. Therefore this project aims to i) determine whether convalescent plasma transfusion may be beneficial in the treatment of critically ill patients with severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection? and ii) to establish a plasma transfusion facility in Pakistan with the help of experts abroad working on the same project in a developed country.

data.projectName: IoT enabled real time remote monitoring of COVID-19 patients in quarantine
data.theme: Indigenous manufacture of Low cost Intensive-care equipment
data.projectDigest:
Due to the coronavirus (COVID-19) outbreak, the hospitals are expecting a large number of patients. Many well developed countries are facing hard times in dealing with a huge number of COVID-19 patients including USA, Italy, Spain and France. The main problem is the continuous monitoring of patients and providing medical assistance where necessary. For patients in quarantine, there are few major parameters including pulse rate, ECG, blood pressure and oxygen saturation in the blood. These are being checked by medical staff through a machine named cardiac monitor. Body temperature is also being monitored by the medical staff.

For large number of patients in quarantine, the medical staff can not monitor the health of all these patients simultaneously. Limited number of cardiac monitors is also an issue. As the medical staff is working in a highly contaminated environment, therefore they are also getting infected and few have also lost their lives, which is another major problem. The proposed project is to implement this algorithm on a modular electronic control system that will enable third party low cost ventilator developers to provide advanced ventilator modes required by COVID-19 patients. The system will be modular enough to be used by third party developers to develop their respective mechanical ventilators thus delivering a sophisticated product in shorter time.

data.projectName: Formulation of concentrated nanoparticles gel for sterilizing and enhancing usage life of PPEs against air borne viruses
data.theme: Development of disinfectants particularly using indigenous herbal ingredients
data.projectDigest: Biological aerosols are interesting compounds for removal of microbiological and viral particles from the ambient air and equally effective against direct contaminated surfaces. Secondly, frequent change of personnel protecting equipment’s (PPEs) for treating COVID-19 patients is challenging task and costly. Moreover, the entrapment of biological particles from air into these simple masks and cloth-based masks is also questionable. This technology transferred project is designed to formulate highly effective nanoparticle gel for sterilizing PPEs. Our previously designed desert flora-based nanoparticles colloids (Khan et al. 10.1016/j.apsusc.2016.05.133; Hashmi et al. 10.1016/j.colsurfa.2017.06.036; Hashmi et al. 10.1016/j.colsurfb.2019.110508; Ma et al. 10.1021/acsomega.9b00871) are extremely effective against various microbes and also have sterilizing effects. The major strategy that will be followed in this project is the encapsulation of different desert floras in tea tree oil and Eucalyptus oils followed by surface modification with alfalfa saponins. This highly biological active formulation will be entrapped in starch or other natural hydrocolloids. The formulated gel will be applied to different PPEs and later will be utilized by common people or by health administrators for treating COVID-19 patients.

data.projectName: Fabrication and characterization of polymer based novel Cu/nanofibers for sensing and deactivation of coronaviruses.
data.projectDigest: Various strategies and actions are being taken in order to overcome the scourge of the virus. In the propose project here we are focusing on the fabrication and characterization of a colorimetric sensor for early detection and deactivation of the coronavirus. Through this theme, development of nanofiber based membrane has been proposed. This membrane will have two main functions; that are detection of the coronavirus and its annihilation. Detection will be done by using colorimetric polymers, which will change the color of the membrane and the intensity of the color may then be related to the numbers of the viruses present on the membrane. After detection the deactivation or killing of virus will commence by the action of the copper ions present in the nanofiber. When the microbial organisms, such as viruses, interact with copper, the copper ions penetrate the cells of the microorganism and destroy its nucleic acids and the blueprints. . Additionally, for killing of the coronavirus, antiviral agents may also be used.  The developed membrane can then be used in face masks, such as 95 Mask, gown or straps. The membrane can also be used as a healthcare sensor strap, which can be fixed on different apparels or home textiles.

data.projectName: Identifying and Detecting COVID patients with Deep Learning and Big Data
data.theme: Development of Infectious Diseases Surveillance Systems using big data analytics and artificial intelligence
data.projectDigest: COVID-19 has killed over 46,000 patients till date worldwide and many are still infected. As of now we have limited resources to test COVID-19 patients and biggest one is lack of detection kits. Even in many developed countries, the health system has come to the point of collapse due to the increasing demand for intensive care units simultaneously. It is utmost need to introduce an easy and cost-effective surveillance system to identify the patients. The aim of this project is real-time identification of COVID-19 suspected patients using computer vision and deep learning models (detectron2, action recognition, OpenCV and thermal temperature) in cities. Early detection of sick people can be helpful in controlling its spread and one can restrict it to a few people and area.

data.projectName: Large Scale Production of Nanomaterials Functionalized Antimicrobial Textiles for Reusable Personal Protective Equipment
data.projectDigest:
COVID-19 pandemic is a global war in which mankind is facing the same invisible enemy i.e., corona virus (COVID-19). The first battlefield is the hospital where our soldiers are the medical workers fighting in frontline. To ensure that this war can be won, healthcare practitioners must be protected from the viral infections. For the purpose Personal Protective  Equipment i.e., clothing gowns, gloves, Surgical caps  masks and shoe covers are primary need. Such materials are manufactured by a few international companies, who expressed their “inability” to supply PPE due to multiple indispensable reasons. It is need of the hour to augment cost-effective supplies of vital healthcare equipment for dealing with COVID-19 cases and to create a strong reserve of personal protective equipment not only for medical staff but for everyone.
The major aim of current project is to develop and promote effective local personal care products with antiviral/antibacterial properties to help reduce the spread of disease. Purpose of task is not only to block microorganisms on the surface but also make fabric capable to kill these organisms. 
Potential customer will be not only healthcare practitioners and patients but also common people to avoid infection and spread of disease.

data.projectName: Optimal Disease Prediction and Self-Isolation Management System for Covid-19
data.piUniversity: Ghulam Ishaq Khan Institute of Engineering Sciences & Technology, Topi
data.theme: Information Collection and Dissemination IT platforms)
data.projectDigest:
Pakistan has also been affected by Covid-19. This pandemic has virtually locked down the entire country and has drastically affected the country economy. Each country has different dynamics and it is important that local dynamics be studied better in order to fight the virus in a befitting manner. To help the government of Pakistan to manage the Covid-19 pandemic like South-Korea, Singapore and Japan, we are aiming to develop an app with two main modules. The first module will be developed to understand the behavior of the pandemic and regional forecasting using mathematical models based on differential equations and graph theory. The mathematical models will be integrated using integrated web-based platform so that quick dissemination is possible to various stakeholders. The app would be able to project how infectious diseases progress over time. 

The second module will be developed for purpose of self-isolation, this app will ask user to give real time user feedback on daily basis or after travel to identify his/her health score based on four coloring strips. Based on scores, our team will be able to closely guide and monitor people. Based on “Red” signals, we can identify “Potential Clusters” and create awareness to users to further restrict their movements and avoid movements unless situation gets better. The cluster will be used to re-define the health policy of Pakistan by identifying hotspots and growth patterns, contact tracing modelling of affected people as per HEC thematic area.

Analysis of these models can lead to accurate health-based policy making and design vaccination programs and voluntarily self-isolation mechanisms for Pakistan.

data.projectName: Up-gradation of Laboratory for Molecular diagnosis of CORONA virus
data.theme: Indigenous manufacture of Low cost Intensive-care equipment
data.projectDigest:
Novel Corona virus (nCOVID-19) is severally affecting the world since originated from the Wuhan China. This pandemic virus has not only stuck the flourishing life of humanity but also creating harass and fear with every passing day as the  number of deaths are increasing throughout the world. The Scientists, doctors and researchers from all over the world are working hard in their specified fields to save the human beings from this lethal virus. The identification or diagnosis of a certain disease is considered as the primary and important task of any disease so that the scientist could develop medicines or vaccines against the lethal pathogen. 

According to the pathogencity of a certain pathogen World Health organization (WHO) has its clear guidelines regarding Bio-safety levels for the complete safety of working hands. W.H.O has recommended Bio-safety level 3 (BSL-3) facilities while dealing with CORONA Virus in diagnostic labs. The current number of well-equipped diagnostic laboratories having proper Bio-safety facilities to perform diagnostic tests of Corona virus is not pleasing in Pakistan.

The present project has been designed for the up-gradation of CAMB Diagnostic Laboratory which is currently providing molecular diagnostic services of HCV & HBV and it needs to be upgraded  up to bio-safety level 3 for the molecular diagnosis of COVID-19.The successful completion of the project will not only protect the working analysts from the contagious virus but also provide the quality molecular diagnosis services for Corona virus. The BSL-3 laboratory at CAMB will not only be used for COVID-19 diagnosis in Pakistani individuals but also be adequate enough to deal other such viruses, if any in future.

data.projectName: Personalized Walk-through Sanitizing Systems
data.projectDigest: We plan to develop two types of walk-through sanitizing gates. One will be low-cost simple gate just for the sanitization purpose using disinfectant.  The other one would be smart sanitizing gate that will not only disinfect the mass audience effectively in seconds but also keep record of the persons and their body temperature. This will be done by CCTV camera monitoring and real time temperature screening. Smart gate will detect the person entering through it automatically, disinfect him/her, take his/her picture along with his/her body temperature and if higher, inform the respective authorities by sending them the e-notification instantly. These smart gates will be very helpful in limiting the spread of the deadly COVID-19 virus in crowded public places and will help in identifying the patient of COVID-19. Being locally manufactured, these gates will play their parts in sustaining country’s economy in this time of economic crisis. Both types of gates will be reliable, less expensive compared to the currently available solutions, and easy to install. They can be installed at entrance of any crowded place like mosques, hospitals, shopping malls, schools, colleges, universities, offices, factories, parks, markets etc. Therefore, the owners of such places would be our anticipated customers.

data.projectName: Infectious disease surveillance by using Deep Learning
data.piUniversity: Quaid-e-Awam University of Engineering, Sciences & Technology, Nawabshah
data.theme: Development of Infectious Diseases Surveillance Systems using big data analytics and artificial intelligence
data.projectDigest: The objective of this research proposal is to meet the current challenges of disease surveillance and control by implementing new methods of data analysis and machine learning to consider the future risk model of infectious diseases such as than COVID-19.  The main purpose of predicting infectious diseases to inform health care to make a timely decision.  Our main task is the implementation of a computation model and inserts disease diffusion models for emerging as well as re-emerging diseases as well as their previous transmission dynamics. Information about the system should be understandable to the public health team.  Because such an understanding would provide information allowing public health officials to detect, monitor and control disease epidemics or pandemics promptly.  We will implement our network-based approach based on machine learning techniques that will characterize cases of infection in time with information from the host and the location of the host and also predict spread of disease near the sub-location.  This computerized infectious disease control model would allow decision-makers such as public health and government to better understand the spread of the disease through information on when, where and how certain modes of disease transmission emerge or reappear, as well as information on other impactable factors such as ecology. , environmental, biological, socio-economic and behavioral environmental factors.

data.projectName: Development of mobile as well as fixed UV-C based systems for disinfecting medical equipment infected with COVID-19
data.piUniversity: Pakistan Institute of Engineering & Applied Sciences, Islamabad (PIEAS)
data.theme: Development of disinfectants particularly using indigenous herbal ingredients
data.projectDigest: Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) is an infectious disease caused by severe acute respiratory syndrome corona virus 2, a type of coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2). The WHO and CDC state that it is primarily spread during close contact and by small droplets (air aerosols) produced when people cough or sneeze; with close contact being within 1–3 m. It has been found that uncovered coughing can lead to droplets travelling up to 4.5 meters. As a result, healthcare persons are at high risk of getting infection from COVID-19 and recently many deaths of healthcare personnel have been reported. Therefore, disinfection of healthcare tools, wearing clothes, masks, pencils, cell phones, writing pads, stethoscopes, eye glasses etc. is extremely important. Different detergents are being used but they cannot be used for disinfecting every thins and every place. Disinfecting of Medicare tools from these viruses, bacteria and other microbials with UV-C light is not new, it has already been under use in hospitals and pathological laboratories. However, these are not available everywhere and not easy to use in mobile quarantine places, doctor clinics, patient rooms, bath rooms and receptions. In addition, optimization of dose for disinfecting Medicare tools is extremely important. This project is being proposed to address all the situations and to optimize proper dose of UVC irradiation and safety precautions. The optimum use of proposed project can be visualized in YouTube video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WRXZjLk_4Hk.

data.projectName: Anti-Coronavirus surfaces for disrupting the spread of COVID-19 outbreak: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and beyond
data.piUniversity: Lahore University of Management Sciences (LUMS), Lahore
data.projectDigest: COVID-19 can spread either via direct contact with infected individuals or via indirect route of coming in contact with surfaces contaminated with novel-coronavirus. Coronaviruses are known to survive on surfaces for several days, which gives them an extraordinary ability of spreading infection and makes their containment a huge challenge. Beside common population, medical/paramedical/government/non-government personnel performing their duties on coronavirus-frontlines are also at the risk of catching COVID-19. Consequently, Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) become essential for protection against COVID-19. Unfortunately, the current stockpile of PPE is insufficient. Besides, several doctors/paramedical-staff in many countries including Pakistan have died of COVID-19 while treating COVID-19 patients. This reflects on the ineffectiveness of the available PPE in preventing the transmission of COVID-19 once their surface becomes contaminated with novel-coronavirus. This proposal offers a system level deployment of innovative technologies based on materials displaying anti-coronavirus surfaces that rapidly kill novel-coronaviruses upon contact. These technologies will impart permanent antiviral character to the surfaces of a vast variety of finished products used in daily-life. Importantly, we propose to market PPE exhibiting a long-term ability of killing coronavirus upon contact. This will enhance PPE’s effectiveness of protection against the novel-coronavirus and contribute in disrupting the spread of COVID-19 pandemic.

data.projectName: HERO (Health Emergency Rescue Operation)
data.theme: Development of Infectious Diseases Surveillance Systems using big data analytics and artificial intelligence
data.projectDigest:
After the outbreak of COVID-19 pandemic around the world, governments are tightening public health measures by imposing Lock-down (social distancing, self-isolation) i.e. to reduce human contact and overcome the spreading of the virus. However, such impositions are creating stress and crisis for common man in terms of food supplies, medication, health and economy. In this regard, drone technology has gained substantial attention to overcome such issues. Governments are harnessing the potential of drones. data.projectName: Reusable Anti bacterial and anti viral mask
data.projectDigest: COVID-19 has undeniably shaken the world and has forced nations to think that nothing is more important than health and life.  There is an absolute consensus that air pollution is a serious problem in today’s society and, in the current scenario, this is equally important for both developed and developing economies. Although actions are being taken to tackle the problem, technology needs to develop more efficient forms of protection and disinfection. Although many air cleaning devices are available in the market, their real-world efficiency at cleaning pollution and limiting the spread of infectious diseases, including COVID-19 pandemics, is often insufficient or unproven. Coronaviruses, specifically, are not directly spread while airborne but rather spread by surface touching. However, contagion also happens when infected people cough or exhale, thus spreading droplets carrying the virus. This can be reduced using, for example, face masks. Unfortunately, coronaviruses have shown survival on different surfaces for up to a few days. Therefore, we need an immediate solution to degrade the pathogens/viruses just after their release form the infected person’s body. This intervention can drastically decrease the spread of the virus till large extent.  By doing so, human to human interaction can be made possible and thus the socio economic activities can be restarted immediately. Such measures have great potential to bring back the normal life and international travelling in aeroplanes, treatment in hospitals, official activities in offices, social gathering in restaurants, academic activities in school, colleges and universities will be restored.In the proposed project, we will make a reusable mask coated with black TiO2/ CuO-TiO2, which can degrade pathogens immediately.

data.projectName: Positive End-Expiratory Pressure (PEEP) Mode Ventilator using Ambu Bag Automation
data.theme: Indigenous manufacture of Low cost Intensive-care equipment
data.projectDigest: Ventilator is a machine to assist in breathing to the patients with severe breathing problems. This project aims to design and manufacture Ventilators indigenously using raw materials including Ambu bag, DC/AS Motor with good torque, Programmable timer switch, spirometer, wood for making structure of ventilator, high duty cord and oxygen cylinder if needed. Positive End-Expiratory Pressure (PEEP) refers to the application of additional pressure at the end of expiration to maintain pressure in the lung slightly above atmospheric pressure. Electric Motor and Programmable timer delay switches will be used to adjust inspiration time, expiration time and tidal flow. A calibrated Nob will be utilized to maintain the PEEP pressure value, using Ambu bag. Matching the ventilator’s inspiration-expiration cycle with body’s natural cycle is very significant and so be achieved using Spirometer at interface of bag and mask.

data.projectName: Autonomous Indoor Multi-Service Robot (AIMSR) for Disinfection of Coronavirus In Hospitals
data.theme: Indigenous manufacture of Low cost Intensive-care equipment
data.projectDigest:
As the world continues to fight the spread of the COVID-19 pandemic, robots  and automation are playing a critical role in helping to safeguard people and process the supplies that humans need as they shift to remote working and home learning. Robots are helping disinfect hospitals. Autonomous deliveries  are bringing supplies to people as they adopt social distancing. Automated workstations are speeding up the work of pharmaceutical companies. Automation is on the front lines of this battle. 
Artificial Intelligence and Robotics are contributing to scientific competitions and are becoming very popular day by day. The field of Robot Automation  is spreading vastly covering almost all sectors of human life. In this project, we will propose and develop Autonomous Indoor Multi-Service Robot (AIMSR)for Disinfection of Coronavirus in Hospitals. The two major procedures used for disinfection are UV and ethanol disinfection. UV disinfecting technology has been around for something like a century, and it’s commonly used to disinfect drinking water.  To disinfect any surface ultraviolet light (UV) lamp will be directly pointed out at a surface for a couple of minutes to be effective. This will terminate bacteria, viruses and other harmful microbes by damaging their DNA and RNA, so they can't multiply. The UV light is also hazardous since it can cause damage to skin and eyes, humans have to be careful around it and the automated service robot will use spray gun equipped with 75% of ethanol disinfectant to effectively kill the live coronavirus.

data.projectName: Development of Nutraceutical Formulation against Coronavirus Disease (COVID-19), and Relief of Flu Like Symptoms
data.projectDigest:
The incidence of 2019 Wuhan novel corona (2019-nCoV) virus has created a global health emergency throughout the world. Efforts have been made to find out the vaccine or effective treatment against the disease. The disease has clinical presentation resembling viral pneumonia, and has emerged as pandemic. Since January 27 to April 3, 2020, more than 1,039,922 global cases with more than 55,170 deaths have been reported. It has been spread in more than 200 countries.  Since 2019-nCov emergence created an urgency for the development of vaccine or effective treatment.

During the current project, we aim to develop new dietary herbal health supplements that can prevent, reduce or stop the progression of SARS-CoV-2, or relieve the flu like symptoms. For this purpose, we have initially selected 15 dietary plants, reported in literature for coronavirus (SARS-CoV, and MERS-CoV). Acute toxicity has already been performed and all these dietary plants have found to be non-toxic. Since the proposed products will be based on dietary plant substances their safety and non-toxic nature is assumed. We are now planning to use different combinations of these dietary plant extracts for dosage optimization, stability, prompt toxicity, antiviral activity, in vivo pneumonia model to observe symptomatic relief of flu like symptoms. The most significant combinations will be processed for standardization through modern techniques, in order to have internally consistent raw material for product development at the industrial level. Finally, we will work with the industrial partner for the commercial development of these health supplements that would be used for the prevention and treatment against SARS-CoV-2. The pilot level production initiation through the approval of DRAP.

data.projectName: Development and transfer of performance effective bio based anti-bacterial facemask and personal protective suit technology
data.projectDigest:
Appropriate face masks and PP (personnel protective) suit can protect against infection caused by Corona virus. The appropriate mask and suits filter out aerosol particles and protects against the infections. It is mainly due to this reason that at the moment there is severe shortage of face masks and suits owing to their significantly higher demand. It is also alarming that there are very a smaller number of Pakistani face mask and PP suit manufacturers and even most of them do not have good quality and as per the president of Pakistan Drugs Lawyers Forum no company in Pakistan is manufacturing A-category N95 mask. 
PI has recently (in just 8 days since 24th March 2020) developed the cost and performance effective antimicrobial face mask by using effective bio antimicrobial agent at the department. This anti-microbial facemask will not only block bacteria and virus but kill them as well. Initial testing has exhibited good results. However, there is need of further optimization, finding more bio anti-microbial finishes for mask and suit as well as finding more suitable fabric and then transferring the technology to the industry. Masood textile mill is the collaborating industry and willing to adopt the technology on success.

data.projectName: Molecular Characterization of COVID-19 Structural Recombinant Proteins and their utility in Developing Improved and Rapid Diagnostic Assays
data.projectDigest: Currently the COVID-19 is an explosive threat with major outbreaks around the globe. In Pakistan the total confirmed COVID-19 cases are more than 2400 and 38 deaths have occurred to date. Fast diagnosis for COVID-19 are immediately needed to prevent further hospitalization and casualties in country. Currently no established diagnostic tests are available in country and only imported detection kits are used for the diagnosis of COVID-19 infection.  So, there is an urgent need to develop an inexpensive, highly sensitive and specific in-house diagnosis system for the detection of COVID-19. Therefore, in the proposed project we will establish in-house rapid, highly sensitive and specific diagnostic assays for screening of COVID-19 infection using the expressed structural recombinant antigens of local COVID-19. We will clone the epitopic sites of structural genes of COVID-19 in pET-28 expression vector and will then transform in E. coli for the production of recombinant proteins. The recombinant viral antigens will be also helpful for development of recombinant viral vaccines. The proposed project will present a good foundation and will be served as an important and start for the initiated research in the directions of vaccines and cost-effective and rapid in-house diagnostic assays for the detection of COVID-19.

data.projectName: Development of rapid diagnostic assays using gold nanostructures for COVID-19
data.projectDigest:
This project is related with the diagnostic kits which can be used for COVID-19 disease and with modification for other enveloped viruses. These kits are based on colorimetric methods using molecular and immunological techniques. 
The principle/hypothesis for this kit is based upon 
1.	the fact that metallic nanoparticles especially gold are known to have a  good plasmon resonance and optical properties. Presence of these properties are responsible for color production (intense red in case of gold nanoparticles). Whenever these nanoparticles have interaction with nucleic acids under certain well defined conditions they produce color change. This property is already explored and reported by other worker  in case of HCV RNA (reported 30 min reaction time with high sensitivity and specificity without need of expensive instruments). I may also work in case of COVID-19.   In this case nanoparticles will be synthesized in our own laboratory. 
2.	On the other hand, whenever the pure salts have interaction with living organism they will get reduce on the presence of reduction ability and produce different colors 
Already available PCR based, Realtime PCR, ELISA based or other available are expensive and time taking. The kits will be cheap, rapid with shorter turnover time. Such assays are highly needed in developing countries with limited resources.

data.projectName: Development of Ventilator for Coronavirus Patients
data.theme: Indigenous manufacture of Low cost Intensive-care equipment
data.projectDigest:
The project, “Development of a Low Cost Ventilator” aims to focus on one of the priority themes; “Indigenous manufacturing of Low cost Intensive-care equipment”. In the ongoing catastrophic situation of Coronavirus disease where all the big economies are on the verge of a sudden collapse, a third world country like Pakistan is searching for all the resources that include Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), Medical specialists and nurses, and Intensive Care Equipment to equip itself in order to prevent economic damages and more importantly save people’s lives. 
One of the most critical lifesaving equipment for Coronavirus patients is a Ventilator which can really make a difference between life and death when the patient is in severe condition. For a country with a population of more than 220 M, Pakistan only has 2400 ventilator, out of which only 1800 are functional.  
We propose a low-cost solution for ventilator technology that would help meet the country’s requirement in this crises. Our team has already build a prototype that performs some functions of a commercial ventilator. Both these functions allow the clinician to sustain the patient’s health by providing sufficient amount of oxygenated air thereby keeping the patient alive in order to allow the immune system to fight against the virus effectively. 
There are two main objectives of the project: 1- To reduce the cost of ventilator that would assure its affordability and, 2- To assemble the ventilator locally to ascertain its availability in any such condition like Covid-19. The cost of the machine would be reduced to (Rs. 160,000/= )automatically due to its local design and assembling by saving money in terms of avoiding huge profits paid to the foreign manufacturers and vendors.

data.projectName: Ventilator design based on controlled-compressed air switching
data.piUniversity: NED University of Engineering & Technology, Karachi
data.theme: Indigenous manufacture of Low cost Intensive-care equipment
data.projectDigest: Ventilators are very critical in current COVID-19 pandemic. Therefore, it is needed to develop rapidly ventilators in huge quantity that are reliable and stable during different modes (of operation) to provide breathing in different critical condition of patients. In this regard, we propose to develop a ventilator, whose design is based on desired mixture of controlled-compressed air/oxygen switching. The design will be able to obtain benchmark pressure profiles, tidal volume and flowrate to be maintained at patient lungs along with required tidal volume and flowrate depending upon the condition of patients. In this regard, we have an important sectoral collaboration with Medicare Network, which deals in all kinds of ventilators and other medical equipment. In addition, we also have financial and technical collaborations of Genesis Solutions. Pvt. Ltd. and SoluNox. Pvt Ltd. With their technical & financial assistance, and experience, we have been able to validate our new switching-based control design of ventilators. Our design is following the standards of UK govt. and application is submitted in DRAP for clinical trial.

data.projectName: Multi-Mode Disinfectant Devices (Air & Surface) for Pandemic COVID’19 by Using Internet of Robotic Things (IoRT)
data.theme: Development of disinfectants particularly using indigenous herbal ingredients
data.projectDigest:
This project aims to design an air purification system and surface disinfectant equipment to disinfect pathogens (bacteria and viruses) in the air in large buildings and on surfaces in rooms respectively. 
Air Disinfection System:
In air purification, the system will take air from inside the building at one end, purify and disinfect it by passing through three stages of purification system including air purifiers, UVC light and chemical/organic spray, and insert back the fresh air to the building. Such a system will help us to provide a reasonably safe environment in residential building, hospitals, shopping malls, and conference halls etc. 
Surface Disinfection System:
In mobile robot-based surface disinfectant, the system will be dual mode operated by humans (manually or teleoperated) with the objective to disinfect maximum number of surfaces (metal, glasses, plastics, table, door knobs and bathroom accessories etc.) from pathogens by using UVC light source and spraying (chemical/organic). This dual-mode disinfection system will help us to disinfect the surfaces inside of rooms where patients are being kept. Manual cleaning and dusting will still be required.
The intelligent IoT based controllers will continuously update the operator about the status of the chemical tank level and device performances throughout the operation.

data.projectName: Development, evaluation and commercialization of a Multiplex Real-time PCR Kit for the specific diagnosis of COVID-19
data.projectDigest: This proposal is aimed to market our newly developed type of test “CEMBPU Multiplex Real-time PCR kit” for the detection of COVID-19 targeting its RNA dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp) genome of 2019-nCoV. The primers/probe are designed to have 100% homology with the 20 genome sequences available on the GISAID/NCBI database as of 16 March 2020. The primers and probe target the RdRp gene targeting two separate portions of this novel virus with no cross reactivity with any other coronavirus sequenced thus far. Specifically, the primers represent 100% homology with over 95% of the NCBI database reference sequences available at the time of design. A 2019-nCoV specific primer and probe mix is provided and this can be detected through the FAM channel and HEX channel. The primer and probe mix provided exploits the TaqMan® principle. During PCR amplification, forward and reverse primers hybridize to the 2019-nCoV cDNA. Two fluorogenic probes are included in the same reaction mixture which consists of DNA probes labelled with a 5`-dye and a 3`-quencher. During PCR amplification, the probe is cleaved, and the reporter dye and quencher are separated. The resulting increase in fluorescence can be detected on a range of Real-time PCR platforms.

data.projectName: INFORMATION LITERACY SKILLS OF MEDICAL PRACTITIONERS IN PAKISTAN
data.projectDigest:
Medical Practitioners are life savers. They make a difference by helping human being, minimize their pain when they are patients (Sherman, 2018). Latest and accurate information is one of the most important ingredients in our modern society (Sheikh, 2016). Being an important segment of society and life savers, doctors need to be information literate. They need to be more skillful and well-informed than other individuals. A well-informed practitioner will be in a better position to serve their patients in a better way. 
The main purpose of this study is to examine the current status of Information Literacy skills of doctors working in various health sectors of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. The findings of the study will be helpful to improve the health sector for the well-being of the people of the province (by achieving the third SDGs of the United Nations). The higher ups of Health Department, Government of KP will also be approached to plan some concrete strategies for the development of Information Literacy skills of medical practitioners. The skilled information literate physicians and medical practitioners will serve the nation in a healthier way (Hennepin Healthcare Research Institute,2018).  Efforts will be made to know whether the doctors of KP have the potential to recognize their needed information, identify the sources of needed information, able to locate and access the sources of needed information, have the knowledge to evaluate and organize the information and are in the position to present the acquired information efficiently.

data.projectName: Patronizing camel milk pasteurization and commercialization for Sustainable Dairy Development in Rahim Yar Khan
data.piUniversity: Khwaja Fareed University of Engineering and Information Technology, Rahim Yar Khan
data.projectDigest: Pakistan have about 1.1 million camel herds with 885 metric tonnes of camel milk with production of about 50,990 metric tonnes [1]. Cholistan desert of Pakistan and is rich diversity of temperature ranges from 6 to 50 0C and homeland of many precious animal genetic resources particularly with variety of Camel breeds. Camel is nature’s incredible creature for nomads and pastoralists in different parts of the world due to its adaptability to harsh conditions. Camel milk is nutritionally balanced in all aspects and is considered as nature’s pharmacy for masses owing to its medicinal and therapeutic characteristics. Camel milk contains three times more vitamin C as compared to bovine milk, which acts as antioxidant and also meets the nutritional requirements of masses in hot and arid environments [2]. Camel milk owns remarkable anti-diabetic potential and contains 52 U insulin/L. Mostly, camel milk is utilized in fresh form by nomads of cholistan to fulfil their dietary needs [3]. The project is aiming to channelize camel milk utilization as nutraceutical and functional food among the different stake holders. Pasteurization with proper marketing and commercialization will be a significant tool poverty alleviation of nomads of the desert of Rahim yar Khan [4].

data.projectName: Development of culture media for growth and industrial metabolite production of Marine Bacteria
data.piUniversity: Federal Urdu University of Arts, Sciences & Technology
data.projectDigest:
Microbial media has undergone several changes since its inception but some key challenges remain unaddressed. In recent years, efforts are mainly focused on exploration of several unconventional nutrient sources both to cater to the specificity in requirement of growth of “fussy microbes” and also to cut off the cost of industrial scale fermentation.
One of the major drawbacks of these commercially available media is their high cost. The problem of high cost is further aggravated when we consider the increase in prices of organic nitrogen and carbon substrates. Moreover, adding to problem is the fact that most of these culture media are imported from foreign countries, adding significant addition to cost in terms of import duty and taxes. The cost of microbiological media, not only limits their use in many industrial processes; but also has impact on the detection of microorganisms for the diagnosis purposes. On the other side, this high cost hinders the propagation of microbiology in Pakistan. Educational institutes neither can offer new programs in Microbiology, nor can support the existing programs. Insufficient budgetary allocations worsen the situation. As a matter of fact, in the current financial crisis, countrywide research in microbiology is facing a struggling phase. Furthermore, Despite having ocean in Karachi, we are unable to explore potential of marine microbes due to inability of marine bacteria to grow under laboratory condition which is of upmost importance for using marine microbes as source of novel compounds and enzymes. Only small fraction of microbes able to grow on known commercial media.
 Therefore, it is imperative to look for alternative and relatively low cost substrates based on native resources that can be used as/in microbiological media.

data.projectDigest: This proposed study will aim to seek insights into student preparedness for transition from secondary to higher secondary schools and to the undergraduate programmes at universities for studying and 21st century skills. Activities and interventions employing the principles of entrepreneurship will be planned for adolescents with follow up discussions. Seminar based discussions before and after the sessions will provide them an exposure to their own self-concept for future employability of the learned skills.

data.projectName: Mapping plant species diversity and distribution in western Himalaya using remote sensing, GIS and multi-trait approachesng, GIS and multi-trait approaches
data.projectDigest: Kashmir Himalayas are globally important biodiversity hotspots and are facing rapid loss in floristic diversity and changing pattern of vegetation. The vegetation distribution pattern, communities, and population dynamics in high altitude areas of the fragile Himalaya (AJK) have seldom given the due attention by researchers and are hence poorly understood. Several countries in the world have benefited from the use of remote sensing and GIS techniques in environmental studies and comparative studies of vegetation cover, over several years, which have enabled to infer degradation or improvement of plant coverings. In Azad Kashmir, such studies are very scare thus, there is wide gap of information on Himalayan plant functional diversity in order to understand species occurrence, species competitive abilities, influence of biological communities on ecosystem functioning and plant community’s response to ongoing climate changes. Nevertheless, in Pakistan, mapping plant diversity from GIS and remotely sensed techniques will have a great benefit and high accuracy that will serve this important field for all human aspects. Plant functional traits are widely used to explain adaptations that enable plants to live under various environmental conditions, which will provide a foundation for predicting changes in plant traits and adaptation in plants under changing climate.

data.localySocioEco: Although, loss of biological diversity is a global issue [1], but in the recent times, human activities and climate change have accelerate this process and greatly affected the diversity of plants around the world [2]. Likewise, this effect has intensified in recent times in various areas of AJK to a point that we are in danger of undermining the primary functions of natural systems, and to a degree that could potentially endanger our own future. Azad Kashmir has a wide variety of altitudes, climatic conditions, geological conditions, river systems and topography that has given rise to an enormous diversity of habitats and, eventually, enormous biodiversity. However, biodiversity losses have resulted from the degradation of natural ecosystems, resource over-exploitation, deforestation and changes in ecological composition of ecosystems; e.g., introducing invasive species that is not native by accident [3]. The remaining Himalayan biodiversity is constantly threatened by factors such as deforestation, overgrazing, soil erosion, road building, and dam construction. So far, with the aid of remote sensing (RS) and geographic information systems (GIS) techniques, no systematic research has used trait-based functional diversity measures, therefore, in AJK and Pakistan, knowledge of their practicability in controlling functional diversity in experimental set-ups is still lacking. In this study, both RS and GIS will be used as examples of the new methods that will contribute to protecting the environment and biodiversity in general, thus filling existing data gaps.

data.projectName: Genetic Testing of Inherited Disorders Prevalent in Malakand Division
data.projectDigest: Genetic disorders have become a major public health problem in the northern areas of Pakistan in recent years. Their treatment and management strategies are a daunting problem due to lack of funding, poorly developed primary and basic health facilities and weak political processes. These disorders therefore require special attention, particularly in remote rural areas where these disorders remain unexplored. In the rural, as well as urban, populations these severe disorders pose serious economical and psychological issues. These issues are emerging as serious public health challenges in Malakand division due to lake of awareness, illiteracy and the unavailability of affordable and efficient diagnosis, prognosis and treatments. Identifying specific causative variants may provide a useful explanation for disease etiology, molecular characterization and pathogenesis. In this project we intend to use high throughput sequencing to investigate the novel causative gene(s) and understand the role in order to develop effective treatments for the most prevalent genetic disorders (Thalassemia, Genetic Deafness, Neurological disorders, Blindness and Mental Retardation) in Malakand division. These causative gene variants, along with other parameters, can be used to systematically design molecular assays and models for improving disease diagnosis, management and prevention. It is further expected that personal genetic profiling will also become more relevant, with implications for patient care in line with the proposed idea of personalized medicine. In our knowledge, if funds were made available through LCF, this will be the first ever systematic approach to disease eradication in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa in particular and in Pakistan in general.

The importance of education cannot be ignored in the development of a society. It is the education that produces human capital and therefore, one the main contributor in a country economic growth. Unfortunately, focusing on the processes in Pakistan, it suffers from inequality in educational outcomes on a massive scale. The more focus is put on the teaching practices and employing effective and tech-based teaching methods. The importance of this aspect cannot be ignored and should be promoted and encourage. This proposed system will provide a platform for institution where will able to communicate effectively with each other, with Higher Education Department (HED), and Higher Education Commission (HEC).

data.projectName: Molecular Genetic Testing and Screening of Monogenic Hereditary Disorders Common in Hazara Division
data.projectDigest: As Hindko and Pashtun are major ethnic groups in the Hazara division, preference to marry within their ethnic groups, mostly first cousin marriages are common that increases the chance of occurrence of diseases that run in families referred to as monogenic hereditary disorders. These disorders can be effectively prevented and controlled through early diagnosis and screening, done through genetic testing. Genetic testing is the medical test based on the human DNA analysis that not only study the diseases at the molecular level but also determine the chance of transmitting the disease to next generation via family screening. Unfortunately due to absence of genetic testing and screening facility in this area, majority of people are unaware of their condition that is adversely affecting the health and hence quality of their life. The proposed project is aimed to target the local population of Hazara division. Emphasis of the study will be to carry out the genetic testing of families with common monogenic hereditary disorders with their consent.  Once the prevalent genetic elements of the common monogenic disorders have been identified, screening of the local community will be done through formulation and subsequent implementation of PCR or Sanger sequencing based genetic tests.

data.localySocioEco: According to Pakistan Health Research Council (PHRC) Noncommunicable diseases (NCDs) are quite common in Pakistan. NCDs are of different types and majority of these are addressed by our health care system except the rare types i.e. Inherited disorders. Tough some work has been carried out on common NCDs like cancer, diabetes and cardiovascular disorders but rare inherited types are neglected. These disorders run in families and results in multiple individuals with disabilities which pose great challenge to family, society and healthcare system. Currently, individuals with genetic disorders are not catered by health care system due to lack of diagnosis and treatment option. Proper management of individuals with inherited disorders requires clinical and molecular genetic testing.  Genetic testing can identify the underlying pathological consequences and this information can be valuable for genetic counseling, disease management, and early screening. Unfortunately, genetic testing facilities are not available in most parts of our country including Hazara region. Lack of genetic testing facilities will undoubtedly increase the number of individuals suffering from inherited disorders, which will not only affect the families but also decrease the proportion of individuals capable to contribute in country’s economic development.

data.projectName: Smart and Sustainable Dairy Farming in Mianwali
data.projectDigest:
Pakistan ranks 4th in the milk-producing countries and yet it fails to meet the per capita consumption requirements of its population mainly because of low yield per cow. However, Pakistan's dairy farming has tremendous potential to increase its yield to fulfill its domestic demand and yet be able to export the surplus produce. These gains are possible by methodically applying global best practices and incorporating the latest developments in agri-tech and science.
As the predominant farms are small to medium-sized and mostly practise antiquated methods of dairy farming,  so any scientific study or intervention in this demographic would bring substantial benefits. We propose to select multiple dairy farms in Mianwali region and transform them into model farms by systematically applying state of the art scientific techniques, equipping them with the latest technology and by introducing modern dairy farm management practices. These smart and sustainable dairy farms will serve as a benchmark for other dairy farmers and findings from farms will be shared with local farmers regularly. Thus, this project is aimed to address the key issues of dairy sector including low production, animal disease control, poor feed management, sustainability of the dairy farms and access to markets through model farming.

data.projectName: Development of Efficient Lithium Ion Batteries from MOF Derived Exceptional Anode Materials
data.piUniversity: Khwaja Fareed University of Engineering and Information Technology, Rahim Yar Khan
data.projectDigest: Pakistan’s first ever Electric Vehicle policy (PEVP) has recently been approved to mitigate climate changes which will undoubtedly cause huge burden on the import-bill in the form of plentiful lithium ion batteries (LIBs) import. Hence, it is necessary to enable the local industry of Pakistan to develop safe, clean, and sustainable LIBs manufacturing units for the continuous economic growth of our country. Economical LIBs are also essential for storing energy produced by renewable energy resources for their integration into the power grid and wind or solar power plants for continuous power supply. To meet these requirements of the hour, in our project, we will carry out intensive research to develop economical electrode materials with nano engineered structures for efficient lithium ion batteries (LIBs). This will surely result in domestic fabrication of LIBs cost-effectively. Furthermore, we will evaluate electrode materials for the storage mechanisms with a focus on performance improvement by either material optimization or by mechanism control. Finally, we will be able to device fully functional LIBs with sufficiently improved lithium storage capabilities. Technology development aspect from this project will augment local industry as well as create new job opportunities in this relatively new area in our country.

data.projectName: Isolated Smart Microgrids for Remote Communities and Electric Vehicles Charging by using Earth Abundant Energy Storage Materials: Planning, Design and Control
data.piUniversity: National University of Computer and Emerging Sciences, Islamabad
data.projectDigest: Renewable energy sources in northern areas, southern Punjab, Baluchistan and coastal areas although abundant, have yet to replace fossil fuels because their intermittent characteristics make them unsuitable as the main form of power generation in conventional electricity networks. By using a combined engineering and environmental science approach, this proposal aims to develop isolated smart microgrids for remote communities and enabling electric vehicles charging stations using earth abundant energy storage materials in a Hybrid AC + DC network (HADN) that will benefit remote communities of northern areas, southern Punjab, Baluchistan and coastal areas, transforming them into self-sufficient and sustainable communities with reduced fuel costs and emissions. Aim of this project is to develop low cost micro grids to sustainably electrifying the remote communities and developing isolated electric vehicle charging stations by introducing low cost sodium-ion batteries in Pakistan using local resources since this technology is cost effective and highly efficient. Pakistan has raw materials including, world’s 2nd largest sodium reserves (in Khewra salt mines) and transition metal reserves in Baluchistan that give additional benefits. We propose to develop, and validate (in laboratory and field trials) the concept of HADNs capable of utilizing local renewable energy resources and materials.

data.localySocioEco: In recent years, environmental pollution and greenhouse gases have come up as major global issues. Governments across the globe have implemented the projects for renewable energy to achieve zero emission and reduce the impact of pollution. Cost of energy generation by renewable energy technologies e.g. solar or wind energy has significantly decreased in the last decade. However, there are issues with these renewable energy technologies, i.e.; solar cells can provide energy when the sun is shining and wind turbines work only when strong wind is blowing. Energy storage or utilization of grid energy is compulsory with these renewable energy technologies. Moreover, vehicle industry is gradually shifting its focus from gasoline to electric vehicles, in which high energy battery is a key component. Cost of current electrochemical energy storage technologies is significantly high (in case of lithium-ion batteries) or their storage density is low (in case of lead acid batteries). Sodium-ion batteries provides a balance between cost and energy density. Lithium’s natural reserve are scarce whereas sodium is abundant in nature. Pakistan has all the major raw materials required for sodium-ion batteries including sodium (Khewra, Punjab), manganese (Khuzdar, Baluchistan) and carbon (Tharparkar, Sindh). Goal of this project is utilizing a low-cost energy storage solution by using local resources so that general public can get maximum benefit from renewable energy technologies. Sodium-ion batteries are already a well-researched topic and this technology is being commercialized in some countries. However, in Pakistan there is no significant research work on material chemistry of sodium-ion. In the long run this project will create a roadmap for low cost micro grids to sustainably electrifying the remote communities, developing isolated electric vehicle charging stations and introducing low cost sodium-ion batteries in Pakistan.

data.projectName: Managerial Overconfidence and Corporate Innovation
data.projectDigest: According to the research, innovation is one of the significant contributor to the sustainability of economic growth. It also plays an important role in the survival of any company, its competitive advantage, contributes positively in firm value, and stock return. Furthermore, famous business experts suggest that top managers contribute primarily to formulating the useful innovation framework. However, some other experts highlighted that a firm's internal environment and corporate culture are essential for innovation induced work environment. It is irrefutable that both firm and managerial characteristics are required to tempt firm-level innovation (Galasso and Simcoe, 2011). Moreover, a manager's traits (i.e., level of confidence/overconfidence) are some of the substantial factors that engage them in innovative projects.

data.projectName: The Effects of Ehsaas Emergency Cash Transfers on Food Intake, COVID 19 inflicted unemployment and Poverty in Rural Sindh, Pakistan
data.piUniversity: Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University Shaheed, Benazirabad
data.projectDigest: The goal of Social Safety Nets “Ehsaas Emergency Cash Programme” is to ensure a minimum “stable living standard” for the marginalized, which is a segment of sustainable development goals (SDGs).  During the last decade the facts and figures of multidimensional poverty index, poverty intensity, and poverty incidence put the question mark on the rural population of Sindh. In 2016, the United Nation reported that around 75 percent population of rural Sindh is living below the poverty line and categorise as the second poorest province among all provinces/regions of Pakistan.  In April 2020, the government of Pakistan take initiative for the Ehsaas Emergency Cash Programme (extension of BISP) to stabilize the income of the poor people and tried to pull them from the poverty circle. It is significant for consumption smoothing and pulls the poor from the poverty circle in unexceptional conditions i.e., COVID-19. As emergency cash transfer was a response to COVID 19 inflicted unemployment and extreme distress. An exercise is going to be made to achieve such goals: 1) to investigate the impact of cash transfers on household consumption, how the cash transfers increase the expenditures pattern of households?; (2) to analyze the household consumption pattern and household’s poverty trend through cash transfer; (3) to check, how this program was touching during COVID 19 inflicted unemployment and extreme distress

data.projectName: Paper Recycling: An Entrepreneurial and Environmental Perspective
data.piUniversity: University of Malakand, Chakdara, Dir, Malakand
data.projectDigest:
As for Pakistan, presently 89 paper recycling companies are operating, but there is a shortage of suppliers in the country and are therefore waste materials are imported from abroad. People from different fields as well as different non-government organizations have taken different initiatives and have come up with innovative solutions to deal with enormous amount of waste produced in Pakistan. However, the size and scope of this informal sector of waste collection is too limited to provide sufficient recyclable waste paper for the industry in Pakistan.

To deal with the aforementioned issues, our proposed project aims to create awareness about the impact of paper waste on our lives, economy and the environment, to encourage reduction of paper wastage, and to initiate a waste paper collection system in education institutions. This will increase the supply for waste paper for excess paper recycling capacity in the country and at the same time create new jobs in this sector. The project will also aim to encourage further investment in the sector by involving local entrepreneurs, and different organizations in the process of paper recycling. Simultaneous research will also be carried out along with the project on three main themes: The Socio-economic and environmental impact of waste management; The attitude of different sectors of society towards waste management, and; Problems and opportunities in paper waste management.

data.projectName: Mushroom cultivation as a cottage industry
data.piUniversity: University of Malakand, Chakdara, Dir, Malakand
data.projectDigest: With the passage of time, agriculture land is decreasing due to ever-growing population in Pakistan. In order to sustain our production and make our country self-sufficient in food, we should adopt new technologies to increase food production. In this regard, Oyster (Pleurotus ostreatus) mushroom also known as tree mushrooms are a kind of fungi which can be cultivated indoor in limited resources with low input and high output. Oyster mushroom is easy to cultivate in home requiring pasteurized compost containing a proper amount of lime and rice or wheat boosa. Spawn will be added in the pasteurized compost and will be kept in a room having 25 - 28?C temperature and above 60% humidity. After a few days of incubation, mushrooms will be grown from the plastic bags filled with compost. This process will be teach in workshops which will be arranged in various villages of Malakand division. In addition, spawn will also be provided to the peoples who will attend workshop. In this way, we can create a mushroom market in the local area for local people. It will not only increase their income, but will also improve their health because mushroom are rich in protein. Overall, it will reduce the unemployment and food insecurity of Pakistan.  In addition, research will also be conducted on other kinds of edible mushrooms

data.projectName: 5G Integrated UAV Base Stations for Disaster Area Coverage
data.projectDigest: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), commonly known as drones, are becoming popular in military and civil industry because of their utmost use in surveillance and reconnaissance in such places where coverage using manned flight is either difficult or risky. In today’s world of modern technology, researchers are working to integrate UAVs into communication infrastructure for covering remote environments like disaster areas. Recently 5th Generation 5G communication has been introduced and reason for using 5G in this project is that it allows high network speed, low delays, and ultra-reliable communication. In remote environments like disaster areas, especially in case of earthquakes and massive floods, where the communication infrastructure gets completely toppled, it is nearly impossible to develop reliable communication. So, in such situations, an effective solution is proposed in this project, i,.e., development of 5G integrated drone stations that can provide ultrareliable-communication network by providing not only calling services but also reliable and fast data services to the affected users especially to the search and rescue teams in the area.

data.projectName: Development of Multimode Biosensor Arrays for the Detection of Cardiac Biomarkers
data.piUniversity: Karakurum International University, Gilgit, Gilgit Baltistan
data.projectDigest: Cardiac ailments lead among death leading diseases and affect a major proportion of world’s population every year.  The life losses due to cardiac problems are almost 30 % of total deaths /year in the world. According to WHO almost 75 % of world population lack access to modern health facilities tumbling around poverty line. In addition, diagnosis and medication for heart problems is quite expensive to afford for a common man especially in the developing countries where health incentives are not ensured. data.projectName: Relationship between Heat Shock Proteins and environmental stress conditions, its impact on long-life
data.projectDigest: The lifespan of human being is vital not only for individuals but for a community as well. Different strategies are going to be applied to increase the mean life. However, variations in lifespan vary to a great extent from region to region. All the longevity genes identified so far have primary roles in other physiological processes. Pathways of long-life involve Insulin/insulin-like protein and proteins critical for cellular growth, like heat shock proteins (HSPs). Hence, longevity mainly results from avoiding infectious diseases and no severe early onset of genetic diseases. In this light, we are going to pursue a genomic study of longevity individuals from Pashtun ethnic group of KP and Chitral as an initial step with emphasis on mitochondrial genome and heat shock proteins. We are strongly hopeful that by characterizing the said population, we will have more chances of better understanding the genetic basis of longevity and of heat shock protein. Moreover, from environmental point of view, the two ethnic groups (Pashtun in southern belt and people of Chitral) live at the extremes. In southern belt of KP, the temperature reaches 50°C during the months of June, July and August but there is little cold during the months of November, December and January. But in contrast, the temperature remains very low for the months of November to February in Chitral and 18°C to 25°C for the months of May to August. We will hence, attempt to explore that what are the genetic factors responsible for protecting against age-associated disease in longevity individuals. Toward this end, we will perform whole-genome sequencing and compare their genetic characteristics to normal individuals having the age of 45 to 70 years and in athletes of southern belt of the corresponding ethnic groups

data.projectName: Dates drying unit for Layyah District using embedded systems
data.projectDigest:
Pakistan is producing about 700,000 metric tons (MT) of dates annually out of which only 86,000 tons are exported and the rest either consumed locally or spoiled due to obsolete dates processing and storage methods in Pakistan. Pakistan is the only country in South Asia to produce dates on commercial basis. Due to lack of technology in dates drying methods most of dates could not get properly dried and the quality suffers drastically. Thus, Pakistan could hardly export Choharas (Dried Dates) to India and Sri Lanka due to outdated processing plants in Pakistan. Pakistan is the third largest country in the world that is producing dates, but economy and exports say otherwise due to lack of usage of latest industrial methods. Thus, our objective is to make a date processing plant, which comprises of dates washing, air dryer machine and solar dryer system. In order to achieve our goals, we have identified the following modules of this project.

Module 1: Design 
Module 2: Dates Washing Machine
Module 3: Dates Cleaning Machine
Module 4: Dates Drying 
a)	Air Drying Machine
b)	Solar Dryer

For dates drying we will be investigating two methods, due to the lack of electricity in dates producing areas, we will also work on solar dryer to dry dates, concurrently.

data.projectName: The factors promoting the rural women Entrepreneurship in Punjab: Community Development and Poverty Alleviation Perspective
data.projectDigest: Women entrepreneurship is becoming popular in Pakistan. There can be a great role of women entrepreneurship in economic development because it is helpful in fostering the small business sector. The majority of the women entrepreneurs belong to the urban areas, whereas rural women entrepreneurship growth is very low in Punjab. This research will explore the factors which may trigger the rural women entrepreneurship growth in Punjab. This research will study the effect of gender-related factors such as women perceived access to resources, gender stereotype, egalitarian attitudes toward women, perceived advantages of being a woman and women's rights awareness on rural women entrepreneurship growth in Punjab. Furthermore, this study will investigate the role of governmental support, social support in the development of rural women entrepreneurship growth. The research will also explore the effect social factors such as environmental turbulence, relational and structural social capital on rural women entrepreneurship growth. This study also aimed to understand the effect of general educational level, vocational training, entrepreneurship education, gender-sensitive entrepreneurship education and peer mentoring programs on rural women entrepreneurship growth.  By conducting a longitudinal study, we will examine the effect of women's entrepreneurial intention on entrepreneurship growth, poverty alleviation, and rural community development.
