data.projectName: A novel interactive livestock disease surveillance & diagnostic digital Platform for farmer advice in Pakistan.
data.piUniversity: Pir Mehr Ali Shah Arid Agriculture, University Rawalpindi
data.projectDigest: The livestock sector plays very important economic and socio-cultural roles for the wellbeing of rural households in Pakistan. The livestock industry still remains neglected and underdeveloped when compared to its full socio-economic potential. In this context, advanced, reliable, low cost digital methods are needed to evaluate the effect of the prevention of endemic animal diseases on the productivity of livestock production systems. The use of symptom animations reduces the complexity and interaction time necessary for vets to get an initial view of symptoms from afar. This is thanks to simple smart phone based conceptual animations system (Dairyexpert) which explain symptoms in local language so farmers can quickly grasp what they're looking for. The system will then also automatically ask if the farmer has seen a number of other related symptoms to help differentiate diseases before passing this data to the vet. Vets can then request further information from the standard (but large) symptom database or ask adlib questions. The vets can then decide whether to send a prescription or follow another course of action such as sending an animal health worker to collect samples or travelling to site for a face to face assessment. This can be highly beneficial diagnosis and early treatment model for the farmers who are living in remote area or have very little or no access to professional veterinarians.

data.projectName: Development of phytogenic prebiotics to produce economical, safe and health poultry products
data.projectDigest: Poultry industry is at high risk of infectious diseases, caused by different microbes. Antibiotics are frequently used as feed additives since last decades. The use of antibiotics as feed premix is restricted due to emergence of bacterial resistance and altering natural gut microbiota and drug residues in the final product. This restriction on the use of antibiotics has encouraged the use of other natural alternative substances like probiotic, prebiotic, symbiotic, plant extracts and enzymes having  least or no side effect on birds performance and poultry products  produced.  Garlic (Allium sativum) for many years is used as natural remedy by possessing varying properties like antioxidant, antiviral, antibacterial, anti-parasitic, anti-cancerous, anti-cholesteremic, anti-fungal. Red chilli help in the reduction of heat stress as it is rich source of vitamin C, improve the production performance of birds.  Onion has  significant role in increasing the concentration of useful microbes in the intestine. In the proposed proposal, we will evaluate different combinations of onion, garlic and chilli extracts for their efficacy as growth promotor, immunomodulator and antimicrobial activity.  Successful completion of the project will lead to the  development of herbal prebiotics, which will enable us to produce hygienic, safe and economical poultry products.

The local industrial revolution not only minimize the national reserve of import product cost but will also strengthen the local job and motivate the researchers as well industry to strengthen the  future collaboration.

data.projectName: Smart Surgical Suture Attachment Force Measurement Device
data.piUniversity: NED University of Engineering & Technology, Karachi
data.projectDigest: In developing countries with greater population like Pakistan, it is a big challenge to provide assured quality controlled surgical needles to well-trained surgeons. There are around 117 medical colleges, 1169 big hospitals and thousands of small-scale hospitals in the country performing major/minor surgeries. In order to check the quality of needle, the common conventional practice is to penetrate the needle manually into a thick card paper 15-20 times. Recently, few global companies have introduced reliable testing solutions based on the standard force measuring meters described in further section. Due to high cost of the developed solutions, most of the local medical entities are unable to utilize it thereby needing a cheaper in-house solution for quality assurance. The proposed product has been recently accepted for publication in IEEE transactions on instrumentation and measurements (Top Journal worldwide in Instrumentation and Measurement). In addition, a very strong and high-profile industrial partner Zauq International has committed the amount of Rs. 17,655,000/- for the said project in two years.

data.projectName: Blockchain and Industrial IoT Enabled Intelligent Supply Chain System: A Value Addition in Textile Industry
data.projectDigest: Currently, Pakistan’s textile industry is in a race to sell its product in international markets. However, they are facing challenges like traceability, transparency, and sustainability, thus losing their value against competitors in the International consumer market. The objective of this research project is to design and develop a cloud service for Traceability, Transparency, and Intelligent Supply Chain Management System in Pakistan’s Textile Industry. The project makes use of IoT, Artificial Intelligence, and Blockchain technologies to serve as a value addition to the textile product manufacturing. The project includes the use of RFIDs, consortium blockchain, and algorithms for intelligent smart contracts. The designed algorithms will create a physical-digital link between textile goods and their digital cryptographic identities on the blockchain. The project is a joint collaborative project including the Department of Computer Science, University of Agriculture-Faisalabad, National Textile University-Faisalabad, Masood Textile Mills Limited, Faisalabad, and Beacon Impex (Pvt) Limited, Faisalabad. The RFIDs will be deployed in Masood Textile Mills Limited, Faisalabad to collect data regarding manufacturing and garments product quality. The supply chain analysis, optimization, and evaluation will be carried out by National Textile University, Faisalabad. The algorithms regarding intelligent smart contracts will be designed and developed by the Department of Computer Science, University of Agriculture, Faisalabad. The smart contracts testing, verification, and validation will be done by Beacon Impex (Pvt) Limited, Faisalabad. The intelligent smart contracts will be deployed in Blockchain cloud services using the popular open-source framework Hyperledger Fabric. The patent filing and commercializing of the service will be carried out in collaboration with the University of Huddersfield, UK. The cloud deployment will provide a cost-effective, immutable, and verifiable solution to the industry. Further, it will allow multiple parties in the business ecosystem to transact without a trusted central authority in a decentralized and transparent manner.

data.projectName: Rapid Histamine Method For Seafood analysis
data.projectDigest:
Fish is among the most popular food consumed in the world. It generates billions of dollars of foreign
revenue for many nations. Fisheries are been cultured throughout the year all over the world. In Pakistan,
Mari culture is at its earlier stages. With profit and loss in balance, there is some successful harvesting
from shrimp ponds of, Sindh. The Shrimp and aquaculture business is booming because of its decreased
harvesting time and increased revenue in terms of foreign exchange. If these ponds are maintained and
meat checked for chemicals. The product can clear customs internationally and be sold as a grade A
product. Histamine, is one of the biogenic amines, has been known as the causative toxin of scombroid
fish poisoning in human. Scombroid fish poisoning is usually a mild illness with a variety of symptoms. The
severity of the symptoms can vary considerably with the amount of histamine ingested and the
individual’s sensitivity to histamine. The main object of this project is to establish a commercial laboratory
test at industrial level of detecting histamine levels in a cost effective manner in shortest period of time.
The project will address SDG2 (no hunger), 3 (good health), 9 (Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure) 12
(Responsible consumption) and 14 (life below water). The primary objective is to determine histamine
levels of Fresh and processed seafood. A fit for consumption seafood addresses all above mentioned SDG.
The team includes marine biologist, microbiologist for lab testing, molecular biologist for residual testing
and biochemist for optimization of procedure. The Industrial partner will provide us in kind the resources
and workbench and samples to test our technique on bulk packages.

data.projectName: To Develop and Install a Prototype Bio Gas Digester
data.piUniversity: Karakurum International University, Gilgit, Gilgit Baltistan
data.projectDigest:
Due to increase in population, both developed and developing countries are facing issues mainly surrounding the future energy security and a better use of natural resources[1]. The world is going to pose threat to human beings due to global warming, climate change and environmental concerns[2]. So, in this perspective, Karakoram International University has established “Center for renewable energy and appropriate technology”. This research center is fully equipped with lab facility and technical and qualified team. Furthermore, the research center is focusing on energy resources, energy management, and energy generation. The design prototype will provide methane gas for domestic use and electrical city generation. After successful installation of this prototype it will be extended to other district of GB and will be prepared as per demand of government, NGOs and, communities and individuals as well as to entire country to meet the existing energy crises. The people of GB have no sui gas facility and wood is used as domestic fuel which causes deforestation. So, this prototype will produce 574.459 lbs./day bio gas which supports to prevent deforestation in region and will provide sufficient fuel for domestic and industrial usage. 
The Objective of Proposed Project 
(I) To manufacture a prototype bio gas digester, of desired capacity (II) To install it at KIU (III) To provide approximately 574.459lbs/day of bio gas for KIU utilization (IV)After the successful trial of the plant, to manufacture plants of various capacity as per demand of the government, NGOs, communities and individuals. data.projectName: Development of Indigenous Grass Pelletizer Machine
data.piUniversity: Mehran University of Engineering & Technology, Jamshoro
data.projectDigest:
The aim of this project is to design and develop an indigenous grass pelletizer machine which would support the compaction and preservation of Leptochola Fusca which is an alternative fodder for livestock. Leptochola Fusca has competitive advantage over traditional fodder (wheat Straw) due to its tolerance of saline and alkaline soils. The development of the proposed machine would encourage not only use of low cost fodder for livestock but also cultivation in saline soils thus improving and reclaiming the land.   
Commonly wheat straw is used as primary fodder for live stocks, however, its nutritional value low and cost of usage is higher. Presently no other alternative is available to the livestock holders. Research shows that as a fodder Leptochola Fusca is better option as compared to wheat straw. Additional benefit of cultivation of Leptochola Fusca is treatment of saline soils

data.projectName: Data Mining based Cancer Diagnosis System
data.projectDigest: The proposed research focusses on decreasing the ratio of deaths due to cancer by early stages diagnosis. Our aim is to diagnose and predict cancer in the human body from multiple datasets including MRI, CT Scans, PET Scans, and pathology data in order to minimize the time, cost and doctor’s efforts in decision making. The project is divided into two phases broadly 1) application of image processing techniques to identify and extract valuable features from the test images, 2) application of data mining techniques to derive variable and values for accurate diagnosis. We will also transform the data produced during tests of different forms (textual, conventional and images) in one uniform set so that the information can easily be analyzed and used for diagnosis purpose. The proposed methodology will contribute to the Body of Knowledge of Data Mining/ Big Data and Medical Image Processing, data integration in shared or distributed databases.

data.projectName: Development and commercialization of ready to use qPCR kit for detection of COVID-19
data.piUniversity: Pakistan Institute of Engineering & Applied Sciences, Islamabad (PIEAS)
data.projectDigest:
Under current pandemic of COVID-19 National Institute for Biotechnology and Genetic Engineering (NIBGE)- collage PIAES takes up the challenge and mobilizes the scientist to indigenously develop the qPCR-based testing kit for the diagnosis of SARS-COV-2 (COVID-19). This kit passes all the parameters of comparison with internationally available kits. This kit is multiplexed, can amplify three targets in a single well at the same time. These three targets include two viral-specific targets (E gene and RdRP gene) and one human-specific target (RNase P gene) acting as an internal control. The cost of this kit is less than half of the available kits. The case for approval of the kit is under process in the Drug regulatory authority of Pakistan (DRAP). Moreover, patent filing is also in process.
In this project, a multifaceted approach is proposed to transfer the developed technology to the Sectoral Partner for its application for SARS-COV-2 diagnosis. This involves the promotion, marketing, advertisement, commercialization, and application of the developed technology through a sectoral partner (Al-Technique Corporation of Pakistan Limited ;ATCOP). Finally, the developed technology will be fully transferred to the Industrial partner for its large-scale application in the country.

data.projectName: Treatment of Waste from Waste: Development of Cost Effective Biotechnological Process To Degrade Textile Dyes Waste From Bio waste.
data.projectDigest:
Textile industries are one of the major cause of environmental pollution due to release of textile wastewater in environment, which pollutes the aquatic environment. The major constituent of waste water is color pollutant or dyes which contain lethal amines, heavy metals, bleaching agent, phenols, etc.  These dyes are highly toxic for aquatic life and cause life threating biological changes and water source will not remain fit for human consumption. 
Therefore, Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) is responsible to monitor implementation of environmental laws by forcing textile industries to treat these effluents before discharge into the receiving watercourses.  
In this project, cheapest biotechnological process will be developed to treat textile waste to decolorize dyes with help of bio waste sources for the first time. This process will be based on the extraction of polyphenol oxidase enzyme (PPOs) from fruits and vegetables waste materials. PPOs oxidize colour with the help of molecular oxygen and will treat dyes by converting into nontoxic effluent. This process will be transferred to industries after completing the project by providing cheapest alternate solution to treat wastewater before discharge and hence overall project will enable to protect environment by lowering the burden of pollution.

data.projectName: Seismic Capacity Assessment of Textile Fiber Reinforced Infilled Walls in Reinforced Concrete Structures: A step Towards Affordable Housing
data.projectDigest:
Affordable housing and the environmental hazards of waste materials, triggered the attention of researchers towards the use of textile material in construction industry. The textile industry and post-consumer products are disposed worldwide in a large scale. The utilization of these wastes in construction industry will not only mitigate the environmental toxicity but will also reduce the consumption of energy, by thermal insulation of fibrous wall panels installed in frame structures.   
In this project locally available textile fibers will be sandwiched between lightweight concrete surfaces to make it easy for transporting and handling. This new composite material will have a direct impact on the nation economy because the textile product and waste will be more utilized in construction industry than before. The use of such composite material will put a positive impact on the life style of a common man and country economy in respect of industrial and constructional development.
This project aims at addressing the challenges in the construction industry, regarding cost effective construction and utilization of textile wastes and/or cheap fibers. This project will encourage the local builders and structural expertise to utilize the local resources to boost the country economy.

data.projectName: Manufacturing of Fuel Briquette from Municipal Waste
data.projectDigest:
Amongst other problems, cleanness and waste management are the biggest problems of Karachi. According to media reports, streets in Karachi are filled with garbage. The main challenge is not only to collect the garbage but disposed-off it properly. Almost 10% of total pollution of Pakistan live in this city. Considering these facts, we are planning to start our work from Karachi. Our proposal would not only help in decreasing garbage but also a new source of fuel can be introduced. 
According to authors’ knowledge, manufacturing of fuel briquettes using municipal waste will be carried for the first time in Pakistan. This innovation can have outstanding impact on the society due to low cost of fuel briquettes as compared with wood and charcoal. Also, fuel briquettes expected to have less environment gradation effects due to low rate of carbon dioxide emission as compared with wood and charcoal. Furthermore, as technology is proved, the required investment to start a fuel briquette business is expected to come down as well.
Also, it can be scaled up to other locations of Pakistan especially to places where biomass is easily available. Farmers can use their biomass waste to convert it into fuel or a commodity to be sold. They usually burn their waste, because it consumes lots of capacity and direct burning cause environmental problems. This idea would not only solve the problem of disposing off biomass but also produces a new source of income for farmers and entrepreneurs. Also, it would create new opportunities for unemployed people for a new source of income.

data.projectName: Design & Development  of Small Scale Wind Turbine Testing Setup  under Varying Turbulence Intensity and Unsteady Wind Conditions
data.piUniversity: Mehran University of Engineering & Technology, Jamshoro
data.projectDigest: The proposed project aims at designing and developing a low speed wind tunnel for the testing of small scale wind turbines. The proposed tunnel shall be used for testing different configuration of both the Horizontal Axis Wind Turbine (HAWT) and the Vertical Axis Wind Turbine (VAWTs).  The wind tunnel will be capable of producing unsteady wind at different freestream velocity values as well as could generate varying turbulence intensity winds at all the operating wind speed values. The anticipated wind tunnel is expected to provide real world field environment which would enable researchers in future to accurately predict the turbine realistic performance and evaluate new design in real world environment. Since wind turbines has to operate within Atmospheric Boundary Layer (ABL) which is highly turbulent in nature. Additionally, the data acquisition and recording systems are also required to be installed in order to accurately predict the transient response of the turbine. In order to evaluate wind tunnel design capabilities straight blade VAWT will be fabricated and tested to validate turbine testing setup performance with published literature.

data.projectName: Cost-effective Production of Anti-Malarial Drug Artemisinin and its Analogues from Cell Suspension Cultures of Artemisia annua
data.projectDigest: Malaria is one of the most prevailing diseases which effects around 214 million people globally as estimated by the WHO (World Health Organization). Artemisia species are the only source of anti-malarial drug artemisinin. However, the natural yield of this compounds is unfortunately very low (approximately 0.1 to 0.5 % of dry weight). Furthermore, artemisinin also possess complex chirality that makes its total synthesis, and even semi-synthesis not very convenient on the industrial scales due to expensive approach. The trace level natural occurrence, and the need of toxic and expensive chemicals in synthetic strategies have directed the research efforts towards the green approaches for its production. Hence, in context of effective malarial treatment there is an urgent need to establish biotechnologically driven alternative approaches for the increased production of artemisinin. At present, a number of approaches have been applied to improve its production rates by using bioprocessing procedures, e.g., hairy roots, calli, tissue and organ, plant cell suspension cultures. For this purpose, using cultures of Artemisia annua e.g., hairy roots, callus, and cell suspensions will be used as primary source. This is an eco-friendly approach for the production of plant-derived pharmaceuticals on large scales at competitive prices to meet the needs of people suffering from various ailments.

data.projectName: Smart IOT Based Low-Cost hybrid PV/Utility Powered Automated Irrigation Water Pumping System for Rural Agricultural Areas
data.projectDigest: Power crisis in Pakistan not only affected the revenue generation of farmer but also the relevant country exports with massive negative impact on Country GDP, accompanying increase in unemployment. Nearly half of the Pakistan labor force are related to Agriculture industry.  Beside, agriculture 24% contribution in GDP, country 68% population that resides in rural areas earn their livelihood from agricultural industry directly or indirectly. There are 23 million hectares agriculture land in the country, in which 83% (19 Million Acres) land is irrigated. To address the energy crisis issue in the agriculture sector some farmers/landlords on their own shifted towards solar water pumps (SWPs) that resulted in their high income and doubling the agriculture productivity. By seeing them earning more, most of the neighboring farmers are taking high interest in shifting to this technology. However, due to the high initial cost of SWPs, farmers in large proportion are not ready to shift to this technology. Further, it is no secret that 70% of the Pakistan and large proportion of the world farmer is a small-scale farmer with nominal income. Any innovation that can help in reducing the upfront cost of the SWPs could be a game changer for them.  This research proposal is an effort to address both energy crisis and the high upfront cost issues on SWPs for all levels of farmers.

data.projectName: Cotton productivity enhancement by the control of Cotton leaf curl disease through a novel approach “program cell death”.
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest: Cotton is an important cash crop of Pakistan. Accounting for 0.8% of the total Gross Domestic Production (GDP), and it is considered the lifeline of Pakistan’s economy. Pakistan has suffered a decline of 17.5% in cotton production during 2019, and 6.9% in 2020. These losses are mainly due to the cotton leaf curl disease (CLCuD). Considerable efforts have been employed to develop resistance against CLCuD. However, progress is slow because 1) out of seven genes, of the cotton virus and its satellite, five are silencing suppressor (Rep, TrAP, C4, V2, and ßC1) and 2) the steadily changing virus population. Consequently, virus control in the field is largely achieved through insecticide applications with all adverse effects on the environment and human health. The proposed project is designed to employ an innovative approach to abate CLCuV by the expression of a modified satellite component of CLCuV that induces plant cell death (PCD) in cells immediately upon virus infection. Since all the CLCuVs interact with single betasatellite,  the PCD approach utilizes the betasatellite and cotton genome-specific gene for PCD, hence the PCD approach is advantageous in the following ways 1) It would avoid the gene silencing problems encounters by viral silencing suppressors. 2). It is applicable not only for one virus but for all the cotton infecting viruses. 3) It will provide resistance against the newly emerged viruses.

data.projectName: End-to-end, Low-cost and Sustainable Solar-based Electrification with Peer-to-Peer Sharing for 1 billion Unelectrified People Worldwide
data.piUniversity: Lahore University of Management Sciences (LUMS), Lahore
data.projectDigest: Access to electricity is key in improving the socio-economic standing of communities. Unfortunately, approx. 1 billion people worldwide and over 50 million in Pakistan have no access to electricity! Electricity provision through national grids is unviable for many of these regions due to infrastructural, generation and cost constraints. The need of the hour is to electrify these offgrid communities through renewables based innovative solution so that they are able to improve their socioeconomic standing and help the GDP of the country. In line with this rationale, this project proposes a) an indigenous development and b) actual field deployment of the proposed electrification solution based on peer-to-peer sharing of electricity through low-cost infrastructure. The integration/aggregation of solar generation in individual rural houses will be used for community applications (water filtration, pumping, school, health units etc.) on need-basis or in predefined scenarios. This will create/enable electricity markets in rural community (a novel concept within offgrid electrification). Smarts will be built on a communication layer which oversees the local solar generation, local storage, entire bi-directional exchange of energy, and thresholds the power usage at each house as per designed power sharing policy.

data.projectName: Bringing Artificial Intelligence to Low-Cost Smart Irrigation System:?????
data.piUniversity: Lahore University of Management Sciences (LUMS), Lahore
data.projectDigest: Pakistan is one of the most water-stressed countries, ranking 14 in the list of countries with extremely high water stress, where agriculture consumes nearly 70% of all water. However, rapid urbanization and industrialization are competing with agriculture sector in the demand for water. Urbanization is pushing an extraordinary increase in water consumption due to daily human activities (sanitation, cleaning, gardening, cooking, drinking etc.). It is putting an enormous pressure on underground water aquifer, energy resources to pump the water, and financial capabilities of the government agencies to keep the system functional and sustainable. To cope with the increasing future water challenges, water mismanagement for domestic usage should be controlled along with several other bigger measures which require an alteration in course of thinking. Towards this end, in this project, we propose to bring our prototype solution for efficient water management for small scale horticultural applications such as lawns, gardens and farms of individual domestic households, to the market. Our developed prototype, a smart water management solution, utilizes the concept of internet of things (IoT) infrastructure to optimize the water usage for gardening and small scale farming. With the proposed project, we aim to increase the functionality of our sensing and controlling nodes by incorporating various sensing, communication, and computation capabilities, with the goal to make it a futuristic product to save water and promote sustainable practices in domestic household water usage, for the local market. More specifically, in the proposed project, we aim to: (a) develop a minimum viable product (MVP) using our prototype, (b) optimize the MVP design by bringing advances in artificial intelligence and machine learning for its sensing, communication and computing capabilities into a final design product, (c) outline the pathways for the mass production of the final product, and (d) secure the local vendor supply chain for parts delivery and product sustainability.

data.projectName: AI based Non-Invasive Diabetes Classification and Atrial Fibrillation Detection
data.projectDigest: Diabetes and atrial fibrillation are two of the silent killers that remain undetected for a long time. A common cause for the two diseases is obesity which has become quire prevalent due to lifestyle issues. Lately Type II diabetes has become very common globally and in Pakistan its prevalence has reached 17.1%, with 19 million people suffering from it in 2019 as per the IDF Diabetes Atlas 9th Edition report. Also, 0.5 percent of the world population suffers from atrial fibrillation according to Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). Our goal is to develop a smart phone application which will capture the video using built-in camera, generate the PPG signals, and classify the diabetic patients and initial cardiac abnormalities which may cause severe heart problems. This app will be freely available 24/7 in all rural and urban areas. Our aim is to assist doctors and patients in a non-invasive manner at early stages to alarm them.  A well reputed industrial partner will coordinate during the whole project lifetime and will help in algorithm development and embedded implementation to produce the final prototype. In commercialization phase, our industrial partner will contribute in building public trustworthiness and market share.

data.projectName: Strabismus and Squint Analysis using Hess Screening System
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest:
Hess screening system is used to test eye squint and strabismus to identify eye muscles, which are responsible for squint. Traditional screening systems includes a Hess screen and manually marking of points on Hess graph by the doctors, which takes 25-30 min. We have revolutionized the concept of Hess screening by introducing a computer supported system, which is operated in two modes. In manual mode, it operates just like traditional systems. However in new computer supported mode, the screen is controlled from computer software and operator directly marks points in software and once he is done with marking, the Hess graph is created on single click. The operational time is reduced from 25-30 min to 8-10 min only. Our product would include Hess screen and the associated Artificial Intelligence software. The main features are
•	With easy editing, auto graphing and reporting capabilities, it dramatically reduces time and effort and ensures pin point accuracy.
•	Digitally store and retrieve patient test reports  without the hassle of tracking them manually.
•	Equipped with report printing and exporting to ready share portable document format it provides an easy and cost-effective solution without compromising on quality and reliability.
•	Algorithms for automated analysis of squint and highlighting problematic areas

data.projectName: IOT based Health Monitoring of Distribution Power Transformer
data.piUniversity: Ghulam Ishaq Khan Institute of Engineering Sciences & Technology, Topi
data.projectDigest: Electrical Transformers are the machines from our electricity providers which converts the high voltage main line to our domestic voltage levels. If it fails to work the entire power system will be shut down before the specialist authorities come to replace it. Preventive maintenance and health monitoring systems diagnoses the problems before hand and does not let the transformer fail. The authorities can continuously get the data and warnings at their offices through IOT and if there are some indication which can cause failure they can reach the transformer and repair it along with a replacement rather than receiving complaints from the residents and following long bureaucratic queues.  This system will be installed with each transformer and it will measure all the important aspects of transformer and transfer these to the technical authorities. If something goes out of a range the authorities can fix it before the transformer is failed and undergoes a replacement or costly maintenance. In this way smooth service of electricity is ensured and life of transformers is increased. Additionally it avoids problems like fires or damages to neighborhood as the stated design enables the transformer to be shut down remotely. The commercialization will allow the government authorities, distribution companies and residential societies to have a ready to use system on a cheaper rate while the companies and housing societies can also use it for smooth operation of electricity distribution.

data.projectName: Pakistan Adaptive Examination System
data.piUniversity: Sir Syed (CASE) Institute of Technology, Islamabad
data.projectDigest:
Education is the corner stone of development in any society. In developed countries, there is always an emphasis on the improvement in the methods to impart education. Sadly, in Pakistan, a developing country, this sector has been neglected by the previous governments. Due to which, the methods to impart education and evaluation are still archaic. However, in the recent years there has been some effort for the betterment of this sector but much is left to be done.  
In reference to the challenges, highlighted above, we intend to develop a software system that will be instrumental in assessment and evaluation of students and highlight their individual needs in terms of subject matter. This will not only relieve stakeholders (teachers, admin, students) from sizeable workload but also provide solid foundation to students to build better understanding of their subject matter. This will in turn increase the efficiency of overall education sector. 
Commercially speaking a smart/intelligent assessment & evaluation of students will attract a lot of attention from potential customers. As far as potential customers are concerned, multitude of schools, colleges, universities and training institutes both in private and public sector are potential customers of this product. 
In terms of benefit to society, this product has the potential to improve quality of education by the identification of strength and weaknesses of students. This will allow the students to make smart identification of career fields based on their area of interest. Further to this, a software solution that can manage bulk of processes related to examination and quizzes will result in significant cost savings and personnel management.
In reference to activities to be undertaken for this project, it is intended to conduct market surveys, which will include Teachers’/students’ feedback on current practices along with suggestions of improvement, especially concerning the product design and front-end interface. We also intend to study practices being followed in developed countries educational institutions. We further intend to analyze challenges, concerning intelligent/smart product development and the adoptions.
Commercial partners will come in very useful in this regard. Their role will include setting targets for commercialization, share blended/interactive technology experiences, provision of education related devices and tools. They will also be instrumental in above mentioned research and studies.

data.projectName: Nanoparticle-based surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy protocols for quality control analysis in pharmaceutical industry
data.projectDigest: In the proposed research project, the technology based on use of Raman spectroscopy and Surface Enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SERS), using silver NPs as SERS substrates, will be demonstrated to the industrial partner, a pharmaceutical industry, for rapid, nondestructive and cost effective analysis of the solid dosage forms of different pharmaceutical formulations. For this purpose, the antibiotics including Ciprofloxacin, levofloxacin and antidiabetic drug Glimepiride are selected after discussion with our industrial partner as these are being produced/formulated in their industrial units. Moreover, comparison of these results with the results from HPLC technique (performed in the industry), a gold standard technique of the pharmaceutical industry, will further help to prove to the industrial partner that Raman spectroscopy can be employed as an alternative or supporting technique for the rapid and cost effective qualitative and quantitative analysis of the pharmaceuticals. The relatively less cost of the Raman spectroscopy instrument as compared to High Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC) is the key point for the industry to be consider the earlier as an alternative technique for the rapid and cost effective analysis of the pharmaceuticals. Moreover, Raman spectroscopy is very useful for the analysis of the combination therapies consisting of more than one type of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) while HPLC will require to separate them or to develop specific method for the detection and quantification of each individual API. Reducing the cost of the analysis can lead to reduce the prices of the pharmaceuticals and will have positive impact on the economy of the country.

data.projectName: WHO Prequalification of Levofloxacin 750 mg film coated tablets and 100  mg dispersible tablets for TB Patients in Pakistan & Beyond
data.projectDigest:
The approaches currently being used in the industry are not in-line with the global development processes and require innovative approach towards product development of generics to be acceptable to global level. Tuberculosis (TB) is considered the disease of the poor and Pakistan ranks globally 5th among the 30 highest-TB burden countries globally with one of the highest incidences of MDR TB in the world. . Studies suggest an estimated 100,000 TB cases go unreported in the country annually. According to the current policy recommendations on treatment and care for drug-resistant TB, Levofloxacin should be included in the treatment of MDR/RR-TB patients on longer regimens (WHO Global TB Programme).
This project aims at  deploying  global innovative approaches towards the development of an anti Tuberculosis (anti-TB) drug. This provides dual benefits of introducing this approach along with the local & international availability of Pakistani products with established quality, safety and efficacy acceptable to the stringent regulatory authorities.
To support national and global efforts to increase access to and the affordability of care and treatment of tuberculosis, WHO, together with UNICEF, UNAIDS and UNITAID, invites manufacturers of selected pharmaceutical products to submit Expressions of Interest (EOIs) for product evaluation.

data.projectName: IoT based smart central control system for nutrient management in hydroponic agriculture
data.piUniversity: National University of Modern Languages, Islamabad (NUML)
data.projectDigest: Hydroponics is a subset of hydroculture, which is the growing of plants in a soil less medium, or an aquatic based environment. Hydroponic growing does not use soil but instead uses mineral nutrient solutions in water to feed the plants. These nutrients are supplied to the roots in a solution that can either be flowing or stationary. By using hydroponic you can lessen the amount of water a plant requires and also the labor when compared to traditional farming.  we propose a self-regulating food growing system is a solution that will let humans grow any crop in soil less (Hydroponics) hostile environment. The system will consist of several different things to achieve its goal. Some of the things such as sensors will be used to measure temperature, humidity in the air etc. The system will also have a self-regulated irrigation system, artificial light. This system will utilize all the sensors and every other technological device to produce healthy crops anytime anywhere.

data.projectName: Conversion of 2-stroke petrol-driven rickshaws into solar-electric hybrid vehicle
data.piUniversity: Sir Syed University of Engg. & Technology, Karachi
data.projectDigest:
Auto rickshaws are popular mode of travelling in cities across Pakistan and are found in almost every city and town. Due to several issues, especially the level of pollution contributed by two-stroke rickshaws, four-stroke CNG rickshaws are supposed to replace them. Four-stroke CNG rickshaws are less noisy, form less pollutants, bigger and more comfortable than the two-stroke rickshaws. However, CNG rickshaws rely on fossil fuels like natural gas, LPG and petrol. Also, they are costlier, poor in quality and have shorter life span (typically 3 to 5 years) as compared with old two-stroke rickshaws (two-stroke rickshaws as old as 50 years can be seen on the roads of Karachi). Even Provincial Government has tried several times to phase out these old rickshaws and officially they have been banned by the Government since 2012, but the owners of old two-stroke rickshaws are not ready to change their rickshaws due to longer life span and low maintenance cost. Around 60,000 two-stroke rickshaws are still running on the road of Sindh without registration, number plate, route permit and payment of taxes. Furthermore, there is shortage of CNG in Pakistan and petrol prices are increasing day by day. Due to these issues, new solutions are being sought. One of the solutions is to convert two-stroke rickshaws into electric or battery operated rickshaws and they can work as electric vehicles (EVs). These converted rickshaws will enjoy benefits inherited by EVs and longer life span. In addition, they can also be equipped with solar panels on their rooftop to charge batteries to make solar-electric hybrid (SOLECT) rickshaws. The use of solar system would make the converted vehicle more environmental friendly and attractive to general public.  They will be environmental friendly, less noisy, easy to operate & maintain and will not use fossil fuels. 
It is worth mentioning here that the scope of this project proposal would not only be limited to the conversion of two-stroke rickshaws, but it expected to bring a breakthrough in newly emerging field of EV manufacturing in Pakistan by strengthening the existing businesses and by providing opportunities for new businesses. Also, it would provide source of income for thousands of families throughout Pakistan.

data.projectName: A novel approach for rapid field detection of plant parasitic nematodes
data.projectDigest:
The growing demand for food with limited available land necessitates that the yield of major crops continues to increase over time. Advances in molecular marker technology, predictive statistics, control over parasitic entity and breeding methodology have allowed for continued increases in crop performance through genetic improvement (Gerald et al., 2013). Plant parasitic nematodes are traditionally detected by a slow and time-consuming process. This typically involves collecting soil samples, extracting the nematodes via an elutriator and identifying the nematodes by visual observation under a microscope. Furthermore, this slow and expensive process requires personnel to have advanced nematology training to identify nematodes based upon morphological features. The conventional approach alone does not justify the availability of new cultivars in shortest span (Cattivelli et al., 2008). Though conventional mode of identification of nematodes is in practice, however, the progress is too slow. Meanwhile, selection based on its component characters could be more efficient and reliable if the knowledge of genes associated with pathogenic effect is known (Muhammad et al., 2003). Transgenic and “omics” technologies promise to make progress through a more fundamental understanding of underlying mechanisms of parasitic inheritance and identifying potential candidate genes (Khan et al., 2013). (Tuberosa, Salvi, 2006). In the field, immediate detection of nematodes will be made possible by the success of the proposed project titled “A novel approach for rapid field detection of plant parasitic nematodes”. Growers would then be able to map their farms with nematode infestations and plant seed genotypes appropriate to their fields. The proposed idea is absolutely novel. No such work has yet been initiated. Furthermore, No such patent has yet been filed / claimed related to the proposed idea
The proposal’s main objective is to make possible early and immediate detection of nematodes in the field. Growers would then be able to map their farms for nematode infestations and utilize genotypes appropriate for their fields. 
The major objectives of this project are:
1. Determination of the best marker protein to identify and quantify cyst nematode in soils.
2. Generate peptide based antibodies to the selected marker protein.
3. Develop a sensitive, simple and cost effective test kit for the CN assay.
4. To develop process for patenting as joint venture with Crop Max Pesticides and University of Swabi.

data.projectName: Designing Novel topologies of 18 and 24 Pulse Autotransformer Rectifier Units (ATRUs) for Aircrafts
data.projectDigest:
Autotransformer Rectifier Units (ATRUs) are considered to be one of the most important integral parts of the Aircrafts Electrical Power Systems. They provide power to the high powered electrical motors, pumps and actuators which are used for various functions in Aircrafts. Having fewer number of elements involved in the rectification system, these power converters are reliable, small weight and volume along with the higher power quality. The main element of the rectification system is the autotransformer which converts the input three phase system into multiple phases like 6, 9, 12, 15 phases and so on thus improving the power quality at the input and output of the system. 
In order to improve the power quality and reduce the system size, there is a need to propose such an autotransformer topology which offers all these qualities at the same time. Two commonly used high-pulse rectification systems (18-pulse and 24-pulse) would be studied and a new topology would be designed to offer higher power quality rectification systems with reduced system sizes and weighs. These rectification systems would be tested and analyzed for incorporation with the modern requirements of Aircrafts Electrical Power Systems.

data.projectName: A3MR for reclamation of denim mills’ wastewater for reuse purpose
data.piUniversity: Mehran University of Engineering & Technology, Jamshoro
data.projectDigest: A unique configuration of a membrane bioreactor is proposed (A3MBR) to treat denim mills' indigo dye effluent, before mixing with other effluent streams. The primary objectives of this proposal are as follows. Objective-1: to select a high-performance, low-cost membrane material, Objective-2: to design pilot-scale A3MBR, pre-and post-treatment system, Objective-3: to reclaim indigo dye wastewater using A3MBR system, and Objective-4: to develop a business strategy the A3MBR in industrial sectors. Comparison of different designs of the A3MBR will be performed using computer models. A feasible pilot-scale treatment train will be installed and operated. The successful installation of the pilot-scale A3MBR will attracted at least two more large-scale project for A3MBR installations. The expected revenue during the will be around 10-15 million PKR per year during first three years and at least 5 projects will be materializing within 5 years of post-TTSF period, contributing to the revenue of 20-25 million PKR for new installations. Another source of revenue will be from consulting for maintenance of already installed A3MBRs. It is expected that after 2 years of Post-TTSF, the consortium will be financially viable and profitable.

data.projectName: Design a optimum depth of moistube irrigation technology under warming climate for Wheat (Triticum aestivum) crop
data.piUniversity: Muhammad Nawaz Shareef University of Agriculture, Multan
data.projectDigest: Agricultural productivity in arid and semi-arid areas is highly affected by the water scarcity issue which is considered to be a major factor for achieving production targets. However, there are certain challenges in the way of installation and maintenance of moistube such as the selection of depth and spacing of drip lines, salt buildup, damage by rodents, clogging and crop germination and establishment. Some of the above-mentioned issues were resolved by a new technology known as “Moistube irrigation (MTI)” which was developed in China using nanotechnology. In this project, we will develop locally to make more economically for farmers community instead of import. The pipes used in new technology are made of flexible semipermeable instead of using micro-porous. However, the performance of MTI on wheat crop under different climatic conditions has not been investigated in Pakistan. But MTI can be designed for local environmental conditions by the collective partnership of academic institutes and industries. This can be done by field and laboratory experiments and numerical modeling. For this purpose, an industrial partner (Ali Akbar Group) will commercialize the MTI system and will also promote its awareness among the farming community.

data.projectName: Development of a climate aware dynamic tool for the prediction & mitigation of solar power soiling losses using the air-quality data & weather forecasts
data.piUniversity: Lahore University of Management Sciences (LUMS), Lahore
data.projectDigest: We propose to develop a market-ready modeling tool for a precise estimation of PV soiling loss using air-quality and weather data that promises to solve the key challenges related to solar power losses due to aerosol dust (soiling). A preliminary form of the model has been recently developed in the research group led by the principle investigator. The physical model has been initially validated through electrical measurements on a roof-top PV testbed installed at the PI’s institute. Here, we propose to further develop and ramp up this preliminary model into a commercial tool in close collaboration with local solar PV industry. The partnership with the industry will enable a widescale validation and associated calibrations into the model using the field data across a large network of PV sites located at a variety of locations/climates within the country.  The tool will have two distinct socio-economic contributions: (i) It will provide a country-wide soiling map for the typical soiling loss factors across all provinces in Pakistan. This map will be a valuable resource during the design & planning phase of new PV plants, and (ii) It will dynamically predict optimal cleaning schedules for a given PV location. This will be valuable during the operational phase of the plant. The end users of the proposed tool will be PV designers, solar investors, public policy makers, solar service providers, private solar system owners & independent power producers (IPPs).

data.projectName: Virtual Reality and Augmented Reality based Serios Games for Rehabilitation of Special Needs Children
data.projectDigest: Virtual Reality and Augmented Reality are a visual technology that combines virtual objects into the real environment in real time.  The use of Virtual Reality (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR) in in various different domains for learning and training purpose is gaining huge momentum. In this research work, the problem of teaching and educating the Special needs children; that possess a certain mental disorder like Dyslexia and Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), is addressed using Virtual Reality and Augmented Reality techniques. A heuristic cognitive model of multimedia learning would be developed based on Virtual Reality and Separate model for Augmented Reality applications. Dyslexia and Autism are a complex mental brain related syndrome, effecting the children in various ways including verbal and nonverbal communications, social interactions, understanding instructions, reading, writing, learning, problems, etc. The use of interactive VR and AR based multimedia application to facilitate and provide a pedagogy for such type of special children would ascertain a unique and new dimension of treating and helping such young hearts in overcoming their disabilities in a very fun and easy way.  The research encompasses designing a framework based on Cognitive Theory of Multimedia Learning (CTML) for interactive VR and AR learning applications, that would be facilitate the special needs children to learn interactively and gain understanding of hard to learn concepts due to their disability.

data.projectName: Designing and Development of a Smart Device to Prevent the Vehicle Accident and Provision of Technical Fault and Black Box information via Android App
data.piUniversity: University of Azad Jammu & Kashmir, Muzaffarabad, Azad Kashmir, Muzaffarabad
data.projectDigest:
In 21st century, there is such a huge innovation in vehicle industries.  The “electric car” is one of the best examples which is totally automated.  As number of vehicles increases the accident rate also increases.  We highly focus to use robotic technology in vehicles which helps the driver during driving in different scenarios. The main aim is the vehicle itself is able of making decisions if driver forget anything during driving. We focus that what are the precautionary measurements to avoid from any accident. Also, what vehicle will take decisions if accident, fire, robbery, or any other mishap detected.
Functionality: So, we are making a solution for any mishap with vehicle and driver. We proposed a device named as Smart Accident Avoidance and Automated Android Based Messaging System. The functionality of device is, during driving the overall status of vehicle i.e. Temperature, Distance of objects from the vehicle, Smoke/Gasses if detected, Alcohol if detected, Battery condition, Machinery fault, Speed, Location, stores all readings in black box and some important readings shown on LCD placed on dashboard of vehicle. With these readings we also store camera video of driver moments during driving. We also assemble a fingerprint sensor for unlocking and ignition and connected with android app. There we will also use some blinking LEDs and buzzer tone if danger ahead is very close. 
After all these futures, if any chance of accident occur by the mistake of others, any robbery or harassment mishap detected, the vehicle itself collects last readings of sensors and send via SMS to Road emergency department as well as driver’s home.

data.projectName: Can plant-derived smoke induce chloroplast activity under stress conditions?
data.piUniversity: Kohat University of Science and Technology, Kohat
data.projectDigest: Plants being sessile encounter various abiotic stresses such as drought, salinity, heat or UV stress. The survival of plants against these environmental stresses depends on their intrinsic ability to recognize stress stimuli and adapt to such stresses. Chloroplasts are cellular organelles that can sense diverse environmental stimuli and alter gene expression to cope with adverse environmental stresses. Chloroplast gene expression is mainly regulated at posttranscriptional levels, including RNA processing, intron splicing, RNA editing and RNA turn over, which is important for the responses of plant to abiotic stresses. Plant-derived smoke solution has been investigated as an emerging plant product playing significant roles in enhancing seed germination and seedling growth. To understand whether plant-derived smoke can enhance chloroplast activity under stress conditions is very important and unknown so far. Therefore, the proposed project is designed to understand the importance of plant-derived smoke in regulating chloroplast activity under stress conditions.

data.projectName: Advancement of early stage developed NDV vaccine candidate in corn into a viable commercial product
data.projectDigest:
The proposed research describes applied research including filed patent, IBC (institutional Biosafety Committee), TAC (Technical Advisory Committee) approved Fusion (F) and Hemagglutinin Neuraminidase (HN) protein gene for production of plant-based vaccine against Newcastle disease virus (NDV). The fundamental justification of the proposal is the Pakistan demand for poultry vaccines which cost about Rs. 6 billion /annum. Pakistan’s poultry sector faces the loss of almost Rs 10 billion PKR due to the outbreak of Newcastle disease in the country. Currently, traditional such as live and killed vaccines are commonly used to control Newcastle disease virus, which cannot cope with outbreak challenges of NDV due to antigenic variations. Moreover, these vaccines always need a low temperature storage that is also major limiting factors of these vaccines. 
The current study aims to strengthen the indigenously developed  plant-based edible vaccines against NDV in collaboration with poultry industry by I) production of hybrid maize by using inbred lines of maize expressing F and HN gene protein against NDV, ii) In house testing of F and HN gene expression, diet assay and study of cell mediated immune response of chicks against NDV followed by its approval as protective measure against NDV through official procedures, III) Seed production and commercialization of hybrid maize providing solution against  NDV. CEMB has already developed inbred lines of maize expressing F and HN gene protein against NDV and tested at laboratory scale. The developed technology is under the process of NBC (National Biosafety Committee) approval for field trials in collaboration with University of Veterinary Sciences Lahore (UVAS). The funds are required for proposed objectives and to commercialize the technology at cost effective price. 
The current technology has been filed for patent after attaining fruitful results at laboratory scale. The developed technology will be advantageous over current mismatched NDV vaccine against the circulating strain. The developed technology will be most efficient against the recent circulating strain of NDV. This proposed project will be bridge between academia and poultry industry for improvement of farmers livelihood. 
In Pakistan, commercial farms are always vaccinated against viral diseases as compared to the domestic Poultry. The breeders of the poultry farms normally rely on imported vaccines to avoid vertical transmission of virus.  The industrial partner will perform field trials on large scale. The industrial partner will utilize the developed technology in comparison with the imported vaccine. The developed vaccine will be assessed by the industrial partners regarding determination of its efficacy as protective antibodies against NDV titer. The industrial partner will help to aware the flock’s breeder regarding use of developed edible vaccine. He will arrange meetings with farmers to familiarize the use of indigenously developed plant-based vaccine against NDV. The industrial partner will help to commercialize the developed technology.

data.projectName: Miniaturization and Productization of GNSS Interference/Jamming Mitigation system for Aerial/Land Based Platforms of Strategic Importance
data.piUniversity: Lahore University of Management Sciences (LUMS), Lahore
data.projectDigest:
There are numerous jamming threats to conventional GNSS receivers incorporated in aircrafts and GNSS-guided aerial platforms. Embargo can be imposed any time on such systems. Moreover, sometimes a system with certain specifications is not available for sale from other countries. Therefore, it is inevitable to achieve self-reliance in such critical technologies of national importance. 
The proposed project aims to miniaturize and productize an “Anti-Jamming Global Navigation System”, which has already been developed by PI through funding (Rs 14.25 Million) provided by the strategic organization (our industry partner for this project).  The developed system has been tested in the lab and open air environment and meets the requirement of the sponsoring agency up to greater extent. Three versions of the system have been developed and tested. The industry partner for this project is the end user and will provide funding of around Rs 9 Million to design the chips, get them fabricated, package them and procure other consumable items for the project. Moreover, the industry partner will also provide support for antenna radiation pattern measurements and qualification of the product.

data.projectName: Integrated Indigenously Developed Networked Hospital Robot for Infectious disease Scenarios
data.projectDigest: There is a relatively high probability of doctors and medical staff being infected by infectious diseases such as COVID-19 while interacting with the patients. In order to reduce the interaction of medical personals with infectious disease patients, there is a need to develop a semi-automated robotic system that should have capabilities like hospital waste management, food/ medicine delivery, record, and feedback the patient's medical data, and spray the disinfectant. The project aims to develop the robot locally in collaboration with local industrial and academic partners and would contribute positively to the country's economy in terms of reducing the medical equipment-related import cost and would play a key role in saving precious lives of medical personals.

data.projectName: Intermittent Steam-powered energy generation using domestic water geysers
data.piUniversity: National University of Sciences & Technology, Rawalpindi/Islamabad (NUST)
data.projectDigest: The project proposes a very simple idea of generating steam using domestic water geysers and then driving a low-pressure steam turbine to generate electricity on an intermittent basis. In case when there is a commercial power shutdown, the electric power produced by the turbine is utilized to trickle charge the UPS battery. Hence, the proposed assembly can keep the UPS running for a much longer period of time than a normal UPS without this assembly. In case when there is no commercial power shutdown, it is utilized to trickle charge a shunt power capacitor. When the capacitor is fully charged, the stored charge is converted to 220 V via a step-up voltage transformer and finally merges with the main commercial power supply thus saving the monthly electricity bill to a certain extent. Hence, the most important parameter of the proposed design includes the pressure of the steam generated which will decide how fast the UPS or the capacitor can be charged and to what extent can it be used to fulfill domestic electrical needs in times of power shut downs and save electricity bill when there is no shutdown.

data.projectName: Electric Rickshaw
data.projectDigest:
E-Rickshaw is a smart electric rickshaw. It is a flexible, non-polluting, and affordable means designed to fulfil the need for the transport industry. According to Pakistan’s NEVP (National Electric Vehicle Policy) sales of electric vehicles will increase by 30% by 2030 and in 2040 sales will increase up to 90%. Unlike conventional rickshaw that uses gasoline or diesel-powered engine, electric rikshaw consists of an electric motor that is powered by the electricity from the batteries and also from the electricity produced from solar panels. Today Rickshaw has become one of the most preferred modes of transportation in major urban cities in Asia and especially in Pakistan. With the innovation of E-Rickshaw, it will revolutionize the way we transport. data.projectName: Telliscope
data.projectDigest:
Due to multitude of threats emerging like terrorism, crimes and lately evolved viruses, societies around the world are employing technologies to keep a close lookout for the threats. This proposed project of intelligent scope, hence the name Telliscope, is an effort along the same lines to provide a low-cost surveillance as well as health check system at the entrance of various locations such as malls, hospitals etc. The university’s respective personnel are already well versed with camera hardware, face/image recognition, sensors data interpretation etc. We propose to combine this knowledge in one ambitious tool that can scan and identify potential entrants of any premises. The tool will be able to scan the temperature and whether the entrant is wearing a mask or not depending upon the initial settings of the system. At present a few high-tech comparable solutions exist in the international market but are prohibitively expensive. We aim to bring this technology at affordable to rate to Pakistani market.
The potential customers and commercial applications of such a system are endless. Physical access control to premises is a real issue, to tackle which, in Pakistan multiple guards are required. The situation is even more complicated in the on-going scenario of a pandemic, where wearing masks is mandatory. However human guards have little authority and are not apt at eliciting compliance. Then there is the issue of terrorism and criminal activity. This product will be able to enforce the pre-requisite of entrance like wearing masks and temperature. It will also use the facial recognition to determine the identity of person of interest.  
To undertake this endeavor, the team involved will have to design the hardware which will include appropriate camera, Thermal sensors, LCD screen, and automatic sanitizer (optional).  The team will also have to undertake the program development for the hardware to work and integration. The system will be developed by the joint effort if university’s team and sectoral partner. However sectoral partner will undertake the efforts related to marketing and commercialization of the product.  The team that forms the sectoral partner’s organization have years of experience in marketing of different commodities and have the knowhow and in-depth knowledge to undertake the endeavor to market such a product.

data.projectName: Facilitating SMEs in improving service quality through Consumers Opinion Analysis
data.projectDigest:
In this document, the proposed project is based on sentiment analysis which is one of the most radical techniques related to Artificial Intelligence (AI). It is the use of lexical or machine learning techniques to automatically determine the semantic orientation of a given text, sentence or document. With the growing use of social media and a huge chunk of data available on the internet, it has become exceedingly difficult to manually analyze and extract meaningful information, such as sentiment polarity out of it. Sentiment polarity extraction is being commonly used nowadays for financial market analysis, planning tours, customer reviews analysis, opinion analysis during elections, and hate speech detection. Based on this futuristic technique, we are proposing a web-based multilingual (English, Urdu, Roman Urdu) spatiotemporal platform for aspect-based sentiment analysis of customer’s reviews related to different food chains.  The potential customer of the end product will be the food chains, and it will allow them to get a visual representation of people’s sentiments over different demographics; or sentiments regarding various aspects of their products e.g. ambience, quality, pricing etc. Similarly, this framework will also help them in comparing the performance of their brand with their competitors. Moreover, this framework will also allow them to analyze the people’s sentiments (regarding their products) overtime, thus, allowing them to increase their Marketing Return on Investment (MROI). Finally, this framework will also display the word cloud of commonly used words in positive and negative polarity bearing comments, hence, the companies will be able to analyze the frequent words in order to address the concerns of the people thereby, improving their Public Relations (PR). This product will have a very positive effect on the food industry.  It will help the food chains in identifying and working on their weak areas, thus, improving the customer’s experience. Moreover, it will also help the food authorities to narrow down the restaurants which are in violation of the SOPs; or health and safety codes. Additionally, the proposed web-based platform will be adaptable for any Small Medium Enterprise (SME) by doing some minor changes in the functionality, thereby, facilitating SMEs in general for improving Quality of Service (QoS) through consumers opinion analysis.  
The development of this product will require a comprehensive R&D. We will kick-off by preparing a high-level design document. After that, we will work on data collection and data annotation. With the available dataset, we will perform experimentation for classifier training. The data collection, annotation and model training will be an iterative process which will continue until the end of the project. Finally, we will allocate our resources for the framework development in accordance with the functionalities specified in the design document.  
After achieving the tentative objectives; system deployment and testing, our partner from the software house will help us in the commercialization of this project.

data.projectName: Mobile App Control Switchable Smart Thin PDLC Film Technology
data.piUniversity: Balochistan University of Information Technology, Engineering and Management Sciences (BUITEMS), Muslim Bagh Subcampus, Qilla-saifullah.
data.projectDigest:
The purpose of this research study will increase the Eco friendly thin film based smart glass panel technology with Electro-optical (E-O) contrast of polymer dispersed liquid crystal (PDLC) films display by applying class ?-longitudinal thermo tropic nematic liquid crystals (NLCs) linear chain polymer mixtures. The NLCs will be selected due to its Characteristics for the thin films such as strong binding, optical clarity, strong adhesion, toughness, and ?exibility. We will calibrate the cell thickness, optimum drive and contrast ratio, pre-tilt angle, response time, morphology, the view angle of the Mobile app control switchable smart thin pdlc film technology. Within this we will study, the electro clinic effect in NLCs with an even director is not an essential condition in the presence of a warped director. Furthermore, we will study the wavelength with reflectance and absorption rate, refractive index, and polymerization process with the help of UV-VIS-NIR spectrophotometer, and Abbe Refractometer respectively.
	The goal of this work is to launch the Mobile app control switchable smart thin pdlc film technology with various epoxy resin monomers / harder/ catalyst / NLCs system in the smart glass thin films. Furthermore, in this study, we will use first time the Tetraethylenepentamine (TEPA) (hardener) in epoxy curing with poly functional epoxy resins feed percentage on the characteristics of thin films will be highlighted. The influence of multiple monomers will exam, by observing the morphology, E-O characterization, point parting, and phase transition temperature (TNI) of smart thin film glass technology.
These Mobile app control switchable smart thin pdlc film technology studies will explain novel insights in business applications of bright glass films, Opto-electrical applications, for instance micro lenses, reflective displays, multi-color displays, and biosensors. Concurrently, these results lengthen the possible applications of epoxy resins smart glass technology films by choosing accurate compositions ratio, heating time, and catalyst reaction used for fabrications of smart films.
The outcomes of this study will show important rewards for industrial technology especially, in glass Industry. PDLC films and develop the PDLC market, especially in the glass industry in our country. Electro-optical (E-O) characteristics of smart glass make them impeccable for numerous applications in various areas, for example, elastic smart glass displays, switchable frames, vegetal orchard and additional technological display instruments. In addition, this project will lead to the building of transferring and introducing the new technology in Glass as well as Polymer industry in Pakistan.

data.projectName: iCare: Smart telemedicine system by providing Cloud-based AI Solution to improve health system in Pakistan
data.projectDigest: In Pakistan, a country where 80 percent of the poor live in rural areas, most of the people in rural areas do not have access to healthcare facilities. The doctor to patient ratio in Pakistan is 1 doctor to 1000 patients and Pakistan ranks 149th out of 188 countries, in the United Nations Sustainable Goals Index, in terms of Health Care. The consequences of reducing healthcare facilities can increase a significant workload on hospitals. However, these consequences can be greatly improved by developing smart gadgets that can reduce the hospitals workload and also improve the quality of life of the general public. There has been a spike in telemedicine services since the covid-19 pandemic started. Many private and public healthcare providers have started their telehealth services, however, the limitations of the digital landscape of Pakistan pose challenges to the growth of the telehealth sector. The most important factor in developing such an application includes sensor fusion which can be from various biosensors. Therefore, it is essential that the decision making from sensory data should be reliable and accurate within acceptable accuracy [5]. Therefore, in this proposal a new telemedicine system has been proposed which will develop a sensor fusion model for effective prediction and analysis of user health. iCare will save many lives by providing prior information about any disease that can prove fatal if diagnosed late. This data will also be valuable for doctors for studying the effect of any new medication on patient’s health and to generate emergency alert notifications.

data.projectName: IoT enabled Hydroponics technology transfer for ensuring food safety and security in Pakistan
data.piUniversity: Pir Mehr Ali Shah Arid Agriculture, University Rawalpindi
data.projectDigest: Current agriculture advancement is being challenged with sustainable food production and security in a demographically obese world. Climate change is another major challenge that contemporary farming practice tries to overcome. Conventional soil dependent farming practices make farmers vulnerable to various manifestations of climate change. Different technologies have been employed to enable farming practices to adapt and build resilience against irregular microclimate shifts. It is imperative that modern farmers need to be equipped with precise management and monitoring of the crop system with access to the scientific data about the field environment to execute intelligent and informed decisions in time. Alternate farming technology like hydroponic culture technique and integration of smart IoT system are deemed promising solutions to the afore-mentioned problems. In this proposal, we aim to develop a smart hydroponic system with technology enabled by IoT system to culture plants hydroponically under various treatments considering measurement and characterization of morphological parameters. This system aims to provide the ideal environment for plants to grow, a system where pH, water level, air temperature and relative humidity are constantly monitored. Additionally, with the use of simple mechanisms, this system provides controlled irrigation of water, and nutrient solution intake. Through the data gathered by the sensors and the use of cloud-based technology as the backend, information is stored, managed, applied and shared via internet by users. Management of resources in a hydroponics set-up would become easier and more efficient based on the success and results of this study.

data.projectName: Development of a Plug and Play IoT based Cradle for Swappable Batteries in Electric Two Wheelers
data.piUniversity: Lahore University of Management Sciences (LUMS), Lahore
data.projectDigest: We propose development of an IoT-based ‘smart cradle’ that will house the swappable batteries in the 2-wheelers. It firmly holds the batteries, provides cushion against all possible shocks and jerks during the ride, act as a vital buffer against various weather conditions that may impact the performance of the battery and provide a channel for communication between the battery and the vehicle. The data from the sensors connected to the battery through the abovementioned housing apparatus will provide riders with important information regarding health of the battery and state of its charge among many other valuable insights. Similarly, data pertaining to health of the battery, its state of charge and the GPS coordinates of the vehicle containing to battery will be relayed to the battery rental service providers to smartly manage the charging infrastructure value chain. The proposed hardware will thus allow development of a comprehensive hardware that will enable swappable batteries to be housed and smartly managed in the in 2-wheelers. Also, the proposed hardware will allow retro-fitting of existing fossil fuel-based 2-wheelers with swappable batteries enabling fast-track EV adoption.

data.projectName: Application of Sustainable Construction Materials and Products to the Housing Sector of Pakistan
data.projectDigest: The biggest challenge to the construction industry of Pakistan is not changing the - traditions,  materials, latest technologies already developed and not using the results of current research work - in the field of housing and construction sector. The reasons behind it include- lack of university-industry linkage, lack of confidence on new developments, lack of latest technology availability, and mainly lack of research under local conditions for local available materials. A lot of effort is required to cope up with this challenge, starting with the development of innovative materials products comprised of locally available materials, carrying out all the required physical and mechanical properties as required by international standard, then taking up the challenge of developing the material at commercial level. The idea does not end here, rather the developed product should be implied in real structural models. Once all the tests satisfy then the management for production at larger scale can be initiated. These are the motivations of our research. We will utilize waste materials, design the mix, develop the low-cost building products incorporating new material and construction methods, will test these products, upscale at industrial level and then apply these in housing/building sector of Pakistan.
